Seyag lachachma shetika lefichach lo yemaher lehashiv velo yarbe ledabber vilammed lattalmidim beshuva vanachat belo tzeaka uvlo arichut lashon hu sheamar shelomo divre chachamim benachat nishmaim

Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 3: Shemma yomar adam hoil vehakkina vehattaava vehakkavod vechayyotze bahem derech raa hen umotziin et haadam min haolam efrosh mehen beoter veetrachek latztzad haacharon ad shello yochal basar velo yishte yayin velo yissa ishsha velo yeshev bedira naa velo yilbash malbush nae ella hassak vehatztzemer hakkashe vechayyotze bahen kegon kohane haovde kochavim gam ze derech raa hi veasur lelech bah hamhallech bederech zo nikra chote shehare hu omer benazir vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh amru chachamim uma im nazir shello perash ella min hayyayin tzarich kappara hammonea atzmo mikkal davar vedavar al achat kamma vechamma lefichach tziuu chachamim shello yimna adam atzmo ella middevarim shemmenato hattora bilvad velo yehe oser atzmo bindarim uvishvuot al devarim hammuttarim kach amru chachamim lo dayyecha ma sheasra tora ella sheatta oser alecha devarim acherim uvakkelal hazze ellu shemmitannin tamid enan bederech tova veasru chachamim sheyehe adam mesaggef atzmo betaanit veal kal haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen tziva shelomo veamar al tehi tzaddik harbe veal titchakkam yoter lamma tishshomem

Kal hammanhig atzmo bidrachim ellu shehorinu ani arev lo sheeno ba lide choli kal yamav ad sheyyazkin harbe veyamut veeno tzarich lerofe veyihye gufo shalem veomed al buro kal yamav ella im ken haya gufo ra mittechillat beriyyato o im haya ragil beminhag min hamminhagot haraim mittechillat moladto o im tavo makkat dever o makkat batztzoret laolam

Kal makom sheen bo rofe echad habbari veechad hachole en rauy lo lazuz mikkal hadderachim haellu shenneemru beferek ze shekkal echad mehen leacharit tova mevi

Kal ir sheen bah asara devarim haellu en talmid chacham rashshay ladur betochah veellu hen rofe veumman uvet hammerchatz uvet hakkisse umayim metzuyin kegon nahar umayan uvet hakkeneset umlammed tinokot velavlar vegabbay tzedaka uvet din makkim vechovshim
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 5: Keshem shehechacham nikkar bechachmato uvdeotav vehu muvdal bahem mishshear haam kach tzarich sheyyihye nikkar bemaasav bemaachalo uvmashkehu uvivilato uvaasiyyat tzerachav uvdibburo uvhillucho uvmalbusho uvchilkul devarav uvmassao uvmattano veyihu kal hammaasim haellu naim umtukkanim beoter ketzad talmid chacham lo yihye gargeran ella ochel maachal harauy lehavrot gufo velo yochal mimmennu achila gassa velo yehe rodef lemalleot bitno keellu shemmitmallein mimmaachal umishte ad shettippach keresam vaalehem meforash bakkabbala vezeriti feresh al penechem amru chachamim ellu bene adam sheochlin veshotin veosin kal yemehem kechaggim vehem haomrim achol veshato ki machar namut vezehu maachal harshaim veshulchanot ellu hem shegginna hakkatuv veamar ki kal shulchanot malu ki tzoa beli makom aval hechacham eno ochel ella tavshil echad o shenayim veochel mimmennu kede chayyav veddayyo hu sheamar shelomo tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho

Keshehechacham ochel meat ze harauy lo lo yochlennu ella beveto al shulchano velo yochal bachanut velo bashshuk ella mippene tzorech gadol kede shello yitganne bifne habberiyyot velo yochal etzel amme haaretz velo al otan hashshulchanot hammeleim ki tzoa velo yarbe seuddotav bechal makom vaafillu im hachachamim velo yochal bisuddot sheyyesh bahen kibbutz harbe veen rauy lo leechol ella bisudda shel mitzva bilvad kegon seuddat erusin venissuin vehu sheyyihye talmid chacham shennasa bat talmid chacham vehatztzaddikim vehachasidim harishonim lo achlu misseudda sheenah shellahen

Keshehechacham shote yayin eno shote ella kede lishrot achila shebbemeav vechal hammishtakker hare ze chote umgunne umafsid chachmato veim nishtakker bifne amme haaretz hare ze chillel et hashshem veasur lishtot yayin batztzahorayim vaafillu meat ella im haya bichlal haachila shehashshetiyya shehi bichlal haachila enah meshakkeret veen nizharin ella miyyayin shelleachar hammazon

Af al pi sheishto shel adam mutteret lo tamid rauy lo letalmid chacham sheyyanhig atzmo bikdushsha velo yehe matzuy etzel ishto ketarnegol ella millele shabbat lelele shabbat im yesh bo koach uchshehu mesapper immah lo yesapper bitchillat hallayela keshehu savea uvitno male velo besof hallayela keshehu raev ella beemtza hallayela kesheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav velo yakel berosho beoter velo yenabbel et piv bedivre havay vaafillu beno levenah hare hu omer bekabbala maggid leadam ma secho amru chachamim afillu sicha kalla shebben adam leishto atid litten aleha et haddin velo yihu shenehem lo shikkorim velo atzlanim velo atzbanim velo echad mehen velo tihye yeshena velo yeenos otah vehi enah rotza ella birtzon shenehem uvsimchatam yesapper veyischak meat immah kede shettityashshev nafshah veyivol bevusha velo beazzut veyifrosh miyyad

Kal hannoheg minhag ze lo day lo shekkiddesh nafsho vetiher atzmo vetikken deotav ella sheim hau lo banim yihu naim uvayeshanim reuyin lechachma velachasidut vechal hannoheg beminhagot shear haam haholchim bachoshech yihu lo banim kemo otam haam

Tzeniut gedola nohagim talmide chachamim beatzman lo yitbazzu velo yitgallu roshan velo gufan vaafillu beshaa sheyyikkanes levet hakkisse yehe tzanua velo yegalle begadav ad sheyyeshev velo yekanneach beyamin veyitrachek mikkal adam veyikkanes cheder lifnim mecheder meara lifnim min hammeara venifne veim nifne achore haggader yitrachek kede shello yishma chavero kolo im nitattesh veim nifne bevika yarchik kede shello yire chavero peruo velo yedabber keshehu nifne afillu letzorech gadol uchderech shennoheg tzeniut bayyom bevet hakkisse kach noheg ballayela ulolam yelammed adam atzmo lehippanot shacharit vearvit bilvad kede shello yitrachek

Talmid chacham lo yehe tzoek vetzoveach bishat dibburo kivhemot vechayyot velo yagbiha kolo beoter ella dibburo benachat im kal habberiyyot uchsheyedabber benachat yizzaher shello yitrachek ad sheyyerae kedivre gasse haruach umakdim shalom lechal haadam kede shettehe ruchan nocha hemennu vedan et kal haadam lechaf zechut mesapper beshevach chavero velo bignuto kelal ohev shalom verodef shalom im roe sheddevarav moilim venishmaim omer veim lav shotek ketzad lo yeratztze chavero bishat kaaso velo yishal lo al nidro beshaa shennadar ad shettitkarer dato veyanuach velo yenachamennu beshaa shemmeto muttal lefanav mippene shehu bahul ad sheyyikberehu vechen kal kayyotze beellu velo yire lachavero bishat kalkalato ella yaalim enav mimmennu velo yeshanne bedibburo velo yosif velo yigra ella bedivre shalom vechayyotze bahen kelalo shel davar eno medabber ella bedivre chachma o bigmilut chasadim vechayyotze bahen velo yesapper im ishsha bashshuk vaafillu hi ishto o achoto o bitto

Lo yelech talmid chacham bekoma zekufa vegaron natuy kainyan shenneemar vattelachna netuot garon umsakkerot enayim velo yehallech akev betzad gudal benachat kemo hannashim vegasse haruach kainyan shenneemar haloch vetafof telachna uvraglehem teakkasna velo yarutz birshut harabbim keminhag meshuggaim velo yichpof komato kevaale chatoteret ella mistakkel lematta kemo shehu omed bitfilla umhallech bashshuk keadam shehu tarud baasakav gam mimmahalacho shel adam nikkar im chacham uvaal dea hu o shote vesachal vechen amar shelomo bechachmato vegam badderech keshessachal holech libbo chaser veamar lakkol sachal hu hu modia lakkol al atzmo shehu sachal

Malbush talmid chacham malbush nae venaki veasur lo sheyyimmatze bevigdo ketem o shamnunit vechayyotze bahen velo yilbash lo malbush melachim kegon bigde zahav veargaman shehakkol mistakkelin bahen velo malbush aniyyim shehu mevazze et lovshav ella begadim benonim naim velo yehe besaro nire mittachat maddav kemo bigde happishtan hakkallim beoter sheosim bemitzrayim velo yihu begadav sechuvin al haaretz kemo bigde gasse haruach ella ad akevo uvet yad shello ad rashe etzbeotav velo yeshalshel tallito mippene shennire kegassut haruach ella beshabbat bilvad im en lo lehachalif velo yinal minalim metullaim telay al gabbe telay bimot hachamma aval bimot haggeshamim muttar im haya ani lo yetze mevussam lashshuk velo bivgadim mevussamim velo yasim boshom bisaro aval im mashach besaro bevoshom kede lehaavir et hazzuhama muttar vechen lo yetze yechidi ballayela ella im ken haya lo zeman kavua latzet bo letalmudo kal ellu mippene hachashad

Talmid chacham mechalkel devarav bemishpat ochel veshote vezan et anshe beto kefi mamono vehatzlachato velo yatriach al atzmo yoter midday tziuu chachamim bederech eretz shello yochal adam basar ella leteavon shenneemar ki teave nafshecha leechol basar dayyo labbari leechol basar meerev shabbat leerev shabbat veim haya ashir kede leechol basar bechal yom ochel tziuu chachamim veamru leolam yochal adam pachot min harauy lo lefi mamono veyilbash karauy lo vichabbed ishto uvanav yoter min harauy lo

Derech baale dea sheyyikba lo adam melacha hamfarneset oto techilla veachar kach yikne bet dira veachar kach yissa ishsha shenneemar mi haish asher nata kerem velo chillelo mi haish asher bana vayit chadash velo chanacho mi haish asher eras ishsha velo lekachah aval hattippeshin matchilin lissa ishsha veachar kach im timtza yado yikne bayit veachar kach besof yamav yechazzer levakkesh ummanut o yitparnes min hatztzedaka vechen hu omer bakkelalot ishsha teares bayit tivne kerem titta kelomar yihu maasecha hafuchin kede shello tatzliach et derachecha uvabberacha hu omer vayehi david lechal derachav maskil va immo

Veasur lo laadam lehafkir o lehakdish kal nechasav veyatriach al habberiyyot velo yimkor sade veyikne bayit velo bayit veyikne mittaltelin o yaase sechora bidme beto aval mocher hu mittaltelin vekone sade kelalo shel davar yasim megammato lehatzliach nechasav ulhachalif hakkale bekayyam velo tihye kavanato lehanot meat lefi shaa o lehanot meat veyafsid harbe

Massao umattano shel talmid chacham beemet uveemuna omer al lav lav veal hen hen medakdek al atzmo becheshbon venoten umvatter laacherim kesheyyikkach mehen velo yedakdek alehen venoten deme hammikkach lealtar veeno naase lo arev velo kabbelan velo yavo beharshaa eno mechayyev atzmo bedivre mikkach umimkar bemakom shello chiyeva oto tora kede sheyyaamod bedibburo velo yeshannehu veim nitchayevu lo acherim baddin maarich umochel lahen umalve vechonen velo yered letoch ummanut chavero velo yatzer leadam leolam bechayyav kelalo shel davar yihye min hannirdafim velo min harodfim min hanneelavim velo min haolvim veadam sheose kal hammaasim haellu vechayyotze bahen alav hakkatuv omer vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 6: Derech beriyyato shel adam lihot nimshach bedeotav uvmaasav achar reav vachaverav venoheg keminhag anshe medinato lefichach tzarich adam lehitchabber latztzaddikim vileshev etzel hachachamim tamid kede sheyyilmad mimmaasehem viyitirachek min harshaim haholchim bachoshech kede shello yilmod mimmaasehem hu sheshshelomo omer holech et chachamim yechkam veroe chesilim yeroa veomer ashre haish vego vechen im haya bimdina shemminhagoteha raim veen anasheha holchim bederech yeshara yelech lemakom sheanasheha tzaddikim venohagim bederech tovim veim hau kal hammedinot shehu yodam veshomea shemuatan nohagim bederech lo tova kemo zemannenu o sheeno yachol lalechet limdina shemminhagoteha tovim mippene haggeyasot o mippene hacholi yeshev levaddo yechidi kainyan shenneemar yeshev badad veyiddom veim hau raim vechattaim sheen menichim oto leshev bammedina ella im ken nitarev immahen venoheg beminhagam hara yetze lammearot velachavachim velammidbarot veal yanhig atzmo bederech chattaim kainyan shenneemar mi yitteneni vammidbar melon orchim

Mitzvat ase lehiddavek bachachamim vetalmidehem kede lilmod mimmaasehem kainyan shenneemar uvo tidbak vechi efshar laadam lehiddavek bashshechina ella kach amru chachamim beferush mitzva zo hiddavek bachachamim vetalmidehem lefichach tzarich adam lehishtaddel sheyyissa bat talmid chacham veyassi bitto letalmid chacham veleechol velishtot im talmide chachamim velaasot perakmatya letalmid chacham ulhitchabber lahen bechal mine chibbur shenneemar uldavka bo vechen tziuu chachamim veamru veheve mitabbek baafar raglehem veshote batztzama et divrehem

Mitzva al kal adam leehov et kal echad veechad miyyisrael kegufo shenneemar veahavta lereacha kamocha lefichach tzarich lesapper beshivcho velachus al mamono kaasher hu chas al mamon atzmo verotze bichvod atzmo vehammitkabbed biklon chavero en lo chelek laolam habba

Ahavat hagger shebba venichnas tachat kanfe hashshechina shette mitzot ase achat mippene shehu bichlal reim veachat mippene shehu ger vehattora amra vaahavtem et hagger tziva al ahavat hagger kemo shetztziva al ahavat atzmo shenneemar veahavta et elohecha hakkadosh baruch hu atzmo ohev gerim shenneemar veohev ger

Kal hassone echad miyyisrael belibbo over belo taase shenneemar lo tisna et achicha bilvavecha veen lokin al lav ze lefi sheen bo maase velo hizhira tora ella al sina shebballev aval hammakke et chavero vehamcharfo af al pi sheeno rashshay eno over mishshum lo tisna

Kesheyyechta ish leish lo yistemennu veyishtok kemo shenneemar barshaim velo dibber avshalom et amnon meuma lemera vead tov ki sane avshalom et amnon ella mitzva alav lehodio velomar lo lamma asita li kach vechach velamma chatata li bedavar peloni shenneemar hocheach tochiach et amitecha veim chazar uvikkesh mimmennu limchol lo tzarich limchol velo yehe hammochel achzari shenneemar vayyitpallel avraham el haelohim

Haroe chavero shechata o shehalach bederech lo tova mitzva lehachaziro lammutav ulhodio shehu chote al atzmo bemaasav haraim shenneemar hocheach tochiach et amitecha hammochiach et chavero ben bidvarim shebbeno leveno ben bidvarim shebbeno leven hammakom tzarich lehochicho beno leven atzmo vidabber lo benachat uvlashon rakka veodio sheeno omer lo ella letovato lahavio lechayye haolam habba im kibbel mimmennu mutav veim lav yochichennu paam sheniyya ushlishit vechen tamid chayyav adam lehochicho ad sheyyakkehu hachote veyomar lo eni shomea vechal sheefshar beyado limchot veeno moche hu nitpas baaon ellu kevan sheefshar lo limchot bahem

Hammochiach et chavero techilla lo yedabber lo kashot ad sheyyachlimennu shenneemar velo tissa alav chet kach amru chachamim yachol atta mochicho ufanav mishtannot talmud lomar velo tissa alav chet mikkan sheasur laadam lehachlim et yisrael vechal shekken barabbim af al pi shehammachlim et chavero eno loke alav aon gadol hu kach amru chachamim hammalbin pene chavero barabbim en lo chelek laolam habba lefichach tzarich adam lehizzaher shello levayyesh chavero barabbim ben katan ben gadol velo yikra lo beshem shehu bosh mimmennu velo yesapper lefanav davar shehu bosh mimmennu bamme devarim amurim bidvarim shebben adam lachavero aval bedivre shamayim im lo chazar bo basseter machlimin oto barabbim umfarsemim cheto umcharfim oto befanav umvazzin umkallelin oto ad sheyyachazor lammutav kemo sheasu kal hanneviim beyisrael

Mi shechata alav chavero velo ratza lehochicho velo ledabber lo kelum mippene shehaya hachote hedot beoter o shehayeta dato meshubbeshet umachal lo belibbo velo setamo velo hochicho hare zo middat chasidut lo hikpida tora ella al hammastema

Chayyav adam lehizzaher bitomim vealmanot mippene shennafshan shefala limod verucham nemucha af al pi shehen baale mamon afillu almanato shel melech vitomav muzharim anu alehen shenneemar kal almana veyatom lo teannun veheach nohagin immahen lo yedabber alehem ella rakkot velo yinhog bahen ella minhag kavod velo yachiv gufam baavoda velibbam bidvarim kashim veyachus al mamonam yoter mimmamon atzmo kal hammaknitan o machisan o hichiv lahen o rada bahen o ibbed mamonan hare ze over belo taase vechal shekken hammakke otam o hamkallelan velav ze af al pi sheen lokin alav hare ansho meforash battora vechara appi veharagti etchem becharev berit karat lahen mi sheamar vehaya haolam shekkal zeman shehem tzoakim mechamas hem naanim shenneemar ki im tzaok yitzak elay shamoa eshma tzaakato bamme devarim amurim bizman sheinna otan letzorech atzmo aval inna otam harav kede lelammedan tora o ummanut o leholichan bederech yeshara hare ze muttar veaf al pi chen lo yinhog bahen minhag kal adam ella yaase lahem hefresh vinahalem benachat uvrachamim gedolim vechavod shenneemar ki yariv rivam echad yatom meav veechad yatom meem vead ematay nikraim yetomim leinyan ze ad shello yihu tzerichin leadam gadol lehissamech alav ulamnan ulhittafel bahen ella yihye ose kal tzarche atzmo leatzmo kishar kal haggedolim
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 7: Hamraggel bachavero over belo taase shenneemar lo telech rachil beammecha veaf al pi sheen lokin al davar ze aon gadol hu vegorem laharog nefashot rabbot miyyisrael lechach nismach lo velo taamod al dam reecha tze ulmad ma era ledoeg haadomi

E zehu rachil ze shettoen devarim veholech mizze laze veomer kach amar peloni kach vechach shamati al peloni af al pi shehu emet hare ze machariv et haolam yesh aon gadol mizze ad meod vehu bichlal lav ze vehu lashon hara vehu hamsapper bignut chavero af al pi sheomer emet aval haomer sheker nikra motzi shem ra al chavero aval baal lashon hara ze sheyyoshev veomer kach vechach asa peloni vechach vechach hau avotav vechach vechach shamati alav veamar devarim shel genay al ze amar hakkatuv yachret kal sifte chalakot lashon medabberet gedolot

Amru chachamim shalosh averot nifrain min haadam baolam hazze veen lo chelek laolam habba avodat kochavim vegilluy araot ushfichut damim velashon hara keneged kullam veod amru chachamim kal hamsapper belashon hara keillu kofer baikkar shenneemar asher amru lilshonenu nagbir sefatenu ittanu mi adon lanu veod amru chachamim shelosha lashon hara horeget haomro vehamkabbelo veze sheomer alav vehamkabbelo yoter min haomro

Veyesh devarim shehen avak lashon hara ketzad mi yomar lifloni sheyyihye kemot shehu atta o sheyyomar shitku mippeloni eni rotze lehodia ma era ume haya vechayyotze baddevarim haellu vechal hamsapper betovat chavero bifne sonav hare ze avak lashon hara shezze gorem lahem sheyesapperu bignuto veal ze hainyan amar shelomo mevarech reehu bekol gadol babboker hashkem kelala techashev lo shemmittoch tovato ba lide raato vechen hamsapper belashon hara derech sechok vederech kallut rosh kelomar sheeno medabber besina hu sheshshelomo amar bechachmato kemitlahleha hayyore zikkim chitztzim vamavet veamar halo mesachek ani vechen hamsapper lashon hara derech rammaut vehu sheyesapper letummo keillu eno yodea sheddavar ze sheddibber lashon hara hu ella keshemmemachin bo omer eni yodea sheddavar ze lashon hara o sheellu maasav shel peloni

Echad hamsapper belashon hara bifne chavero o shello befanav vehamsapper devarim sheggormim im nishmeu ish mippi ish lehazzik chavero begufo o bemamono vaafillu lehatzer lo o lehafchido hare ze lashon hara veim neemru devarim ellu bifne shelosha kevar nishma haddavar venoda veim sipper haddavar echad min hashshelosha paam acheret en bo mishshum lashon hara vehu shello yitkaven lehaavir hakkol ulgalloto yoter
Kal ellu hem baale lashon hara sheasur ladur bishchunatam vechal shekken leshev immahem velishmoa divrehem velo nechtam gezar din al avotenu bammidbar ella al lashon hara levad

Hannokem mechavero over belo taase shenneemar lo tikkom veaf al pi sheeno loke alav dea raa hi ad meod ella rauy lo laadam lihot maavir al middotav al kal divre haolam shehakkol etzel hammevinim divre hevel vahavay veenan keday linkom alehem ketzad hi hannekima amar lo chavero hashileni kardumcha amar lo eni mashilcha lemachar tzarich lishol mimmennu amar lo chavero hashileni kardumcha amar lo eni mashilcha kederech shello hishaltani kesheshshaalti mimmecha hare ze nokem ella kesheyyavo lo lishol yitten belev shalem velo yigmol lo kaasher gemalo vechen kal kayyotze baellu vechen amar david bedeotav hattovot im gamalti sholmi ra vaachalletza vego

Vechen kal hannoter leechad miyyisrael over belo taase shenneemar velo tittor et bene ammecha ketzad hi hannetira reuven sheamar leshimon hasker li bayit ze o hashileni shor ze velo ratza shimon leyamim ba shimon liruven lishol mimmennu o liskor mimmennu veamar lo reuven he lecha hareni mashilcha veeni kemotcha lo ashallem lecha kemaasecha haose kaze over belo tittor ella yimche haddavar millibbo velo yitterennu shekkal zeman shehu noter et haddavar vezochro shemma yavo linkom lefichach hikpida tora al hannetira ad sheyyimche heaon millibbo velo yizkerennu kelal vezo hi haddea hannechona sheefshar sheyyitkayyem bah yishshuv haaretz umassaam umattanam shel bene adam ze im ze
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 1: Kal mitzot shebbattora ben ase ben lo taase im avar adam al achat mehen ben bezadon ben bishgaga kesheyyaase teshuva veyashuv mecheto chayyav lehitvaddot lifne hael baruch hu shenneemar ish o ishsha ki yaasu vego vehitvaddu et chattatam asher asu ze vidduy devarim vidduy ze mitzvat ase ketzad mitvaddin omer anna hashshem chatati aviti pashati lefanecha veasiti kach vechach vahare nichamti uvoshti bemaasay ulolam eni chozer ledavar ze vezehu ikkaro shel vidduy vechal hammarbe lehitvaddot umaarich beinyan ze hare ze meshubbach vechen baale chattaot vaashamot beet shemmeviin karbenotehen al shiggatan o al zedonan en mitkapper lahen bekarbanam ad sheyyaasu teshuva veyitvaddu vidduy devarim shenneemar vehitvadda asher chata aleha vechen kal mechuyeve mitot bet din umchuyeve malkot en mitkapper lahen bemitatan o bilkiyyatan ad sheyyaasu teshuva veyitvaddu vechen hachovel bachavero vehammazzik mamono af al pi sheshshillem lo ma shehu chayyav lo eno mitkapper ad sheyyitvadde veyashuv millaasot kaze leolam shenneemar mikkal chattot haadam

Sair hammishtalleach lefi shehu kappara al kal yisrael kohen gadol mitvadde alav al leshon kal yisrael shenneemar vehitvadda alav et kal aonot bene yisrael sair hammishtalleach mechapper al kal averot shebbattora hakkallot vehachamurot ben sheavar bezadon ben sheavar bishgaga ben shehoda lo ben shello hoda lo hakkol mitkapper besair hammishtalleach vehu sheasa teshuva aval im lo asa teshuva en hassair mechapper lo ella al hakkallot uma hen hakkallot uma hen hachamurot hachamurot hen shechayyavin alehem mitat bet din o karet ushvuat shave vasheker af al pi sheen bahen karet hare hen min hachamurot ushar mitzot lo taase umitzot ase sheen bahen karet hem hakkallot

Bazzeman hazze sheen bet hammikdash kayyam veen lanu mizbach kappara en sham ella teshuva hatteshuva mechapperet al kal haaverot afillu rasha kal yamav veasa teshuva baacharona en mazkirin lo shum davar merisho shenneemar rishat harasha lo yikkashel bah beom shuvo merisho veatzmo shel yom hakkippurim mechapper lashshavim shenneemar ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem

Af al pi shehatteshuva mechapperet al hakkol veatzmo shel yom hakkippurim mechapper yesh averot shehen mitkapperim lishatan veyesh averot sheen mitkapperim ella leachar zeman ketzad avar adam al mitzvat ase sheen bah karet veasa teshuva eno zaz mishsham ad shemmochalin lo uvellu neemar shuvu banim shovavim erpa meshuvotechem vego avar al mitzvat lo taase sheen bah karet velo mitat bet din veasa teshuva teshuva tola veom hakkippurim mechapper uvellu neemar ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem avar al keretot umitot bet din veasa teshuva teshuva veom hakkippurim tolin veyissurin habbain alav gomrin lo hakkappara ulolam en mitkapper lo kappara gemura ad sheyyavou alav yissurin uvellu neemar ufakadti veshevet pisham uvingaim aonam bamme devarim amurim beshello chillel et hashshem beshaa sheavar aval hamchallel et hashshem af al pi sheasa teshuva vehiggia yom hakkippurim vehu omed bitshuvato uvau alav yissurin eno mitkapper lo kappara gemura ad sheyyamut ella teshuva yom hakkippurim veyissurin shelashtan tolin umita mechapperet shenneemar venigla veaznay tzevaot vego im yechuppar heaon hazze lachem ad temutun
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 2: E zo hi teshuva gemura ze shebba leyado davar sheavar bo veefshar beyado laasoto uferash velo asa mippene hatteshuva lo miyyira velo mikkishlon koach ketzad hare shebba al ishsha baavera ulachar zeman nityached immah vehu omed beahavato bah uvchoach gufo uvammedina sheavar bah ufarash velo avar zehu baal teshuva gemura hu sheshshelomo amar uzchor et borecha bime bechurotecha veim lo shav ella bime ziknuto uvet shei efshar lo laasot ma shehaya ose af al pi sheenah teshuva meulla moelet hi lo uvaal teshuva hu afillu avar kal yamav veasa teshuva beom mitato umet bitshuvato kal aonotav nimchalin shenneemar ad asher lo techshach hashshemesh vehaor vehayyareach vehakkochavim veshavu heavim achar haggeshem shehu yom hammita mikkelal sheim zachar boro veshav kodem sheyyamut nislach lo

Uma hi hatteshuva hu sheyyaazov hachote cheto visiro mimmachashavto veyigmor belibbo shello yaasehu od shenneemar yaazov rasha darko vego vechen yitnachem al sheavar shenneemar ki achare shuvi nichamti veyaid alav yodea taalumot shello yashuv leze hachet leolam shenneemar velo nomar od elohenu lemaase yadenu vego vetzarich lehitvaddot bisfatav velomar inyanot ellu sheggamar belibbo

Kal hammitvadde bidvarim velo gamar belibbo laazov hare ze dome letovel vesheretz beyado sheen hattevila moelet lo ad sheyyashlich hashsheretz vechen hu omer umode veozev yerucham vetzarich lifrot et hachet shenneemar anna chata haam hazze chataa gedola vayyaasu lahem elohe zahav

Middarche hatteshuva lihot hashshav tzoek tamid lifne hashshem bivchi uvtachanunim veose tzedaka kefi kocho umitrachek harbe min haddavar shechata bo umshanne shemo kelomar ani acher veeni oto haish sheasa otan hammaasim umshanne maasav kullan letova ulderech yeshara vegole mimmekomo sheggalut mechapperet aon mippene sheggoremet lo lehikkana velihot anav ushfal ruach

Veshevach gadol lashshav sheyyitvadde barabbim veodia peshaav lahem umgalle averot shebbeno leven chavero laacherim veomer lahem amnam chatati lifloni veasiti lo kach vechach vahareni hayyom shav umitnachem vechal hammitgae veeno modia ella mechasse peshaav en teshuvato gemura shenneemar mechasse feshaav lo yatzliach bamme devarim amurim baaverot shebben adam lachavero aval baaverot shebben adam lammakom eno tzarich lefarsem atzmo veazzut panim hi lo im gillam ella shav lifne hael baruch hu uforet chataav lefanav umitvadde alehem lifne rabbim setam vetova hi lo shello nitgalla aono shenneemar ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa

Af al pi shehatteshuva vehatztzeaka yafa laolam baasara hayyamim shebben rosh hashshana veom hakkippurim hi yafa beoter umitkabbelet hi miyyad shenneemar dirshu behimmatzo bamme devarim amurim beyachid aval tzibbur kal zeman sheosim teshuva vetzoakin belev shalem hem naanin shenneemar ka elohenu bechal karenu elav

Yom hakkippurim hu zeman teshuva lakkol layyachid velarabbim vehu ketz mechila uslicha leyisrael lefichach chayyavim hakkol laasot teshuva ulhitvaddot beom hakkippurim umitzvat vidduy yom hakkippurim sheyyatchil meerev hayyom kodem sheyyochal shemma yechanek basseudda kodem sheyyitvadde veaf al pi shehitvadda kodem sheyyochal chozer umitvadde belele yom hakkippurim arvit vechozer umitvadde beshacharit uvmusaf uvmincha uvinila vehechan mitvadde yachid achar tefillato ushliach tzibbur beemtza tefillato bivracha reviit

Havidduy shennahagu bo kal yisrael aval anachnu chatanu kullanu vehu ikkar havidduy averot shehitvadda alehem beom hakkippurim ze chozer umitvadde alehen beom hakkippurim acher af al pi shehu omed bitshuvato shenneemar ki feshaay ani eda vechattati negdi tamid

En hatteshuva velo yom hakkippurim mechapperin ella al averot shebben adam lammakom kegon mi sheachal davar asur o baal beila asura vechayyotze bahen aval averot shebben adam lachavero kegon hachovel et chavero o hamkallel chavero o gozlo vechayyotze bahen eno nimchal lo leolam ad sheyyitten lachavero ma shehu chayyav lo viratztzehu af al pi shehechezir lo mamon shehu chayyav lo tzarich leratztzoto velishl mimmennu sheyyimchol lo afillu lo hiknit et chavero ella bidvarim tzarich lefayeso velifgoa bo ad sheyyimchol lo lo ratza chavero limchol lo mevi lo shura shel shelosha bene adam mereav ufogin bo umvakkeshin mimmennu lo nitratztza lahen mevi lo sheniyya ushlishit lo ratza menicho veholech lo veze shello machal hu hachote veim haya rabbo holech uva afillu elef peamim ad sheyyimchol lo

Asur laadam lihot achzari velo yitpayyes ella yehe noach lirtzot vekashe lichos uvshaa shemmevakkesh mimmennu hachote limchol mochel belev shalem uvnefesh chafetza vaafillu hetzer lo vechata lo harbe lo yikkom velo yittor vezehu darkam shel zera yisrael velibbam hannachon aval haovde kochavim arle lev enan ken ella veevrato shemara netzach vechen hu omer al haggivonim lefi shello machalu velo nitpayesu vehaggivonim lo mibbene yisrael hemma

Hachote lachavero umet chavero kodem sheyevakkesh mechila mevi asara bene adam umaamidan al kivro veyomar bifnehem chatati la elohe yisrael velifloni ze shekkach vechach asiti lo veim haya chayyav lo mamon yachaziro layyorshim lo haya yodea lo yorshin yannichennu bevet din veyitvadde
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 3: Kal echad veechad mibbene haadam yesh lo zechuyyot vaaonot mi shezzechuyyotav yeterot al aonotav tzaddik umi sheaonotav yeterot al zechuyyotav rasha mechetza lemechetza benoni vechen hammedina im hau zechuyyot kal yoshveha merubbot al aonotehen hare zo tzaddeket veim hau aonotehem merubbin hare zo reshaa vechen kal haolam kullo

Adam sheaonotav merubbin al zechuyyotav miyyad hu met berisho shenneemar al rov aonech vechen medina sheaonoteha merubbin miyyad hi ovedet shenneemar zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba vego vechen kal haolam kullo im hau aonotehem merubbin mizzechuyyotehen miyyad hen nishchatin shenneemar vayyar ki rabba raat haadam veshikkul ze eno lefi minyan hazzechuyyot vehaaonot ella lefi gadlam yesh zechut shehi keneged kamma aonot shenneemar yaan nimtza vo davar tov veyesh aon shehu keneged kamma zechuyyot shenneemar vechote echad yeabbed tova harbe veen shoklin ella bedato shel el deot vehu hayyodea heach orchin hazzechuyyot keneged haaonot

Kal mi shennicham al hammitzot sheasa vetaha al hazzechuyyot veamar belibbo uma hoalti baasiyyatan halvay lo asiti otan hare ze ibbed et kullan veen mazkirim lo shum zechut baolam shenneemar vetzidkat hatztzaddik lo tatztzilennu beom risho en ze ella betohe al harishonot uchshem sheshshoklin zechuyyot adam vaaonotav bishat mitato kach bechal shana veshana shoklin aonot kal echad veechad mibbae haolam im zechuyyotav beom tov shel rosh hashshana mi shennimtza tzaddik nechtam lechayyim umi shennimtza rasha nechtam lemita vehabbenoni tolin oto ad yom hakkippurim im asa teshuva nechtam lechayyim veim lav nechtam lemita

Af al pi shettekiat shofar berosh hashshana gezerat hakkatuv remez yesh bo kelomar uru yeshenim mishshenatchem venirdamim hakitzu mittardematchem vechappesu bemaasechem vechizru bitshuva vezichru boraachem ellu hashshochchim et haemet behavle hazzeman veshogim kal shenatam behevel varik asher lo yoil velo yatztzil habbitu lenafshotechem vehetivu darchechem umaallechem veyaazov kal echad mikkem darko haraa umachashavto asher lo tova lefichach tzarich kal adam sheyyire atzmo kal hashshana kullah keillu chetzo zakkay vechetzo chayyav vechen kal haolam chetzo zakkay vechetzo chayyav chata chet echad hare hichria et atzmo veet kal haolam kullo lechaf chova vegaram lo hashchata asa mitzva achat hare hichria et atzmo veet kal haolam kullo lechaf zechut vegaram lo velahem teshua vehatztzala shenneemar vetzaddik yesod olam ze shetztzadak hichria et kal haolam lizchut vehitztzilo umippene inyan ze nahagu kal bet yisrael leharbot bitzdaka uvmaasim tovim velaasok bemitzot merosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim yeter mikkal hashshana venahagu kullam lakum ballayela baasara yamim ellu ulhitpallel bevatte kenesiyyot bedivre tachanunim uvchibbushin ad sheyyeor hayyom

Beshaa sheshshoklin aonot adam im zechuyyotav en mechashshevin alav aon shechata bo techilla velo sheni ella mishshelishi veelach im nimtzeu aonotav mishshelishi veelach merubbin al zechuyyotav otam shette aonot mitztarfim vedanin oto al hakkol veim nimtzeu zechuyyotav keneged aonotav asher meaon shelishi veelach maavirim kal aonotav rishon rishon lefi shehashshelishi nechshav rishon shekkevar nimchalu hashshenayim vechen harvii hare hu rishon shekkevar nimchal hashshelishi vechen ad sofan bamme devarim amurim beyachid shenneemar hen kal elle yifal el paamayim shalosh im gaver aval hatztzibbur tolin lahen aon rishon sheni ushlishi shenneemar al shelosha pishe yisrael veal arbaa lo ashivennu uchshemmechashshevin lahen al derech ze mechashshevin lahen mervii veelach habbenonim im haya bichlal mechetza aonot shellahen shello heniach tefillin meolam danin oto kefi cheto veyesh lo chelek laolam habba vechen kal harshaim sheaonotehen merubbim danin otan kefi chataehem veyesh lahen chelek laolam habba shekkal yisrael yesh lahem chelek laolam habba af al pi shechatu shenneemar veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz eretz zo mashal kelomar eretz hachayyim vehu haolam habba vechen chaside ummot haolam yesh lahem chelek laolam habba

Veellu hen sheen lahen chelek laolam habba ella nichratim veovdin veniddonin al godel risham vechattatam leolam ulolme olamim hamminim vehaeppikorosin vehakkofrim battora vehakkofrim bitchiyyat hammetim uvviat haggoel hammordim umachatie harabbim vehapporshin middarche tzibbur vehaose averot beyad rama befarhesya kihoyakim vehammosrim umattile ema al hatztzibbur shello leshem shamayim veshofche damim uvaale lashon hara vehammoshech arlato

Chamishsha hen hannikraim minim haomer sheen sham eloha veen laolam manhig vehaomer sheyyesh sham manhig aval hen shenayim o yoter vehaomer sheyyesh sham ribbon echad aval shehu guf uvaal temuna vechen haomer sheeno levaddo harishon vetzur lakkol vechen haoved kochav o mazzal vezulato kede lihot melitz beno uven ribbon haolamim kal echad mechamishsha ellu hu min

Shelosha hen hannikraim eppikorsin haomer sheen sham nevua kelal veen sham madda shemmaggia mehabbore lelev bene haadam vehammachchish nevuato shel moshe rabbenu vehaomer sheen habbore yodea maase bene haadam kal echad mishshelosha ellu hen eppikorosim shelosha hen hakkofrim battora haomer sheen hattora meim afillu pasuk echad afillu teva achat im amar moshe amaro mippi atzmo hare ze kofer battora vechen hakkofer beferushah vehu tora shebbeal pe vehammachchish maggideha kegon tzadok uvayettos vehaomer shehabbore hechelif mitzva zo bemitzva acheret uchvar batla tora zo af al pi shehi hayeta meim kegon hahagrim kal echad mishshelosha ellu kofer battora

Shenayim hem hammumarim miyyisrael hammumar laavera achat vehammumar lechal hattora kullah mumar laavera achat ze shehechezik atzmo laasot otah avera bezadon vehurgal venitparsem bah afillu hayeta min hakkallot kegon shehuchzak tamid lilbosh shaatnez o lehakkif pea venimtza keillu batla mitzva zo min haolam etzlo hare ze mumar leoto davar vehu sheyyaase lehachis mumar lechal hattora kullah kegon hachozrim ledate haovde kochavim beshaa sheggozrin gezera veyidbak bahem veyomar ma betza li lehiddabbek beyisrael shehem shefalim venirdafim tov li sheeddabbek beellu sheyyadam takkifa hare ze mumar lechal hattora kullah

Machatie harabbim ketzad echad shehechti bedavar gadol kegon yaravam vetzadok uvayettos veechad shehechti bedavar kal afillu levattel mitzvat ase veechad haones acherim ad sheyyechteu kimnashshe shehaya horeg et yisrael ad sheyyaavdu avodat kochavim o shehita acherim vehiddicham keyeshua

Happoresh middarche tzibbur af al pi shello avar averot ella nivdal meadat yisrael veeno ose mitzot bichlalan velo nichnas betzaratan velo mitanne betaanitan ella holech bedarko keechad miggoye haaretz uchillu eno mehen en lo chelek laolam habba haose averot beyad rama kihoyakim ben sheasa kallot ben sheasa chamurot en lo chelek laolam habba vezehu hannikra megalle panim battora mippene sheheez mitzcho vegilla panav velo bosh middivre tora
Shenayim hem hammosrin hammoser chavero beyad akkum lehargo o lehakkoto vehammoser mamon chavero beyad akkum o beyad annas shehu keakkum ushnehem en lahem chelek laolam habba
Mattile ema al hatztzibbur shello leshem shamayim ze harode tzibbur bechazka vehem yereim umfachadim mimmennu vechavanato lichvod atzmo vechal chafatzav shello lichvod shamayim kegon malche haakkum

Kal echad veechad meesrim vearbaa anashim ellu shemmaninu af al pi shehen miyyisrael en lahem chelek laolam habba veyesh averot kallot meellu veaf al pi chen amru chachamim sheharagil bahen en lahem chelek laolam habba uchday hen lehitrachek mehen ulhizzaher bahen veellu hen hamchanne shem lachavero vehakkore lachavero bechinnuo vehammalbin pene chavero barabbim vehammitkabbed biklon chavero vehamvazze talmide chachamim vehamvazze rabbotav vehamvazze et hammoadot vehamchallel et hakkadashim bamme devarim amurim shekkal echad meellu en lo chelek laolam habba keshemmet belo teshuva aval im shav merisho umet vehu baal teshuva hare ze mibbene haolam habba sheen lecha davar sheomed bifne hatteshuva afillu kafar baikkar kal yamav uvaacharona shav yesh lo chelek laolam habba shenneemar shalom shalom larachok velakkarov amar urfativ kal harshaim vehammumarim vechayyotze bahen shechazru bitshuva ben begaluy ben bematmoniyyot mekabbelin otan shenneemar shuvu banim shovavim af al pi sheadayin shovav hu shehare basseter shav velo begaluy mekabbelin oto bitshuva
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 4: Arvaa veesrim devarim meakkevin et hatteshuva arbaa mehen aon gadol vehaose echad mehen en hakkadosh baruch hu maspik beyado laasot teshuva lefi godel cheto veellu hen hammachti et harabbim uvichlal aon ze hamakkev et harabbim millaasot mitzva v vehammatte et chavero midderech tova leraa kegon mesit umaddiach g haroe beno yotze letarbut raa veeno memache beyado hoil uvno birshuto illu micha bo haya poresh venimtza kemachtio uvichlal aon ze kal sheefshar beyado limchot baacherim ben yachid ben rabbim velo micha ella yannichem bechishlonam d vehaomer echta veashuv uvichlal ze haomer echta veom hakkippurim mechapper

Umehen chamishsha devarim hannoalim darche hatteshuva bifne osehen veellu hen happoresh min hatztzibbur lefi shebbizman sheyyaasu teshuva lo yihye immahen veeno zoche immahen bizchut sheosin v vehacholek al divre chachamim lefi shemmachlakto goremet lo lifrosh mehen veeno yodea darche hatteshuva g vehammalig al hammitzot shekkevan shennitbazzu beenav eno rodef acharehen velo osan veim lo yaase bamme yizke d vehamvazze rabbotav sheddavar ze gorem lo ledachofo ultardo kegechazi uvizman shennitrad lo yimtza melammed umore lo derech haemet vehassone et hattochachot shehare lo hinniach lo derech teshuva shehattochacha goremet litshuva shebbizman shemmodiin lo laadam chataav umachlimin oto chozer bitshuva kemo shekkatuv battora zechor ve al tishkach mamrim heyitem velo natan lachem lev am naval velo chacham vechen yeshayahu hochiach et yisrael veamar hoy goy chote yada shor konehu middati ki kashe atta vechen tzivahu hael lehochiach lachattaim shenneemar kera vegaron al tachsoch vechen kal hanneviim hochichu leyisrael ad shechazru bitshuva lefichach tzarich lehaamid bechal kahal vekahal miyyisrael chacham gadol vezaken vire shamayim minneurav veahuv lahem sheyehe mochiach larabbim umachaziran bitshuva veze shessone et hattochachot eno ba lammochiach velo shomea devarav lefichach yaamod bechattotav shehem beenav tovim

Umehem chamishsha devarim haose otan i efshar lo sheyyashuv bitshuva gemura lefi shehem aonot shebben adam lachavero veeno yodea chavero shechata lo kede sheyyachazir lo o yishal mimmennu limchol lo veellu hen hamkallel et harabbim velo killel adam yadua kede sheyyishal mimmennu kappara v vehacholek im gannav shellefi sheeno yodea geneva zo shel mi hi ella haggannav gonev larabbim umevi lo vehu lokeach veod shehu machazik yad haggannav umachtio g vehammotze aveda veeno machriz aleha ad sheyyachazirah livaleha leachar zeman kesheyyaase teshuva eno yodea lemi yachazir d vehaochel shor aniyyim vitomim vealmanot ellu bene adam umlalin hem veenan yeduim umfursamim vegolim meir leir veen lahem makkir kede sheyyeda shor ze shel mi hu veyachazirennu lo vehamkabbel shochad lehattot din eno yodea ad hechan higgia hattaya zo vechamma hi kochah kede sheyyachazir shehaddavar yesh lo raglayim veod shehu machazik yad ze umachtio

Umehen chamishsha devarim haose otan en chezkato lashuv mehen lefi shehem devarim kallim beene rov haadam venimtza chote vehu yedamme sheen ze chet veellu hen haochel misseudda sheenah maspeket livaleha shezze avak gezel hu vehu medamme shello chata veyomar kelum achalti ella birshuto v hammishtammesh baavoto shel ani shehaavot shel ani eno ella kegon kordom umacharesha veyomar belibbo enan chaserim vahare lo gazalti oto g hammistakkel baaraot maale al dato sheen bechach kelum shehu omer vechi baalti o karavti etzlah vehu eno yodea sheriyyat haenayim aon gadol shehi goremet legufan shel araot shenneemar velo taturu achare levavchem veachare enechem d hammitkabbed biklon chavero omer belibbo sheeno chet lefi sheen chavero omed sham velo higgia lo boshet velo biyesho ella arach maasav hattovim vechachmato lemul maase chavero o chachmato kede sheyyerae mikkelalo shehu mechubbad vachavero bazuy vehachoshed kesherim omer belibbo sheeno chet lefi shehu omer me asiti lo vechi yesh sham ella chashad shemma asa o lo asa vehu eno yodea shezze aon shemmesim adam kasher bedato kevaal avera

Umehen chamishsha devarim haose otam yimmashech acharehem tamid vekashim hem lifrosh mehen lefichach tzarich adam lehizzaher mehen shemma yidbak bahen vehen kullan deot raot ad meod veellu hen rechilut velashon hara uvaal chema uvaal machashava raa vehammitchabber larasha mippene shehu lomed mimmaasav vehen nirshamim belibbo hu sheamar shelomo veroe chesilim yeroa uchvar bearnu behilchot deot devarim shetztzarich kal adam linhog bahen tamid kal vachomer levaal teshuva
Kal ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen af al pi shemmeakkevin et hatteshuva en monin otah ella im asa adam teshuva mehen hare ze baal teshuva veyesh lo chelek laolam habba
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 5: Reshut lechal adam netuna im ratza lehattot atzmo lederech tova velihot tzaddik harshut beyado veim ratza lehattot atzmo lederech raa velihot rasha harshut beyado hu shekkatuv battora hen haadam haya keachad mimmennu ladaat tov vara kelomar hen min ze shel adam haya yachid baolam veen min sheni dome lo beze hainyan sheyehe hu meatzmo bedato uvmachashavto yodea hattov vehara veose kal ma shehu chafetz veen mi sheyeakkev beyado millaasot hattov o hara vechevan shekken hu pen yishlach yado

Al yaavor bemachashavtecha davar ze sheomrim tippeshe ummot haolam verov galme bene yisrael shehakkadosh baruch hu gozer al haadam mittechillat beriyyato lihot tzaddik o rasha en haddavar ken ella kal adam rauy lo lihot tzaddik kemoshe rabbenu o rasha keyaravam o chacham o sachal o rachaman o achzari o kilay o shua vechen shear kal haddeot veen lo mi sheyyichpehu velo gozer alav velo mi shemmoshcho leechad mishshene hadderachim ella hu meatzmo umiddato note lee zo derech sheyyirtze hu sheyyirmeyahu amar mippi elon lo tetze haraot vehattov kelomar en habbore gozer al haadam lihot tov velo lihot ra vechevan shekken hu nimtza ze hachote hu hifsid et atzmo ulfichach rauy lo livkot ulkonen al chataav veal ma sheasa lenafsho ugmalah raa hu shekkatuv acharav ma yitonen adam chay vego vechazar veamar hoil urshutenu beyadenu umiddatenu asinu kal haraot rauy lanu lachazor bitshuva velaazov rishenu sheharshut atta beyadenu hu shekkatuv acharav nachpesa derachenu venachkora venashuva vego

Vedavar ze ikkar gadol hu vehu ammud hattora vehammitzva shenneemar ree natatti lefanecha hayyom et hachayyim uchtiv ree anochi noten lifnechem hayyom kelomar sheharshut beyedchem vechal sheyyachpotz haadam laasot mimmaase bene haadam ose ben tovim ben raim umippene ze hainyan neemar mi yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem kelomar sheen habbore kofe bene haadam velo gozer alehen laasot tova o raa ella hakkol masur lahem

Illu hael haya gozer al haadam lihot tzaddik o rasha o illu haya sham davar shemmoshech et haadam beikkar toladto lederech min hadderachim o lemadda min hammaddaot o ledea min haddeot o lemaase min hammaasim kemo shebbodim millibbam hattippeshim hovre shamayim heach haya metzave lanu al yede hanneviim ase kach veal taase kach hetivu darchechem veal telchu achare rishachem vehu mittechillat beriyyato kevar nigzar alav o toladto timshoch oto ledavar shei efshar lazuz mimmennu uma makom haya lechal hattora kullah uve ze din veeze mishpat nifra min harasha o meshallem sachar latztzaddik hashofet kal haaretz lo yaase mishpat veal titmah vetomar heach yihye haadam ose kal ma sheyyachpotz veyihu maasav mesurim lo vechi yease baolam davar shello birshut kono velo cheftzo vehakkatuv omer kl asher chafetz asa bashshamayim uvaaretz da shehakkol kecheftzo yease veaf al pi shemmaasenu mesurin lanu ketzad keshem shehayyotzer chafetz lihot haesh veharuach olim lemala vehammayim vehaaretz yordim lematta vehaggalgal sovev beiggul vechen shear beriyyot haolam lihot keminhagan shechafetz bo kacha chafetz lihot haadam reshuto beyado vechal maasav mesurin lo velo yihye lo lo kofe velo moshech ella hu meatzmo uvdato shennatan lo hael ose kal shehaadam yachol laasot lefichach danin oto lefi maasav im asa tova metivin lo veim asa raa merein lo hu shehannavi omer miyyedchem hayeta zot lachem gam hemma bacharu bedarchehem uvinyan ze amar shelomo semach bachur beyaldutecha veda ki al kal elle yeviacha haelohim bammishpat kelomar da sheyyesh beyadcha koach laasot veatid atta litten et haddin

Shemma tomar vahalo hakkadosh baruch hu yodea kal ma sheyyihye vekodem sheyyihye yeda shezze yihye tzaddik o rasha o lo yeda im yeda shehu yihye tzaddik i efshar shello yihye tzaddik veim tomar sheyyeda sheyyihye tzaddik veefshar sheyyihye rasha hare lo yeda haddavar al buro da shetteshuvat sheela zo arukka meeretz midda urchava minni yam vechamma ikkarim gedolim vahararim ramim teluyim bah aval tzarich atta leda ulhavin bedavar ze sheani omer kevar bearnu beferek sheni mehilchot yesode hattora shehakkadosh baruch hu eno yodea middea shehi chutz mimmennu kivne adam shehem vedatam shenayim ella hu yitalle shemo vedato echad veen dato shel adam yechola lehassig davar ze al buro uchshem sheen koach baadam lehassig velimtzo amittat habbore shenneemar ki lo yirani haadam vachay kach en koach baadam lehassig velimtzo dato shel habbore hu shehannavi amar ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem velo darchechem derachay vechevan shekken hu en banu koach leda heach yeda hakkadosh baruch hu kal habberuim vehammaasim aval neda belo safek shemmaase haadam beyad haadam veen hakkadosh baruch hu moshcho velo gozer alav laasot kach velo mippene kabbalat haddat bilvad noda davar ze ella biraot berurot middivre hachachma umippene ze neemar bannevua sheddanin et haadam al maasav kefi maasav im tov veim ra veze hu haikkar shekkal divre hannevua teluyin bo
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 6: Pesukim harbe yesh battora uvdivre neviim shehen nirin kesotrin ikkar ze venichshalin bahen rov haadam veyaale al datan mehen shehakkadosh baruch hu hu gozer al haadam laasot raa o tova vesheen libbo shel adam masur lo lehattoto lechal asher yirtze vahare ani mevaer ikkar gadol shemmimmennu teda perush kal otan happesukim bizman sheadam echad o anshe medina chotim veose hachote chet sheose middato uvirtzono kemo shehodanu rauy lehippara mimmennu vehakkadosh baruch hu yodea ech yippara yesh chet shehaddin noten shennifraim mimmennu al cheto baolam hazze begufo o bemamono o bevanav hakketannim shebbanav shel adam hakketannim sheen bahem daat velo higgiu lichlal mitzot kekinyano hen uchtiv ish becheto yamut ad sheyyease ish veyesh chet shehaddin noten shennifrain mimmennu laolam habba veen laover alav shum nezek baolam hazze veyesh chet shennifrain mimmennu baolam hazze velaolam habba
Bamme devarim amurim bizman shello asa teshuva aval im asa teshuva hatteshuva kitris lifne happuranut uchshem shehaadam chote middato uvirtzono kach hu ose teshuva middato uvirtzono

Veefshar sheyyechta adam chet gadol o chataim rabbim ad sheyyitten haddin lifne dayan haemet sheyehe happeraon mizze hachote al chataim ellu sheasa birtzono umiddato shemmonin mimmennu hatteshuva veen mannichin lo reshut lashuv merisho kede sheyyamut veyovad becheto sheasa hu shehakkadosh baruch hu amar al yede yeshayahu hashmen lev haam hazze vego vechen hu omer vayyihu malivim bemalache haelohim uvozim devarav umittateim binviav ad alot chamat beammo ad leen marpe kelomar chatu birtzonam vehirbu lifshoa ad shennitchayevu limnoa mehen hatteshuva shehi hammarpe lefichach katuv battora vaani akshe et lev paro lefi shechata meatzmo techilla veherea leyisrael haggarim beartzo shenneemar hava nitchakkema lo natan haddin limnoa hatteshuva mimmennu ad shennifra mimmennu lefichach chizzek hakkadosh baruch hu et libbo velamma haya sholeach lo beyad moshe veomer shelach vaase teshuva uchvar amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu en atta meshalleach shenneemar veatta vaavadecha yadati vego veulam baavur zot heemadticha kede lehodia levae haolam shebbizman shemmonea hakkadosh baruch hu hatteshuva lachote eno yachol lashuv ella yamut berisho sheasa bitchilla birtzono vechen sichon lefi aonot shehau lo nitchayyev lemano min hatteshuva shenneemar ki hiksha elohecha et rucho veimmetz et levavo vechen hakkenaanim lefi toavotehen mana mehen hatteshuva ad sheasu milchama im yisrael shenneemar ki meet hayeta lechazzek et libbam likrat hammilchama im yisrael lemaan hacharimam vechen yisrael bime eliyyahu lefi shehirbu lifshoa mana meotan hammarbim lifshoa teshuva shenneemar veatta hasibbota et libbam achorannit kelomar manata mehen hatteshuva nimtzeta omer shello gazar hael al paro lehara leyisrael velo al sichon lachato beartzo velo al hakkenaanim lehativ velo al yisrael laavod avoda zara ella kullan chatu meatzman vechullan nitchayevu limnoa mehen hatteshuva

Uchinyan ze shoalin hatztzaddikim vehanneviim bitfillatam meet leazram al haemet kemo sheamar david horeni darkecha kelomar al yimnauni chataay derech haemet shemmimmenna eda darkecha veyichud shemecha vechen ze sheamar veruach nediva tismecheni kelomar tanniach ruchi laasot cheftzecha veal yigremu li chataay lemaneni mitteshuva ella tihye harshut beyadi ad sheechezor veavin veeda derech haemet veal derech zo kal haddome lifsukim ellu

Umahu ze sheamar david tov veyashar al ken yore chattaim baddarech yadrech anavim vego ze sheshshalach neviim lahem modiim darche umachzirin otan bitshuva veod shennatan bahem koach lilmod ulhavin shemmidda zo bechal adam shekkal zeman shehu nimshach bedarche hachachma vehatztzedek mitave lahen verodef otam vehu ma sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha ba littaher mesayein oto kelomar yimtza atzmo neezar al haddavar vahalo katuv battora vaavadum veinnu otam hare gazar al hammitzriyyim laasot ra uchtiv vekam haam hazze vezana achare elohe nechar haaretz hare gazar al yisrael laavod avoda zara velamma nifra mehen lefi shello gazar al ish peloni hayyadua sheyyihye hu hazzone ella kal echad veechad meotan hazzonim laavod avoda zara illu lo ratza laavod lo haya oved velo hodio habbore ella minhago shel olam ha lema ze dome leomer haam hazze yihye bahen tzaddikim urshaim lo mippene ze yomar harasha kevar nigzar alav sheyyihye rasha mippene shehodia lemoshe sheyyihu reshaim beyisrael kainyan shenneemar ki lo yechdal evon mikkerev haaretz vechen hammitzriyyim kal echad veechad meotan hammetzerim vehammereim leyisrael illu lo ratza lehara lahem harshut beyado shello gazar al ish yadua ella hodio shessof zaro atid lehishtabed beeretz lo lahem uchvar amarnu sheen koach baadam leda heach yeda hakkadosh baruch hu devarim haatidin lihot
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 7: Hoil urshut kal adam netuna lo kemo shebbearnu yishtaddel adam laasot teshuva ulhitvaddot befiv mechataav velinor kappav mechataav kede sheyyamut vehu baal teshuva veyizke lechayye haolam habba

Leolam yire adam atzmo keillu hu note lamut veshemma yamut bishato venimtza omed becheto lefichach yashuv mechataav miyyad velo yeamer kesheazkin ashuv shemma yamut terem sheyyazkin hu sheshshelomo amar bechachmato bechal et yihu vegadecha levanim

Al tomar sheen teshuva ella meaverot sheyyesh bahen maase kegon zenut vegezel ugneva ella keshem shetztzarich adam lashuv meellu kach hu tzarich lechappes bedeot raot sheyyesh lo velashuv min hakkaas umin haeva umin hakkina umin hahittul umerdifat hammamon vehakkavod umerdifat hammaachalot vechayyotze bahen min hakkol tzarich lachazor bitshuva veellu haaonot kashim meotan sheyyesh bahen maase shebbizman sheadam nishka beellu kashe hu lifrosh mehem vechen hu omer yaazov rasha vego

Veal yedamme adam baal teshuva shehu meruchak mimmaalat hatztzaddikim mippene haaonot vehachataot sheasa en haddavar ken ella ahuv venechmad hu lifne habbore keillu lo chata meolam velo od ella shessecharo harbe shehare taam taam hachet uferash mimmennu vechavash yitzro amru chachamim makom shebbaale teshuva omdin en tzaddikim gemurin yecholin laamod bo kelomar maalatan gedola mimmaalat ellu shello chatu meolam mippene shehen kovshim yitzram yoter mehem

Kal hanneviim kullan tziuu al hatteshuva veen yisrael nigalin ella bitshuva uchvar hivticha tora shessof yisrael laasot teshuva besof galutan umiyyad hen nigalin shenneemar vehaya chi yavou alecha kal haddevarim vego veshavta ad elohecha veshav elohecha vego

Gedola teshuva shemmekarevet et haadam lashshechina shenneemar shuva yisrael ad elohecha veneemar velo shavtem aday neum veneemar im tashuv yisrael neum elay tashuv kelomar im tachazor bitshuva bi tidbak hatteshuva mekarevet et harchokim emesh haya ze sanouy lifne hammakom meshukkatz umruchak vetoeva vehayyom hu ahuv venechmad karov veyadid vechen atta motze shebbelashon shehakkadosh baruch hu marchik hachotim bah mekarev et hashshavim ben yachid ben rabbim shenneemar vehaya bimkom asher yeamer lahem lo ammi attem yeamer lahem bene el chay veneemar bichanyahu berishato kitvu et haish hazze ariri gever lo yitzlach beyamav im yihye kanyahu ben yehoyakim melech yehuda chotam al yad yemini vego vechevan sheshshav begaluto neemar bizrubbavel beno bayyom hahu neum tzevaot ekkachacha zerubbavel ben shealtiel avdi neum vesamticha kachotam

Kamma meulla maalat hatteshuva emesh haya ze muvdal me elohe yisrael shenneemar aonotechem hau mavdilim benechem leven elohechem tzoek veeno naane shenneemar ki tarbu tefilla vego veose mitzot vetorfin otan befanav shenneemar mi vikkesh zot miyyedchem remos chatzeray mi gam bachem veyisgor delatayim vego vehayyom hu mudbak bashshechina shenneemar veattem haddevekim ba elohechem tzoek venaane miyyad shenneemar vehaya terem yikrau vaani eene veose mitzot umkabbelin otan benachat vesimcha shenneemar ki chevar ratza haelohim et maasecha velo od ella shemmitavim lahem shenneemar vearva la minchat yehuda virushalomi kime olam uchshanim kadmoniyyot

Baale teshuva darkan lihot shefalim vaanavim beoter im cherfu otan hakkesilim bemaasehem harishonim veamru lahen emesh hayita ose kach vechach veemesh hayita omer kach vechach al yargishu lahen ella shomin usmechim veodin shezzo zechut lahem shekkal zeman shehem boshim mimmaasehem sheavru venichlamim mehen zechutam merubba umaalatam mitgaddelet vechet gamur hu lomar levaal teshuva zechor maasecha harishonim o lehazkiran lefanav kede levayesho o lehazkir devarim veinyanim haddomin lahem kede lehazkiro me asa hakkol asur umuzhar alav bichlal honayat devarim shehizhira tora aleha shenneemar velo tonu ish et amito
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 8: Hatova hatztzefuna latztzaddikim hi chayye haolam habba vehi hachayyim sheen mavet immahen vehattova sheen immah raa hu shekkatuv battora lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim mippi hashshemua lamdu lemaan yitav lach leolam shekkullo tov vehaarachta yamim leolam shekkullo aroch veze hu haolam habba sechar hatztzaddikim hu sheyyizku lenoam ze veyihu betova zo ufiron harshaim hu shello yizku lechayyim ellu ella yikkartu veyamutu vechal mi sheeno zoche lechayyim ellu hu hammet sheeno chay laolam ella nichrat berisho veaved kivhema vezehu karet hakketuva battora shenneemar hikkaret tikkaret hannefesh hahi mippi hashshemua lamdu hikkaret baolam hazze tikkaret laolam habba kelomar sheotah hannefesh sheppersha min hagguf baolam hazze enah zocha lechayye haolam habba ella gam min haolam habba nichretet

Haolam habba en bo guf ugviyya ella nafshot hatztzaddikim bilvad belo guf kemalache hashsharet hoil veen bo geviyyot en bo lo achila velo shetiyya velo davar mikkal haddevarim sheggufot bene adam tzerichin lahen baolam hazze velo yeera davar bo min haddevarim shemmearin laggufot baolam hazze kegon yeshiva vaamida veshena umita veetzev uschok vechayyotze bahen kach amru chachamim harishonim haolam habba en bo lo achila velo shetiyya velo tashmish ella tzaddikim yoshvim veatrotehem berashehen venehenin mizziv hashshechina hare nitbarer lecha sheen sham guf lefi sheen sham achila ushtiyya veze sheamru tzaddikim yoshvin derech chida amru kelomar hatztzaddikim metzuyin sham belo amal uvlo yegia vechen ze sheamru atrotehen berashehen kelomar daat sheyyadu shebbiglalah zachu lechayye haolam habba metzuya immahen vehi haatara shellahen kainyan sheamar shelomo baatara sheittera lo immo vahare hu omer vesimchat olam al rosham veen hassimcha guf kede shettanuach al harosh kach atara sheamru chachamim kan hi hayedia umahu ze sheamru nehenin mizziv hashshechina sheyyodim umassigin meamittat hakkadosh baruch hu ma sheenam yodim vehem bagguf haafel hashshafal

Kal nefesh haamura beinyan ze enah hanneshama hatztzericha lagguf ella tzurat hannefesh shehi haddea shehissiga mehabbore kefi kochah vehessegah haddeot hannifradot ushar hammaasim vehi hatztzura shebbearnu inyanah beferek revii mehilchot yesode hattora hi hannikret nefesh beinyan ze chayyim ellu lefi sheen immahem mavet sheen hammavet ella mimmeorot hagguf veen sham guf nikreu tzeror hachayyim shenneemar vehayeta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim vezehu hassachar sheen sachar lemala mimmennu vehattova sheen achareha tova vehi shehitauu lah kal hanneviim

Vechamma shemot nikreu lah derech mashal har umkom kadsho vederech hakkodesh vechatzrot venoam veohel vehechal uvet veshaar vachachamim karu lah derech mashal letova zo hamzummenet latztzaddikim seudda vekorin lah bechal makom haolam habba

Hannekama sheen nekama gedola mimmenna shettikkaret hannefesh velo tizke leotan hachayyim shenneemar hikkaret tikkaret hannefesh hahi aona bah veze haavaddon hu shekkorin oto hanneviim derech mashal beer shachat vaavaddon vetafte vaaluka vechal leshon kelaya vehashchata korin lo lefi shehi hakkelaya sheen achareha tekuma vehahefsed sheeno chozer leolam

Shemma tekal beenecha tova zo utdamme sheen sechar hammitzot veheot haadam shalem bedarche haemet ella lihoto ochel veshote maachalot tovot uvoel tzurot naot velovesh bigde shesh verikma veshochen beahole shen umishtammesh bichle kesef vezahav udvarim haddomim leellu kemo shemmedammin ellu haarviyyim hattippeshim haevilim hashshetufim bezimma aval hachachamim uvaale dea yedu shekkal haddevarim haellu divre havay vehevel hem veen bahem toelet veenah tova gedola etzlenu baolam hazze ella mippene sheanu baale guf ugviyya vechal haddevarim haellu tzarche hagguf hem veen hannefesh mitava lahem umchammedatan ella mippene tzorech hagguf kede sheyyimtza cheftzo veyaamod al buro uvizman sheen sham guf nimtzeu kal haddevarim haellu betelim hattova haggedola shettihye bah hannefesh baolam habba en shum derech baolam hazze lehassigah veleda otah sheen anu yodim baolam hazze ella tovat hagguf velah anu mitavin aval otah hattova gedola ad meod veen lah erech betovot haolam hazze ella derech mashal aval bederech haemet shennaaroch tovat hannefesh baolam habba betovot hagguf baolam hazze bemaachal uvmishte eno chen ella otah hattova gedola ad en cheker veen lah erech vedimon hu sheamar david ma rav tuvcha asher tzafanta lireecha vego

Vechamma kamah david vehitava lechayye haolam habba shenneemar lule heemanti lirot betuv beeretz chayyim kevar hodiunu hachachamim harishonim shettovat haolam habba en koach baadam lehassigah al buryah veen yodea gadlah veyafyah veatzmah ella hakkadosh baruch hu levaddo veshekkal hattovot shemmitnabbeim bahem hanneviim leyisrael enan ella lidvarim shebbagguf shennehenin bahen yisrael limot hammashiach bizman shettashuv hammemshala leyisrael aval tovat chayye haolam habba en lah erech vedimon velo dimmuha hanneviim kede shello yifchatu otah baddimon hu sheyeshayahu amar ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo kelomar hattova shello raata otah en navi velo raa otah ella elohim asa otah haelohim laadam shemmechakke lo amru chachamim kal hanneviim kullan lo nibbeu ella limot hammashiach aval haolam habba ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha

Ze shekkaru oto chachamim haolam habba lo mippene sheeno matzuy atta veze haolam oved veachar kach yavo oto haolam en haddavar ken ella hare hu matzuy veomed shenneemar asher tzafanta lireecha paalta vego velo kerauhu olam habba ella mippene sheotan hachayyim bain lo laadam achar chayye haolam hazze sheanu kayyamim bo beguf venefesh vezehu hannimtza lechal adam barishona
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 9: Meachar shennoda shemmattan secharan shel mitzot vehattova shennizke lah im shamarnu derech hakkatuv battora hi chayye haolam habba shenneemar lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim vehannekama shennokmim min harshaim sheazvu archot hatztzedek hakketuvot battora hi hakkaret shenneemar hikkaret tikkaret hannefesh hahi aonah bah mahu ze shekkatuv bechal hattora kullah im tishmeu yaggia lachem kach veim lo tishmeu yikre etchem kach vechal otan haddevarim baolam hazze kegon sova veraav umilchama veshalom umalchut veshiflut vishivat haaretz vegalut vehatzlachat maase vehefsedo ushar kal divre habberit kal otan haddevarim emet hau veyihu uvizman sheanu osim kal mitzot hattora yaggiu elenu tovot haolam hazze kullan uvizman sheanu ovrin alehen tikrena otanu haraot hakketuvot veaf al pi chen en otan hattovot hem sof mattan secharan shel mitzot velo otan haraot hem sof hannekama shennokmin meover al kal hammitzot ella kach hu hechrea kal haddevarim hakkadosh baruch hu natan lanu tora zo etz chayyim hi vechal haose kal hakkatuv bah veodo dea gemura nechona zoche bah lechayye haolam habba ulfi godel maasav verov chachmato hu zoche vehivtichanu battora sheim naase otah besimcha uvtovat nefesh venehge bechachmatah tamid sheyyasir mimmennu kal haddevarim hammonim otanu millaasotah kegon choli umilchama veraav vechayyotze bahen veyashpia lanu kal hattovot hammachazikot et yadenu laasot hattora kegon sova veshalom veribbuy kesef vezahav kede shello naasok kal yamenu bidvarim shehagguf tzarich lahen ella neshev penuyim lilmod bachachma velaasot hammitzva kede shennizke lechayye haolam habba vechen hu omer battora achar shehivtiach betovot haolam hazze utzdaka tihye lanu vego vechen hodianu battora sheim naazov hattora middaat venaasok behavle hazzeman kainyan shenneemar vayyishman yeshurun vayyivat sheddayan haemet yasir min haozvim kal tovot haolam hazze shehen chizzeku yedehem livot umevi alehem kal haraot hammonim otan milliknot haolam habba kede sheyyovdu berisham hu shekkatuv battora tachat asher lo avadta et vego veavadta et oyevecha asher yeshallechennu bach nimtza perush kal otan habberachot vehakkelalot al derech zo kelomar im avadtem et besimcha ushmartem darko mashpia lachem habberachot haellu umarchik hakkelalot mikkem ad shettihu penuyim lehitchakkem battora velaasok bah kede shettizku lechayye haolam habba veyitav lecha leolam shekkullo tov vetaarich yamim leolam shekkullo aroch venimtzetem zochin lishne haolamot lechayyim tovim baolam hazze hammeviim lechayye haolam habba sheim lo yikne po chachma umaasim tovim en lo bema yizke shenneemar ki en maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma bishol veim azavtem et ushgitem bemaachal uvmishte uznut vedome lahem mevi alechem kal hakkelalot haellu umesir kal habberachot ad sheyyichlu yemechem bevehala vafachad velo yihye lachem lev panuy velo guf shalem laasot hammitzot kede shettovdu mechayye haolam habba venimtza sheibbadtem shene olamot shebbizman sheadam tarud baolam hazze becholi uvmilchama uravon eno mitassek lo bachachma velo bamitzot shebbahen zochin lechayye haolam habba

Umippene ze nitauu kal yisrael neviehem vechachmehem limot hammashiach kede sheyyanuchu mimmalchuyyot sheenan menichot lahen laasok battora uvammitzot kahogen veyimtzeu lahem margoa veyirbu bechachma kede sheyyizku lechayye haolam habba lefi shebbeotan hayyamim tirbe haddea vehachachma vehaemet shenneemar ki mala haaretz dea et veneemar velo yelammedu ish et achiv veish et reehu veneemar vahasiroti et lev haeven mibbesarchem mippene sheoto hammelech sheyyaamod mizzera david baal chachma yihye yeter mishshelomo venavi gadol hu karov lemoshe rabbenu ulfichach yelammed kal haam veore otam derech veyavou kal haggoyim leshamo shenneemar vehaya beacharit hayyamim nachon yihye har bet berosh heharim vesof kal hassachar kullo vehattova haacharona sheen lah hefsek vegeraon hu chayye haolam habba aval yemot hammashiach hu haolam hazze veolam keminhago holech ella shehammalchut tachazor leyisrael uchvar amru chachamim harishonim en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud malchuyyot bilvad
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 10: Al yomar adam hareni ose mitzot hattora veosek bechachmatah kede sheakabbel kal habberachot hakketuvot bah o kede sheezke lechayye haolam habba veefrosh min haaverot shehizhira tora mehen kede sheennatzel min hakkelalot hakketuvot battora o kede shello ekkaret mechayye haolam habba en rauy laavod et al hadderech hazze shehaoved al derech ze hu oved miyyira veenah maalat hanneviim velo maalat hachachamim veen ovdim al derech ze ella amme haaretz vehannashim vehakketannim shemmechannechin otan laavod miyyira ad shettirbe datan veyaavdu meahava

Haoved meahava osek battora uvammitzot veholech bintivot hachachma lo mippene davar baolam velo mippene yirat haraa velo kede lirash hattova ella ose haemet mippene shehu emet vesof hattova lavo biglalah umaala zo hi maala gedola meod veen kal chacham zoche lah vehi maalat avraham avinu shekkerao hakkadosh baruch hu ohavo lefi shello avad ella meahava vehi hammaala shetztzivanu bah hakkadosh baruch hu al yede moshe shenneemar veahavta et elohecha uvizman sheyyeehov adam et ahava haruya miyyad yaase kal hammitzot meahava

Vechetzad hi haahava haruya hu sheyyohav et ahava gedola yetera azza meod ad shettehe nafsho keshura beahavat venimtza shoge bah tamid keillu chole choli haahava sheen dato penuya meahavat otah ishsha vehu shoge bah tamid ben beshivto ben bekumo ben beshaa shehu ochel veshote yeter mizze tihye ahavat belev ohavav shogim bah tamid kemo shetztzivanu bechal levavcha uvchal nafshecha vehu sheshshelomo amar derech mashal ki cholat ahava ani vechal shir hashshirim mashal hu leinyan ze

Amru chachamim harishonim shemma tomar hareni lamed tora bishvil sheehye ashir bishvil sheekra rabbi bishvil sheakabbel sachar baolam habba talmud lomar leahava et kal ma sheattem osim lo taasu ella meahava veod amru chachamim bemitzotav chafetz meod velo bischar mitzotav vechen hau gedole hachachamim metzavim linvone talmidehem umaskilehem beyichud al tihu kaavadim hamshammeshim et harav vechu ella mippene shehu harav rauy leshammesho kelomar ivdu meahava

Kal haosek battora kede lekabbel sachar o kede shello taggia alav puranut hare ze osek shello lishmah vechal haosek bah lo leyira velo lekabbel sachar ella mippene ahavat adon kal haaretz shetztziva bah hare ze osek bah lishmah veamru chachamim leolam yaasok adam battora vaafillu shello lishmah shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah lefichach keshemmelammedin et hakketannim veet hannashim uchlal amme haaretz en melammedin otan ella laavod miyyira uchde lekabbel sachar ad shettirbe datan veyitchakkemu chachma yetera megallim lahem raz ze meat meat umargilin otan leinyan ze benachat ad sheyyassiguhu veyeduhu veyaavduhu meahava

Davar yadua uvarur sheen ahavat hakkadosh baruch hu niksheret belibbo shel adam ad sheyyishge bah tamid karauy veyaazov kal ma shebbaolam chutz mimmenna kemo shetztziva veamar bechal levavcha uvchal nafshecha eno ohev hakkadosh baruch hu ella bedaat sheyedaehu veal pi haddea tihye haahava im meat meat veim harbe harbe lefichach tzarich haadam leyached atzmo lehavin ulhaskil bechachmot utvunot hammodiim lo et kono kefi koach sheyyesh baadam lehavin ulhassig kemo shebbearnu behilchot yesode hattora
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 1: Nashim vaavadim uktannim peturim mittalmud tora aval katan aviv chayyav lelammedo tora shenneemar velimmadtem otam et benechem ledabber bam veen haishsha chayyevet lelammed et benah shekkal hachayyav lilmod chayyav lelammed

Keshem shechayyav adam lelammed et beno kach hu chayyav lelammed et ben beno shenneemar vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha velo beno uven beno bilvad ella mitzva al kal chacham vechacham miyyisrael lelammed et kal hattalmidim af al pi sheenan banav shenneemar veshinnantam levanecha mippi hashshemua lamdu banecha ellu talmidecha shehattalmidim keruyin banim shenneemar vayyetzu vene hanneviim im ken lamma nitztava al beno veal ben beno lehakdim beno leven beno uven beno leven chavero

Vechayyav liskor melammed livno lelammedo veeno chayyav lelammed ben chavero ella bechinnam mi shello limmedo aviv chayyav lelammed et atzmo kesheyyakkir shenneemar ulmadtem otam ushmartem laasotam vechen atta motze bechal makom shehattalmud kodem lammaase mippene shehattalmud mevi lide maase veen hammaase mevi lide talmud

Haya hu rotze lilmod tora veyesh lo ben lilmod tora hu kodem livno veim haya beno navon umaskil lehavin ma sheyyilmod yoter mimmennu beno kodem veaf al pi shebbeno kodem lo yibbatel hu shekkeshem shemmitzva alav lelammed et beno kach hu metzuve lelammed atzmo
Leolam yilmod adam tora veachar kach yissa ishsha sheim nasa ishsha techilla en dato penuya lilmod veim haya yitzro mitgabber alav ad shennimtza sheen libbo panuy yissa veachar kach yilmod tora

Meematay aviv chayyav lelammedo tora mishsheyyatchil ledabber melammedo tora tziva lanu mshe u shema yisrael veachar kach melammedo meat meat pesukim pesukim ad sheyyihye ben shesh o ben sheva hakkol lefi buro umolicho etzel melammed hattinokot

Haya minhag hammedina likkach melammed hattinokot sachar noten lo secharo vechayyav lelammedo besachar ad sheyyikra tora shebbichtav kullah makom shennahagu lelammed tora shebbichtav besachar muttar lelammed besachar aval tora shebbeal pe asur lelammedah besachar shenneemar ree limmadti etchem chukkim umishpatim kaasher tzivani vego ma ani bechinnam lamadti af attem lemadtem bechinnam mimmenni vechen keshettelammedu ledorot lammedu bechinnam kemo shellemadtem mimmenni lo matza mi sheyelammedo bechinnam yelammedo besachar shenneemar emet kene yachol yelammed laacherim besachar talmud lomar veal timkor ha lamadta sheasur lo lelammed besachar af al pi shellimmedo rabbo besachar

Kal ish miyyisrael chayyav betalmud tora ben ani ben ashir ben shalem begufo ben baal yissurin ben bachur ben shehaya zaken gadol shettashash kocho afillu haya ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka umchazzer al happetachim vaafillu baal ishsha uvanim chayyav likboa lo zeman letalmud tora bayyom uvallayela shenneemar vehagita bo yomam valayela

Gedole chachme yisrael hau mehen chotve etzim umehen shoave mayim umehen sumim veaf al pi chen hau oskin betalmud tora bayyom uvallayela vehem mikkelal matike hashshemua ish mippi ish mippi moshe rabbenu
Ad ematay chayyav lilmod tora ad yom moto shenneemar ufen yasuru millevavcha kol yeme chayyecha vechal zeman shello yaasok belimmud hu shocheach

Vechayyav leshallesh et zeman lemidato shelish battora shebbichtav ushlish battora shebbeal pe ushlish yavin veyaskil acharit davar mereshito veotzi davar middavar vidamme davar ledavar veyavin bammiddot shehattora nidreshet bahen ad sheyyeda heach hu ikkar hammiddot veheach yotzi haasur vehammuttar vechayyotze bahen middevarim shellamad mippi hashshemua veinyan ze hu hannikra gemara

Ketzad haya baal ummanut vehaya osek bimlachto shalosh shaot bayyom uvattora tesha otan hattesha kore beshalosh mehen battora shebbichtav uvshalosh battora shebbeal pe uvshalosh acherot mitbonen bedato lehavin davar middavar vedivre kabbala bichlal tora shebbichtav hen uferushan bichlal tora shebbeal pe vehainyanim hannikraim pardes bichlal haggemara hen bamme devarim amurim bitchillat talmudo shel adam aval kesheyyagdil bechachma velo yehe tzarich lo lilmod tora shebbichtav velo laasok tamid battora shebbeal pe yikra beittim mezummanim tora shebbichtav vedivre hashshemua kede shello yishkach davar middivre dine tora veyifne kal yamav laggemara bilvad lefi rochav sheyyesh belibbo veyishshuv dato

Ishsha shellamda tora yesh lah sachar aval eno kischar haish mippene shello nitztavet vechal haose davar sheeno metzuve alav laasoto en secharo kischar hamtzuve sheasa ella pachot mimmennu veaf al pi sheyyesh lah sachar tziuu chachamim shello yelammed adam et bitto tora mippene sherov hannashim en datam mechuvenet lehitlammed ella hen motziot divre tora ledivre havay lefi aniyyut datan amru chachamim kal hamlammed et bitto tora keillu limmedah tiflut bamme devarim amurim betora shebbeal pe aval tora shebbichtav lo yelammed otah lechattechilla veim limmedah eno kimlammedah tiflut
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 2: Moshivin melammede tinokot bechal medina umdina uvchal pelech ufelech uvchal ir vair vechal ir sheen bah tinokot shel bet rabban machrimin et anshe hair ad shemmoshivin melammede tinokot veim lo hoshivu machrimin et hair sheen haolam mitkayyem ella behevel pihem shel tinokot shel bet rabban

Machnisin et hattinokot lehitlammed keven shesh keven sheva lefi koach habben uvinyan gufo ufachot mibben shesh en machnisim oto umakke otan hamlammed lehattil alehem ema veeno makke otam makkat oyev makkat achzari lefichach lo yakke otam beshotim velo bemaklot ella birtzua ketanna veoshev umlammedan kal hayyom kullo umiktzat min hallayela kede lechannechan lilmod bayyom uvallayela velo yibbatlu hattinokot kelal chutz mearve shabbatot veyamim tovim besof hayyamim uvyamim tovim aval beshabbat en korin battechilla aval shonin barishon veen mevattelin hattinokot vaafillu levinyan bet hammikdash

Melammed hattinokot shehu meniach hattinokot veotze o shehu ose melacha acheret immahen o shehu mitrashshel belimmudan hare ze bichlal arur ose melechet remiyya lefichach en rauy lehoshiv melammed ella baal yira mahir likrot uldakdek
Umi sheen lo ishsha lo yelammed tinokot mippene immotehem habbaot etzel benehem vechal ishsha lo telammed tinokot mippene avotehem shehem baim etzel habbanim
Esrim vachamishsha tinokot lemedim etzel melammed echad hau yoter al esrim vachamishsha ad arbaim moshivin immo acher lesayeo belimmudam hau yoter al arbaim maamidin lahem shene melammede tinokot

Molichin et hakkatan mimmelammed limlammed acher shehu mahir mimmennu ben bemikra ben bedikduk bamme devarim amurim keshehau shenehem beir achat velo haya hannahar mafsik benehem aval meir leir o mitztzad hannahar letziddo afillu beotah hair en molichin et hakkatan ella im ken haya binyan bari al gabbe hannahar binyan sheeno rauy lippol bimhera

Echad mibbene mavoy shebbikkesh leheasot melammed afillu echad mibbene hechatzer en yecholin shechenav limchot beyado vechen melammed tinokot shebba chavero ufatach bayit lelammed tinokot betziddo kede sheyyavou tinokot acherim lo o kede sheyyavou mittinokot shel ze etzel ze eno yachol limchot beyado shenneemar chafetz lemaan tzidko yagdil tora veyadir
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 3: Bishlosha ketarim nichteru yisrael keter tora vecheter kehunna vecheter malchut keter kehunna zacha bo aharon shenneemar vehayeta lo ulzaro acharav berit kehunnat olam keter malchut zacha bo david shenneemar zaro leolam yihye vechiso chashshemesh negdi keter tora hare munnach veomed umuchan lechal yisrael shenneemar tora tziva lanu moshe morasha kehillat yaakov kal mi sheyyirtze yavo veyittol shemma tomar sheotam hakketarim gedolim mikketer tora hare hu omer bi melachim yimlochu veroznim yechokku tzedek bi sarim yasoru ha lamadta shekketer tora gadol mishshenehem
Amru chachamim mamzer talmid chacham kodem lechohen gadol am haaretz shenneemar yekara hi mippeninim mikkohen gadol shennichnas lifnay velifnim
En lecha mitzva bechal hammitzot kullan shehi shekula keneged talmud tora ella talmud tora keneged kal hammitzot kullan shehattalmud mevi lide maase lefichach hattalmud kodem lemaase bechal makom
Haya lefanav asiyyat mitzva vetalmud tora im efshar lammitzva leheasot al yede acherim lo yafsik talmudo veim lav yaase hammitzva veyachazor letalmudo

Techillat dino shel adam eno niddon ella al hattalmud veachar kach al shear maasav lefichach amru chachamim leolam yaasok adam battora ben lishmah ben shello lishmah shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah

Mi shennesao libbo lekayyem mitzva zo karauy velihot muchtar becheter tora lo yassiach dato lidvarim acherim velo yasim al libbo sheyyikne tora im haosher vehakkavod keachat kach hi darkah shel tora pat bammelach tochal umayim bammesura tishte veal haaretz tishan vechayye tzaar tichye uvattora atta amel velo alecha haddavar ligmor velo atta ben chorin libbatel mimmenna veim hirbeta tora hirbeta sachar vehassachar lefi hatztzaar

Shemma tomar ad sheakabbetz mamon echezor veekra ad sheekne ma sheani tzarich veeppane measakay veechezor veekra im taale machashava zo al libbecha en atta zoche lechitrah shel tora leolam ella ase toratcha keva umlachtecha aray velo tomar lichsheeppane eshne shemma lo tippane

Katuv battora lo vashshamayim hi velo meever layyam hi lo vashshamayim hi lo begasse haruach hi metzuya velo bimhalleche meever layyam hi lefichach amru chachamim lo kal hammarbe bischora machkim vetziuu chachamim heve memaet beesek vaasok battora

Divre tora nimshelu kammayim shenneemar hoy kal tzame lechu lammayim lomar lecha ma mayim enam mitkannesin bimkom midron ella nizchalin mealav umitkabbetzim bimkom ashboren kach divre tora enam nimtzaim begasse haruach velo belev kal gevah lev ella bedakka ushfal ruach shemmitabbek baafar ragle hachachamim umesir hattaaot vetaanuge hazzeman millibbo veose melacha bechal yom meat kede chayyav im lo haya lo ma yochal ushar yomo velelo osek battora

Kal hammesim al libbo sheyyaasok battora velo yaase melacha veyitparnes min hatztzedaka hare ze chillel et hashshem uvizza et hattora vechibba meor haddat vegaram raa leatzmo venatal chayyav min haolam habba lefi sheasur lehanot middivre tora baolam hazze amru chachamim kal hannehene middivre tora natal chayyav min haolam veod tziuu veamru al taasem atara lehitgaddel bahen velo kardom lachpor bahen veod tziuu veamru ehov et hammelacha usna et harabbanut vechal tora sheen immah melacha sofah betela vegoreret aon vesof adam ze sheyehe melastem et habberiyyot

Maala gedola hi lemi shehu mitparnes mimmaase yadav umiddat chasidim harishonim hi uvaze zoche lechal kavod vetova shebbaolam hazze velaolam habba shenneemar yegia kappecha ki tochel ashrecha vetov lach ashrecha baolam hazze vetov lach laolam habba shekkullo tov

En divre tora mitkayemin bemi shemmarpe atzmo alehen velo beellu shellomdin mittoch iddun umittoch achila ushtiyya ella bemi shemmemit atzmo alehen umtzaer gufo tamid velo yitten shena leenav ulafappav tenuma amru chachamim derech remez zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel en hattora mitkayyemet ella bemi shemmemit atzmo beahole hachachamim vechen amar shelomo bechachmato hitrappita beom tzara tzar kochecha veod amar af chachmati amda li chachma shellamadti beaf hi amda li amru chachamim berit keruta shekkal hayyagea betorato bevet hammidrash lo bimhera hu meshakkeach vechal hayyagea betalmudo betzina machkim shenneemar veet tzenuim chachma vechal hammashmia kolo bishat talmudo talmudo mitkayyem beyado aval hakkore belachash bimhera hu shocheach
