Af al pi shemmitzva lilmod bayyom uvallayela en adam lamed rov chachmato ella ballayela lefichach mi sheratza lizkot becheter hattora yizzaher bechal lelotav velo yeabbed afillu echad mehen beshena vaachila ushtiyya vesicha vechayyotze bahen ella betalmud tora vedivre chachma amru chachamim en rinna shel tora ella ballayela shenneemar kumi ronni vallayela vechal haosek battora ballayela chut shel chesed nimshach alav bayyom shenneemar yomam yetzave chasdo uvallayela shiro immi tefilla leel chayyay vechal bayit sheen nishmaim bo divre tora ballayela esh ochalto shenneemar kal choshech tamun litzpunav teachlehu esh lo nuppach ki devar baza ze shello hishgiach al divre tora kal ikkar vechen kal sheefshar lo laasok battora veeno osek o shekkara veshana uferash lehavle olam veheniach talmudo uznacho hare ze bichlal boze devar amru chachamim kal hamvattel et hattora meosher sofo levattelah meoni vechal hamkayyem et hattora meoni sofo lekayemah meosher veinyan ze meforash hu battora hare hu omer tachat asher lo avadta et elohecha besimcha uvtuv levav merov kl veavadta et oyevecha veomer lemaan annotcha lehetivcha beacharitecha
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 4: En melammedin tora ella letalmid hagun nae bemaasav o letam aval im haya holech bederech lo tova machzirin oto lammutav umanhigin oto bederech yeshara uvodkin oto veachar kach machnisin oto levet hammidrash umlammedin oto amru chachamim kal hashshone letalmid sheeno hagun keillu zarak even lemarkulis shenneemar kitzror even bemargema ken noten lichsil kavod veen kavod ella tora shenneemar kavod chachamim yinchalu vechen harav sheeno holech bederech tova af al pi shechacham gadol hu vechal haam tzerichin lo en mitlammedin mimmennu ad shuvo lammutav shenneemar ki sifte chohen yishmeru daat vetora yevakshu mippihu ki malach tzevaot hu amru chachamim im harav dome lemalach tzevaot tora yevakkeshu mippihu im lav al yevakkeshu tora mippihu

Ketzad melammedim harav yoshev barosh vehattalmidim mukkafim lefanav kaatara kede sheyehu kullam roim harav veshomim devarav velo yeshev harav al hakkisse vetalmidav al hakkarka ella o hakkol al haaretz o hakkol al hakkisot uvarishona haya harav yoshev vehattalmidim omdim umikkodem churban bayit sheni nahagu hakkol lelammed lattalmidim vehem yoshvim

Im haya melammed mippiv lattalmidim melammed veim haya melammed al pi hamtargem omed beno uven hattalmidim veharav omer lamtargem vehamtargem mashmia lechal hattalmidim uchshehem shoalin lamtargem hu shoel larav veharav meshiv lamtargem vehamtargem meshiv lashshoel velo yagbiha harav kolo yoter mikkol hamtargem velo yagbiha hamtargem kolo beet sheshshoel et harav yoter mikkol harav en hamtargem rashshay lo lifchot velo lehosif velo leshannot ella im ken haya hamturgeman aviv shel chacham o rabbo omer harav lamturgeman kach amar li rabbi o kach amar li abba mari uchsheomer hamturgeman haddevarim laam omer beshem hechacham umazkir shemo shel avi harav o shel rabbo veomer kach amar rabbana peloni af al pi shello hizkir harav shemo shel chacham sheasur likrot lerabbo o leaviv bishmo

Harav shellimmed velo hevinu hattalmidim lo yichos alehem veyirgaz ella chozer veshone haddavar afillu kamma peamim ad sheyyavinu omek hahalacha vechen lo yomar hattalmid hevanti vehu lo hevin ella chozer veshoel afillu kamma peamim veim kaas alav rabbo veragaz yomar lo rabbi tora hi velilmod ani tzarich vedati ketzara

Lo yihye hattalmid bosh mechaverav shellamdu mippaam rishona o sheniyya vehu lo lamad ella achar kamma peamim sheim nitbayyesh middavar ze nimtza nichnas veotze levet hammidrash vehu eno lamed kelum lefichach amru chachamim harishonim en habbayeshan lamed velo hakkappedan melammed bamme devarim amurim bizman shello hevinu hattalmidim haddavar mippene amko o mippene datan shehi ketzara aval im nikkar larav shehem mitrashshelin bedivre tora umitrappin alehen ulfichach lo hevinu chayyav lirgoz alehen ulhachliman bidvarim kede lechaddedam uchinyan ze amru chachamim zerok mara battalmidim lefichach en rauy larav linhog kallut rosh lifne hattalmidim velo lischok bifnehem velo leechol velishtot immahem kede shettehe emato alehen veyilmedu mimmennu bimhera

En shoalin et harav kesheyyikkanes lammidrash ad shettityashshev dato alav veen hattalmid shoel kesheyyikkanes ad sheyyityashshev veyanuach veen shoalin shenayim keechad veen shoalin et harav meinyan acher ella meoto hainyan shehen asukin bo kede shello yitbayyesh veyesh larav lehatot et hattalmidim bishelotav uvammaasim sheose bifnehem kede lechaddedan uchde sheyyeda im zochrim hem ma shellimmedam o enam zochrim veen tzarich lomar sheyyesh lo reshut lishl otam beinyan acher sheen oskin bo kede lezarzam

En shoalin meummad veen meshivin meummad velo miggavoha velo merachok velo meachore hazzekenim veen shoalin harav ella beinyan shehen korin bo veen shoalin ella miyyira velo yishal bainyan yoter mishshalosh halachot

Shenayim sheshshaalu shaal echad kainyan veshaal echad shello kainyan nizkakin lainyan maase vesheeno maase nizkakin lammaase halacha umidrash nizkakin lahalacha midrash veaggada nizkakin lammidrash aggada vekal vachomer nizkakin lakkal vachomer kal vachomer ugzera shava nizkakin lakkal vachomer hau hashshoalin shenayim echad chacham veechad talmid nizkakin lechacham talmid veam haaretz nizkakin lattalmid shenehem chachamim shenehem talmidim shenehem amme haaretz shaalu shenehem bishte halachot o bishte teshuvot o bishte sheelot shene maasim harshut beyad hamtargem meatta

En yeshenim bevet hammidrash vechal hammitnamnem bevet hammidrash chachmato naaset keraim keraim vechen amar shelomo bechachmato ukraim talbish numa veen mesichin bevet hammidrash ella bedivre tora bilvad afillu mi shennitattesh en omrim lo refua bevet hammidrash veen tzarich lomar shear haddevarim ukdushshat bet hammidrash chamura mikkedushshat batte kenesiyyot
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 5: Keshem sheadam metzuve bichvod aviv veyirato kach hu chayyav bichvod rabbo veyirato yeter meaviv sheaviv mevio lechayye haolam hazze verabbo shellimmedo chachma mevio lechayye haolam habba raa avedat aviv vaavedat rabbo shel rabbo kodemet leshel aviv aviv verabbo nosim bemassa meniach et shel rabbo veachar kach shel aviv aviv verabbo shevuyim bashshivya pode et rabbo veachar kach pode et aviv veim haya aviv talmid chacham pode et aviv techilla vechen im haya aviv talmid chacham af al pi sheeno shakul keneged rabbo meshiv avedato veachar kach meshiv avedat rabbo veen lecha kavod gadol mikkevod harav velo mora mimmora harav amru chachamim mora rabbach kemora shamayim lefichach amru kal hacholek al rabbo kecholek al hashshechina shenneemar behatztzotam al vechal haose meriva im rabbo keose meriva im hashshechina shenneemar asher ravu vene yisrael et vayyikkadesh bam vechal hammitraem al rabbo kemitraem al shenneemar lo alenu telunotechem ki al vechal hamharher achar rabbo keillu meharher achar shechina shenneemar vayedabber haam belohim uvmshe

Ezehu cholek al rabbo ze shekkovea lo midrash veoshev vedoresh umlammed shello birshut rabbo verabbo kayyam veaf al pi sherabbo bimdina acheret veasur laadam lehorot bifne rabbo leolam vechal hammore halacha bifne rabbo chayyav mita

Haya beno uven rabbo shenem asar mil veshaal lo adam devar halacha muttar lehashiv ulhafrish min haissur afillu bifne rabbo muttar lehorot ketzad kegon sheraa adam ose davar haasur mippene shello yada beissuro o mippene risho yesh lo lehafrisho velomar lo davar ze asur vaafillu bifne rabbo veaf al pi shello natan lo rabbo reshut shekkal makom sheyyesh chillul hashshem en cholkin kavod larav bamme devarim amurim bedavar shennikra mikre aval likboa atzmo lehoraa veleshev ulhorot lechal shoel afillu hu besof haolam verabbo besof haolam asur lo lehorot ad sheyyamut rabbo ella im ken natal reshut merabbo velo kal mi shemmet rabbo muttar lo leshev ulhorot battora ella im ken haya talmid shehiggia lehoraa

Vechal talmid shello higgia lehoraa umore hare ze rasha shote vegas haruach vealav neemar ki rabbim chalalim hippila vego vechen chacham shehiggia lehoraa veeno more hare ze monea tora venoten michsholot lifne haivverim vealav neemar vaatzumim kal harugeha ellu hattalmidim hakketannim shello hirbu tora karauy vehem mevakkeshim lehitgaddel bifne amme haaretz uven anshe iram vekoftzin veoshvin barosh ledin ulhorot beyisrael hem hammarbim hammachaloket vehem hammacharivim et haolam vehamchabbin nerah shel tora vehamchabbelim kerem tzevaot alehem amar shelomo bechachmato echezu lanu shualim shualim ketannim mechabbelim keramim

Veasur lo letalmid likrot lerabbo bishmo vaafillu shello befanav vehu sheyyihye hashshem peli shekkal hashshomea yeda shehu peloni velo yazkir shemo befanav vaafillu likrot laacherim sheshshemam keshem rabbo kederech sheose beshem aviv ella yeshanne et shemam afillu leachar motam velo yitten shalom lerabbo o yachazir lo shalom kederech shennotnim lereim umachazirim ze laze ella shoche lefanav veomer lo beyira vechavod shalom alecha rabbi veim natan lo rabbo shalom yachazir lo shalom alecha rabbi umori

Vechen lo yachalotz tefillav lifne rabbo velo yasev ella yoshev keoshev lifne hammelech velo yitpallel lo lifne rabbo velo leachar rabbo velo betzad rabbo veen tzarich lomar sheasur lo lehallech betziddo ella yitrachek leachar rabbo velo yehe mechaven keneged achorav veachar kach yitpallel velo yikkanes im rabbo bammerchatz velo yeshev bimkom rabbo velo yachria devarav befanav velo yistor et devarav velo yeshev lefanav ad sheyyomar lo shev velo yaamod millefanav ad sheyyomar lo amod o ad sheyyittol reshut laamod uchsheyyippater merabbo lo yachazor lo laachorav ella nirta laachorav ufanav keneged panav
Vechayyav laamod mippene rabbo mishsheyyirennu merachok melo enav ad sheyyitkasse mimmennu velo yire komato veachar kach yeshev vechayyav adam lehakbil pene rabbo baregel

En cholkin kavod letalmid bifne rabbo ella im ken derech rabbo lachalok lo kavod vechal hammelachot shehaeved ose lerabbo talmid ose lerabbo veim haya bemakom sheen makkirin oto velo hau lo tefillin vechash shemma yomru eved hu eno noel lo minalo veeno choltzo vechal hammonea talmido milleshammesho monea mimmennu chesed uforek mimmennu yirat shamayim vechal talmid shemmezalzel davar mikkal kevod rabbo gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael

Raa rabbo over al divre tora omer lo limmadtanu rabbenu kach vechach vechal zeman shemmazkir shemua befanav omer lo kach limmadtanu rabbenu veal yomar davar shello shama merabbo ad sheyyazkir shem omro uchsheyyamut rabbo korea kal begadav ad shehu megalle et libbo veeno meache leolam bamme devarim amurim berabbo muvhak shellamad mimmennu rov chachmato aval im lo lamad mimmennu rov chachmato hare ze talmid chaver veeno chayyav bichvodo bechal ellu haddevarim aval omed millefanav vekorea alav keshem shehu korea al kal hammetim shehu mitabbel alehem afillu lo lamad mimmennu ella davar echad ben katan ben gadol omed millefanav vekorea alav
Vechal talmid chacham sheddeotav mechuvanot eno medabber bifne mi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma af al pi shello lamad mimmennu kelum

Harav hammuvhak sheratza limchol al kevodo bechal haddevarim haellu o beechad mehen lechal talmidav o leechad mehen harshut beyado veaf al pi shemmachal chayyav hattalmid lehaddero vaafillu beshaa shemmachal

Keshem shehattalmidim chayyavin bichvod harav kach harav tzarich lechabbed et talmidav ulkarvan kach amru chachamim yehi kevod talmidcha chaviv alecha keshellecha vetzarich adam lehizzaher betalmidav ulahovam shehem habbanim hamhannim laolam hazze velaolam habba

Hattalmidim mosifin chachmat harav umarchivin libbo amru chachamim harbe chachma lamadti merabbotay veoter mechaveray umittalmiday yoter mikkullam uchshem sheetz katan madlik et haggadol kach talmid katan mechadded harav ad sheyyotzi mimmennu bishelotav chachma mefoara
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 6: Kal talmid chacham mitzva lehaddero veaf al pi sheeno rabbo shenneemar mippene seva takum vehadarta pene zaken zaken ze shekkana chachma umeematay chayyavin laamod mippanav mishsheyyikrav mimmennu bearba ammot ad sheyyaavor mikkeneged panav

En omdin mippanav lo bevet hammerchatz velo bevet hakkisse shenneemar takum vehadarta kima sheyyesh bah hiddur veen baale ummanuyyot chayyavin laamod mippene talmide chachamim beshaa sheoskin bimlachtan shenneemar takum vehadarta ma hiddur sheen bah chesron kis af kima sheen bah chesron kis uminnayin shello yaatzim enav min hechacham kede shello yirehu ad shello yaamod mippanav shenneemar veyareta meelohecha ha kal davar shehu masur lallev neemar bo veyareta meelohecha

En rauy lechacham sheyyatriach et haam vichaven atzmo lahen kede sheyyaamdu mippanav ella yelech bederech ketzara umitkaven shello yiru oto kede shello yatrichen laamod vehachachamim hau makkifin veholchin bederech hachitzona sheen makkirehen metzuyin sham kede shello yatrichum
Rochev hare hu kimhallech uchshem sheomdim mippene hamhallech kach omdin mippene harochev
Shelosha shehau holchin badderech harav baemtza gadol mimino vekatan missemolo

Haroe chacham eno omed mippanav ad sheyyaggia lo learba ammot vechevan sheavar yoshev raa av bet din omed millefanav mishsheyyirennu merachok melo enav veeno yoshev ad sheyyaavor meacharav arba ammot raa et hannasi omed millefanav melo enav veeno yoshev ad sheyyeshev bimkomo o ad sheyyitkasse meenav vehannasi shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul keshehannasi nichnas kal haam omdim veenan yoshvin ad sheyyomar lahem shevu kesheav bet din nichnas osin lo shette shurot veomdin mikkan umikkan ad shennichnas veoshev bimkomo ushar haam yoshvin bimkoman

Chacham shennichnas kal sheyyaggia lo bearba ammot omed millefanav echad omed veechad yoshev ad shennichnas veoshev bimkomo bene chachamim vetalmide chachamim bizman sheharabbim tzerichin lahem mekappetzin al rashe haam venichnasim limkomam veen shevach letalmide chachamim sheyyikkansu laacharona yatza letzorech chozer limkomo bene chachamim bizman sheyyesh bahen daat lishmoa hofchin penehen kelappe avihen en bahen daat lishmoa hofchin penehen kelappe haam
Talmid shehu yoshev lifne rabbo tamid eno rashshay laamod mippanav ella shacharit vearvit bilvad shello yehe kevodo merubbe mikkevod shamayim

Mi shehu zaken muflag bezikna af al pi sheeno chacham omdin lefanav vaafillu hechacham shehu yeled omed bifne hazzaken hammuflag bezikna veeno chayyav laamod melo komato ella kede lehaddero vaafillu zaken kuti mehadderin oto bidvarim venotnin lo yad lesamcho shenneemar mippene seva takum kal seva bemashma

Talmide chachamim enam yotzin beatzman laasot im kal hakkahal bevinyan vachafira shel medina vechayyotze bahen kede shello yitbazzu bifne amme haaretz veen govin mehen levinyan hachoma vetikkun hashshearim uschar hashshomrim vechayyotze bahen velo litshurat hammelech veen mechayevim otan litten hammas ben mas shehu katzuv al bene hair ben mas shehu katzuv al kal ish vaish shenneemar gam ki yitnu vaggoyim atta akabbetzem vayyachellu meat mimmassa melech vesarim vechen im hayeta sechora letalmid chacham menichim oto limkor techilla veen menichim echad mibbene hashshuk limkor ad sheyyimkor hu vechen im haya lo din vehaya omed bichlal baale dinim harbe makdimin oto umoshivin oto

Aon gadol hu levazzot et hachachamim o lisnotan lo charva yerushalayim ad shebbizzu bah talmide chachamim shenneemar vayyihu malivim bemalache haelohim uvozim devarav umittateim binviav kelomar bozim melammede devarav vechen ze sheamra tora im bechukkotay timasu melammede chukkotay timasu vechal hamvazze et hachachamim en lo chelek laolam habba vahare hu bichlal ki devar baza

Af al pi shehamvazze et hachachamim en lo chelek laolam habba im bau edim shebbizzahu afillu bidvarim chayyav nidduy umnaddin oto bet din barabbim vekonsin oto litra zahav bechal makom venotnin otah lechacham vehamvazze et hechacham bidvarim afillu leachar mita menaddin oto bet din vehem mattirim oto kesheyyachazor bitshuva aval im haya hechacham chay en mattirin oto ad sheyeratztze ze shennidduhu bishvilo vechen hechacham atzmo menadde lichvodo leam haaretz shehifkir bo veen tzarich lo edim velo hatraa veen mattirin lo ad sheyeratztze et hechacham veim met hechacham bain shelosha umattirin lo veim ratza hechacham limchol lo velo niddahu harshut beyado

Harav shennidda lichvodo kal talmidav chayyavin linhog nidduy bamnudde aval talmid shennidda lichvod atzmo en harav chayyav linhog bo nidduy aval kal haam chayyavin linhog bo nidduy vechen menudde lenasi menudde lechal yisrael menudde lechal yisrael eno menudde lannasi menudde leiro menudde leir acheret menudde leir acheret eno menudde leiro

Bamme devarim amurim bemi shennidduhu al shebbizza talmide chachamim aval mi shennidduhu al shear devarim shechayyavim alehem nidduy afillu niddahu katan shebbeyisrael chayyav hannasi vechal yisrael linhog bo nidduy ad sheyyachazor bitshuva middavar shennidduhu bishvilo veyattiru lo al esrim vearbaa devarim menaddin et haadam ben ish ben ishsha veellu hen hamvazze et hechacham vaafillu leachar moto v hamvazze sheliach bet din g hakkore lachavero eved d mi sheshshalchu lo bet din vekavu lo zeman velo ba hamzalzel bedavar echad middivre sofrim veen tzarich lomar bedivre tora v mi shello kibbel alav et haddin menaddin oto ad sheyyitten z mi sheyyesh birshuto davar hammazzik kegon kelev ra o sullam raua menaddin oto ad sheyyasir hezzeko ch hammocher karka shello leoved kochavim menaddin oto ad sheyekabbel alav kal ones sheyyavo min haoved kochavim leyisrael chavero baal hammetzar t hammeid al yisrael bearkaot shel ovde kochavim vehotzi mimmennu beeduto mamon shello kedin yisrael menaddin oto ad sheyeshallem y tabbach kohen sheeno mafrish hammattanot venotnan lechohen acher menaddin oto ad sheyyitten y hamchallel yom tov sheni shel galuyyot af al pi shehu minhag yv haose melacha beerev happesach achar chatzot yg hammazkir shem shamayim levattala o lishvua bedivre havay yd hammevi et harabbim lide chillul hashshem tv hammevi et harabbim lide achilat kadashim bachutz tz hamchashshev shanim vekovea chodashim bechutza laaretz yz hammachishil et haiver ych hamakkev harabbim millaasot mitzva yt tabbach sheyyatza terefa mittachat yado ch tabbach shello badak sakkino lifne chacham ch hammakshe atzmo ledaat chv mi sheggeresh et ishto veasa beno uvenah shuttafut o massa umattan hammeviin lahen lehizzakek ze laze kesheyyavou levet din menaddin otam chg chacham sheshshemuato raa chd hamnadde mi sheeno chayyav nidduy
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 7: Chacham zaken bechachma vechen nasi o av bet din shessarach en menaddin oto befarhesya leolam ella im ken asa keyaravam ben nevat vachaverav aval keshechata shear chattaot malkin oto betzina shenneemar vechashalta hayyom vechashal gam navi immecha layela af al pi shekkashal kassehu kelayela veomrim lo hikkaved veshev bevetcha vechen kal talmid chacham shennitchayyev nidduy asur levet din likpotz ulnaddoto bimhera ella borchin middavar ze venishmatin mimmennu vachaside hachachamim hau mishtabbechim shello nimnu meolam lenaddot talmid chacham af al pi shennimnin lehalkoto im nitchayyev malkot vaafillu makkat mardut nimnin alav lehakkoto
Vechetzad hu hannidduy omer peloni yehe beshammata veim nidduhu befanav omer lo peloni ze beshammata vehacherem omer lo peloni muchram vearur bo ala bo shevua bo nidduy
Vechetzad mattirin hannidduy o hacherem omer lo sharuy lecha umachul lecha veim hittiruhu shello befanav omer lo peloni sharuy lo umachul lo

Mahu hamminhag sheyyinhog hamnudde beatzmo veshennohagin immo menudde asur lesapper ulchabbes keavel kal yeme nidduo veen mezammenin alav velo kollin oto baasara lechal davar shetztzarich asara velo yoshvin immo bearba ammot aval shone hu laacherim veshonin lo veniskar vesocher veim met benidduy bet din sholchin umannichin even al arono kelomar shehen rogmin oto lefi shehu muvdal min hatztzibbur veen tzarich lomar sheen maspidin oto veen melavin et mittato

Yoter alav hammuchram sheeno shone laacherim veen shonin lo aval shone hu leatzmo shello yishkach talmudo veeno niskar veen niskarin lo veen nosin venotnin immo veen mitassekin immo ella meat esek kede parnasato
Mi sheyyashav benidduy sheloshim yom velo bikkesh lehattiro menaddin oto sheniyya yashav sheloshim yom acherim velo bikkesh lehattiro machrimin oto
Bechamma mattirin hannidduy o hacherem bishlosha afillu hedotot veyachid mumche mattir hannidduy o hacherem levaddo veyesh letalmid lehattir hannidduy o hacherem vaafillu bimkom harav
Shelosha shenniddu vehalchu lahen vechazar ze middavar shennidduhu biglalo bain shelosha acherim umattirin lo
Mi shello yada mi shenniddahu yelech lo etzel hannasi veyattir lo nidduo
Nidduy al tenay afillu al pi atzmo tzarich hafara talmid chacham shennidda atzmo vaafillu nidda atzmo al daat peloni vaafillu al davar shechayyav alav nidduy hare ze mefer leatzmo

Mi shennidduhu bachalom afillu yada mi niddahu tzarich asara bene adam sheshshonin halachot lehattiro minnidduo veim lo matza toreach acharehem ad parsa lo matza mattirim lo afillu asara sheshshonim mishna lo matza mattirin lo asara sheyyodim likrot battora lo matza mattirin lo afillu asara sheenan yodin likrot lo matza bimkomo asara mattirin lo afillu shelosha

Mi shennidduhu befanav en mattirin lo ella befanav nidduhu shello befanav mattirin lo befanav veshello befanav veen ben nidduy lahafara kelum ella menaddin umattirin berega echad kesheyyachazor hamnudde lammutav veim rau bet din lehanniach ze benidduy kamma shanim mannichin kefi risho vechen im rau bet din lehacharim laze lechattechilla ulhacharim mi sheyyochal immo veshote immo o mi sheyyaamod immo bearba ammot machrimin kede leyassero uchde laasot seyag lattora ad shello yifretzu hachotim af al pi sheyyesh reshut lechacham lenaddot lichvodo eno shevach letalmid chacham lehanhig atzmo bedavar ze ella maalim aznav middivre am haaretz velo yashit libbo lahen kainyan sheamar shelomo bechachmato gam lechal haddevarim asher yedabberu al titten libbecha vechen haya derech chasidim harishonim shomim cherpatam veenan meshivin velo od ella shemmochalim lamcharef vesolchim lo vachachamim gedolim hau mishtabbechim bemaasehem hannaim veomrim shemmeolam lo niddu adam velo hechrimuhu lichvodan vezo hi darkam shel talmide chachamim sherauy lelech bah bamme devarim amurim keshebbizzahu o cherfahu basseter aval talmid chacham shebbizzahu o cherfo adam befarhesya asur lo limchol al kevodo veim machal neenash shezze bizon tora ella nokem venoter haddavar kenachash ad sheyevakkesh mimmennu mechila veyislach lo
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 1: Mitzvat ase min hattora levarech achar achilat mazon shenneemar veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha veeno chayyav min hattora ella im ken sava shenneemar veachalta vesavata uverachta umiddivre sofrim achal afillu kezayit mevarech acharav

Umiddivre sofrim levarech al kal maachal techilla veachar kach yehane mimmennu vaafillu nitkaven leechol o lishtot kal shehu mevarech veachar kach yehane vechen im heriach reach tov mevarech veachar kach yehane mimmennu vechal hannehene belo beracha maal vechen middivre sofrim levarech achar kal ma sheyyochal vechal ma sheyyishte vehu sheyyishte reviit vehu sheyyochal kezayit umatemet enah tzericha beracha lo lefaneha velo leachareha ad reviit

Uchshem shemmevarchin al hahanaya kach mevarchin al kal mitzva umitzva veachar kach yaase otah uvrachot rabbot tikkenu chachamim derech shevach vehodaya vederech bakkasha kede lizkor et habbore tamid af al pi shello nehena velo asa mitzva
Nimtzeu kal habberachot kullan shelosha minim birchot hanaya uvirchot mitzot uvirchot hodaa shehen derech shevach vehodaya uvakkasha kede lizkor et habbore tamid ulyira mimmennu

Venosach kal habberachot ezra uvet dino tikkenum veen rauy leshannotam velo lehosif al achat mehem velo ligroa mimmenna vechal hamshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim babberachot eno ella toe vechal beracha sheen bah hazkarat hashshem umalchut enah beracha ella im ken hayeta semucha lachavertah

Kal haochel davar haasur ben bezadon ben bishgaga eno mevarech alav lo battechilla velo bassof ketzad hare sheachal tevel shel divrehem o sheachal maaser rishon shello nittelu terumotav o maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu kehilchatan eno mevarech veen tzarich lomar im achal nevelot utrefot o shata yen nesech vechayyotze bo

Aval im achal demay af al pi sheeno rauy ella laaniyyim o maaser rishon shennittela terumato af al pi shello nittal mimmennu cheshbon teruma gedola vehu shehikdimo beshibbolin o maaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu af al pi shello natan et hachomesh hare ze mevarech techilla vasof vechen kal keotze bahen
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 2: Seder birkat hammazon kach hi rishona birkat hazzan sheniyya birkat haaretz shelishit bone yerushalayim reviit hattov vehammetiv beracha rishona moshe rabbenu tikkenah sheniyya tikken yehoshua shelishit tikken david ushlomo beno reviit chachme mishna tikkenuha

Happoalim shehau osin melacha etzel baal habbayit veachlu pittan en mevarchin lefaneha umvarchin leachar seuddatan shette berachot bilvad kede shello yevattelu melechet baal habbayit beracha rishona ketikkunah sheniyya poteach bevirkat haaretz vecholel bah bone yerushalayim vechotem bevirkat haaretz veim hau osin bisuddatan bilvad o shehaya baal habbayit mesev immahen mevarchin arba berachot ketikkunan kishar kal adam

Birkat haaretz tzarich lomar hodaya bitchillatah uvsofah vechotem bah al haaretz veal hammazon vechal shello amar eretz chemda tova urchava bevirkat haaretz lo yatza yede chovato vetzarich lehazkir bah berit vetora ulhakdim berit letora shehabberit hazzot sheomrim bevirkat haaretz hi berit mila shennichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot vehattora kullah nichretu aleha shalosh beritot shenneemar elle divre habberit vego millevad habberit asher karat ittam bechorev attem nitztzavim vego leavrecha bivrit vego

Beracha shelishit poteach bah rachem Adonai elohenu alenu veal yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha veal tziyyon mishkan kevodecha o nachamenu Adonai elohenu birushalayim irecha vechotem bah bone yerushalayim o menachem ammo yisrael bevinyan yerushalayim ulfichach nikret beracha zo nechama vechal mi shello amar malchut bet david bivracha zo lo yatza yede chovato mippene shehi inyan habberacha sheen nechama gemura ella bachazarat malchut bet david

Beshabbatot uvyamim tovim matchil benechama umsayyem benechama veomer kedushshat hayyom baemtza ketzad matchil nachamenu Adonai elohenu betziyyon irecha o rachem Adonai elohenu al yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha umsayyem menachem ammo yisrael bevinyan yerushalayim o bone yerushalayim veomer baemtza beshabbat elohenu velohe avotenu retze vehachalitzenu Adonai elohenu bemitzotecha uvmitzvat yom hashshevii haggadol vehakkadosh hazze ki yom ze gadol vekadosh hu millefanecha nishbot bo venanuach bo beahava kemitzvat retzonecha birtzoncha hanach lanu Adonai elohenu veal tehe alenu tzara veraa veyagon vaanacha beom menuchatenu uvyamim tovim omer yaale veyavo vechen berashe chodashim uvchullo shel moed mosif beemtza beracha shelishit yaale veyavo

Bachanukka uvfurim mosif beemtza birkat haaretz al hannissim kederech shemmosif battefilla veom tov o rosh chodesh shechal lihot beshabbat mazkir retze vehachalitzenu techilla veachar kach yaale veyavo vechen rosh chodesh tevet shechal lihot beshabbat mazkir al hannissim bevirkat haaretz urtze vehachalitzenu veyaale veyavo benechama

Beracha reviit tzarich lehazkir bah shalosh malchuyyot uchshemmevarech haoreach etzel baal habbayit mosif bah beracha levaal habbayit ketzad omer yehi ratzon shello yevosh baal habbayit baolam hazze velo yikkalem laolam habba vechu veyesh lo reshut lehosif bevirkat baal habbayit ulhaarich bah

Uchshemmevarchin bevet haavel omer bivracha reviit hammelech hachay hattov vehammetiv el emet dayan emet shofet betzedek shallit beolamo laasot bo kirtzono sheanachnu ammo vaavadav uvakkol anachnu chayyavin lehodot lo ulvarcho umvakkesh rachamim al haavel lenachamo kefi ma sheyyirtze vegomer harachaman chu

Bevet chatanim mevarchin birkat chatanim achar arba berachot ellu bechal seudda usudda sheochlim sham veen mevarchin beracha zo lo avadim velo ketannim ad kamma mevarchin beracha zo im haya almon shennasa almana mevarchin otah beom rishon bilvad veim bachur shennasa almana o almon shennasa betula mevarchin otah kal shivat yeme hammishte

Beracha zo shemmosifin bevet chatanim hi beracha acharona mishsheva berachot shel nissuin bamme devarim amurim keshehau haochlin hem sheamdu bevirkat nissuin veshamu habberachot aval im hau haochlin acherim shello shamu birkat nissuin bishat nissuin mevarchin bishvilam achar birkat mazon sheva berachot kederech shemmevarchin bishat nissuin vehu sheyyihu asara vachatanim min hamminyan

Veellu hen sheva berachot baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam yotzer haadam baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shehakkol bara lichvodo baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher yatzar et haadam betzalmo betzelem demut tavnito vehitkin lo mimmennu binyan ade ad baruch atta Adonai yotzer haadam sos tasis vetagel akara bekibbutz baneha letochah besimcha atta Adonai mesammeach tziyyon bevaneha sammeach tesammach reim vaahuvim kesammechacha yetzircha began eden mikkedem baruch atta Adonai mesammeach chatan vechalla baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bara sason vesimcha chatan vechalla gila verinna ditza vechedva ahava achava shalom vereut mehera Adonai elohenu yishshama beare yehuda uvchutzot yerushalayim kol sason vekol simcha kol chatan vekol kalla kol mitzhalot mechuppatam unarim minneginatam baruch atta Adonai mesammeach chatan im hakkalla

Shachach velo hizkir beshabbat o beom tov kedushshat hayyom im nizkar kodem sheyyatchil bivracha reviit beshabbat omer baruch Adonai asher natan menucha leammo yisrael leot velivrit kodesh baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hashshabbat beom tov omer baruch asher natan yamim tovim leammo yisrael lesashon ulsimcha baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim umatchil bevirkat reviit vegomer veim nizkar achar shehitchil bivracha reviit posek vechozer larosh shehu birkat hazzan

Mi sheachal veshachach velo berech im nizkar kodem sheyyitakkel hammaachal shebbemeav chozer umvarech nitakkel hammazon shebbemeav eno chozer umvarech vechen im neelam mimmennu velo yada im berech o lo berech chozer umvarech vehu shello nitakkel hammazon shebbemeav
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 3: Chamishsha minin hen hachittin vehasseorin vehakkussemin veshibbolet shual veshipon hakkussemin mimmin hachittin veshibbolet shual veshipon mimmin hasseorim vachamishsha minin haellu keshehen shibbolim nikraim tevua bechal makom veachar sheddashin vezorin otan nikrain dagan uchshettochanin otan velashin et kimchan veofin otan nikrain pat vehappat hannaase meechad mehen hi hannikret pat bechal makom belo liuuy

Ketzad hi hattefela sheenah meorevet hare shetztzarich leechol dag maliach veachal happat immo kede shello yazzik hammelach gerono ulshono hare ze mevarech al hammaliach ufoter et happat mippene shehappat tefela lo vechen kal kayyotze baze

Issa shenneefet bakkarka kemo shehaarviyyim shochne hammidbarot ofim hoil veen aleha tzurat pat mevarech aleha battechilla bore mine mezonot veim kava mezono aleha mevarech hammotzi vechen issa shellashah bidvash o beshemen o bechalav o sheerev bah mine tavlin vaafaah vehi hannikret pat habbaa bechisnin af al pi shehu pat mevarech aleha bore mine mezonot veim kava seuddato aleha mevarech hammotzi

Orez shebbishshelo o sheasa mimmennu pat battechilla mevarech alav bore mine mezonot ulvassof bore nefashot uvilvad shello yehe meorav im davar acher ella orez levaddo aval pat dochan o pat shel shear mine kitnit battechilla mevarech shehakkol ulvassof bore nefashot rabbot

Kal shemmevarchin alav battechilla hammotzi mevarchin leacharav bassof birkat hammazon kesidrah arba berachot vechal shemmevarchin alav battechilla bore mine mezonot mevarchin bassof leacharav beracha achat meen shalosh chutz min haorez

Vezo hi beracha achat meen shalosh baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam al hammichya veal hakkalkala veal eretz chemda tova urchava sheratzita veshehinchalta et avotenu rachem Adonai elohenu alenu veal yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha veal tziyyon mishkan kevodecha vehaalenu letochah vesammechenu bevinyanah unvarechcha aleha bikdushsha uvtahora baruch atta Adonai al haaretz veal hammichya uvshabbatot veyamim tovim omer bivracha zo bichlalah meen kedushshat hayyom kederech shemmazkir bevirkat hammazon
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 4: Kal hamvarech birkat hammazon o beracha achat meen shalosh tzarich levarech otah bammakom sheachal achal keshehu mehallech yoshev bemakom sheppasak vivarech achal keshehu omed yoshev bimkomo vivarech shachach levarech birkat hammazon venizkar kodem sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav mevarech bammakom shennizkar veim haya mezid chozer limkomo umvarech veim berech bammakom shennizkar yatza yede chovato vechen im berech keshehu omed o keshehu mehallech yatza yede chovato ulchattechilla lo yevarech birkat hammazon velo beracha shemmeen shalosh ella keshehu yoshev uvammakom sheachal

Mi shennistappek lo im berech hammotzi o lo berech hammotzi eno chozer umvarech mippene sheeno min hattora shachach levarech hammotzi im nizkar ad shello gamar seuddato chozer umvarech veim nizkar leachar sheggamar eno chozer umvarech

Haya ochel bevayit ze ufasak seuddato vehalach levayit acher o shehaya ochel ukraahu chavero ledabber immo veyatza lo lefetach beto vechazar hoil veshinna mekomo tzarich levarech lemafrea al ma sheachal vechozer umvarech battechilla hammotzi veachar kach yigmor seuddato

Chaverim shehau yoshvim leechol veyatzu likrat chatan o likrat kalla im hinnichu sham zaken o chole chozrin limkoman vegomrin seuddatan veenan tzerichin levarech sheniyya veim lo hinnichu sham adam keshehen yotzin tzerichin beracha lemafrea uchshehen chozrin tzerichin beracha lechattechilla

Vechen im hau mesubbin bishtiyya o leechol perot shekkal hamshanne mekomo hare pasak achilato ulfichach mevarech lemafrea al ma sheachal vechozer umvarech sheniyya lechattechilla al ma shehu tzarich leechol vehamshanne mekomo mippinna lefinna bevayit echad eno tzarich lachazor ulvarech achal bemizrachah shel teena uva leechol bemaaravah tzarich lachazor ulvarech

Berech al happat patar et happarperet sheochlin bahen happat mimmine hattavshil uferot vechayyotze bahen aval im berech al happarperet lo patar et happat berech al maase kedera patar et hattavshil berech al hattavshil lo patar et maase kedera

Gamar belibbo milleechol o millishtot veachar kach nimlach leechol o lishtot af al pi shello shinna mekomo chozer umvarech veim lo gamar belibbo ella dato lachazor leechol velishtot afillu pasak kal hayyom kullo eno tzarich levarech shenit

Hau shotin veamru bou unvarech birkat hammazon o bou unkaddesh kiddush hayyom neesar alehem lishtot ad sheyevarchu o yekaddeshu veim ratzu lachazor velishtot kodem sheyevarchu o yekaddeshu af al pi sheenam rashshaim tzerichim lachazor ulvarech techilla bore peri haggafen veachar kach yishtu aval im amru bou venavdil en tzerichin lachazor ulvarech

Hau mesubbin lishtot yayin uva lahen min yayin acher kegon shehau shotin adom veheviu shachor o yashan veheviu chadash enan tzerichin levarech birkat hayyayin paam sheniyya aval mevarchin baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hattov vehammetiv

En mevarchin al ochel min kal haochalin velo al mashke min kal hammashkin ad sheyyavo lefanav veim berech veachar kach hevio lefanav tzarich lachazor ulvarech natal ochel uverech alav venafal miyyado venisraf o shetafo nahar notel acher vechozer umvarech alav af al pi shehu meoto hammin vetzarich lomar baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed al beracha rishona kede shello lehotzi shem shamayim levattala omed adam al ammat hammayim umvarech veshote af al pi shehammayim shehau lefanav bishat habberacha enam hammayim sheshshata mippene shellechach nitkaven techilla

Devarim habbaim betoch hasseudda vehen mechamat hasseudda enan tzerichin beracha lifnehem velo leacharehem ella birkat hammotzi shebbattechilla uvirkat hammazon shebbassof poteret hakkol shehakkol tefela lasseudda udvarim sheenan mechamat hasseudda shebbau betoch hasseudda teunin beracha lifnehem velo leacharehem udvarim habbaim leachar hasseudda ben mechamat hasseudda ben shello mechamat hasseudda teunin beracha lifnehen ulacharehem

Beshabbatot uvyamim tovim uvisudat hakkazat haddam uvshaa sheyyatza min hammerchatz vechayyotze bahen sheadam kovea seuddato al hayyayin im berech al hayyayin shellifne hammazon patar et hayyayin sheshshata leachar hammazon kodem sheyevarech birkat hammazon aval bishar hayyamim tzarich lachazor ulvarech battechilla al hayyayin shel achar hammazon ba lahen yayin betoch hammazon kal echad veechad mevarech leatzmo sheen bet habbelia panuy sheyyaanu amen veeno poter et hayyayin shelleachar hammazon
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 5: Nashim vaavadim chayyavin bevirkat hammazon vesafek yesh baddavar im hen chayyavin min hattora lefi sheen kavua lah zeman o enam chayyavin min hattora lefichach en motziin et haggedolim yede chovatan aval hakketannim chayyavin bevirkat hammazon middivre sofrim kede lechannechan bemitzot

Veachar kach omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hazzan et haolam kullo betuvo ad sheggomer arba berachot vehen onin amen achar kal beracha uvracha

Hau haochlin measara ulmala mezammenin beshem ketzad hamvarech omer nevarech lelohenu sheachalnu mishshello vehen onin baruch elohenu sheachalnu mishshello uvtuvo chayinu vehu chozer veomer baruch elohenu sheachalnu mishshello uvtuvo chayinu umatchil birkat hammazon

Hassoed bevet chatanim mishsheyyatchilu lehitassek betzarche seuddat nissuin velahachinah ad sheloshim yom achar hannissuin mevarech nevarech shehassimcha bimono sheachalnu mishshello vehem onim baruch shehassimcha bimono sheachalnu mishshello vechu veim hau asara mevarech nevarech lelohenu shehassimcha bimono sheachalnu mishshello vehem onin baruch elohenu shehassimcha vechu vechen seudda sheosin otah achar hannissuin mechamat hannissuin ad shenem asar chodesh mevarech shehassimcha bimono

Hakkol chayyavin bevirkat hazzimmun kederech shechayyavin bevirkat hammazon afillu kohanim sheachlu kadshe hakkadashim baazara vechen kohanim veyisreelim sheachlu keechad veachlu hakkohanim teruma veyisrael chullin chayyavin bezimmun kechiyyuvan bevirkat hammazon

Nashim vaavadim uktannim en mezammenin alehen aval mezammenin leatzman velo tehe chavura shel nashim vaavadim uktannim mippene happeritzut aval nashim mezammenot leatzman o avadim leatzman uvilvad shello yezammenu beshem anderoginus mezammen lemino veeno mezammen lo lenashim velo laanashim mippene shehu safek vehattumtum eno mezammen kelal katan hayyodea lemi mevarchin mezammenin alav veaf al pi shehu keven sheva o keven shemone umitztaref ben leminyan shelosha ben leminyan asara lezammen alav vehannachri en mezammenin alav

En mezammenin ella al mi sheachal kezayit pat ulmala shiva sheachlu pat ushlosha achlu immahen yarak o tzir vechayyotze bahen mitztarfin lezammen beshem vehu sheyyihye hamvarech meochle happat aval shishsha sheachlu pat vearbaa yarak en mitztarfin ad sheyyihu ochle happat rov hannikkar bamme devarim amurim baasara aval bishlosha tzarich sheyyochlu kal echad veechad mehen kezayit pat veachar kach mezammenin

Shenayim sheachlu vegamru milleechol uva shelishi veachal im yecholin leechol immo kal shehu vaafillu mishshear ochalin mitztaref immahen vechacham gadol shebbamsubbin hu shemmevarech lechullan af al pi shello ba ella baacharona

Shelosha sheachlu keechad enan rashshain lechalek vechen arbaa vechen chamishsha veshishsha yesh lahem lechalek ad asara measara ulmala enam rashshaim lechalek ad esrim shekkal zeman sheyyechalku vetihye birkat hazzimmun lechal chelek vechelek kezimmun hakkol yesh lahem lechalek

Shelosha bene adam shebbau mishshalosh chavurot shel shelosha shelosha enan rashshain lechalek veim kevar zimmen kal echad veechad mehen bachavura shello rashshain lechalek veenan chayyavin bezimmun shekkevar zimmenu alehen shelosha sheyyashvu leechol pat af al pi shekkal echad veechad ochel mishshello enan rashshain lechalek

Shette chavurot shehau ochlin bevayit echad bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu mitztarfin lezimmun echad veim lav ellu mezammenin leatzman veellu mezammenin leatzman veim yesh shammash echad benehem shehu holech umshammesh mechavura zo lachavura zo mitztarfin lezimmun echad af al pi sheen miktzat ellu roin et ellu vehu sheyyishmeu shettehen kal divre hamvarech beveur

Shelosha sheachlu veyatza echad mehen lashshuk korin lo kede sheyechaven lishmoa ma shehen omrim umzammenin alav vehu bashshuk veotze yede chovato velichsheyyachazor leveto yachazor vivarech birkat hammazon leatzmo aval asara sheachlu veyatza echad mehen lashshuk en mezammenin alav ad sheyyachazor limkomo veyeshev immahen
Shelosha sheachlu keechad vekadam echad mehen uverech leatzmo mezammenin alav veyatzu hashshenayim yede chovat zimmun vehu lo yatza bezimmun ze sheen zimmun lemafrea

Shenayim sheachlu keechad kal echad veechad mevarech leatzmo veim haya echad mehen yodea veechad eno yodea ze sheyyodea mevarech bekol ram vehashsheni one amen achar kal beracha uvracha veotze yede chovato uven mevarech leaviv veeved mevarech lerabbo veishsha mevarechet levalah veotzin yede chovatan aval amru chachamim tavo meera lemi sheishto uvanav mevarchin lo

Bamme devarim amurim sheyyatzu yede chovatan bizman sheachlu velo savu shehen chayyavim levarech middivre sofrim ulfichach motziin otan katan o eved o ishsha mide chovatan aval im achal vesava shehu chayyav bevirkat hammazon min hattora ben ishsha ben katan o eved en motziin otan shekkal hachayyav bedavar min hattora en motziin otan mide chovatan ella hachayyav beoto davar min hattora kemoto
Hannichnas etzel acherim umtzaan mevarchin bevirkat hazzimmun im matza hamvarech omer nevarech hu one baruch hu umvorach veim matza haochlim onin baruch sheachalnu mishshello hu one acharehen amen
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 6: Kal haochel happat shemmevarchin alav hammotzi tzarich netilat yadayim techilla vasof veaf al pi shehi pat chullin veaf al pi sheen yadav meluchlachot veeno yodea lahen tuma lo yochal ad sheyyittol shette yadav vechen kal davar shettibbulo bemashkin tzarich netilat yadayim techilla

Kal hannotel yadav ben laachila ben likriat shema ben litfilla mevarech techilla asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al netilat yadayim shezzo mitzvat chachamim shennitztavenu min hattora lishmoa mehen shenneemar al pi hattora asher yorucha vmayim acharonim en mevarchin alehen sheenam ella mippene hassakkana ulfichach chayyav adam lehizzaher bahen beoter

Netilat yadayim ben tavshil letavshil reshut ratza notel ratza eno notel uferot shel chullin enan tzerichin netilat yadayim ben battechilla ben bassof vechal hannotel yadav leferot hare ze miggasse haruach kal pat shehammelach bo tzarich netilat yadayim baacharona shemma yesh bo melach sedomit o melach shettivo kemelach sedomit veyaavir yadav al enav visamme mippene ze chayyavin littol yadayim besof kal seudda mippene hammelach uvmachane peturim minnetilat yadayim battechilla mippene shehen terudim bemilchama vechayyavin baacharona mippene hassakkana
Ad hechan hi netilat yadayim ad happerek vechamma shiur hammayim reviit lechal shette yadayim vechal shechotztzim bitvila chotzetz bintilat yadayim vechal haole lemiddat mikve ole leshiur reviit

Kal hatztzarich netilat yadayim vehitbil yadav beme mikve eno tzarich davar acher veim hitbilan bemayim sheen bahem shiur mikve o bemayim sheuvin shebbakkarka lo asa kelum sheen hammayim sheuvin metaharin et hayyadayim ella bintila

Kal hannotel yadav tzarich lehizzaher bearbaa devarim bammayim atzman shello yihu pesulin lintilat yadayim uvashshiur sheyyihye bahen reviit lechal shette yadayim uvakkeli sheyyihu hammayim shennotlin bahen bichli uvnotel sheyyihu hammayim bain mikkoach noten

Arbaa devarim poslin et hammayim shinnuy mare vegilluy vaasiyyat melacha bahen vehefsed shemmonea et habbehema millishtot mehen ketzad mayim shennishtannu maritan ben bechelim ben bekarkaot ben mechamat davar shennafal letochan ben mechamat mekoman hare ellu pesulin vechen im nitgallu gilluy haoser otan mishshetiyya nifselu lintilat yadayim

Kal mayim shennaasa bahen melacha naasu shofchin ufsulin lintilat yadayim ketzad mayim sheuvin shehediach bahen kelim o sheshshara bahem pitto vechayyotze beze ben bechelim ben bekarkaot pesulin lintilat yadayim hediach bahen kelim mudachin o chadashim lo pesalan mayim shehannachtom metabbel bahen et hakkeachim pesulin veshehu chofen mehen bishat lisha kesherim shehammayim shebbechafnav hen shennaasu bahen melacha aval hammayim shechofen mehem hare hen bechashrutan

Vechal mayim shennifselu mishshetiyyat kelev kegon shehau marim o meluchim o achurin o reach ra ad shello yishte mehen hakkelev bechelim pesulin lintilat yadayim uvkarkaot kesherim lehatbil chamme teverya bimkoman matbilin bahem et hayyadayim aval im natal mehen bichli o shehiflig mehen amma lemakom acher en notlin mehen lo rishonim velo acharonim mippene sheenan reuyin lishtiyyat behema

Yesh lannotel litten al yadav meat meat ad sheyyitten kashshiur veim natan harviit kullah bishtifa achat kasher notlin arbaa o chamishsha ze betzad ze o yad ze al gabbe ze bishtifa achat uvilvad sheyyarpu yedehen kede sheyyavo benehen hammayim veyihye beotah hashshetifa kede reviit lechal echad veechad

En notlin mayim layyadayim lo bedafnot hakkelim velo beshule hammachatz velo bacharasim velo bimgufat hechavit veim tikken hammegufa lintila notlin mimmenna layyadayim vechen hachemet shettikkenah notlin mimmenna layyadayim aval sak vekuppa shennitkenu en notlin mehen layyadayim velo yitten lachavero bechafnav sheen chafnav keli vechelim shennishberu shevira hamtaheret otan mide tuma en notnin bahem layyadayim mippene shehen shivre kelim
Bechal hakkelim notlim layyadayim vaafillu kele gelalim uchle adama vehu sheyyihu shelemim keli sheeno machazik reviit o en bo reviit en notnin mimmenna layyadayim

Hakkol kesherin litten layyadayim afillu cheresh shote vekatan im en sham acher manniach hakkeli ben birkav vetzak al yadav o yatte hechavit al yadav veyittol o notel yado achat vetzak bezo al zo vechozer vetzak barishona al hashsheniyya vehakkof notel layyadayim

Hashshoket sheddole adam beyado o begalgal venoten letochah vehammayim nimshachin mimmenna baamma veholchin umashkin hayerakot o habbehema vehinniach yadav bashshoket veavru hammayim veshatfu al yadav lo alta lo netila shehare en kan noten al yadav veim hau yadav kerovot lishfichat haddeli ad shennimtzeu hammayim shatfu al yadav mikkoach netinat haadam alta lo netila

Mayim shennistappek lo im naasa mehen melacha o lo naasa im yesh bahen kashshiur o sheen bahen im hen tehorin o temein safek natal yadav safek lo natal yadav sefeko tahor shekkal safek shebbetahorat yadayim tahor

Mayim harishonim tzarich sheyyagbiha yadav lemala ad shello yetzu mayim chutz lapperek veyachzeru vitammeu et hayyadayim veacharonim tzarich sheyyashpil yadav lematta kede sheyyetze kal koach hammelach meal yadav mayim rishonim nittalim ben al gabbe keli ben al gabbe karka veacharonim enan nittalin ella al gabbe keli mayim rishonim nittalin ben bechamme haur ben betzonen veacharonim enan nittalin bechammin vehu sheyyihu chammim shehayyad soledet bahen mippene sheen maavirin et hazzuhama sheeno yachol leshafshef bahen aval hau poshrin notlin mehen baacharona

Notel adam yadav shacharit umatne alehen kal hayyom veeno tzarich littol et yadav lechal achila vaachila vehu shello yassiach dato mehen aval im hissiach dato mehen tzarich littol yadav bechal et shetztzarich netila

Lat adam et yadav bemappa veochel bahen pat o davar shettibbulo bemashke af al pi shello natal yadav hammaachil laacherim eno tzarich netilat yadayim vehaochel tzarich netilat yadayim af al pi sheacher noten letoch piv veeno nogea bammaachal vehu haddin leochel bemagrefa shetztzarich netilat yadayim

Asur lehaachil mi shello natal yadav veaf al pi shehu noten letoch piv veasur lezalzel bintilat yadayim vetziuuyim harbe tziuu chachamim vehizhiru al haddavar afillu en lo mayim ella kede shetiyya notel yadav bemiktzatan veachar kach ochel veshote miktzatan

Tzarich adam lenaggev et yadav veachar kach yochal vechal haochel belo nigguv yadayim keochel lechem tame vechal hannotel yadav baacharona menaggev veachar kach mevarech vetechef lintilat yadayim birkat hammazon lo yafsik benehem bedavar acher afillu lishtot mayim achar shennotel yadav baacharona asur ad sheyevarech birkat hammazon
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 7: Minhagot rabbot nahagu chachme yisrael basseudda vechullan derech eretz veellu hen keshennichnasin lasseudda haggadol shebbechullan notel et yadav techilla veachar kach nichnasin veoshvin mesubbin vegadol mesev barosh vesheni lo lematta hemennu hau shelosha mittot gadol mesev barosh vesheni lo lemala hemennu ushlishi lo lematta hemennu

Baal habbayit mevarech hammotzi umashlim habberacha veachar kach botzea vehaoreach mevarech birkat hammazon kede sheyevarech levaal habbayit veim hau kullan baale habbayit haggadol shebbahen botzea vehu mevarech birkat hammazon

En habbotzea rashshay livtzoa ad sheyyaviu melach o liftan lifne kal echad veechad ella im ken nitkavvenu leechol pat chareva veeno botzea lo perusa ketanna mippene shehu nire ketzar ayin velo perusa gedola yoter mikkevetza mippene shennire kiravtan uvshabbat yesh lo livtzoa perusa gedola veeno botzea ella mimmakom shennitbashshel yafe yafe

Mitzva min hammuvchar livtzoa kikkar shelema im hayeta sham shelema shel seorim ufrusa shel chittim manniach shelema betoch perusa uvotzea mishshettehen kede sheyyivtza mechittim umishshelema beshabbatot uvyamim tovim chayyav livtzoa al shette kikkarot notel shettehen beyado uvotzea achat mehen

Habbotzea noten perusa lifne kal echad veechad vehaacher notel beyado veen habbotzea noten beyad haochel ella im ken haya avel vehabbotzea hu poshet yadav techilla veochel veen hammesubbin rashshain litom ad sheyyitom hamvarech veen habbotzea rashshay litom ad sheyyichle amen mippi rov hammesubbin veim ratza habbotzea lachalok kavod lerabbo o lemi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma veyannichennu lifshot yado kodem lo harshut beyado

Shenayim mamtinin ze laze bikara shelosha en mamtinin gamru mehen shenayim hashshelishi mafsik immahen gamar echad mehen hashshenayim en mafsikin lo ella ochlin veholchin ad sheggomrin en mesichin bisudda kede shello yavo lide sakkana umippene ze im ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon kal echad veechad mevarech leatzmo sheim berech echad veone haone amen bishat habbelia yavo lide sakkana veen mistakkelin bifne haochel velo limnato shello levayesho

Hashshammash sheomed lifne hammesubbin eno ochel immahen vederech rachamanut hu litten letoch piv mikkal tavshil vetavshil kede leyashshev dato veim natnu lo yayin mevarech al kal kos vechos shennotnin lo mippene sheen shetiyyato teluya birtzono ella birtzonam

Yatza echad min hammesubbin lehashtin mayim notel yado achat venichnas dibber im chavero vehiflig notel shette yadav venichnas im hau mesubbin lishtiyya nichnas veoshev bimkomo venotel yadav veachar kach machazir panav laorchin velamma notel bimkomo shemma yomru lo natal yadav mippene sheen sham achila

En mannichin basar chay al happat veen maavirin kos male al happat veen somchin et hakkeara befat veen zorkin et happat velo et hachatichot velo et haochalin sheen lahen kelippin kegon tutim vaanavim utenim mippene shehen nimasin umuttar limshoch et hayyayin betzinnorot bevatte chatanim vezorkin lifnehem kelaot veegozim bimot hachamma aval lo bimot haggeshamim mippene shennimasin veen notlin yedehen beyayin ben chay ben mazug vechen en mafsidin shear ochalin umashkin derech bizzuy uvita

Asur leorchim littol kelum mimma shellifnehem velitten beyad beno o bitto shel baal habbayit shemma yitbayyesh baal hasseudda shehare en lo ella ma shehevi lifnehem venimtzeu hakketannim notlim otam veholchim lo yishlach adam lachavero chavit yayin veshemen tzaf al piha shemma yishlach lo adam chavit shekkullah yayin vidamme shehu shemen veshemen hu sheal paneha bilvad vizammen orchim veyitbayyesh vechen kal kayyotze bidvarim ellu hammeviim lide busha levaal hasseudda asurin

Gamru milleechol mesallekin et hashshulchan umchabbedin et hammakom sheachlu bo veachar kach notlin et yedehem shemma yeshayeru sham perurin sheyyesh bahen kezayit sheasur lehallech bahen velirchotz alehen aval perurin sheen bahen kezayit muttar leabbedan bayyad

Heviu lahem mayim lintila kal shemmevarech birkat hammazon hu notel yadav techilla kede shello yeshev haggadol veyadav mezohamot ad sheyyittol acher ushar hassoadin notlin yadan bassof ze achar ze veen mechabbedin bedavar ze sheen mechabbedin beyadayim mezohamot velo bigsharim velo bidrachim ella befetach harauy limzuza uvishat kenisa
Gamru littol yedehen veniggevu yedehen uverchu birkat hammazon veheviu et hammugmar mi shebberech birkat hammazon hu mevarech al hammugmar vechullan onin amen

Im haya sham yayin meviin kos machazik reviit o yater al reviit umviin besamim veochez et hayyayin bimino veet habbesamim bismolo umvarech birkat hammazon veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al habbesamim im hau habbesamim shemen arev vechayyotze bo tacho berosh hashshammash veim haya hashshammash talmid chacham tacho bakkotel kede shello yetze mevussam lashshuk

Af al pi sheen birkat hammazon tzericha yayin im berech al hayyayin kamminhag sheamarnu tzarich sheyyadiach kos shel beracha mibbifnim velishtof oto mibbachutz vimalleennu yayin chay vechevan shehiggia levirkat haaretz noten letocho meat mayim kede sheyehe arev lishtiyya veen mesichin al kos shel birkat hammazon ella hakkol shotkim ad shettichle birkat hammazon uvirkat hayyayin veyishtu
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 8: Kal perot hailan mevarchin alehen battechilla bore peri haetz ulvassof bore nefashot rabbot chutz mechameshet hamminin hakketuvin battora vehem anavim verimmonim utenim vezetim utmarim shehu mevarech alehen bassof beracha achat meen shalosh veal perot haaretz vehayerakot mevarchin alehen battechilla bore peri haadama ulvassof bore nefashot rabbot devarim sheen giddulan min haaretz kegon basar ugvina vedagim uvetzim umayim vechalav udvash vechayyotze bahen battechilla mevarech shehakkol ulvassof bore nefashot rabbot vehashshote mayim shello lerauot tzamo eno taun beracha lo lefanav velo leacharav

Hassochet perot vehotzi mehen mashkin mevarech alehen battechilla shehakkol ulvassof bore nefashot chutz min haanavim vehazzetim sheal hayyayin hu mevarech bore peri haggafen ulvassof beracha achat meen shalosh veal hashshemen battechilla hu mevarech bore peri haetz bamme devarim amurim shehaya choshesh bigrono veshata min hashshemen im me hashshelakot vechayyotze bahen shehare nehene bishtiyyato aval im shata hashshemen levaddo o shello haya choshesh bigrono mevarech alav shehakkol shehare lo nehena betaam hashshemen

Perot o yerakot sheddarkan leheachel chayyim im bishlan o shelakan mevarech alehen battechilla shehakkol ulvassof bore nefashot virakot sheddarkan leheachel shelukin kegon keruv velefet im achalan chayyin mevarech alehen battechilla shehakkol ulvassof bore nefashot rabbot veim bishlan o shelakan mevarech alehen bore peri haadama ulvassof bore nefashot rabbot devarim sheddarkan leheachel chayyin umvushshalin achalan ben chayyin ben mevushshalin mevarech alehen battechilla beracha haruya lahen im hau perot etz mevarech bore peri haetz veim hau perot haadama o yerakot mevarech bore peri haadama

Yerakot sheddarkan lehishshalek shelakan mevarech al me shelek shellahen bore peri haadama vehu sheshshelakan lishtot memehen shemmeme hashshelakot kishlakot bemakom sheddarkan lishtotan devash temarim mevarchin alav techilla shehakkol aval temarim shemmeachan bayyad vehotzi garinin shellahen vaasaan kemo issa mevarech alehen techilla bore peri haetz ulvassof beracha achat meen shalosh

Hakkanim hammetukim shessochatin otan umvashshelin memehen ad sheyyikpa veyidme lemelach kal haggeonim omrim shemmevarchin alav bore peri haadama umiktzatam amru bore peri haetz vechen amru shehammotzetz otam kanim mevarech bore peri haadama vaani omer sheen ze peri veen mevarchin alav ella shehakkol shello yihye devash ellu hakkanim shennishtanna al yede ur gadol middevash temarim shello nishtanna al yede haur umvarchin alav shehakkol

Hakkor vehu rosh haddekel shehu kemo etz lavan mevarech alav battechilla shehakkol kafras shel tzalaf mevarech alav bore peri haadama mippene sheeno peri vehaevonot shel tzalaf hen happeri shehen ketzurot temarim dakkim ketannim mevarech alehen bore peri haetz

Happilpelin vehazzangevil bizman shehen retubbin mevarech alehen bore peri haadama aval yeveshin en teunin beracha lo lifnehem velo leacharehem mippene shehen tavlin veeno ochel vechen ochalin sheen reuyin laachila umashkin sheenan reuyin lishtiyya enan teunin beracha lo lifnehen velo leacharehen

Happat sheippesha vehayyayin shehikrim vetavshil sheavra tzurato vehannovlot shehen paggin vehashshechar vehachometz vehaggovay vehammelach vehakkemehin vehappitriyyot al kullan mevarech techilla shehakkol vechal hamvarchin lefanav shehakkol laacharona mevarech bore nefashot vechal hattaun beracha leacharav taun beracha lefanav

Shemarim shennatan alehem shelosha vehotzi mehen arbaa mevarech alehen bore peri haggafen shezze yayin mazug hu hotzi pachot mearbaa af al pi sheyyesh bahem taam yayin mevarech alehen shehakkol techilla
Berech al perot hailan bore peri haadama yatza veal perot haadama bore peri haetz lo yatza veal kullam im berech shehakkol yatza vaafillu al happat veal hayyayin

Lakach kos shel shechar beyado vehitchil habberacha al menat lomar shehakkol vetaa veamar bore peri haggafen en machzirin oto vechen im hau lefanav perot haaretz vehitchil habberacha al menat lomar bore peri haadama vetaa veamar bore peri haetz en machzirin oto vechen im haya lefanav tavshil shel dagan ufatach al menat lomar bore mine mezonot vetaa veamar hammotzi yatza mippene shebbeshaa shehizkir et hashshem vehammalchut shehen ikkar habberacha lo nitkaven ella livracha haruya leoto hammin vehoil velo haya beikkar habberacha taut af al pi shettaa besofah yatza veen machzirin oto

En malin beno shel adam shello middato ella im ken avar venimna lemulo shebbet din malin oto beal karcho nitallem mibbet din velo malu oto kesheyyigdal hu chayyav lamul et atzmo vechal yom veom sheyyaavor alav mishsheyyigdal velo yamul et atzmo hare hu mevattel mitzvat ase aval eno chayyav karet ad sheyyamut vehu arel bemezid

Echad eved shennolad birshut yisrael veechad eved hannilkach min hakkutim chayyav harav lamul otan ella sheyelid bayit nimmol lishmona umiknat kesef nimmol bayyom shennilkach afillu lekacho bayyom shennolad nimmol beomo

Yesh miknat kesef shennimmol lishmona veyesh yelid bayit shennimmol bayyom shennolad ketzad lakach shifcha velakach ubbarah immah veyalda hare ze nimmol lishmona veaf al pi shellakach haubbar bifne atzmo vahare haubbar atzmo miknat kesef hoil vekana immo kodem shennolad nimmol lishmona

Lakach shifcha leubbareha o shellakach shifcha al menat shello lehatbilah leshem avdut af al pi shennolad birshuto nimmol bayyom shennolad shehare hannolad hazze keillu hu miknat kesef levaddo uchillu hayyom kanahu sheen immo bichlal shifchot yisrael kede sheyyihye habben yelid bayit veim tavla immo achar sheyyalda hare ze nimmol lishmona

Lakach eved gadol min haakkum velo ratza haeved lamul megalgelin immo kal shenem asar chodesh yeter al ken asur lekayemo keshehu arel ella chozer umochro leakkum veim hitna alav mittechilla vehu etzel rabbo haakkum shello yamul oto muttar lekayemo vehu arel uvilvad sheyekabbel alav sheva mitzot shennitztauu bene noach veyihye keger toshav aval im lo kibbel alav sheva mitzot yehareg miyyad veen mekabbelim ger toshav ella bizman shehayyovel noheg

Ger shennichnas likhal yisrael chayyav mila techilla veim mal keshehaya akkum tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit bayyom shennitgayyer vechen katan shennolad keshehu mahul tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit bayyom hashshemini anderoginus vehu hayyalud sheyyesh lo zachrut kezachar venakvut kinkeva tzarich lamul oto bashshemini vechen yotze dofen umi sheyyesh lo shette arlot malin et shettehen bashshemini

En malin leolam ella bayyom achar alot hashshemesh ben bayyom hashshemini shehu zemannah ben shello bizmannah shehu mitteshii vahala shenneemar bayyom hashshemini bayyom velo ballayela mal mishsheala ammud hashshachar kasher vechal hayyom kasher lemila veaf al pi chen mitzva lehakdim bitchillat hayyom shezzerizin makdimin lemitzot

Mila bizmannah docha et hashshabbat veshello bizmannah enah docha lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov uven bizmannah uven shello bizmannah docha et hatztzaraat ketzad sheim hayeta baheret beor haarla chotchah im haarla af al pi shekketzitzat nega hatztzaraat belo taase yavo ase veyidche et lo taase

Keshem shemmilat habbanim docha et hashshabbat kach milat haavadim shehen nimmolim lishmona docha et hashshabbat im chal shemini shellahen beshabbat chutz milid bayit shello tavla immo ad sheyyalda sheaf al pi shennimmol lishmona eno doche et hashshabbat

Katan shennolad keshehu mahul umi shennolad bachodesh hashshemini leibburo kodem shettiggamer beriyyato shehu kenefel mippene sheeno chay veotze dofen veanderoginus umi sheyyesh lo shette arlot en dochin et hashshabbat ella nimolin beechad beshabbat shehu yom teshii shellahen

Mi shennolad ben hashshemashot safek bayyom safek ballayela monin min hallayela venimmol litshii shehu safek shemini veim nolad erev shabbat ben hashshemashot eno doche et hashshabbat ella nimmol beechad beshabbat sheen dochin et hashshabbat missafek

Mi shennolad bachodesh hashshemini im haya shalem bisaro uvtzipparnav hare ze valad shalem uven shiva hu ella shennishtaha umuttar letaltelo beshabbat veeno keeven umalin oto beshabbat aval im nolad usaro lakuy veen tzipparnav shelemin kivriyyatan hare ze ben shemona vadday shello haya rauy lehivaled ella betisha veyatza kodem sheyyiggamer ulfichach hu chashuv keeven veasur letaltelo beshabbat veaf al pi chen im shaha sheloshim yom hare hu valad shel kayyama vahare hu kishar hannoladin lechal davar shekkal sheshshaha sheloshim yom baadam eno nefel

Mi shennolad bachodesh hashshevii leibburo im nolad shalem hare ze valad shel kayyama umalin oto beshabbat safek ben shiva safek ben shemona malin oto beshabbat al kal panim im ben shiva hu veshalem hu bedin hu sheyyidche shabbat veim ben shemona hu hare ze shemmal kimchattech basar hu lefi shezze nefel im hu ben shemona

Hotzi haubbar rosho chutz lime immo ben hashshemashot af al pi shello yatza kullo ella belele shabbat en malin oto beshabbat vechal mi sheeno doche et hashshabbat eno doche et yom tov rishon vedoche et yom tov sheni uvishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana eno doche lo et harishon velo et hashsheni vechen mila shello bizmannah enah docha et shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana

Chole en malin oto ad sheyyavri umonin lo meet sheyyavri mechalo shiva yamim meet leet veachar kach malin oto bamme devarim amurim beshechalatzto chamma vechayyotze becholi ze aval im kaavu lo enav beet sheyyippatchu enav veyerafu malin oto miyyad vechen kal kayyotze baze

Katan shennimtza bashshemini shello yarok beoter en malin oto ad sheyyippol bo dam veyachzeru marav kemare hakketannim habberiim vechen im haya adom beoter kemi shetztzavu oto en malin oto ad sheyyibbala bo damo veyachzeru marav kishar hakketannim mippene shezze choli hu vetzarich lehizzaher bidvarim ellu harbe

Ishsha shemmala benah rishon umet mechamat mila shehichshila et kocho vechen mala et hashsheni umet mechamat mila ben mibbaalah harishon ben mibbaalah hashsheni hare ze lo yamul et hashshelishi bizmanno ella mamtinin lo ad sheyyagdil veyitchazzek kocho en malin ella valad sheen bo shum choli shessakkanat nefashot docha et hakkol veefshar lamul leachar zeman vei efshar lehachazir nefesh achat miyyisrael leolam
Mishneh Torah, Circumcision 2: Hakkol kesherin lamul vaafillu arel veeved veishsha vekatan malin bemakom sheen sham ish aval akkum lo yamul kelal veim mal eno tzarich lachazor velamul sheniyya uvakkol malin vaafillu betzur uvizchuchit uvchal davar shekkoret velo yamul bikrumit shel kane mippene hassakkana umitzva min hammuvchar lamul bevarzel ben besakkin ben bemisparayim venahagu kal yisrael besakkin

Ketzad mohalin chotchin et kal haor hamchappe et haatara ad shettitgalle kal haatara veachar kach porin et hakkerum harach shellematta min haor betzipporen umachaziro lechan ulchan ad sheyyerae besar haatara veachar kach motzetz et hammila ad sheyyetze haddam mimmekomot rechokim kede shello yavo lide sakkana vechal mi sheeno motzetz maavirin oto veachar shemmotzetz noten aleha ispelanit o retiyya vechayyotze bahen

Yesh tzitzin meakkevin et hammila veyesh tzitzin sheen meakkevin et hammila ketzad im nishar meor haarla or hachofe rov gavhah shel atara hare ze arel kemot shehaya veze haor hu tzitz hamakkev veim lo nishar mimmennu ella meat sheeno chofe rov gavhah shel atara zehu tzitz sheeno meakkev

Hammal kal zeman sheosek bammila chozer ben al hatztzitzin shemmeakkevin ben al tzitzin sheen meakkevin perash al tzitzin hamakkevin chozer al tzitzin sheenan meakkevin eno chozer mal velo para et hammila keillu lo mal

Katan shebbesaro rach umduldal beoter o shehaya baal basar ad sheyyerae keillu eno mahul roin oto beet sheyyitkashshe im nire shehu mahul eno tzarich kelum vetzarich letakken et habbasar mikkan umikkan mippene marit haayin veim beet sheyyitkashshe lo nire mahul chozrin vekotztzin et habbasar hamduldal mikkan umikkan ad shetterae haatara geluya beet kishshuy vedavar ze middivre sofrim aval min hattora af al pi shehu nire kearel hoil umal eno tzarich lamul paam sheniyya

Osin kal tzarche mila beshabbat malin uforin umotztzin vechozer al tzitzin hamakkevin af al pi shepperash veal tzitzin sheen meakkevin kal zeman shello perash venoten aleha ispelanit aval machshire mila enan dochin et hashshabbat ketzad hare shello matzu sakkin en osin sakkin beshabbat velo meviin oto mimmakom lemakom vaafillu mavoy sheeno meorav en meviin oto mechatzer lechatzer veen eruv middivrehem nidche mippene havaat hassakkin hoil veefshar lahavio meerev shabbat

Vechen en shochakin lah sammanin veen mechimmin lah chammin veen osin lah ispelanit veen torfin yayin veshemen veim lo shachak kammon meerev shabbat loes beshinnav venoten veim lo taraf yayin veshemen noten ze leatzmo veze leatzmo ze hakkelal kal sheefshar laasoto meerev shabbat eno doche et hashshabbat aval im shachach velo hechinu hammachshirin tiddache hammila litshii

Malu et hakkatan beshabbat veachar kach nishpechu hachammin o nitpazzeru hassammanin osin lo hakkol beshabbat mippene shessakkana hi lo makom sheddarkan leharchitz et hakkatan marchitzin oto beshabbat beom hammila ben lifne hammila ben leachar hammila o bashshelishi shel mila shechal lihot beshabbat ben rechitzat kal gufo ben rechitzat mila ben bechammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat ben bechammin shehuchammu beshabbat mippene shessakkana hi lo

Shachchu velo heviu sakkin meerev shabbat omer leakkum lehavi sakkin beshabbat uvilvad shello yavi oto derech reshut harabbim kelalo shel davar kal davar sheasiyyato beshabbat asura alenu mishshum shevut muttar lanu lomar leakkum laasot otan kede laasot mitzva bizmannah vedavar sheasiyyato asura alenu mishshum melacha asur lanu lomar leakkum laasoto beshabbat

Machshire mila afillu bizmannah enan dochin et yom tov hoil veefshar laasotan meerev yom tov vekal vachomer haddevarim im lo dachu machshire mila shevut shehu middivrehem heach yidchu lo taase shebbattora aval shochakin lah sammanin beom tov hoil verauy likdera vetorfin lah yayin veshemen
Mishneh Torah, Circumcision 3: Hammal mevarech kodem sheyyamul asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al hammila im mal ben chavero veim mal et beno mevarech vetzivanu lamul et habben vaavi habben mevarech beracha acheret baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lehachniso bivrito shel avraham avinu mitzva al haav lamul et beno yater al mitzva shemmetzuvin yisrael sheyyamulu kal arel shebbenehen lefichach im en sham aviv en mevarchin achareha beracha zo veyesh mi shehora sheyevarchu otah bet din o echad min haam veen rauy laasot ken
Veim hau sham omdin omrim keshem shehichnasto labberit ken tachnisehu letora ulchuppa ulmaasim tovim

Veachar kach mevarech avi habben o hammal o echad min haomdin sham baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddash yedid mibbeten vechok bishero sam vetzeetzaav chatam beot berit kodesh al ken bischar zot el chay chelkenu tzurenu tzave lehatztzil yedidut sheerenu mishshachat lemaan berito asher sam bivsarenu baruch atta Adonai koret habberit vaavi habben mevarech shehecheyanu

Hammal et haggerim mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lamul et haggerim ulhattif mimmennu dam berit sheilmale dam habberit lo nitkayemu shamayim vaaretz shenneemar im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti

Hammal et avdo mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lamul et haavadim ulhattif mehen dam berit sheilmale dam berit lo nitkayemu shamayim vaaretz veim mal eved shel acherim mevarech al milat haavadim vehammal adam gadol tzarich lechassot ervato ad sheyevarech veachar kach megallehu umal oto
Ger shemmal kodem shennitgayyer vekatan shennolad keshehu mahul keshemmattifin mimmennu dam berit enan tzerichin beracha vechen anderoginus en mevarchin al millato mippene shehu eno zachar vadday

Akkum shetztzarich lachtoch arlato mippene makka o mippene shechin shennolad bo haya asur leyisrael lachtoch lo otah shehaakkum en maalim otam mide mita velo moridin otan eleha af al pi shennaaset mitzva birfua zo shehare lo nitkaven lemitzva lefichach im nitkaven haakkum lemila muttar leyisrael lamul oto

Meusa hi haarla shennitgannu bah haggoyim shenneemar ki kal haggoyim arelim ugdola hi hammila shello nikra avraham avinu shalem ad shemmal shenneemar hithallech lefanay vehye tamim veettena veriti beni uvenecha vego vechal hammefer berito shel avraham avinu vehinniach arlato o meshachah af al pi sheyyesh bo tora umaasim tovim en lo chelek laolam habba

Bo ure kamma chamura mila shello nitla lemoshe rabbenu aleha afillu shaa achat af al pi shehaya badderech vechal mitzot hattora nichretu alehen shalosh beritot shenneemar elle divre habberit asher tziva Adonai millevad habberit asher karat ittam bechorev vesham hu omer attem nitztzavim hayyom kullechem leavrecha bivrit Adonai elohecha hare shalosh beritot veal hammila nichretu shelosh esre beritot im avraham avinu veettena veriti beni uvenecha ani hinne veriti ittach vahakimoti et beriti beni uvenecha livrit olam veatta et beriti tishmor zot beriti asher tishmeru vehaya leot berit vehayeta veriti bivsarchem livrit olam et beriti hefar vahakimoti et beriti itto livrit olam veet beriti akim et yitzchak berich rachamana desayean
Mishneh Torah, Fringes 1: Anaf sheosin al kenaf habbeged mimmin habbeged hu hannikra tzitzit mippene shehu dome letzitzit shel rosh shenneemar vayyikkacheni betzitzit rashi veze heanaf hu hannikra lavan mippene sheen anu metzuvin letzavo veen lechute heanaf minyan min hattora
Velokchin chut tzemer shennitzba keen harakia vechorchin oto al heanaf vechut ze hu hannikra techelet veen leminyan hakkerichot shekkorech chut ze shiur min hattora
Nimtzeu bemitzva zo shene tzavim sheyyaase al hakkanaf anaf yotze mimmenna vesheyyichroch al heanaf chut techelet shenneemar veasu lahem tzitzit venatnu al tzitzit hakkanaf petil techelet

Vehattechelet eno meakkev et hallavan vehallavan eno meakkev et hattechelet ketzad hare sheen lo techelet ose lavan levaddo vechen im asa lavan utchelet venifsak hallavan venitmaet ad hakkanaf venishar hattechelet levaddo kasher

Af al pi sheen echad mehen meakkev et chavero enan shette mitzot ella mitzvat ase achat amru chachamim harishonim vehaya lachem letzitzit melammed sheshshenehem mitzva achat vearba tzitziyyot meakkevot zo et zo shearbatan mitzva achat vehallovesh tallit sheyyesh bah lavan o techelet o shenehem keechad hare kiyyem mitzvat ase achat

Ketzad osin et hatztzitzit matchil mizzavit shel tallit shehi sof haarug umarchik mimmenna lo yoter al shalosh etzbaot lemala velo pachot mikkesher gudal umachnis sham arbaa chutin vechoflan baemtza nimtzeu shemona chutim meshullashin teluyin min hakkeren veorech hachutim hashshemona en pachot mearba etzbaot veim hau yoter al ken afillu amma o shettayim kesherin vechal haetzbaot begudal veyihye echad mishshemona hachutim chut techelet vehashshiva levanim

Velokeach chut echad min hallavan vechorech bo kericha achat al shear hachutin betzad habbeged umannicho velokeach chut hattechelet vechorech bo shette kerichot betzad kericha shel lavan vekosher veellu hashshalosh kerichot hem hannikrain chulya umarchik meat veose chulya sheniyya bechut shel techelet levaddo umarchik meat veose chulya shelishit vechen ad chulya acharona shehu korech bah shette kerichot shel techelet uchricha acharona shel lavan mippene shehitchil belavan mesayyem bo shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin velamma yatchil belavan kede sheyehe samuch lichnaf minah veal derech ze hu ose bearba hakkenafot

Kamma chulot hu ose bechal kanaf lo pachot mishsheva velo yoter mishshelosh esre vezo hi mitzva min hammuvchar veim lo karach aleha ella chulya achat keshera veim karach hattechelet al rov hatztzitzit keshera venoy hattechelet sheyyihu kal hachulot bishlish hachutin hamshulshalin ushne shelishehen anaf vetzarich lefardo ad sheyyihye ketzitzit sear harosh

Haose lavan belo techelet lokeach echad mishshemona hachutin vechorech oto al shear hachutin ad shelishan umanniach shene shelishitan anaf uchricha zo im ratza lichroch otah chulot chulot keen shekkorech battechelet harshut beyado veze hu minhagenu veim ratza lichroch belo minyan chulot ose kelalo shel davar yitkaven lihot hakkaruch shelish veheanaf shene shelishim veyesh mi sheeno medakdek bedavar ze belavan veim karach hallavan al rov hachutin o shello karach ella chulya achat keshera
Echad chute lavan veechad chute techelet im ratza laasot shezurin ose afillu haya hachut kaful mishshemona chutin veshazur ad shennaase petil echad eno nechshav ella chut echad

Chute hatztzitzit ben lavan ben techelet tzerichin teviyya leshem tzitzit veen osin otan lo min hatztzemer hanneechaz bakkotzim keshehatztzon rovtzin benehem velo min hannimin hannitlashin min habbehema velo mishshiyyure sheti shehaoreg meshayyer besof habbeged ella min haggizza shel tzemer o min happishtan veen osin otan mitztzemer haggazul velo mishshel ir hanniddachat velo mishshel kadashim veim asa pasul hammishtachave livhema tzamrah pasul letzitzit aval hammishtachave lefishtan hannatua hare ze kasher shehare nishtanna
Tzitzit sheasa oto kuti pasul shenneemar dabber el bene yisrael veasu lahem tzitzit aval im asa otah yisrael belo kavana keshera vetzitzit shennaasa min heasuy mikkodem pasul

Ketzad hevi kanaf sheyyesh bah tzitzit utfarah al habbeged afillu yesh beotah hakkanaf amma al amma pasul shenneemar veasu lahem tzitzit lo min heasuy shehare ze dome lemi shennaaset meeleha umuttar lehattir tzitzit mibbeged ze velitlotam beveged acher ben lavan ben techelet

Tala hachutin ben shette kenafayim mizzo lezo vekashar kanaf zo kehilchatah vechanaf zo kehilchatah veachar kach chatachan baemtza venifredu ze mizze pasul shehare beet shekkesharan hau pesulin lefi sheshshette hakkenafayim meorot zo bazo bachutin shebbenehen uvshaa sheppesakan naasu shette tzitziyyot nimtza ose min heasuy

Hittil tzitzit al hatztzitzit im nitkaven levattel et harishonot mattir harishona o chotchah uchshera veim nitkaven lehosif af al pi shechatach achat mishshettehen hare zo pesula shehare keshehosif pasal et hakkol uchshehittir o chatach hattosefet nimtza hashshear naasa min heasuy sheasiyyato harishona pesula hayeta
Vechen hammattil levaalat shalosh veachar kach hishlimah learba vehittil larviit kullah pesula shenneemar taase velo min heasuy
En koflin et hattallit lishnayim umattilin tzitzit al arba kenafeha keshehi kefula ella im ken tefarah kullah vaafillu meruach achat

Nifsak hakkanaf sheyyesh bah tzitzit chutz leshalosh etzbaot tofrah bimkomah betoch shalosh lo yitpor nitmaata zavit shel beged shebben chute hatztzitzit uven sof haarug afillu lo nishar min haarug ella kal shehu kasher vechen im nitmaatu chute hatztzitzit afillu lo nishtayyer mehem ella kede aniva kasher veim nifsak hachut meikkaro afillu chut echad pesula
Mishneh Torah, Fringes 2: Techelet haamura battora bechal makom hi hatztzemer hatztzavua kefatuch shebbakkachol vezo hi demut harakia hanniret leen hashshemesh betahoro shel rakia vehattechelet haamura batztzitzit tzarich shettihye tzeviatah tzevia yedua sheomedet beyafyah velo tishtanne vechal shello nitzba beotah tzevia pasul letzitzit af al pi shehu keen harakia kegon shetztzevao beistis o beshachor o bishar hammashchirin hare ze pasul letzitzit rachel bat ez tzamrah pasul letzitzit

Ketzad tzovin techelet shel tzitzit lokchin hatztzemer veshorin oto besid veachar kach mechabbesin oto ad sheyyihye naki umartichim oto beahala vechayyotze bo kederech shehatztzabbain osin kede sheyyiklot et haayin veachar kach meviin dam chillazon vehu dag sheddome eno leen hattechelet vedamo shachor kido uvyam hammelach hu matzuy venotnin et haddam leora venotnin immo sammanin kemo hakkamonya vechayyotze bahen kederech shehatztzabbain osin umartichin oto venotnin bo hatztzemer ad sheyyease keen rakia vezo hi hattechelet shel tzitzit

Hattechelet shel tzitzit tzericha tzevia lishmah veim tzevaah shello lishmah pesula vehayyora sheyyesh bah hatztzeva im tzava bah meat tzemer levadko im hu yafe im lav nifsela hayyora kullah ella ketzad yaase lokeach hatztzeva min hayyora bichli katan umanniach bo tzemer shebbodek bo vesoref et shebbadak shehare nitzba livdika veshofech hatztzeva shebbakkeli shebbadak bo shehare taamo ufsalo vetzovea hattechelet bishar hatztzeva shello nifgam

Hattechelet enah nilkachat ella min hammumche choshshin shemma nitzbea shello lishmah af al pi shennilkecha min hammumche im nivdeka venoda shennitzbea beechad mishshear tzivonin hammashchirim sheenan omdin pesula

Ketzad bodkin otah ad sheyyodea im nitzbea kehilchatah im lav lokchin teven verir shel shabbelul ume raglayim shennitchammetzu arbaim yom veshorin hattechelet bechullan meet leet im amda beenah velo kahata keshera veim kahata lokchin batzek shel seorin shemmeappeshin oto lemuryas venotnin et zo hattechelet shennishtannet betocho veofe habbatzek betannur umotziim hattechelet min happat veroin otah im kahata mimma shehayeta pesula veim hosif enah vehushchara yoter mimma shehayeta kodem haafiyya keshera

Chatzer shemmochrin bah techelet vehau muchzakin bechashrut lokchin mimmenna setam veen tzarich bedika vahare hi bechezkatah ad shettechashed hammafkid techelet etzel hakkuti hare zo pesula shemma hechelifah veim hayeta bichli vehaya chatum bishne chotamot chotam betoch chotam keshera bechotam echad pesula
