Mishneh Torah, Eruvin 7: Mi sheyyatza meerev shabbat chutz lammedina veamad bemakom yadua betoch hattechum o besofo veamar shevitati bemakom ze vechazar leiro velan sham yesh lo lehallech lemachar meoto makom alpayim amma lechal ruach veze hu ikkar eruve techumin learev beraglav velo amru learev behannachat mezon shette seuddot bilvad bammakom af al pi shello yatza velo amad sham ella lehakel al heashir shello yetze ella yishlach eruvo beyad acher veyannichu lo

Vechen im nitkaven likboa shevitato bemakom yadua etzlo kegon ilan o bayit o gader shehu makkir mekomo veyesh beno uveno keshechashcha alpayim amma o pachot vehechezik badderech vehalach kede sheyyaggia leoto makom veyikne bo shevita af al pi shello higgia velo amad sham ella hechziro chavero lalun etzlo o shechazar meatzmo lalun o nitakkev lemachar yesh lo lehallech ad makom shennitkaven lo umeoto hammakom alpayim amma lechal ruach shekkevan sheggamar belibbo likboa sham shevitato vehechezik badderech naasa kemi sheamad sham o shehinniach eruvo sham

Bamme devarim amurim beani sheen matrichin oto lehanniach eruv o berachok kegon mi shehaya ba badderech vehaya yare shemma techshach vehu sheyyishshaer min hayyom kede lehaggia leoto makom shekkana bo shevita kodem shettechshach im ratz bechal kocho vehaya beno uven oto makom keshettechshach alpayim amma o pachot aval im lo haya rachok velo ani o shello nishar min hayyom kede sheyyaggia afillu ratz bechal kocho o shehaya ben hammakom shennitkaven lishbot bo uven hammakom shehu omed bo keshechashcha yeter mealpayim amma o shello kiven hammakom shekkana bo shevita hare ze lo kana shevita berichuk makom veen lo ella alpayim amma lechal ruach mimmakom shehu omed bo keshechashcha

Mi sheamad mibbeod yom birshut hayyachid vekana sham shevita o shehaya ba badderech venitkaven lishbot birshut hayyachid hayyadua etzlo vekana sham shevitato hare ze mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma lechal ruach veim hayeta reshut hayyachid zo makom shello hukkaf ledira o tel o bika im haya bah bet satayim o pachot mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma lechal ruach veim hayeta yoter al bayit satayim en lo bah ella arba ammot vechutza mehen alpayim amma lechal ruach vechen im hinniach eruvo bemakom shello hukkaf ledira

Hakkone shevita berichuk makom velo siyyem mekom shevitato lo kana shevita sham ketzad haya ba badderech veamar shevitati bemakom peloni o besade pelonit o bevika pelonit o berichuk elef amma o alpayim mimmekomi ze hare ze lo kana shevita berachok veen lo ella alpayim amma lechal ruach mimmakom shehu omed bo keshechashcha

Amar shevitati tachat ilan peloni o tachat sela peloni im yesh tachat oto ilan o oto sela shemone ammot o yater lo kana shevita shehare lo kiven mekom shevitato sheim ba lishbot betoch arba ammot ellu shemma bearba ammot haacherot hu shekkana shevita

Lefichach tzarich lehitkaven lishbot beikkaro o bearba ammot shebbidromo o shebbitzfono veim haya tachtav pachot mishshemone ammot venitkaven lishbot tachtav kana shehare en sham shiur shene mekomot vahare miktzat mekomo mesuyyam hau shenayim baim badderech echad mehen makkir ilan o gader o makom shehu kovea bo shevita vehashsheni eno makkir ze sheeno makkir moser shevitato lammakkir vehammakkir mitkaven lishbot hu vachavero bammakom shehu makkir

Anshe hair sheshshalchu echad mehen leholich lahen eruvan lemakom yadua vehechezik badderech vehechziro chavero velo holich eruvan hen lo kanu shevita beoto makom shehare lo hunnach sham eruvan veen lahen lehallech mimmedinatan ella alpayim amma lechal ruach vehu kana sham eruv shehare hu ba badderech venitkaven lishbot sham vehechezik badderech lefichach yesh lo lehallech leoto makom lemachar ulhallech mimmennu alpayim amma lechal ruach

Ze sheamarnu shetztzarich hakkone shevita berichuk makom sheyyachazik badderech lo sheyyetze veyelech bassade ella afillu yered min haaliyya lelech leoto makom vekodem sheyyetze mippetach hechatzer hechziro chavero hare ze hechezik vekana shevita vechal hakkone shevita berichuk makom eno tzarich lomar shevitati bemakom peloni ella kevan sheggamar belibbo vehechezik bederech kal shehu kana sham shevita veen tzarich lomar mi sheyyatza beraglav veamad bemakom shekkone bo shevita sheeno tzarich lomar kelum ella kevan sheggamar belibbo kana

Hattalmidim sheholchin veochlin belele shabbat bassadot uvakkeramim etzel baale habbattim sheppittan metzuya leovre derachim habbaim sham uvaim velanim bevet hammidrash mehallechin alpayim amma lechal ruach mibbet hammidrash lo mimmekom haachila sheillu matzu seuddatan bevet hammidrash lo hau yotzin lassade veen datan somechet laddira ella al bet midrasham
Mishneh Torah, Eruvin 8: En mannichin shene eruvin echad bammizrach veechad bammaarav kede sheyehallech bemiktzat hayyom al echad mishni haeruvin uvishar hayyom al haeruv hashsheni sheen mearvin shene eruvin leom echad taa veerev lishte ruchot kimdumme hu shemmearvin lishte ruchot o sheamar lishnayim tzeu vearvu alay echad erev alav latztzafon veechad erev alav laddarom mehallech keragle shenehem

Ketzad mehallech keragle shenehem sheeno yachol lehallech ella bemakom sheyyesh lishnehem lehallech bo natan haechad eruv berichuk elef amma leruach mizrach vehinniach hashsheni mehen eruvo berichuk chamesh meot amma leruach maarav en ze sheervu alav mehallech bammaarav ella elef amma keragle mi sheerev alav bammizrach velo yehallech bammizrach ella elef vachamesh meot amma keragle mi sheerev alav bammaarav lefichach im erev o ervu alav shene eruvin ellu echad berichuk alpayim amma lammizrach veechad berichuk alpayim amma lammaarav hare ze lo yazuz mimmekomo

Mearev adam shene eruvin bishte ruchot umatne veomer im era li devar mitzva o nilchatzti lemachar venitzrachti leruach zo ze haeruv hu sheani somech alav vehaeruv shebbaruach hashshenit eno kelum veim nitzrachti leruach zo hashshenit ze haeruv hu sheani somech alav veshebbaruach harishona eno kelum veim nitzrachti lishte haruchot yesh li lismoch al eze eruv sheertze uleze sheertze elech veim lo era li davar velo nitzrachti leruach mehen en shene haeruvin haellu eruv veeni somech al echad mehen ella hareni kivne iri sheyyesh lo alpayim amma lechal ruach michutz lachoma

Keshem sheasur latzet chutz lattechum beshabbat kach asur latzet beom tov uvom hakkippurim uchshem shehammotzi mershut lirshut beshabbat chayyav kach hammotzi mershut lirshut beom hakkippurim chayyav aval beom tov muttar lehotzi mershut lirshut lefichach mearvin eruve chatzerot umishtattefin bammevoot leom hakkippurim keshabbat umarvin eruve techumin leom hakkippurim ulyamim tovim kederech shemmearvin leshabbat

Yom tov shechal lihot samuch leshabbat ben millefaneha ben milleachareha o shene yamim tovim shel galuyyot yesh lo learev shene eruvin lishte ruchot vesomech al e ze mehen sheyyirtze layyom harishon veal haeruv shebbaruach hashsheniyya layyom hashsheni o mearev eruv echad leruach achat vesomech alav leechad mishshene yamim uvayyom hashsheni yihye kivne hair uchillu lo asa eruv veyesh lo alpayim amma lechal ruach bamme devarim amurim bishne yamim tovim shel galuyyot aval bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana hare hen keom echad veeno mearev lishne yamim ella leruach achat
Vechen matne adam al eruvo veomer eruvi leshabbat zo aval lo leshabbat acheret o leshabbat acheret aval lo leshabbat zo leshabbatot velo leyamim tovim leyamim tovim velo leshabbatot

Amar lachamishsha hareni mearev al eze mikkem sheertze ratziti elech lo ratziti lo elech af al pi sheratza mishshechashcha yelech davar shehu middivre sofrim yesh bo berera vechen hamarev leshabbatot shel kal hashshana veamar ratziti elech lo ratziti lo elech ella ehye kivne iri kal shabbat sheyyirtze yelech af al pi sheratza mishshettechshach

Hamarev lishne yamim tovim shel galuyyot o leshabbat veom tov af al pi shehu eruv echad leruach achat lishne hayyamim tzarich sheyyihye haeruv bimkomo matzuy belayil harishon uvlel sheni kal ben hashshemashot ketzad hu ose molicho beerev yom tov o beerev shabbat umachshich alav venotlo beyado uva lo im haya lel yom tov ulmachar molicho leoto makom umannicho sham ad shettechshach veochlo im haya lel shabbat o mevio im haya lel yom tov mippene shehen shette kedushshot veenan keom echad kede shennomar millel rishon kana haeruv lishne yamim

Neechal haeruv barishon kana haeruv larishon veen lo eruv lashsheni erev beraglav barishon tzarich learev beraglav bashsheni vehu sheyyelech veyaamod beoto makom veyachashov belibbo sheyyikne sham shevita erev befat barishon im ratza learev beraglav bashsheni hare ze eruv veim ratza learev befat tzarich learev beotah happat atzmah sheerev bah barishon
Yom hakkippurim shechal lihot erev shabbat o leachar shabbat bizman shemmekaddeshin al pi hariyya yerae li shehen keom echad ukdushsha achat hem

Ze sheamarnu sheyyesh lo learev shene eruvin bishte ruchot lishne hayyamim vehu sheyyihye efshar lo lehaggia lechal echad mishshene haeruvin bayyom harishon aval im i efshar lo lehaggia laeruv shel yom hashsheni bayyom harishon en eruv hashsheni eruv shehaeruv mitzvato sheyyihye basseudda haruya mibbeod yom veze hoil veeno yachol lehaggia leze haeruv bayyom harishon hare zo enah reuya mibbeod yom

Ketzad hare shehinniach eruvo berichuk alpayim amma mibbeto leruach mizrach vesamach alav leom rishon vehinniach eruv sheni berichuk amma achat o mea o elef beruach maarav vesamach alav leom sheni en ze hashsheni eruv shehare bayyom harishon en ze haeruv hashsheni rauy lo mibbeod yom lefi sheeno yachol lehaggia elav shehare lo nishar lo beruach maarav kelum

Aval im hinniach eruvo berichuk elef vachamesh meot amma mibbeto beruach mizrach vesamach alav leom rishon vehinniach eruv sheni rachok mibbeto leruach maarav betoch chamesh meot amma vesamach alav leom sheni hare ze eruv shehare efshar lo sheyyaggia lo bayyom harishon

Yom tov shechal lihot beerev shabbat eno ose eruv beom tov lo eruve chatzerot velo eruve techumin ella mearev hu beom chamishi shehu erev yom tov veim chalu shene yamim tovim shel galuyyot bachamishi veerev shabbat meerev miyyom revii eruve techumin veeruve chatzerot veim shachach velo erev hare ze mearev eruve chatzerot bachamishi uverev shabbat umatne aval lo eruve techumin

Ketzad matne omer bachamishi im hayyom yom tov en bidvaray kelum veim lav hare ze eruv ulmachar chozer umarev veomer im hayyom yom tov kevar eravti meemesh veen bidvaray hayyom kelum veim emesh haya yom tov hare ze eruv bamme devarim amurim bishne yamim tovim shel galuyyot aval bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana hare hen keom echad veeno mearev lahen ella meerev yom tov salik hilchot oruvin
Mishneh Torah, Fasts 1: Mitzvat ase min hattora lizok ulharia bachatzotzrot al kal tzara shettavo al hatztzibbur shenneemar al hatztzar hatztzorer etchem vahareotem bachatzotzrot kelomar kal davar sheyyatzer lachem kegon batztzoret vedever vearbe vechayyotze bahen zaaku alehen vehariu

Vedavar ze middarche hatteshuva hu shebbizman shettavo tzara veyizaku aleha veyariu yedu hakkol shebbiglal maasehem haraim hura lahen kakkatuv aonotechem hittu vego veze hu sheyyigrom lahem lehasir hatztzara mealehem

Aval im lo yizaku velo yariu ella yomru davar ze mimminhag haolam era lanu vetzara zo nikra nikret hare zo derech achzariyyut vegoremet lahem lehiddabbek bemaasehem haraim vetosif hatztzara tzarot acherot hu shekkatuv battora vahalachtem immi bekeri vehalachti gam ani immachem bachamat keri kelomar kesheavi alechem tzara kede shettashuvu im tomru shehi keri osif lachem chamat oto keri

Umiddivre sofrim lehitannot al kal tzara shettavo al hatztzibbur ad sheyeruchamu min hashshamayim uvime hattaaniyyot haellu zoakin bitfillot umitchannenim umriin bachatzotzrot bilvad veim hau bammikdash meriin bachatzotzrot uvshofar hashshofar mekatztzer vehachatzotzrot maarichot shemmitzvat hayyom bachatzotzrot veen tokin bachatzotzrot veshofar keechad ella bammikdash shenneemar bachatzotzrot vekol shofar hariu lifne hammelech

Taaniyyot ellu sheggozrin al hatztzibbur mippene hatztzarot enan yom achar yom sheen rov hatztzibbur yecholim laamod bedavar ze veen gozrin battechilla taanit ella besheni beshabbat uvachamishi shelleacharav uvsheni shelleacharav vechen al hasseder hazze sheni vachamishi vesheni ad sheyeruchamu

En gozrin taanit al hatztzibbur lo beshabbatot velo beyamim tovim vechen en tokin bahen lo beshofar velo bachatzotzrot velo zoakim umitchannenim bahem battefilla ella im ken hayeta ir shehikkifuha akkum o nahar o sefina hammittarefet bayyam afillu yachid hannirdaf mippene akkum mippene listim umippene ruach raa mitannin alehem beshabbat ve zoakin umitchannenim alehem battefilla aval en tokin ella im ken taku lekabbetz et haam laazor otam ulhatztzilan

Vechen en gozrin taanit battechilla berashe chodashim o bachanukka ufurim o bechullo shel moed veim hitchilu lehitannot al hatztzara afillu yom echad ufaga bahen yom meellu mitannin umashlimin hayyom betaanit

Taaniyyot ellu shemmitannin al hatztzarot en mitannin bahen lo ubbarot velo menikot velo ketannim umuttarin leechol ballayela af al pi shemmitannin lemachar chutz mittaaniyyot hammatar kemo sheyyitbaer vechal taanit sheochlin bah ballayela ben tzibbur ben yachid hare ze ochel veshote ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar vehu shello yashen aval im yashen eno chozer veochel

Keshem shehatztzibbur mitannim al tzaratan kach hayyachid mitanne al tzarato ketzad hare shehaya lo chole o toe bammidbar o asur bevet haasurin yesh lo lehitannot alav ulvakkesh rachamim bitfillato veomer anenu vechu bechal tefilla shemmitpallel velo yitanne beshabbatot velo bemoadot velo berashe chodashim velo bachanukka ufurim

Kal taanit shello kibbelah alav hayyachid mibbeod yom eno taanit ketzad mekabbelah kesheyyitpallel tefillat mincha omer achar hattefilla machar ehe betaanit vegomer belibbo lehitannot lemachar veaf al pi shehu ochel ballayela lo hifsid kelum vechen im gamar belibbo vekibbel alav lehitannot shelosha o arbaa yamim ze achar ze af al pi shehu ochel kal layela velayela lo hifsid taanito veeno tzarich kavana lechal yom vaom mibbeodo

Kibbel alav mibbeod yom lehitannot lemachar bilvad vehitanna uvallayela nimlach lehitannot beom sheni af al pi shellan betaanito enah taanit mippene shello kibbelah alav mibbeod yom veen tzarich lomar shehaya ochel veshote ballayela vehishkim babboker venimlach lehitannot sheen zo taanit kelal

Haroe chalom ra tzarich lehitannot lemachar kede sheyyashuv veyeor bemaasav vichappes bahen veyachazor bitshuva umitanne vaafillu beshabbat umitpallel anenu bechal tefilla af al pi shello kibbelah mibbeod yom vehammitanne beshabbat mitanne yom acher mippene shebbittel oneg shabbat

Mitanne adam shaot vehu shello yochal kelum shear hayyom ketzad hare shehaya tarud bachafatzav vmitassek bitzrachav velo achal ad chatzot o ad tesha shaot venimlach lehitannot bashshaot shennisharu min hayyom hare ze mitanne otan shaot umitpallel bahen anenu shehare kibbel alav hattaanit kodem sheot hattaanit vechen im achal veshata veachar kach hitchil lehitannot shear hayyom hare ze taanit shaot

Kal hashsharuy betaanit ben shehaya mitanne al tzarato o al chalomo ben shehaya mitanne im hatztzibbur al tzaratam hare ze lo yinhog iddunin beatzmo velo yakel rosho velo yihye sameach vetov lev ella doeg veonen kainyan shenneemar ma yitonen adam chay gever al chataav umuttar lo litom et hattavshil vaafillu bichde reviit vehu shello yivla ella toem ufolet shachach veachal mashlim taanito

Yachid shehaya mitanne al hachole venitrappe al tzara veavra hare ze mashlim taanito haholech mimmakom shemmitannin lemakom sheen mitannin hare ze mitanne umashlim taanito halach mimmakom sheen mitannin lemakom shemmitannin hare ze mitanne immahen shachach veachal veshata al yitrae bifnehem veal yinhog iddunin beatzmo

Tzibbur shehau mitannin al haggeshamim veyardu lahen geshamim im kodem chatzot yardu lo yashlimu ella ochlin veshotin umitkannesin vekorin hallel haggadol sheen omrin hallel haggadol ella benefesh sevea vecheres melea veim achar chatzot hoil veavar rov hayyom bikdushsha yashlimu taanitan vechen im hau mitannin al tzara veavra o al gezera uvatla im kodem chatzot lo yashlimu veim achar chatzot yashlimu

Bechal yom taanit sheggozrin al hatztzibbur mippene hatztzarot bet din vehazzekenim yoshvin bevet hakkeneset uvodkim al maase anshe hair meachar tefillat shacharit ad chatzot hayyom umsirin hammichsholot shel averot umazhirin vedorshin vechokrin al baale chamas vaaverot umafrishin otan veal baale zeroa umashpilin otan vechayyotze bidvarim ellu umechatzi hayyom velaerev revia hayyom korin bivrachot uklalot shebbattora shenneemar musar beni al timas veal takotz betochachto umaftirin bannavi betochachot meinyan hatztzara urvia hayyom haacharon mitpallelim mincha umitchannenim vezoakim umitvaddim kefi kocham
Mishneh Torah, Fasts 2: Elu hen hatztzarot shel tzibbur shemmitannin umatriin alehem al hatzarat sone yisrael leyisrael veal hacherev veal haddever veal chayya raa veal haarbe veal hechasil veal hashshiddafon veal hayyerakon veal hammappolet veal hecholaim veal hammezonot veal hammatar

Kal ir sheyyesh bah tzara mikkal ellu otah hair mitanna umatraat ad shettaavor hatztzara vechal sevivoteha mitannot velo matriot aval mevakkeshim alehem rachamim uvchal makom en tzoakin velo matriin beshabbat kemo sheamarnu chutz mitztzarat hammezonot shetztzoakin aleha afillu beshabbat aval en matriin aleha bachatzotzrot beshabbat

Al hatzarat sone yisrael leyisrael ketzad akkum shebbau laaroch milchama im yisrael o littol mehem mas o likkach miyyadam eretz o ligzor alehem gezera afillu bemitzva kalla hare ellu mitannin umatriin ad sheyeruchamu vechal hearim shessevivotehem mitannin aval en matriin ella im ken taku lehitkabbetz leezratan

Al hacherev ketzad afillu cherev shel shalom kegon shearchu milchama akkum im akkum veavru bimkom yisrael af al pi sheen benehem uven yisrael milchama hare zo tzara umitannin aleha shenneemar vecherev lo taavor beartzechem mikkelal sheriyyat hammilchama tzara

Veal haddever e zo hi dever ir sheyyesh bah chamesh meot ragli veyatzu mimmenna shelosha metim bishlosha yamim ze achar ze hare ze dever yatzu beom echad o bearbaa yamim en ze dever hau bah elef veyatzu mimmenna shishsha metim bishlosha yamim ze achar ze dever yatzu beom echad o bearbaa en ze dever vechen lefi cheshbon ze veen hannashim vehakketannim vehazzekenim sheshshavtu mimmelacha bichlal minyan anshe hammedina leinyan ze
Haya dever beeretz yisrael mitannin shear galuyyot yisrael alehen haya dever bammedina veshayyarot holchot uvaot mimmenna limdina acheret shettehen mitannot af al pi shehen rechokot zo mizzo

En mitannin al chayya raa ella bizman shehi meshullachat ketzad nirata bair bayyom hare zo meshullachat nirata bassade bayyom im raata shene bene adam velo barcha mippenehem hare zo meshullachat veim haya sade hassemucha laagam veraata shene bene adam veradfa acharehem hare zo meshullachat lo radfa acharehem enah meshullachat veim haya baagam afillu radfa acharehem enah meshullachat ella im ken tarfa shenehem veachla echad mehen aval im achla shenehem baagam enah meshullachat mippene shezze hu mekomah umippene haravon tarfa lo mippene shehi meshullachat

Battim habbenuyim bemidbarot uvaaratzot hanshammot hoil vehen mekom gedude chayya im alta laggag venatla tinok mearisa hare zo meshullachat veim lo higgia lemidda zo enah meshullachat sheellu bene adam hem shessikkenu beatzmam uvau limkom hachayyot

Shear mine remes haaretz veremes haof sheshshullechu vehizziku kegon shilluach nechashim veakrabbim veen tzarich lomar tzerain veyattushin vehaddome lahen en mitannin alehem velo matriin aval zoakin belo terua

Al haarbe veal hechasil afillu lo nire mehen ella kanaf echad bechal eretz yisrael mitannin umatriin alehen veal haggovay bechal shehu aval al hechagav en mitannin alav velo matriin ella zoakin bilvad
Al hashshiddafon veal hayyerakon mishsheyyatchil battevua vaafillu lo hitchil ella mimmakom katan kimlo pi tannur gozrin alav taanit umatriin

Al hammappolet ketzad hare sheravta bair mappolet ketalim beriim sheenan omdim betzad hannahar hare zo tzara umitannin umatriin aleha vechen al haraash veal haruchot shehen mappilin et habbinyan vehorgin mitannin umatriin alehen

Al hecholayim ketzad hare sheyyarad choli echad laanashim harbe beotah hair kegon askara o charchur vechayyotze bahen vehau metim beoto hacholi hare zo tzarat tzibbur vegozrin lah taanit umatriin vechen chikkuch lach hare hu kishchin poreach veim pashat berov hatztzibbur mitannin umatriin alav aval chikkuch yavesh tzoakim alav bilvad

Al hammezonot ketzad hare shehuzlu devarim shel sechora sherov chayye anshe otah hair mehen kegon kele pishtan bevavel veyayin veshemen beeretz yisrael venitmaet hammassa vehammattan ad sheyyitztarech hattaggar limkor shevi asara beshishsha veachar kach yimmatze lokeach hare zo tzarat tzibbur umatriin aleha vezoakin aleha beshabbat

Al hammatar ketzad hare sherabbu alehen geshamim ad sheyyatzeru lahen hare ellu mitpallelin alehen sheen lecha tzara yetera mizzo shehabbattim noflin venimtzeu battehen kivrehen uveretz yisrael en mitpallelin al rov haggeshamim mippene shehi eretz harim uvattehem benuyim baavanim verov haggeshamim tova lahen veen mitannin lehaavir hattova

Tevua shetztzamcha venimna hammatar vehitchilu tzemachin livash hare ellu mitannin vezoakin ad sheyyerdu geshamim o ad sheyyivshu hatztzemachim vechen im higgia zeman happesach o karov lo beeretz yisrael shehu zeman perichat hailanot sham velo yardu geshamim hare ellu mitannin vezoakin ad sheyyerdu geshamim haruyin leilanot o ad sheyyaavor zemannam

Vechen im higgia zeman chag hassukkot velo yardu geshamim harbe kede lemalleot mehem habborot hashshichin vehammearot hare ellu mitannin ad sheyyered geshem harauy levorot veim en lahem mayim lishtot mitannim al haggeshamim bechal et shello yihye lahem mayim lishtot vaafillu bimot hachamma
Pasku haggeshamim ben geshem legeshem arbaim yom bimot haggeshamim hare zo makkat batztzoret umitannim vezoakim ad sheyyerdu haggeshamim o ad sheyyaavor zemannam
Mishneh Torah, Fasts 3: Hare shello yardu lahem geshamim kal ikkar mittechillat yemot haggeshamim im higgia shiva asar bemarcheshvan velo yardu geshamim matchilin talmide chachamim bilvad lehitannot sheni vachamishi vesheni vechal hattalmidim reuyin lechach

Higgia rosh chodesh kislev velo yardu geshamim bet din gozrin shalosh taaniyyot al hatztzibbur sheni vachamishi vesheni umuttarin bahen leechol velishtot ballayela veanshe mishmar en mitannin immahen mippene shehen asukin baavoda vechal haam nichnasim levatte kenesiyyot umitpallelin vezoakin umitchannenin kederech sheosin bechal hattaaniyyot

Avru ellu velo naanu bet din gozrin shalosh taaniyyot acherot al hatztzibbur sheni vachamishi vesheni uvshalosh ellu ochlin veshotin mibbeod yom kemo sheosin betzom kippur veanshe mishmar mitannin miktzat hayyom velo mashlimin veanshe bet av vehem haoskin baavoda beoto hayyom lo yihu mitannim kal ikkar vechal taanit sheochlin bah mibbeod yom im achal ufasak vegamar shello leechol eno chozer veochel af al pi sheyyesh shehut bayyom

Beshalosh taaniyyot ellu kal haam asurin baasiyyat melacha bayyom umuttarin ballayela vaasurin birchitzat kal hagguf bechammin aval panav yadav veraglav muttar lefichach noalin et hammerchatzaot vaasurin besicha veim lehaavir et hazzuhama muttar vaasurin betashmish hammitta uvinilat hassandal bair aval badderech muttar linol umitpallelin bevatte kenesiyyot vezoakin umitchannenin kishar taaniyyot

Avru ellu velo naanu bet din gozrin sheva taaniyyot acherot al hatztzibbur sheni vachamishi vesheni vachamishi vesheni vachamishi vesheni uvellu hashsheva bilvad ebbarot umenikot mitannot aval bishar hattaaniyyot en ebbarot umenikot mitannot veaf al pi sheenan mitannot en meannegot atzman betafnukim ella ochlot veshotot kede kiyyum havalad
Uvsheva taaniyyot ellu anshe mishmar mitannin umashlimin veanshe bet av mitannin miktzat hayyom velo mashlimin vechal davar shehu asur beshalosh emtzaiyyot asur beellu hashsheva haacharonot

Viterot ellu shebbahen bilvad matriin umitpallelin birchov hair umoridin zaken lehochiach laam kede sheyyashuvu middarkam umosifin shesh berachot bitfillat shacharit uvitfillat mincha venimtzeu mitpallelin chd berachot venoalin et hachanuyyot uvashsheni mattin leet erev ufotchin et hachanuyyot aval bachamishi potchin kal hayyom mippene kevod hashshabbat veim yesh lachanut shene petachim poteach echad venoel echad veim yesh lachanut itztabba poteach kedarko bachamishi veeno choshesh

Avru ellu velo naanu memaatin bemassa umattan uvvinyan shel simcha kegon tziyyur vechiyyur uvintia shel simcha kegon mine hadas umine ahalim ummaatin beerusin venissuin ella im ken lo kiyyem mitzvat periyya urviyya vechal mi shekkiyyem mitzvat periyya urviyya asur lo leshammesh mittato bishne reavon ummaatin bishelat shalom ben adam lachavero vettalmide chachamim lo yishalu shalom ella kinzufin uchimnuddin lammakom veam haaretz shennatan lahem shalom machzirin lo besafa rafa vechoved rosh

Talmide chachamim chozrin levaddam umitannim sheni vachamishi vesheni ad sheyyetze nisan shel tekufa aval lo hatztzibbur sheen gozrin al hatztzibbur bishvil geshamim shello yardu yeter mishshelosh esre taaniyyot ellu uchshemmitannin hayechidim ad sheyyatza nisan muttarin leechol ballayela umuttarin baasiyyat melacha uvirchitza uvsicha vetashmish hammitta unilat hassandal kishar kal hattaaniyyot umafsikin lerashe chodashim ufurim yatza nisan shel tekufa vehu keshehiggia hashshemesh litchillat mazzal shor en mitannim sheen haggeshamim bazzeman hazze ella siman kelala hoil velo yardu kal ikkar mittechillat hashshana

Bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael vechal haddome lah aval mekomot sheonat haggeshamim shellahen kodem yz bemarcheshvan o achar zeman ze kesheyyaggia zemannam velo yardu geshamim yechidim mitannim sheni vachamishi vesheni umafsikin berashe chodashim uvachanukka uvfurim veshohin achare chen kemo shiva yamim im lo yardu geshamim bet din gozrin al hatztzibbur shelosh esre taaniyyot al hasseder sheamarnu

Kal taaniyyot sheggozrin hatztzibbur bechutza laaretz ochlim bahem ballayela vedinehem kedin shear hattaaniyyot sheen gozrin al hatztzibbur taanit kegon tzom kippur ella beeretz yisrael bilvad uviglal hammatar uvotan eser taaniyyot shehen shalosh emtzaiyyot vesheva acharonot
Mishneh Torah, Fasts 4: Vechal yom vaom mishsheva taaniyyot haacharonot shel matar mitpallelin al seder ze motziin et hatteva lirchovah shel ir vechal haam mitkabbetzim umitkassim besakkim venotnin efer makle al gabbe hatteva veal gabbe sefer tora kede lehagdil et habbechiyya ulhachnia libbam veechad min haam notel min haefer venoten berosh hannasi uvrosh av bet din bemakom hanachat tefillin kede sheyyikkalmu veyashuvu vechal echad veechad notel venoten berosho

Veachar kach maamidin benehen zaken chacham vehen yoshvin lo haya sham zaken chacham maamidin chacham lo haya sham lo zaken velo chacham maamidin adam shel tzura veomer lifnehem divre kibbushin achenu lo sak velo taanit gormin ella teshuva umaasim tovim shekken matzinu beninve shello neemar beanshe ninve vayyar haelohim et sakkam veet taanitam ella vayyar haelohim et maasehem uvkabbala hu omer kiru levavchem veal bigdechem umosif beinyanot ellu kefi kocho ad sheyyachnia libbam veyashuvu teshuva gemura

Veachar sheggomer ze divre kibbushin omdin bitfilla umaamidin sheliach tzibbur harauy lehitpallel betaaniyyot ellu veim haya oto sheomer divre hakkibbushin rauy lehitpallel mitpallel veim lav moridin acher

Vee ze hu harauy lehitpallel betaaniyyot ellu ish shehu ragil bitfilla veragil likrot battora neviim uchtuvim umtuppal veen lo veyesh lo yegia bassade velo yihye bevanav uvivne beto vechal kerovav hannilvim alav baal avera ella yihye beto rekan min haaverot velo yatza alav shem ra beyalduto shefal berech umrutztze laam veyesh lo neima vekolo arev veim haya zaken im kal hammiddot haellu hare ze mefoar veim eno zaken hoil veyesh bo kal hammiddot haellu yitpallel

Ushliach tzibbur matchil umitpallel ad birkat goel yisrael veomer zichronot veshofarot meen hatztzara veomer el batztzarata li karati vayyaaneni essa enay el heharim vego mimmaamakkim keraticha tefilla leani chi yaatof vego

Veomer divre tachanunim kefi kocho veomer ree na veanyenu veriva rivenu umaher legaolenu umitchannen veomer besof tachanunav mi sheana et avraham avinu behar hammoriyya hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze baruch atta goel yisrael

Umatchil lehosif shesh berachot shehu mosif zo achar zo umitchannen bechal achat mehen bedivre tachanunim ufsukim middivre kabbala umikkitve hakkodesh kefi shehu ragil vechotem bechal achat mehen bachatimot ellu
Barishona hu chotem mi sheana et moshe vaavotenu al yam suf hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze baruch atta zocher hannishkachot
Bashsheniyya hu chotem mi sheana et yehoshua baggilgal hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze baruch atta shomea terua
Bashshelishit hu chotem mi sheana et shemuel bammitzpa hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze baruch atta shomea tzeaka
Barviit hu chotem mi sheana et eliyyahu behar hakkarmel hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze baruch atta shomea tefilla
Bachamishit hu chotem mi sheana et yona bime haddaga hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze baruch atta haone beet tzara

Bashshishshit hu chotem mi sheana et david ushlomo beno birushalayim hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze baruch atta hamrachem al haaretz vechal haam onin amen achar kal beracha uvracha kederech sheonin achar kal habberachot
Bashsheviit omer refaenu venerafe vechu vegomer hattefilla al hasseder vetokin bachatzotzrot vechasseder hazze osin bechal makom

Keshehau mitpallelin al hasseder hazze birushalayim hau mitkannesin lehar habbayit keneged shaar hammizrach umitpallelin kasseder hazze uchshemmaggia sheliach tzibbur lomar mi sheana et avraham omer baruch atta elohenu elohay yisrael min haolam vead haolam baruch atta goel yisrael vehen onin acharav baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed vechazzan hakkeneset omer lattokim tiku bene aharon tiku vechozer hammitpallel veomer mi sheana et avraham behar hammoriyya hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze veachar kach tokin hakkohanim umriin vetokin

Vechen babberacha hashsheniyya lazo shehi rishona min hashshesh shemmosif chotem bah baruch elohim elohe yisrael min haolam vead haolam baruch atta zocher hannishkachot vehen onin baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed vechazzan hakkeneset omer lahen hariu bene aharon hariu vechozer sheliach tzibbur veomer mi sheana et moshe vaavotenu al yam suf hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem bayyom hazze veachar kach meriin vetokin umriin

Vechen al kal beracha uvracha beachat omer tiku uvachat omer hariu ad sheyyigmor kal sheva habberachot venimtzeu hakkohanim paam tokin umriin vetokin ufaam meriin vetokin umriin sheva peamim veen osim hasseder ze ella behar habbayit bilvad uchshehen tokin umriin sham tokin bachatzotzrot uvshofar keechad kemo sheamarnu

Sheva taaniyyot haellu kal makom sheggozrin otam sham achar shemmitpallelin yotzin kal haam levet hakkevarot uvochin umitchannenim sham kelomar hare attem metim keellu im lo tashuvu middarchechem uvchal taanit mittaaniyyot hatztzarot sheggozrin al hatztzibbur mitpallelin tefillat neila bechal makom
Yardu lahem geshamim ad matay yihu yordin veyifseku hatztzibbur min hattaanit mishsheyyerdu beomek haaretz hachareva tefach uvabbenonit tefachayim uvaavuda ad sheyyerdu beomek shelosha tefachim
Mishneh Torah, Fasts 5: Yesh sham yamim shekkal yisrael mitannim bahem mippene hatztzarot sheeru bahen kede leorer hallevavot liftoach darche hatteshuva veyihye ze zikkaron lemaasenu haraim umaase avotenu shehaya kemaasenu atta ad sheggaram lahem velanu otan hatztzarot shebbezichron devarim ellu nashuv lehetiv shenneemar vehitvaddu et aonam veet aon avotam vego

Veellu hen yom shelishi betishre shebbo neherag gedalya ben achikam venichbat gachelet yisrael hannishara vesibbev lehatam galutan vaasiri betevet shebbo samach melech bavel nevuchadnetzar harasha al yerushalayim veheviah bematzor uvmatzok vez betammuz chamishsha devarim eru bo nishtabberu halluchot uvatel hattamid mibbayit rishon vehuvkea yerushalayim bechurban sheni vesaraf appostomos harasha et hattora veheemid tzelem bahechal

Vetisha beav chamishsha devarim eru bo nigzar al yisrael bammidbar shello yikkansu laaretz vecharav habbayit barishona uvashsheniyya venilkeda ir gedola uvetar shemah vehau bah alafim urvavot miyyisrael vehaya lahem melech gadol vedimmu kal yisrael ugdole hachachamim shehu hammelech hammashiach venafal beyad haromiyyim venehergu kullam vehayeta tzara gedola kemo churban bet hammikdash uvo bayyom hammuchan lefuranut charash turnusrufus harasha et hahechal veet sevivav lekayyem ma shenneemar tziyyon sade techaresh

Vearbaa yeme hatztzomot haellu hare hen meforashin bakkabbala tzom harvii vetzom hachamishi vego tzom harvii ze shiva asar betammuz shehu bachodesh harvii vetzom hachamishi ze tisha beav shehu bachodesh hachamishi vetzom hashshevii ze shelosha betishre shehu bachodesh hashshevii vetzom haasiri ze asara betevet shehu bachodesh haasiri

Venahagu kal yisrael bizmannim ellu lehitannot uvg baadar zecher lattaanit shehitannu bime haman shenneemar divre hatztzomot vezaakatam veim chal yg baadar lihot beshabbat makdimin umitannin bachamishi shehu y aval echad mearbaa yeme hatztzomot shechal lihot beshabbat dochin oto leachar hashshabbat chal lihot beerev shabbat mitannin beerev shabbat uvchal hatztzomot haellu en matriin velo mitpallelin bahen tefillat neila aval korin battora shacharit umincha be vayechal mshe uvchullan ochlim veshotin ballayela chutz mittisha beav

Mishsheyyikkanes av memaatin besimcha veshabbat shechal tisha beav lihot betochah asur lesapper ulchabbes velilbosh keli megohatz afillu keli pishtan ad sheyyaavor hattaanit vaafillu lechabbes ulhanniach leachar hattaanit asur uchvar nahagu yisrael shello leechol basar beshabbat zo velo yikkansu lammerchatz ad sheyyaavor hattaanit veyesh mekomot shennahagu levattel hashshechita merosh hachodesh ad hattaanit

Tisha beav lelo keomo lechal davar veen ochlin ella mibbeod yom uven hashshemashot shello asur keom hakkippurim velo yochal basar velo yishte yayin basseudda hammafsik bah aval shote hu yayin miggitto sheyyesh lo shelosha yamim o pachot veochel basar maliach sheyyesh lo shelosha yamim o yeter velo yochal shene tavshilin

Bamme devarim amurim sheachal erev tisha beav achar chatzot aval im saad kodem chatzot af al pi shehu mafsik bah ochel kal ma sheyyirtze veerev tisha beav shechal lihot beshabbat ochel veshote kal tzarko umaale al shulchano afillu kisuddat shelomo vechen tisha beav atzmo shechal lihot beshabbat eno mechasser kelum

Zo hi middat kal haam sheenan yecholin lisbol yeter midday aval chasidim harishonim kach hayeta middatan erev tisha beav hau meviin lo laadam levaddo pat chareva bemelach veshore bemayim veoshev ben tannur vechirayim veochlah veshote aleha kiton shel mayim bidaga uvshimmamon uvchiyya kemi shemmeto muttal lefanav kaze rauy lachachamim laasot o karov mizze umiyyamenu lo achalnu erev tisha beav tavshil afillu shel adashim ella im ken haya beshabbat

Ubbarot umenikot mitannot umashlimot betisha beav veasur birchitza ben bechammin ben betzonen vaafillu lehoshit etzbao bemayim veasur besicha shel taanug uvinilat hassandal uvtashmish hammitta keom hakkippurim umakom shennahagu laasot bo melacha osin umakom shennahagu shello laasot en osin uvchal makom talmide chachamim betelin veamru chachamim shehaose bo melacha eno roe siman beracha leolam

Talmide chachamim en notnin ze laze shalom betisha beav ella yoshvim davim veneenachim kaavelim veim natan lahem am haaretz shalom machazirim lo besafa rafa vechoved rosh veasur likrot betisha beav battora o banneviim o bakketuvim uvmishna uvahalachot uvigmara uvhaggadot veeno kore ella beiyyov uvkinot uvaddevarim haraim shebbeyirmeyahu vetinokot shel bet rabban betelin bo umiktzat hachachamim nohagin shello lehanniach bo tefillin shel rosh

Mishshecharav bet hammikdash tikkenu chachamim shehau beoto haddor sheen bonin leolam binyan mesuyyad umchuyyar kevinyan hammelachim ella tach beto betit vesad besid umshayyer makom amma al amma keneged happetach belo sid vehallokeach chatzer mesuyyedet umchuyyeret hare zo bechezkatah veen mechayevim oto liklof hakketalim

Vechen hitkinu shehaorech shulchan laasot seudda laorchim mechasser mimmennu meat umanniach makom panuy belo keara min hakkearot haruot latet sham uchshehaishsha osa tachshite hakkesef vehazzahav meshayyeret min mimmine hattachshit shennoheget bahen kede shello yihye tachshit shalem uchshehechatan nose ishsha lokeach efer makle venoten berosho mekom hanachat hattefillin vechal ellu haddevarim kede lizkor yerushalayim shenneemar im eshkachech yerushalami tishkach yemini tidbak leshoni lechikki im lo ezkerechi im lo aale et yerushalami al rosh simchati

Vechen gazru shello lenaggen bichle shir vechal mine zemer vechal mashmie kol shel shir asur lismoach bahen veasur leshaman mippene hachurban vaafillu shira bappe al hayyayin asura shenneemar bashshir lo yishtu yayin uchvar nahagu kal yisrael lomar divre tushbachot o shir shel hodaot lael vechayyotze bahen al hayyayin

Veachar kach gazru al atrot chatanim shello lehannicham kelal veshello yanniach hechatan berosho shum kalil shenneemar haser hammitznefet veharem haatara vechen gazru al atrot kallot im haya shel kesef o zahav aval shel gedil muttar lechalla

Mi sheraa are yehuda bechurbanam omer are kadshecha hau midbar vekorea raa yerushalayim bechurbanah omer yerushalayim midbar vego bet hammikdash bechurbano omer bet kadshenu vetifartenu vego vekorea umehechan chayyav likroa min hatztzofim uchsheyyaggia lammikdash korea kera acher veim paga bammikdash techilla keshsheyyavo midderech hammidbar korea al hammikdash umosif al yerushalayim

Kal hakkeraim haellu kullam korea beyado meemmad vekorea kal kesut shealav ad sheyegalle et libbo veeno meache keraim ellu leolam aval rashshay hu leshallan lemallan lelakketan ultafran kemin sullamot
Haya holech uva lirushalayim holech uva toch sheloshim yom eno korea kera acher veim leachar sheloshim yom chozer vekorea

Kal hatztzomot haellu atidim libbatel limot hammashiach velo od ella shehem atidim lihot yom tov vime sason vesimcha shenneemar ko amar tzevaot tzom harvii vetzom hachamishi vetzom hashshevii vetzom haasiri yihye levet yehuda lesason ulsimcha ulmoadim tovim vehaemet vehashshalom ehavu salik hilchot taoniot
Mishneh Torah, Leavened and Unleavened B: Kal haochel kezayit chametz befesach mittechillat lel chamishsha asar ad sof yom echad veesrim benisan bemezid chayyav karet shenneemar ki kal ochel chametz venichreta beshogeg chayyav karban chattat kevua echad haochel veechad hammache veshote

Hechametz bappesach asur bahanaya shenneemar lo yeachel chametz lo yehe bo hetter achila vehammanniach chametz birshuto befesach af al pi shello achalo over bishne lavin shenneemar lo yerae lecha seor bechal gevulecha veneemar seor lo yimmatze bevattechem veissur hechametz veissur hasseor shebbo machmitzin echad hu

Eno loke mishshum lo yerae ve lo yimmatze ella im ken kana chametz befesach o chimtzo kede sheyyaase bo maase aval im haya lo chametz kodem happesach uva happesach velo biaro ella hinnicho birshuto af al pi sheavar al shene lavin eno loke min hattora mippene shello asa bo maase umakkin oto makkat mardut

Chametz sheavar alav happesach asur bahanaya leolam vedavar ze kenas hu middivre sofrim mippene sheavar al bal yerae uval yimmatze asaruhu afillu hinnicho bishgaga o beones kede shello yanniach adam chametz birshuto befesach kede sheyyehane bo achar happesach

Chametz shennitarev bedavar acher toch happesach ben bemino ben shello bemino hare ze oser bechal shehu vechametz shel yisrael sheavar alav happesach af al pi shehu asur bahanaya im nitarev ben bemino ben shello bemino hare ze muttar leachlo achar happesach shello kansu veasru ella bechametz atzmo aval hattaarovet muttar baachila leachar happesach

En chayyavin karet ella al achilat atzmo shel chametz aval eruv chametz kegon kutach habbavli veshechar hammadi vechal haddome lahen middevarim shehechametz meorav bahen im achalan befesach loke veen bo karet shenneemar kal machmetzet lo tochelu bamme devarim amurim besheachal kezayit chametz betoch hattaarovet bichde achilat shalosh betzim hu shelloke min hattora aval im en battaarovet kezayit bichde achilat shalosh betzim af al pi sheasur lo leechol im achal eno loke ella makkin oto makkat mardut

Haochel min hechametz atzmo befesach kal shehu hare ze asur min hattora shenneemar lo yeachel veaf al pi chen eno chayyav karet o karban ella al kashshiur shehu kezayit vehaochel pachot mikkezayit bemezid makkin oto makkat mardut

Asur leechol chametz beom arbaa asar mechatzot hayyom ulmala shehu mittechillat shaa sheviit bayyom vechal haochel bazzeman hazze loke min hattora shenneemar lo tochal alav chametz kelomar al karban happesach kach lamdu mippi hashshemua beferush davar ze lo tochal chametz mishshaa sheruya lishchitat happesach shehu ben haarbayim vehu chatzi hayyom

Veasru chachamim leechol chametz mittechillat shaa shishshit kede shello yigga beissur tora umittechillat shaa shishshit yihye hechametz asur baachila uvahanaya kal shaa shishshit middivre sofrim ushar hayyom mishsheviit ulmala min hattora shaa chamishit en ochlin bah chametz gezera mishshum yom hamunnan shemma yite ben chamishit leshishshit veeno asur bahanaya beshaa chamishit lefichach tolin bah teruma velechem toda vechayyotze bahen mechametz shehu kodesh lo ochlin velo sorfin ad shettaggia shaa shishshit vesorfin hakkol

Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 1: Sheshet yamim haellu sheasaran hakkatuv baasiyyat melacha shehen rishon ushvii shel pesach verishon ushmini shel chag hassukkot uvom chag hashshavuot uvechad lachodesh hashshevii hen hannikrain yamim tovim ushvitat kullan shava shehen asurin bechal melechet avoda chutz mimmelacha shehi letzorech achila shenneemar ach asher yeachel lechal nefesh vego

Kal hashshovet mimmelechet avoda beechad mehen hare kiyyem mitzvat ase shehare neemar bahen shabbaton kelomar shevot vechal haose beechad mehen melacha sheenah letzorech achila kegon shebbana o haras o arag vechayyotze baellu hare bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase shenneemar kal melechet avoda lo taasu kal melacha lo yease vahem veim asa beedim vehatraa loke min hattora
Haose avot melachot harbe beom tov behatraa achat kegon shezzara uvana vesatar vearag behatraa achat eno loke ella achat chilluk melachot leshabbat veen chilluk melachot leom tov

Kal melacha shechayyavin aleha beshabbat im asa otah beom tov shello letzorech achila loke chutz min hahotzaa mershut lirshut vehahavara shemmittoch shehuttera hotzaa beom tov letzorech achila huttera shello letzorech achila lefichach muttar beom tov lehotzi katan o sefer tora o mafteach vechayyotze beellu mershut lirshut vechen muttar lehavir af al pi sheeno letzorech achila ushar melachot kal sheyyesh bo tzorech achila muttar kegon shechita vaafiyya velisha vechayyotze bahen vechal sheen bahen tzorech achila asur kegon ketiva vaariga uvinyan vechayyotze bahen

Kal melacha sheefshar leheasot meerev yom tov velo yihye bah hefsed velo chesron im naaset mibbaerev asru chachamim laasot otah beom tov af al pi shehi letzorech achila velamma asru davar ze gezera shemma yaniach adam melachot sheefshar laasotan meerev yom tov leom tov venimtza yom tov kullo holech baasiyyat otan melachot veyimmana missimchat yom tov velo yihye lo penay leechol

Umizze hattaam atzmo lo asru hahotzaa beom tov veaf al pi shekkal hahotzaa hi melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev yom tov velamma lo asaruha kede leharbot besimchat yom tov veolich veyavi kal ma sheyyirtze veyashlim chafatzav velo yihye kemi sheyyadav asurot aval shear melachot sheefshar laasotan meerev yom tov hoil veyesh bahen esek en osin otan beom tov
Ketzad en kotzrin velo dashin velo zorin velo borrin velo tochanin et hachittim velo merakkedin beom tov shekkal ellu vechayyotze bahem efshar laasotan meerev yom tov veen bechach hefsed velo chesron

Aval lashin veofin veshochatin umvashshelin beom tov sheim asa ellu mibbaerev yesh bechach hefsed o chesron taam sheen lechem cham o tavshil shebbishshel hayyom kelechem shenneefa meemesh uchtavshil shenitbashshel meemesh velo basar shennishchat hayyom kevasar shennishchat meemesh vechen kal kayyotze beellu vechen machshire ochel nefesh sheyyesh bahen chesron im naasu mibbaerev osin otan beom tov kegon shechikat tavlin vechayyotze bahen
En ofin umvashshelin beom tov ma sheyyeachel bechol velo huttera melacha shehi letzorech achila ella kede lehanot bah beom tov asa kede leechol beom tov vehotir muttar leechol hammotar bechol

Memallea ishsha kedera basar af al pi sheenah tzericha ella lachaticha achat memalle nachtom chavit shel mayim af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lekiton echad ummallea ishsha tannur pat af al pi sheenah tzericha ella lechikkar echad shebbizman shehappat merubba battannur hi neefet yafe umoleach adam kamma chatichot basar bevat achat af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lachaticha achat vechen kal kayyotze baze

Hamvashshel o haofe beom tov kede leechol bo bayyom o shezzimmen orchim velo bau venishar hattavshil vehappat hare ze muttar leechol lemachar ben bechol ben beshabbat uvilvad shello yaarim veim heerim asur vaafillu beshabbat sheachar yom tov mippene shehechmiru bemaarim yoter min hammezid

Mi shehayeta lo behema mesukkenet lo yishchot otah beom tov ella im ken yodea sheyyachol leechol mimmenna kezayit tzali mibbeod yom kede shello yishchot beom tov ma sheyyochal bechol vechen kal kayyotze baze

En ofin umvashshelin beom tov kede lehaachil kutim o kelavim shenneemar hu levaddo yease lachem lachem velo lechutim lachem velo lichlavim lefichach mezammenin et hakkuti beshabbat veen mezammenin oto beom tov gezera shemma yarbe bishvilo aval im ba hakkuti meelav ochel immahen ma shehen ochlin shekkevar hechinuha

Behema shechetzyah shel kuti vechetzyah shel yisrael muttar leshachotah beom tov shei efshar leechol mimmenna kezayit basar belo shechita aval issa shechetzyah lechutim vechetzyah leyisrael asur leefot otah mippene sheyyachol lechallek habbatzek bene hachayil shennatnu kemach leyisrael laasot lahem pat beom tov im keshennotnin pat mimmenna letinok en makpidin muttar leefoto lahen beom tov shekkal pat ufat rauy lattinok issat hakkelavim bizman sheharoim ochlin mimmenna neefet beom tov
Hamvashshel beom tov lechutim o livhema o lehanniach lechol eno loke sheillu bau lo orchim haya oto tavshil rauy lahen asa lenafsho vehotir muttar lehaachil mimmennu lechutim velivhema

Rechitza vesicha hare hen bichlal achila ushtiyya veosin otan beom tov shenneemar ach asher yeachel lechal nefesh lechal shetztzarich hagguf lefichach mechimmin chammin beom tov verochetz bahen panav yadav veraglav aval kal gufo asur mishshum gezerat merchatz vechammin shehuchammu meerev yom tov rochetz bahen kal gufo beom tov shello gazru al davar ze ella beshabbat bilvad

Kal sheasur beshabbat ben mishshum shehu dome limlacha o mevi lide melacha ben shehu mishshum shevut hare hu asur beom tov ella im ken haya bo tzorech achila vechayyotze bah o devarim shehem muttarim beom tov kemo sheyyitbaer bahalachot ellu vechal sheasur letaltelo beshabbat asur letaltelo beom tov ella letzorech achila vechayyotze bah vechal shemmuttar beshabbat muttar beom tov veyesh beom tov ma sheen beshabbat issur muktze shehammuktze asur beom tov umuttar beshabbat mippene sheyyom tov kal mishshabbat asru bo hammuktze shemma yavo lezalzel bo

Ketzad tarnegolet haomedet legaddel betzim veshor haomed lacharisha veone shovach uferot haomdin lischora kal ellu vechayyotze bahen muktze hen veasur leechol mehen beom tov ad sheyyachin otam mibbaerev veyachashov alehem laachila aval beshabbat hakkol muchan etzel shabbat veeno tzarich hachana uchshem shehammuktze asur beom tov kach hannolad asur

Chol mechin leshabbat vechol mechin leom tov aval en yom tov mechin leshabbat velo shabbat mechina leom tov lefichach betza shennolda beom tov achar hashshabbat asura veaf al pi shehattarnegolet omedet laachila hoil umeemesh nigmera habbetza nimtza shabbat mechin otah leom tov vaasaruha bechal yom tov gezera mishshum yom tov sheachar shabbat vechen betza shennolda bechal shabbat asura gezera mishshum shabbat sheachar yom tov

Uchshem sheasur leachlah kach asur letaltelah vaafillu nitarva beelef kullan asurot shehare lemachar yutteru hakkol vechal davar sheyyesh lo mattirin afillu beelef alafim eno batel hashshochet tarnegolet beom tov umatza bah betzim gemurot hare ellu muttarot sheen ze davar matzuy tamid vedavar sheeno matzuy ella akray bealma lo gazru bo

Ze sheanu osin bechutza laaretz kal yom tov meellu shene yamim minhag hu veom tov sheni middivre sofrim hu umiddevarim shennitchaddeshu baggalut veen osin bene eretz yisrael shene yamim tovim ella berosh hashshana bilvad uvhilchot kiddush hachodesh missefer ze nevaer ikkar minhag ze umee ze taam osin rosh hashshana shene yamim bechal makom

Yom tov sheni af al pi shehu middivre sofrim kal davar sheasur barishon asur bashsheni vechal hamchallel yom tov sheni vaafillu shel rosh hashshana ben bedavar shehu mishshum shevut ben bimlacha ben sheyyatza chutz lattechum makkin oto makkat mardut o menaddin oto im lo yihye min hattalmidim uchshem sheharishon asur bahesped vetaanit vechayyav besimcha kach hashsheni veen benehen hefresh ella leinyan met bilvad

Ketzad hammet beom tov rishon yitasseku bikvurato hakkutim uvom tov sheni yitasseku bo yisrael veosin lo kal tzerachav kegon asiyyat hammitta utfirat hattachrichin uktzitzat habbesamim vechal kayyotze baze sheyyom tov sheni legabbe hammet kechol hu chashuv vaafillu bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana

Shene yamim tovim ellu shel galuyyot shette kedushshot hen veenan keom echad lefichach davar shehaya muktze beom tov rishon o shennolad barishon im hechin oto lashsheni hare ze muttar ketzad betza shennolda barishon teachel bashsheni chayya veof shennitztzodu barishon yeachlu bashsheni davar hamchubbar lakkarka shenneekar barishon yeachel bashsheni vechen muttar lichchol et haayin beom tov sheni veaf al pi sheen sham choli bamme devarim amurim bishne yamim tovim shel galuyyot aval shene yamim shel rosh hashshana kedushsha achat hen uchom echad hen chashuvim lechal ellu haddevarim ella leinyan hammet bilvad aval betza shennolda barishon shel rosh hashshana asura bashsheni vechen kal kayyotze baze shabbat hassemucha leom tov venolda betza beechad mehen asura bashsheni vechen kal kayyotze baze vaafillu nolda beom sheni lo teachel beshabbat hassemucha lo
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 2: Efroach shennolad beom tov asur mippene shehu muktze veegel shennolad beom tov im hayeta immo omedet laachila muttar mippene shehu muchan al gabbe immo veillu shachat immo haya ze shebbemeeha muttar beom tov af al pi shello nolad

Behemot sheyyotzot veroot chutz lattechum uvaot velanot betoch hattechum hare ellu muchanin velokchin mehen veshochatin otan beom tov aval haroot velanot chutz lattechum im bau beom tov en shochatin otan beom tov mippene shehen muktzin veen daat anshe hair alehem

Vechen behemat kadashim shennolad bah mum beom tov hoil velo hayeta dato aleha meerev yom tov asur leshachotah beom tov lefichach asur lirot mume kadashim beom tov gezera shemma yattirem hechacham bemuman veyavo ze lishchot bo bayyom aval roe hu hammum meerev yom tov ulmachar mattir o oser

Bechor shennolad umumo immo hare ze muchan veen mevakkerim oto beom tov veim avar veraa mumo uvikkero vehittiro hare ze shochet veochel bechor shennafal labbor ose lo parnasa bimkomo shehare eno yachol lehaaloto mippene sheeno rauy lishchita beom tov oto veet beno shennaflu labbor maale et harishon al menat leshachoto veeno shochato umaarim umaale et hashsheni al menat leshachoto veshochet et e ze mehen sheyyirtze mishshum tzaar baale chayyim hittiru lehaarim behemat chullin shennafla min haggag veamda meet leet vahare hi tzericha bedika shochatin otah beom tov vetibbadek efshar shettimmatze keshera veteachel

Avazin vetarnegolin veonim shebbabbayit hare ellu muchanin veen tzerichin zimmun aval yone shovach veone aliyya vetzipporim shekkinnenu bitfichin o bechira uvappardes hare ellu muktze vetzarich lezammen mibbaerev velomar ellu veellu ani notel veeno tzarich lenaanea

Zimmen shechorim ulvanim umatza shechorim bimkom levanim ulvanim bimkom shechorim asurim sheani omer shemma otan shezzimmen parchu lahen veellu acherim hen vechal safek muchan asur zimmen shenayim umatza shelosha hakkol asur shelosha umatza shenayim muttarin zimmen betoch hakken umatza lifne hakken im en sham bakken ella hen veenan yecholin lifroach af al pi sheyyesh sham ken acher bekeren zavit betoch chamishshim amma hare ellu muttarin sheen hamdadde medadde ella keneged kinno beshave

Dagim shebbevevarin gedolim vechen chayya vaof shebbevevarin gedolim kal shehu mechussar tzida ad sheomrim have metzuda untzudennu hare ze muktze veen tzadin otan beom tov veim tzad lo yochlo vechal sheeno tzarich metzuda hare ze muchan vetzadin oto beom tov veochlin oto vechen chayya shekkinnena befardes hassamuch lair yeladeha keshehen ketannim sheenan tzerichin tzida enam tzerichim zimmun mippene sheddato alehen

Metzudot chayya veofot vedagim shepperasan meerev yom tov lo yittol mehen beom tov ella im ken yodea shennitztzodu meerev yom tov hassocher ammat hammayim meerev yom tov ulmachar hishkim umatza bah dagim hare ellu muttarin shekkevar nitztzodu meerev yom tov vahare hen muchanin

Bayit shehi male perot muchanin venifchat notel mimmekom happechat haomed al hammuktze meerev yom tov bashshana hashsheviit shekkal happerot hefker tzarich sheyyirshom veyomar mikkan vead kan ani notel veim lo rasham lo yittol

Kuti shehevi teshura leyisrael beom tov im yesh meoto hammin bimchubbar lakkarka o shehevi chayya o ofot o dagim sheefshar letzudan bo bayyom hare ellu asurin ad laerev veyamtin bichde sheyyeasu vaafillu hadas vechayyotze bo eno meriach bo laerev ad sheyyamtin bichde sheyyeasu veim en meoto hammin bimchubbar lakkarka o shehayeta tzurato muchachat alav shemmeetmol neekar o nitztzod im hevio mittoch hattechum muttar veim hevio michutz lattechum hare ze asur vehabba bishvil yisrael ze michutz lattechum muttar leyisrael acher

Etzim shennashru min haddekel beom tov asur lehassikan mippene shehen nolad veim nashru letoch hattannur marbe alehen etzim muchanin umassikan aremat hatteven veotzar shel etzim en matchilin bahen beom tov ella im ken hechin mibbaerev mippene shehen muktze veim haya hatteven meorav bekotzim shehare eno rauy ella leesh hare ze muchan

En mevakkein etzim missavar shel korot mippene shehen muktze velo min hakkora shennishbera beom tov mippene shehi nolad vechen kelim shennishberu beom tov en massikin bahen mippene shehen nolad aval massikin bechelim shelemim o bechelim shennishberu meerev yom tov shehare huchnu limlacha acheret mibbaerev kayyotze bo egozim ushkedim sheachalan meerev yom tov massikin biklippehen beom tov veim achalan beom tov en massikin biklippehen veyesh nuschaot sheyyesh bahen sheim achalan mibbaerev en massikin biklippehen shehare huktzu veim achalan beom tov massikin mippene shehen muchanin al gav haochel
Kotz ratov hare hu muktze mippene sheeno rauy lehassaka lefichach asur lo laasoto kemo shippud litzlot bo basar vechen kal kayyotze baze

Ale kanim vaale gefanim af al pi shehen mechunnasin bekarpaf kevan sheharuach mefazzeret otan hare hen kimfuzzarin vaasurin veim hinniach alehen keli kaved meerev yom tov hare ellu muchanin

Behema shemmeta beom tov im hayeta mesukkenet meerev yom tov hare ze mechattechah lakkelavim veim lav hoil velo hayeta dato aleha hare ze muktze velo yazzizennah mimmekomah behemat kadashim shemmeta utruma shennitmet lo yazzizennah mimmekomah

Dagim veofot vechayya shehen muktze en mashkin otan beom tov veen notnin lifnehem mezonot shemma yavo likkach mehen vechal sheasur leachlo o lehishtammesh bo beom tov mippene shehu muktze asur letaltelo

Hammachnis afar meerev yom tov im yiched lo bachatzero keren zavit hare ze muchan umuttar letaltelo velaasot bo kal tzerachav vechen efer shehussak meerev yom tov muchan veshehussak beom tov kal zeman shehu cham kede litzlot bo betza muttar letaltelo sheadayin esh hu veim lav asur letaltelo mippene shehu nolad mi shehaya lo deker nautz meerev yom tov venitteko beom tov veheela afar im haya oto afar tichoach hare ze mechasse bo umtaltelo aval im heela gush afar hare ze lo yichtosh oto beom tov
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 3: Mi shehaya lo afar muchan o efer muchan shemmuttar letaltelo hare ze shochet chayya vaof umchasse damam veim en lo afar muchan o efer harauy letaltelo hare ze lo yishchot veim avar veshachat lo yechasse damam ad laerev vechen beriyya shehu safek im chayya hi im behema en shochatin otah beom tov veim shachat lo yechasse damah ad laerev afillu haya lo afar muchan o efer shemma yomar haroe chayya vaddait hi ulfichach kissa damo beom tov veyavo haroe lehattir chelbo

Vechen hashshochet chayya vaof meerev yom tov lo yechasse damam beom tov shachat behema chayya vaof beom tov venitarev damam lo yechasse oto ad laerev veim haya lo afar muchan o efer veyachol lechassot hakkol bidkira achat hare ze yechassehu

Hashshochet behema beom tov muttar lo litlosh tzemer limkom hassakkin beyado uvilvad shello yezizennu mimmekomo ella yishshaer sham mesubbach kishar tzemer hatztzavar aval beof lo yimrot mippene shehu darko venimtza tolesh beom tov

Hammafshit or behema beom tov lo yimlachennu shezze ibbud hu venimtza ose melacha shello letzorech achila aval notno lifne bet hadderisa kede sheyyidresu alav velo yippased velo hittiru davar ze ella mippene simchat yom tov kede shello yimmana millishchot umuttar limloach basar letzali al gabbe haor umaarimim bedavar ze ketzad moleach meat basar mikkan umat mikkan ad sheyyimlach haor kullo

Bamme devarim amurim bemoleach letzali sheeno tzarich melach harbe aval likdera asur limloach al haor vechen en molchin et hachalavim veen mehappechin bahen veen shotchin otan baruach al gabbe yetedot mippene sheenan reuyin laachila

Hammafshit et habbehema lo yargil beom tov ketzad hu hammargil ze hammotzi kal basar meregel achat kede sheyyotzi kal haor shalem velo yikkara mippene shettoreach behefshet ze torach gadol veen bo tzorech lammoed vechen asur laasot bet yad babbasar vehu sheyyaase besakkin shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol umuttar laasot siman babbasar

Molgin et harosh veet haraglayim umhavhavin otan baur aval en toflin otan besid uvcharsit velo baadama veen gozzin otan bemisparayim vechen en gozzin et hayyarak betisporet shello aval metakkenin et haochel sheyyesh bo kotzim kegon kundas veakkeviyyot betisporet

Muttar lalush issa gedola beom tov vehallash issa meerev yom tov eno mafrish mimmenna challa beom tov veim lashah beom tov mafrish mimmenna challa venotnah lakkohen veim hayeta issa temea o shennitmet hachalla lo yevashshel et hachalla sheen mevashshelin beom tov ella leechol vezo lisrefa omedet vechen en sorfin otah beom tov sheen sorfin kadashim shennitmeu beom tov shesserefat kadashim shennitmeu mitzvat ase shenneemar baesh yissaref vaasiyyat melacha sheenah letzorech achila vechayyotze bahen ase velo taase veen ase doche et lo taase vaase

Ketzad yaase bah yenichennah ad haerev veyisrof otah haya yom tov shel pesach sheim yenichennah tachamitz lo yafrish et hachalla batzek ella yofe et kal haissa hattemea veachar kach yafrish hachalla lechem

En ofin befurni chadasha gezera shemma tippachet vetafsid hallechem veyimmana missimchat yom tov en gorfin tannur vechirayim aval mechabbeshin et haefer shebbahen veim i efshar leefot bo o litzlot ella im ken garaf muttar vesotmin pi hattannur betit verefesh shebbisvivot hannahar vehu sherikkecho meemesh aval legabbel tit beom tov asur umuttar legabbel et haefer listom bo pi hattannur

Tannur vechirayim chadashim en sachin otan beshemen beom tov veen tashin otan bematlit veen mefigin otan betzonen kede lechasman veim bishvil leefot bahen muttar en melabbenin et haavanim litzlot o leefot alehen mippene shemmechasseman umassikin veofin befurni umchimmin chammin beantichi

En osin gevina beom tov sheim gibben meerev yom tov en baze chesron taam aval dachin et hattavlin kedarkan sheim yaduch otan mibbaerev yafug taaman aval melach eno niddoch beom tov ella im ken hitta hammachtesh o sheyyaduch bikara vechayyotze bah kede sheyeshanne sheim shachak hammelach meerev yom tov lo yafug taamo veen shochakin et happilpelin barechayim shellahen ella dach otan bimducha kechal hattavlin

En kotshin et harifot bemachteshet gedola aval kotshin bemachteshet ketanna shezze hu hashshinnuy shellah uveretz yisrael afillu biktanna asur shehattevua shellahen tova hi veim kotshin otam meerev yom tov en bechach hefsed

Hakkemach af al pi sherikkedo meerev yom tov vehesir mimmennu hassubbin en merakkedin oto paam sheniyya beom tov ella im ken nafal betocho tzeror o kesam vechayyotze bahem veim shinna muttar ketzad kegon sheyerakked meachore hannafa o sherikked al gabbe hashshulchan vechayyotze beshinnuy ze

Mollin melilot umfarchin kitnit beom tov umnappeach al yad al yad bechal kocho veochel vaafillu bekanon o betamchuy aval lo benafa velo bichvara vechen habborer kitniyyot beom tov borer kedarko becheko uvtamchuy aval lo benafa velo betavla velo bichvara

Bamme devarim amurim keshehaochel merubbe al happesolet aval im hayeta happesolet merubba al haochel borer et haochel umeniach et happesolet veim haya torach bivrerat happesolet min haochel yeter mittorach bivrerat haochel min happesolet af al pi shehaochel merubbe borer et haochel umeniach et happesolet

En mesannenin et hachardal bemisnenet shellah mippene shennire kevorer aval notnin betza bemisnenet shel chardal vehu mistannen meelav veim hayeta hammeshammeret teluya muttar litten lah yayin beom tov aval lo yitle battechilla shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol umaarim vetole et hammeshammeret litlot bah rimmonim vetole bah rimmonim veachar kach noten letochah shemarim
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 4: En motziin et haesh lo min haetzim velo min haavanim velo min hammattachot kegon shechochchin otan zo bazo o makkin zo bazo ad shettetze haesh vechen hanneft hachad beoter shehu bemayim shemmenidin otam ad sheyyiddalek o keli zach kashe o zechuchit melea mayim shemmannichin otah keneged en hashshemesh ad sheyyachazor naghah lappishtan vechayyotze bo veyidlak kal ze vechayyotze bo asur beom tov shello huttar beom tov ella lehavir meesh metzuya aval lehamtzi esh asur shehare efshar lehamtzi otah mibbaerev

Af al pi shehuttera havara beom tov shello letzorech asur lechabbot et haesh afillu huvara letzorech achila shehakkibbuy melacha sheen bo tzorech achila kelal uchshem sheen mechabbim et haesh kach en mechabbim et hanner veim kibba loke kemi shearag o bana

En mesallekin et pi hanner lemala kede shettichbe veen mesirin et hashshemen mimmennu veeno chotech et rosh happetila bichli aval nofetz et roshah beyado agudda shel etzim shehudleka bimdura kal etz shello achaza bo haesh muttar leshamto veeno dome lemesir shemen min hanner

En mechabbin et haddeleka kede lehatztzil mamon beom tov kederech sheen mechabbin beshabbat ella menichah veotze veen mechabbin et hanner mippene tashmish hammitta ella kofe alav keli o ose mechitztza beno leven hanner o motzio levet acher veim eno yachol laasot achat mikkal ellu hare ze asur lechabbot veasur leshammesh ad shettichbe meeleha
Muttar letaltel et hanner vehu dolek veen gozrin shemma yichbe veasur lehaniach et hanner al gabbe dekel vechayyotze bo beom tov shemma yavo lehishtammesh bimchubbar beom tov

En meashshenin biktoret beom tov mippene shehu mechabbe vaafillu lehariach bah veen tzarich lomar legammer et habbayit veet hakkelim shehu asur umuttar leashshen tachat happerot kede sheyyuchsheru laachila kemo shemmuttar litzlot basar al haesh ummattekin et hachardal begachelet shel mattechet aval lo begachelet shel etz mippene shehu mechabbe veen mechabbin et haesh kede shello titashshen hakkedera o habbayit

En nofchin bemappuach beom tov kede shello yaase kederech shehaummanin osin aval nofchin bishfoferet en osin pechamin veen godlin et happetila velo mehavhavin otah velo chotchin otah lishnayim bichli aval memaachah bayyad veshore otah beshemen umanniach otah ben shette nerot umadlik baemtza venimtzet happetila nechleket befi shette nerot

En shovrin et hacheres veen chotchin et hanneyar litzlot alehem veen potzin et hakkane laasoto kemo shippud litzlot bo maliach shippud shennirtzaf af al pi shehu yachol lefashto beyado en metakkenin oto shene kelim shehen mechubbarin bitchillat asiyyatan kegon shette nerot o shene kosot en pochatin otan lishnayim mippene shehu kimtakken keli

En mashchizin et hassakkin bemashchezet shellah aval mechaddedah al gabbe haetz o al gabbe cheres o even veen morim davar ze larabbim kede shello yavou lechaddedah bemashchezet bamme devarim amurim besheyechola lachtoch bedochak o shennifgema aval im enah yechola lachtoch kelal en mashchizin otah afillu al haetz shemma yavo lehashchizah bemashchezet vmippene ze asru leharot sakkin lechacham beom tov shemma tihye peguma veyomar lo asur lishchot bah mishshum pegimatah veyelech vichaddedennah bemashchezet vechacham sheraa hassakkin leatzmo hare ze mashilah leam haaretz

En mevakkein etzim beom tov lo bekordom velo bemaggal velo bimgera ella bekofitz uvatztzad hachad shello aval lo batztzad harachav mippene shehi kekordom velamma asru bekordom vechayyotze bo shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol shehare efshar haya lo levakkea meerev yom tov velamma lo neesar habbikkua kelal mippene sheefshar sheyyifga beetz ave velo yuchal lehaviro veyimmana millevashshel lefichach hittiru levakkea beshinnuy vechal haddevarim haddomin laze mizze hattaam hittiru bahen ma shehittiru veasru ma sheasru
Lo tikkanes ishsha ben haetzim littol mehen ud litzlot bo veen somchin et hakkedera velo et haddelet bivkaat shel kora shello hittiru letaltel etzim beom tov ella lehassaka bilvad

Mesallekin terise chanuyyot umachzirin otan beom tov kede sheyyotzi tavlin shehu tzarich lahen min hachanut velo yimmana missimchat yom tov bamme devarim amurim besheyyesh lahen tzir beemtza aval yesh lahen tzir min hatztzad asur gezera shemma yitka vesheen lahen tzir kal ikkar afillu babbayit muttar lehachazir

Kelim shehen mefutztzalin kegon menora shel chulot vechisse veshulchan shehen chatichot chatichot maamidin otan beom tov vehu shello yitka lefi sheen binyan bechelim avanim shel bet hakkisse muttar letzaddedan beom tov binyan aray hu umishshum kevodo lo gazru

Haose medura beom tov keshehu orech et haetzim eno manniach ze al ze ad sheyyasdir hammaaracha mippene shennire kevone veaf al pi shehu binyan aray asur ella o shofech haetzim beirbuv o orech beshinnuy ketzad manniach etz lemala umanniach acher tachtav veacher tachtav ad shehu maggia laaretz

Vechen hakkedera ochez otah umachnis haavanim tachteha aval lo yannichennah al gabbe haavanim vechen hammitta ochez hakkerashim lemala umachnis haraglayim tachtehen afillu betzim lo yaamid otan beshura al gabbe shura ad sheyyaamdu kemo migdal ella yeshanne veyatchil millemala lematta vechen kal kayyotze baze tzarich shinnuy

Mesirin zevuvin hannitlim babbehema af al pi shehen osin chabbura veen meyalledin et habbehema beom tov aval mesaadin ketzad ochez bavalad shello yippol laaretz venofeach lo bechatmo venoten dad letoch piv hayeta behema tehora verichaka et havalad muttar lezallef mishshilyatah alav velitten bul melach berachmah kede shetterachem alav aval hattemea asur laasot lah ken lefi sheenah tzericha

Keli shennitma meerev yom tov en matbilin oto beom tov gezera shemma yashhe oto betumato veim haya tzarich lehatbil mayim shebbo matbil et hakkeli bememav veeno choshesh keli shehaya tahor litruma veratza lehatbilo lekodesh muttar lehatbilo vechen kal kayyotze baze mittevilot maalot shear hattumot

Keli shennitma beom tov matbilin oto beom tov nitma hakkeli bemashkin temein shehen velad hattuma meerev yom tov matbilin oto beom tov lefi shehu tahor min hattora kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo umadlin bidli tame vehu tahor meelav nidda sheen lah begadim lehachalif maaremet vetovelet bivgadeha

Devarim rabbim asru beom tov mishshum gezerat mikkach umimkar ketzad en poskim damim lechattechilla al habbehema beom tov ella mevi shette behemot shaot zo lazo veshochatin achat mehen umchallekin benehen ulmachar yodin kamma deme hashsheniyya vechal echad veechad noten deme chelko keshehen mechallekin benehen lo yomar ze ani besela veatta bishnayim sheen mazkirin shum damim ella ze notel shelish veze revia

Keshehen mechallekin lo yishkelu bemoznayim sheen mashgichin bechaf moznayim kal ikkar afillu litten bo basar leshamro min haachbarim asur im hau hammoznayim teluyin mippene shennire keshokel bechaf moznayim vetabbach umman asur lishkol beyado veasur lishkol bichli male mayim veen metilin challashim al hammanot aval metilin challashim al besar hakkadashim beom tov kede lechabbev et hammitzva

Lo yomar adam lattabbach ten li bedinar basar ella ten li chelek o chatzi chelek ulmachar osin cheshbon al shaveo vechen lo yikkach mibbaal hachanut bemidda o bemishkal ella ketzad hu ose omer lachenvani malle li keli ze ulmachar noten lo shaveo vaafillu haya keli hamyuchad lemidda yemalleennu vehu shello yazkir lo shem midda
Hannachtom moded tavlin venoten lakkedera bishvil shello yafsid tavshilo aval haishsha lo tamod kemach leissa vechen lo yamod adam seorim litten lifne behemto ella meshaer venoten lah

Umuttar likkach min hachenvani betzim veegozim beminyan vechen kal kayyotze bahen uvilvad shello yazkir lo shum damim velo sechum minyan ketzad sechum hamminyan hare shehaya noshe bo asara rimmonim o asara egozim lo yomar lo beom tov ten li asara kede sheyyihye lecha esrim etzli ella lokeach setam ulmachar ose cheshbon
Holech adam etzel chenvani o roe haragil etzlo o etzel happattam haragil etzlo velokeach mimmennu behemot veofot vechal ma sheyyirtze vehu shello yazkir lo shum damim velo sechum minyan
Halvaat yom tov tovin otah bedin sheim tomar lo nittena lehittava eno noten lo kelum venimtza nimna missimchat yom tov

Af al pi sheen magbihin teruma umaasrot beom tov im hau lo terumot umaasrot shehigbihan meemesh hare ze molichan lakkohen beom tov veen tzarich lomar challa uzroa ulchayayim vekeva shemmolichan lakkohen beom tov veggabbae tzedaka govin min hachatzerot beom tov velo yihu machrizin kederech shemmachrizin bechol ella govin betzina venotnin letoch chekan umchallekin lechal shechuna ushchuna bifne atzmah
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 5: Af al pi shehuttera hotzaa beom tov afillu shello letzorech lo yissa massaot gedolot kederech shehu ose bechol ella tzarich leshannot veim i efshar leshannot muttar ketzad hammevi kadde yayin mimmakom lemakom lo yeviem besal uvkuppa aval mevi hu al ketefo o lefanav hammolich et hatteven lo yafshil et hakkuppa leacharav aval molichah beyado

Vechen massoot sheddarkan lissa otan bemot yissa otan al gabbo meacharav vesheddarkan lissa otan meachorav yissa otan al ketefo vesheddarkan lehinnase al hakkatef yissa otan beyado lefanav o yifrosh alehen beged vechal kayyotze baze mishshinnuy hammassa veim i efshar leshannot nose umevi kedarko bamme devarim amurim benose al haadam aval al gabbe behema lo yavi kelal shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol

En manhigin et habbehema bemakkel veen hassuma yotze bemaklo velo haroe betarmilo veen yotzin bechisse echad haish veechad haishsha shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol vish shehau rabbim tzerichin lo yotzin bechisse acharav umotziin oto al hakkatef afillu beappiron

En molichin et hassullam shel shovach mishshovach leshovach birshut harabbim shemma yomru letakken gaggo hu molicho aval birshut hayyachid molicho af al pi shekkal makom sheasru chachamim mippene marit haayin afillu bechadre chadarim asur kan hittiru mippene simchat yom tov

Mi shehau lo perot al gaggo vetzarich lefannotam lemakom acher lo yoshitem miggag legag vaafillu baggaggin hashshavin velo yeshalshelem bechevel min hachallonot velo yoridem besullamot shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol aval mashshilan afillu derech arubba mimmakom lemakom beoto haggag shachat behema bassade lo yevienna bemot lair o bemota aval meviah evarim evarim

Kal shenneotin bo afillu bechol af al pi sheen neotin bo beom tov kegon tefillin muttar leshalchan lachavero beom tov veen tzarich lomar davar shenneotin bo beom tov kegon yenot shemanim uslatot shemmuttar leshalchan vechal davar sheen neotin bo bechol ad sheyyaase bo maase sheasur laasoto beom tov en meshallechin oto beom tov

Ketzad en meshallechin beom tov tevua lefi sheen neotin bah bechol ella im ken tachan veasur litchon beom tov aval meshallechin kitniyyot mippene shemmevashshelan beom tov o kole otan veochlan umshallechin chayya behema veofot afillu chayyim mippene shemmuttar lishchot beom tov vechen kal kayyotze baze

Kal davar shemmuttar leshalcho beom tov kesheyyishlachennu lachavero teshura lo yishlachennu beshura veen shura pechuta mishshelosha bene adam ketzad hare sheshshalach lachavero behemot o yenot beyad shelosha bene adam keechad o arbaa ze achar ze vechullan holchin beshura achat hare ze asur shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol shalach shelosha minin beyad shelosha bene adam keechad hare ze muttar
Hamarev eruve techumin leom tov hare behemto vechelav uferotav kamohu veen molichin otan ella betoch alpayim amma lechal ruach mimmekom eruvo

Cheftze hefker hare hen keragle mi shezzacha bahen vecheftze hakkutim konin shevita bimkoman veyesh lahen alpayim amma lechal ruach mimmekoman gezera bealim kutim mishshum bealim yisrael perot sheyyatzu chutz limkoman vechazru afillu bemezid lo hifsidu et mekoman mippene shehen keadam sheyyatza beones vechazar beones
Hammoser behemto livno hare hi keragle haav mesarah leroe vaafillu netanah lo beom tov hare hi keragle haroe mesarah lishne roim hare hi keragle bealeha mippene shello kana echad mehen

Mi shezzimmen etzlo orchim beom tov lo yolichu beyadam manot lemakom sheen baal hasseudda yachol lelech bo shekkal hasseudda keragle baal hasseudda lo keragle haorchin ella im ken zacha lahen acher bemanot ellu meerev yom tov

Vechen mi shehau perotav mufkadin beir acheret veervu bene otah hair lavo etzlo lo yaviu lo mipperotav shepperotav kamohu af al pi shehen beyad ellu sheervu bamme devarim amurim besheyyiched lahen keren zavit aval im lo yiched lahen hare hen keragle ze shehen mufkadin etzlo

Bor shel yachid keragle bealav veshel otah hair keragle anshe otah hair veshel ole bavel shehen mesurin lakkol keragle hammalle mehen shekkal mi shemmille mehen molichan lemakom shehu mehallech neharot hammoshchin umaayanot hannovin keragle kal adam veim hau bain michutz lattechum letoch hattechum memallein mehen beshabbat veen tzarich lomar beom tov

Shor shel roe keragle anshe otah hair veshor shel petam keragle mi shellekacho leshachoto beom tov mippene sheddaat bealav lemachro laanashim acherim chutz meanshe otah hair mippene shehu mefuttam vehakkol shomin shamo uvain liknoto vechen im shechato bealav beom tov umachar besaro kal echad veechad min hallokchim molich menato lemakom shehu holech mippene sheddaat bealav meerev yom tov kach hu sheyyikchu mimmennu anshe ayarot acherot venimtza shor ze kevor shel ole bavel shehu masur lakkol
Haggachelet keragle bealeha lo keragle shoalah vehashshalhevet keragle mi shehi beyado lefichach hammadlik ner o etz mechavero molicho lechal makom shehu holech

Hashshoel keli mechavero meerev yom tov af al pi shello netano lo ella beom tov hare hu keragle hashshoel shealo mimmennu beom tov af al pi sheddarko tamid lishl mimmennu keli ze bechal yom tov hare hu keragle hammashil

Shenayim sheshshaalu chaluk echad haechad shealo mimmennu sheyyitteno lo shacharit vehashsheni shealo mimmennu sheyyitteno lo arvit hare keli ze keragle shene hashshoalim veenam molichim oto ella bemakom sheshshenehem yecholin lehallech bo

Achbarim shehen mafsidin et hailanot tzadin otan bammoed bisde hailan tzad kedarko ketzad chofer vetole hammetzuda veim haya sade lavan samuch lisde hailan tzadin otan bassade hallavan beshinnuy kede shello yikkansu lisde hailan veyachrivuha vechetzad tzad beshinnuy noetz shippud baaretz umakke bekordom veachar kach menatteko venimtza mekomo guma

Kotel ginna shennafal bonehu maase hedot o goder oto bekanim vegome vechayyotze bahen vechen im asa maake laggag bone oto maase hedot aval kotel chatzer shennafal bonehu kedarko veim haya gohe sotro mippene hassakkana uvonehu kedarko

Bone adam itztabba leshev o lishon aleha hatztzir vehatztzinnor vehakkora vehammanul vehammafteach shennishberu metakkenan bammoed kedarko ben beshel barzel ben beshel etz shezze hefsed gadol hu sheim yaniach happetach patuach udlatot shevurot nimtza meabbed kal ma shebbabbayit uchvar bearnu kal sheyyesh bo hefsed eno tzarich shinnuy
En chofrin kever lihot muchan lemet sheyyamut veen bonin oto aval im haya asuy hare ze metakkeno bammoed ketzad mosif bemiddato o mekatztzer mimmiddato kede sheyyihye nachon leet sheyyikbor bo

En mefannin et hammet velo et haatzamot mikkever lekever lo mimmechubbad levazuy velo mibbazuy limchubbad veasur laasot ken leolam bishar hayyamim ella im ken haya mefannehu betoch shello mefannehu bishar hayyamim afillu mimmechubbad levazuy

En matliin et hailanot velo mazhimin et hannetiot velo megazzemin aval sachin et hailanot veet happerot shebbahen beshemen veokrin et happishta mippene shehi reuya lachafof bah bammoed vekotzrin et hakkishshut mippene shehi reuya lehattilah leshechar bammoed vechen kal kayyotze baze

En mechannesin et hatztzon laddir kede sheyezabbelu et hakkarka shehare hu medayyer sadehu bammoed veim bau mealehen muttar veen mesayein otan veen mosrin lahen shomer lenaer et hatztzon haya sechir shabbat sechir chodesh sechir shana sechir shavua mesayein otan vesochrin shomer lenaer et tzonam mimmakom lemakom kede sheyezabbelu kal hassade hazzevel shebbechatzer mesallekin oto latztzedadin veim naasa chatzer kerefet bakar motziin oto laashpa

Hammashve pene hakkarka im nitkaven letakken makom sheyyaamid bo keri shel tevua o sheyyadush bo muttar veim nitkaven laavodat haaretz asur vechen hamlakket etzim mittoch sadehu im letzorech etzim muttar veim letakken hakkarka asur vechen happotek mayim leginna im nitkaven sheyyikkansu haddagim muttar veim lehashkot haaretz asur vechen hakkotzetz charaot min haddekel im nitkaven lehaachil labbehema muttar veim nitkaven laavodat hailan asur umimmaasav yukkar lee ze davar hu mitkaven

Tannur vechirayim sheefshar sheyivshu veyofe bahen bammoed osin veim lav en osin otan vben kach uven kach bonin al cheres shel tannur veal hikkira hattefela shellahen umsargin et hammittot venokrin et harechayim ufotchim lahen ayin umaamidin otan uvonin ammat hammayim shel rechayim

Zoftin et hechavit kede shello yippased hayyayin vezoftin et habbakbuk mippene sheen bo torach vesotmin pi hechavit shel shechar kede shello tippased umchappin et hakketziot bekash kede shello yovdu umrakkechin et habbegadim bayyadayim mippene shehu maase hedot aval en osin kishre bet hayyadayim mippene shehu maase umman vechen kal kayyotze baze

Kotztzin tzipparne chamor shel rechayim uvonin evus labbehema vesus sheyyirkav alav muttar littol tzipparnav ulsarko kede leyappoto veen marbiin behema bammoed aval makkizin lah dam veen monin mimmenna refua vechal maachalot umashkim sheenan maachal beriim ella lirfua muttar laadam leachlan velishtotan bammoed

En mefannin mechatzer lechatzer bammoed velo mikkeura lenaa velo minnaa lichura aval mefanne hu mibbayit levayit beotah chatzer umviin kelim shehen letzorech hammoed mibbet haumman kegon karim uchsatot utzlochiyyot aval kelim sheenan letzorech hammoed kegon machresha min hallotesh o tzemer mibbet hatztzabba en meviin veim en laumman ma yochal noten lo secharo umannichan etzlo veim eno maamino mannichan babbayit hassamuch lo veim choshesh lahem shemma yigganvu mefannan lechatzer acheret aval lo yavi leveto ella betzina
