Asur laasot melacha bearve yamim tovim min hammincha ulmala kemo arve shabbatot vechal haose melacha bahen eno roe siman beracha leolam vegoarin bo umvattelin oto beal karcho aval en makkin oto makkat mardut veen tzarich lomar sheen menaddin oto chutz meerev happesach achar chatzot shehaose bo melacha achar chatzot menaddin oto veen tzarich lomar shemmakkin oto makkat mardut im lo nidduhu lefi sheyyom arbaa asar benisan eno kishar arve yamim tovim mippene sheyyesh bo chagiga ushchitat karban

Lefichach yom arbaa asar benisan asur baasiyyat melacha middivre sofrim kemo chullo shel moed vehu kal mechullo shel moed veeno asur ella mechatzi hayyom ulmala shehu zeman hashshechita aval mehanetz hachamma ad chatzi hayyom taluy bamminhag makom shennahagu laasot osin makom shennahagu shello laasot en osin

Vaafillu bemakom shennahagu laasot lo yatchil battechilla laasot melacha bearbaa asar af al pi shehu yachol legamrah kodem chatzot ella shalosh ummanuyyot bilvad hen shemmatchilin bahem bemakom shennahagu laasot veosin ad chatzot veellu hen hachayyatin vehassapparin vehakkovsin aval shear ummanuyyot im hitchil bahen kodem arbaa asar hu sheyyigmor ad chatzot sheen haam tzerichin lishar ummanuyyot tzorech harbe

Haholech mimmakom sheosin lemakom sheen osin lo yaase bayyishshuv mippene hammachaloket aval ose hu bammidbar vehaholech mimmakom sheen osin lemakom sheosin lo yaase notnin alav chumre makom sheyyatza mishsham vechumre makom shehalach lesham veaf al pi chen lo yitrae bifnehem shehu batel mippene haissur leolam al yeshanne adam mippene hammachaloket vechen mi sheddato lachazor limkomo noheg keanshe mekomo ben lehakel ben lehachamir vehu shello yitrae bifne anshe hammakom shehu bo mippene hammachaloket

Molichin umviin kelim mibbet haumman bearbaa asar achar chatzot af al pi sheenan letzorech hammoed vegorfin zevel mittachat ragle behema umotziim oto laashpa umoshivin shovachin lattarnegolim tarnegolet sheyyashva al habbetzim shelosha yamim o yeter umeta moshivin acheret tachteha bearbaa asar kede shello yippasdu habbetzim uvammoed en moshivin aval im barcha bammoed meal habbetzim machzirin otah limkomah seliku lehu hilchot shevitat yom tov
Mishneh Torah, Rest on the Tenth of Tish: Mitzvat ase lishbot mimmelacha beasor lachodesh hashshevii shenneemar shabbat shabbaton hu lachem vechal haose bo melacha bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase shenneemar uveasor vego kal melacha lo taasu uma hu chayyav al asiyyat melacha beom ze im asa birtzono bezadon chayyav karet veim asa bishgaga chayyav karban chattat kevua

Kal melacha shechayyavin al zedonah beshabbat sekila chayyavin al zedonah beasor karet vechal shechayyavin alav karban chattat beshabbat chayyavin alav karban chattat beom hakkippurim vechal davar sheasur laasoto beshabbat af al pi sheeno melacha asur laasoto beom hakkippurim veim asa makkin oto makkat mardut kederech shemmakkin oto al hashshabbat vechal sheasur letaltelo beshabbat asur letaltelo beom hakkippurim vechal sheasur leamro o laasoto lechattechilla beshabbat kach asur beom hakkippurim kelalo shel davar en ben shabbat leom hakkippurim beinyanim ellu ella shezzedon melacha beshabbat biskila uvom hakkippurim becharet

Umuttar lekannev et hayyarak beom hakkippurim min hammincha ulmala umahu hakkinuv sheyyasir et healim hamuppashot vikatztzetz hashshear vitakken oto laachila vechen mefatztzein beegozin umfarchin berimmonim min hammincha ulmala mippene agmat nefesh veom hakkippurim shechal lihot beshabbat asur biknivat yarak uviftziat egozim uvifrichat rimmonim kal hayyom uchvar nahagu haam beshinar uvammaarav shello yaasu achat mikkal ellu beom hatztzom ella hare hu keshabbat lechal devarav

Mitzvat ase acheret yesh beom hakkippurim vehi lishbot bo meachila ushtiyya shenneemar teannu et nafshotechem mippi hashshemua lamdu e ze hu innuy shehu lannefesh ze hatztzom vechal hatztzam bo kiyyem mitzvat ase vechal haochel veshote bo bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase shenneemar ki chal hannefesh asher lo teunne beetzem hayyom hazze venichreta meachar sheanash hakkatuv karet lemi shello nitanna lamadnu shemmuzharin anu bo al achila ushtiyya vechal haochel o hashshote bo beshogeg chayyav karban chattat kevua

Vechen lamadnu mippi hashshemua sheasur lirchotz bo o lasuch o linol et hassandal o livol umitzva lishbot mikkal ellu kederech sheshshovet maachila ushtiyya shenneemar shabbat shabbaton shabbat leinyan achila veshabbaton leinyanim ellu veen chayyavin karet o karban ella al achila ushtiyya aval im rachatz o sach o naal o baal makkin oto makkat mardut

Keshem sheshshevut melacha bo ben bayyom uven ballayela kach shevut leinnuy ben bayyom ben ballayela vetzarich lehosif mechol al hakkodesh bichnisato uvitziato shenneemar veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha lachodesh baerev kelomar hatchel latzum ulhitannot meerev tisha hassamuch laasiri vechen bayetzia shoha beinnuo meat millel achad asar samuch laasiri shenneemar meerev vead erev tishbetu shabbattechem

Nashim sheochlot veshotot ad shechashecha vehen enan yodot shemmitzva lehosif mechol al hakkodesh en memachin beyadan shello yavou laasot bezadon shehare i efshar sheyyihye shoter bevet kal echad veechad lehazhir nashav vehanach lahen sheyehu shoggin veal yehu mezidin vechen kal haddome laze

Haochel beom hakkippurim maachalin haruyin leechol laadam kechotevet haggassa shehi pachot mikkevetza kimat hare ze chayyav vechal haochalim mitztarfin leshiur ze vechen hashshote mashkin haruyin lishtiyyat adam kimlo lugmav shel shote kal echad veechad lefi lugmav chayyav vechamma melo lugmav kede sheyesallekem letzad echad veyerae male lugmav veshiur ze beadam benoni pachot merviit vechal hammashkin mitztarfin leshiur ze vehaachila ushtiyya en mitztarfin leshiur echad

Echad haochel ochalim hammuttarim o sheachal devarim haasurin kegon piggul venotar vetevel unvelot utrefot vechelev o dam hoil veachal ochalim haruyin laadam hare ze chayyav karet mishshum ochel beom hakkippurim
Achal o shata pachot mishshiur ze eno chayyav karet af al pi shehu asur min hattora bachatzi shiur en chayyavin karet ella al kashshiur vehaochel o hashshote chatzi shiur makkin oto makkat mardut

Achal meat vechazar veachal im yesh mittechillat achila rishona ad sof achila acharona kede achilat shalosh betzim hare ellu mitztarfot lechashshiur veim lav en mitztarfot lechashshiur shata meat vechazar veshata im yesh mittechillat shetiyya rishona ad sof shetiyya acharona kede shetiyyat reviit mitztarfin leshiur veim lav en mitztarfin

Achal ochalim sheenan reuyin lemaachal adam kegon asavim hammarim o serafim habbeushin o sheshshata mashkin sheenan reuyin lishtiyya kegon tzir o muryas vechometz chay afillu achal veshata mehen harbe hare ze patur min hakkaret aval makkin oto makkat mardut

Shata chometz mazug bemayim chayyav hakkoses pilpelin vezangevil yavesh vechayyotze bahen patur aval zangevil ratov chayyav achal ale gefanim patur lulve gefanim chayyav veellu hen lulve gefanim kal shellivlevu beeretz yisrael merosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim yeter al ze hare hen keetzim ufatur vechen kal kayyotze baellu

Achal tzali bemelach mitztaref hammelach labbasar tzir sheal gabbe yarak mitztaref mippene shemmachshire haochel hamoravim im haochel keochel hen chashuvim haya savea meachila gassa sheachal ad shekkatz bimzono veachal yeter al savo patur kemi sheachal ochalin sheenam reuyin laachila sheaf al pi shezze hammaachal hayyater rauy leraev eno rauy lechal mi shessavea keze

Chole sheyyesh bo sakkana sheshshaal leechol beom hakkippurim af al pi sheharofim habbekiin omrin eno tzarich maachilin oto al pi atzmo ad sheyyomar dayyi amar hachole eni tzarich veharofe omer tzarich maachilin oto al piv vehu sheyyihye rofe baki rofe echad omer tzarich veechad omer eno tzarich maachilin oto miktzat harofin omrin tzarich umiktzatan omrin eno tzarich holchin achar harov o achar habbekiin uvilvad shello yomar hachole tzarich ani aval im amar tzarich ani maachilin oto lo amar hachole shehu tzarich venechleku harofim vehau kullam bekiin veellu sheamru eno tzarich keminyan sheamru tzarich maachilin oto

Ubbara shehericha lochashin lah beaznah sheyyom hakkippurim hu im nitkarra datah bezikkaron ze mutav veim lav maachilin otah ad shettityashshev nafshah vechen mi sheachazo bulmos maachilin oto ad sheyyeoru enav vaafillu nevelot ushkatzim maachilin oto miyyad veen mashhin oto ad sheyyimtzeu devarim hammuttarin

Katan ben tesha shanim uven eser shanim mechannechin oto leshaot ketzad haya ragil leechol bishte shaot bayyom maachilin oto beshalosh haya ragil beshalosh maachilin oto bearba lefi koach habben mosifin leannot oto beshaot ben achat esre shana ben zachar ben nekeva mitanne umashlim middivre sofrim kede lechannecho bemitzot

Bat shettem esre shana veom echad uven shelosh esre shana veom echad sheheviu shette searot hare hen kigdolim lechal hammitzot umashlimin min hattora aval im lo heviu shette searot adayin ketannim hen veenam mashlimin ella middivre sofrim katan shehu pachot mibben tesha en meannin oto beom hakkippurim kede shello yavo lide sakkana

Asur lirchotz beom hakkippurim ben bechammin ben betzonen ben kal gufo ben evar echad afillu etzba ketanna asur lehoshitah bammayim vehammelech vehakkalla rochatzin et penehen kalla kede shello titganne al balah vehammelech kede sheyyerae beyafo shenneemar melech beyafo techezena enecha vead kamma nikret kalla ad sheloshim yom

Mi shehaya meluchlach betzoa o tit rochetz mekom hattinnofet kedarko veeno choshesh umdicha ishsha yadah achat bemayim venotenet pat letinok vehachole rochetz kedarko af al pi sheeno mesukkan vechal chayyave tevilot tovlin kedarkan ben betisha beav ben beom hakkippurim

Mi sheraa keri bazzeman hazze beom hakkippurim im lach hu mekanneach bemappa vedayyo veim yavesh hu o shennitlachlech rochetz mekomot hamluchlachin bilvad umitpallel veasur lo lirchotz kal gufo o litbol sheen hattovel bazzeman hazze tahor mippene tumat met veen harchitza mikkeri litfilla bazzeman hazze ella minhag veen minhag levattel davar haasur ella leesor et hammuttar velo amru sheharoe keri beom hakkippurim tovel ella keshettikkenu tevila levaale kerayin uchvar bearnu shebbatla takkana zo

Tit shehu lach beoter kede sheyyanniach adam yado alav vetaale bah lachluchit sheim hidbik otah leyado haacheret tidbak bah lachluchit asur leshev alav lo yemalle adam keli cheres mayim veyitztannen bo shehammayim nizchalim middefanav afillu kele mattachot asur shemma yinnatzu mayim al besaro umuttar lehitztannen beferot
Lokeach adam mitpachat meerev yom hakkippurim veshore otah bemayim umnaggevah meat umannichah tachat habbegadim ulmachar maavirah al panav veeno choshesh veaf al pi sheyyesh bah kor harbe

Haholech lehakbil pene rabbo o pene aviv o mi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma o likrot bevet hammidrash over bammayim ad tzavaro veeno choshesh veose mitzva shehalach laasotah vechozer bammayim limkomo sheim lo tattir lo lachazor eno holech venimtza nichshal min hammitzva vechen haholech lishmor perotav over bammayim ad tzavaro veeno choshesh uvilvad shello yotziu yedehem mittachat shule meilehem kederech sheosin bechol

Asur linol minal vesandal afillu beraglo achat umuttar latzet besandal shel shaam veshel gemi vechayyotze bahen vechorech adam beged al raglav veotze bo shehare keshi haaretz maggia leraglav umargish shehu yachef hattinokot af al pi shehen muttarin baachila uvishtiyya urchitza vesicha monin otan mimminal vesandal

Muttar lechal adam linol et hassandal mechamat akrav vechayyotze bah kede shello tishshachennu vehachayya mutteret linol et hassandal mishshum tzinna kal sheloshim yom vehachole kayyotze bah af al pi sheen sham sakkana
Asur lasuch miktzat gufo kechal gufo ben sicha shel taanug ben sicha sheenah shel taanug veim haya chole af al pi sheen bo sakkana o sheyyesh lo chatatin berosho sach kedarko veeno choshesh

Yesh mekomot shennahagu lehadlik et hanner belele yom hakkippurim kede sheyyihye lo boshet panim meishto velo yavo lide tashmish hammitta veyesh mekomot shennahagu shello lehadlik shemma yire ishto vetissa chen beenav veyavo lide tashmish veim chal yom hakkippurim lihot beshabbat chayyavin hakkol lehadlik bechal makom shehadlakat ner beshabbat chova salik hilchot shevitat osor
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 1: Shevita bashshevii mimmelacha mitzvat ase shenneemar uvayyom hashshevii tishbot vechal haose bo melacha bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase shenneemar lo taase chal melacha uma hu chayyav al asiyyat melacha im asa birtzono bezadon chayyav karet veim hau sham edim vehatraa niskal veim asa bishgaga chayyav karban chattat kevua
Kal makom shenneemar behilchot shabbat shehaose davar ze chayyav hare ze chayyav karet veim hau sham edim vehatraa chayyav sekila veim haya shogeg chayyav chattat

Vechal makom shenneemar shehaose davar ze patur hare ze patur min hakkaret umin hassekila umin hakkarban aval asur laasot oto davar beshabbat veissuro middivre sofrim vehu harchaka min hammelacha vehaose oto bezadon makkin oto makkat mardut vechen kal makom shenneemar en osin kach vechach o asur laasot kach vechach beshabbat haose oto davar bezadon makkin oto makkat mardut
Vechal makom shenneemar muttar laasot kach vechach hare ze muttar lechattechilla vechen kal makom shenneemar eno chayyav kelum o patur mikkelum en makkin oto kelal

Devarim hammuttarim laasotan beshabbat uvishat asiyyatan efshar shettease biglalan melacha veefshar shello tease im lo nitkaven leotah melacha hare ze muttar ketzad gorer adam mitta vechisse vesafsal vechayyotze bahen beshabbat uvilvad shello yitkaven lachpor charitz bakkarka bishat geriratan ulfichach im chafru hakkarka eno choshesh bechach lefi shello nitkaven vechen mehallech adam al gabbe asavim beshabbat uvilvad shello yitkaven laakor otan lefichach im neekru eno choshesh verochetz yadav baafar happerot vechayyotze bo uvilvad shello yitkaven lehashshir hassear lefichach im nashar eno choshesh vechen pirtza dechuka muttar lehikkanes bah beshabbat af al pi shemmashshir tzerorot vechen kal davar sheen mitkaven kegon ze hare ze muttar

Aval asa maase venaaset biglalo melacha shevadday tease bishvil oto maase af al pi shello nitkaven lah chayyav shehaddavar yadua shei efshar shello tease otah melacha ketzad hare shetztzarich lerosh of letzachek bo hakkatan vechatach rosho beshabbat af al pi sheen sof megammato laharigat haof bilvad chayyav shehaddavar yadua shei efshar sheyyachtoch rosh hachay veyichye ella hammavet ba bishvilo vechen kal kayyotze baze

Kal haose melacha beshabbat af al pi sheeno tzarich legufah shel melacha chayyav aleha ketzad hare shekkibba et hanner mippene shehu tzarich lashshemen o lappetila kede shello yovad o kede shello yissaref o kede shello yibbaka cheres shel ner mippene shehakkibbuy melacha vahare nitkaven lechabbot veaf al pi sheeno tzarich leguf hakkibbuy velo kibba ella mippene hashshemen o mippene hacheres o mippene happetila hare ze chayyav vechen hammaavir et hakkotz arba ammot birshut harabbim o hamchabbe et haggachelet kede shello yizzoku bahen rabbim chayyav veaf al pi sheeno tzarich leguf hakkibbuy o leguf hahaavara ella leharchik hahezzek hare ze chayyav vechen kal kayyotze baze

Kal hammitkaven laasot melacha venaasa lo melacha acheret shello nitkaven lah patur aleha lefi shello naaset machashavto ketzad zarak even o chetz bachavero o bivhema kede lehargan vehalach veakar ilan bahalichato velo harag hare ze patur hare ze kal vachomer im nitkaven leissur kal venaasa issur chamur kegon shennitkaven lizrok becharmelit veavra haeven lirshut harabbim shehu patur vechen kal kayyotze baze nitkaven laasot davar hammuttar veasa davar acher kegon shennitkaven lachtoch et hattalush vechatach et hamchubbar eno chayyav kelum vechen kal kayyotze baze

Nitkaven lilkot teenim shechorot velikket levanot o shennitkaven lilkot teenim veachar kach anavim venehpach haddavar velikket haanavim battechilla veachar kach teenim patur af al pi shellikket kal ma shechashav hoil velo likket kasseder shechashav patur shebbelo kavana asa shello asra tora ella melechet machshevet

Hau lefanav shette nerot dolkot o kevuot nitkaven lechabbot zo vechibba et zo lehadlik zo vehidlik et zo chayyav shehare asa min hammelacha shechashav laasotah ha lema hu dome lemi shennitkaven lilkot teena zo velikket teena acheret o lemi shennitkaven laharog et ze veharag et ze shehare naaset melacha shechashav laasotah

Aval im nitkaven lehadlik rishona ulchabbot sheniyya achareha venehpach haddavar vechibba rishona veachar kach hidlik sheniyya achareha patur kibba zo vehidlik zo binshima achat chayyav sheaf al pi shello hikdim hahadlaka hare ze lo icher otah ella shettehen keachat ulfichach chayyav vechen kal kayyotze baze vechal haose melacha bemitassek velo nitkaven lah patur

Kal hammitkaven laasot melacha venaaset beoter al kavanato chayyav befachot mikkavanato patur ketzad hare shennitkaven lehotzi massa leacharav uva lo lefanav chayyav shehare nitkaven lishmira pechuta venaaset shemira meulla aval im nitkaven lehotzi lefanav uva lo leacharav patur shehare nitkaven lehotzi bishmira meulla vehotzi bishmira pechuta vechen kal kayyotze baze
Haya chagur besinnar vehishlich hammassa ben besaro vachaluko ben shebba ze hammassa sheddarko lehotzio badderech hazzot lefanav ben shebba leacharav chayyav shekken darko lihot chozer

Kal hamitkaven laasot melacha beshabbat vehitchil bah veasa kashshiur chayyav af al pi shello hishlim kal hammelacha shennitkaven lehashlimah ketzad hare shennitkaven lichtov iggeret o shetar beshabbat en omrim lo yitchayyev ze ad sheyyashlim cheftzo veyichtov kal hashshetar o kal haiggeret ella mishsheyyichtov shette otiyyot chayyav vechen im nitkaven leerog beged shalem mishsheyeerog shene chutin chayyav veaf al pi shekkavanato lehashlim habbeged hoil veasa kashshiur bechavana chayyav vechen kal kayyotze baze

Kal melacha shehayyachid yachol laasot otah levaddo veasu otah shenayim beshuttafut ben sheasa ze miktzatah veze miktzatah kegon sheakar ze hachefetz mershut zo vehinnicho hashsheni birshut acheret ben sheasu otah shenehem keechad mittechilla vead sof kegon sheachazu shenehem bekulmos vechatvu o achazu kikkar vehotziuhu mershut lirshut hare ellu peturin

Veim en echad mehen yachol laasotah levaddo ad sheyyitztarfu kegon shenayim sheachazu kora vehotziuha lirshut harabbim hoil veen koach beechad mehen laasotah levaddo veasu otah beshuttafut mittechilla vead sof shenehen chayyavin veshiur echad lishnehen haya koach beechad lehotzi kora zo levaddo vehashsheni eno yachol lehotziah levaddo venishtattefu shenehem vehotziuha ze harishon sheyyachol chayyav vehashsheni mesayyea hu umsayyea eno chayyav kelum vechen kal kayyotze baze

Kal hamkalkelin peturin ketzad hare shechaval bachavero o bivhema derech hashchata vechen im kara begadim o serafan o shavar kelim derech hashchata hare ze patur chafar guma veeno tzarich ella laafarah hare ze mekalkel ufatur af al pi sheasa melacha hoil vechavanato lekalkel patur

Kal hamkalkel al menat letakken chayyav ketzad hare shessatar kede livnot bimkomo o shemmachak kede lichtov bammakom shemmachak o shechafar guma kede livnot betochah yesodot vechal kayyotze baze chayyav veshiuran keshiur hamtakken

Kal haose melacha beshabbat miktzatah beshogeg umiktzatah bezadon ben shehezid ulvassof shagag ben sheshshagag ulvassof hezid patur ad sheyyaase shiur hammelacha kullah mittechilla vead sof bezadon veachar kach yihye chayyav karet veim yihye beedim vehatraa chayyav sekila o sheyyaase shiur melacha kullah bishgaga mittechilla vead sof veachar kach yihye chayyav chattat kevua
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 2: Dechuya hi shabbat etzel sakkanat nefashot kishar kal hammitzot lefichach chole sheyyesh bo sakkana osin lo kal tzerachav beshabbat al pi rofe umman shel oto makom safek shehu tzarich lechallel alav et hashshabbat safek sheeno tzarich vechen im amar rofe lechallel alav et hashshabbat verofe acher omer eno tzarich mechallelin alav et hashshabbat shessefek nefashot doche et hashshabbat

Amaduhu beom hashshabbat shehu tzarich lechach vechach lishmona yamim en omrim namtin ad haerev kede shello lechallel alav shette shabbatot ella matchilin mehayyom shehu shabbat umchallelin alav afillu mea shabbatot kal zeman shehu tzarich veyesh bo sakkana o sefek sakkana mechallelin umadlikin lo et hanner umchabbin millefanav et hanner veshochatin lo veofin umvashshelin umchimmin lo chammin ben lehashkoto ben lirchitzat gufo kelalo shel davar shabbat legabbe chole sheyyesh bo sakkana hare hu kechol lechal haddevarim shehu tzarich lahen

Kesheosim devarim haellu en osin otan lo al yede nachrim velo al yede ketannim velo al yede avadim velo al yede nashim kede shello tehe shabbat kalla beenehem ella al yede gedole yisrael vechachmehem veasur lehitmahmeha bechillul shabbat lechole sheyyesh bo sakkana shenneemar asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem velo sheyyamut bahem ha lamadta sheen mishpete hattora nekama baolam ella rachamim vechesed veshalom baolam veillu haeppikorosim sheomrim shezze chillul shabbat veasur alehen hakkatuv omer gam ani natatti lahem chukkim lo tovim umishpatim lo yichu bahem

Hachoshesh beenav vehu sheyyihye bishtehem o beachat mehem tzir o shehau demaot shottot mehen merov hakkeev o shehaya dam shotet mehen o shehaya bahen kaddachat vechayyotze bacholaim ellu hare ze bichlal cholim sheyyesh bahen sakkana umchallelin alav et hashshabbat veosin lo kal tzarche refua

Vechen im yesh makka bachalal gufo min hassafa ulfanim ben befiv ben bemeav ben bichvedo utcholo o bishar mekomot kal sheyyesh bachalalo hare ze chole sheyyesh bo sakkana veeno tzarich omed shechalo kaved hu lefichach mechallelin alav et hashshabbat miyyad belo amida umakka shehi begav hayyad vegav haregel hare hi kemakka shel chalal veenah tzericha omed umchallelin aleha et hashshabbat vehachom shemmesammer et habbasar kemakka shel chalal dami umchallelin alav et hashshabbat vechen kal choli sheharofim omrin shezze yesh bo sakkana af al pi shehu beor habbasar mibbachutz mechallelin alav et hashshabbat al pihem

Habbolea nima shel mayim mechimmin lo chammin beshabbat veosin lo kal tzarche refua mippene shehi sakkanat nefashot vechen mi shenneshacho kelev shote o echad mizzochale heafar shemmemitin afillu hau safek memitin safek en memitin osin lo kal tzarche refua lehatztzilo

Chole sheamaduhu rofim lehavi lo gerogeret achat veratzu asara bene adam veheviu lo eser gerogarot bevat achat kullan peturin mikkelum vaafillu heviu baze achar ze vaafillu hivri barishona shehare kullam birshut heviu

Chole shehaya tzarich lishte gerogarot velo matzu ella shette gerogarot bishne ektzin veshalosh gerogarot beoketz echad kortin haoketz sheyyesh bo shalosh af al pi sheen tzerichin ella lishtayim kede shello yarbu bivtzira ella yichretu oketz echad velo yichretu shenayim vechen kal kayyotze baze

Hamvashshel lechole beshabbat veachal hachole vehotir asur levari leechol min hammuttar gezera shemma yarbe bishvilo aval hashshochet lachole beshabbat muttar labbari leechol mimmennu basar chay sheen baddavar tosefet kede shennigzor shemma yarbe bishvilo vechen kal kayyotze baze

Chole sheen bo sakkana osin lo kal tzerachav al yede nachri ketzad omrin lannachri laasot lo vehu ose levashshel lo veleefot ulhavi refua mershut lirshut vechayyotze baellu vechen kochel enav min hannachri beshabbat af al pi sheen sham sakkana veim hau tzerichim lidvarim sheen bahen melacha osin otan afillu yisrael lefichach maalin aznayim beshabbat umaalin unkeli umachzirin et hashshever vechal kayyotze baze muttar

Hayyoledet keshekkoraat leled hare hi besakkanat nefashot umchallelin aleha et hashshabbat korin lah chachama mimmakom lemakom vechotchim et hattabbur vekoshrin oto veim hayeta tzericha lener beshaa shehi tzoeket bachavaleha madlikin lah et hanner vaafillu hayeta suma mippene sheddatah mityashshevet aleha banner veaf al pi sheenah roa veim hayeta tzericha leshemen vechayyotze bo meviin lah vechal sheefshar leshannot meshannin bishat havaa kegon shettavi lah chavertah keli taluy bisarah veim i efshar mevia kedarkah

En meyalledin et haovedet kochavim umazzalot beshabbat vaafillu besachar veen choshshin leeva veaf al pi sheen sham chillul aval meyalledin et bat ger toshav mippene sheanu metzuvin lehachaoto veen mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat

Chayya mishsheyyatchil haddam lihot shotet ad shetteled veachar shetteled ad shelosha yamim mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat veosin lah kal tzeracheha ben sheamra tzericha ani ben sheamra eni tzericha umishshelosha ad shiva im amra eni tzericha en mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat veim shatka veen tzarich lomar im amra tzericha ani shemmechallelin aleha et hashshabbat umishshiva vead sheloshim yom hare hi kechola sheen bo sakkana vaafillu amra tzericha ani en osin lah melacha ella al yede nachrim

Osin medura lechayya vaafillu bimot hachamma mippene shehatztzinna kasha lechayya harbe bammekomot hakkarim aval en osin medura lechole lehitchammem bah hikkiz dam venitztannen osin lo medura afillu bitkufat tammuz umarchitzin et havalad beshabbat bayyom shennolad achar shechotchin et tibburo afillu bechammin shehuchammu beshabbat umolchin oto umlappefin oto mippene shessakkana hi lo im lo yaasu lo kal ellu vechen marchitzim oto lifne hammila ulachar hammila uvayyom hashshelishi lammila bechammin shehuchammu beshabbat mippene hassakkana

Haishsha sheyyashva al hammashber umeta meviin sakkin beshabbat afillu derech reshut harabbim vekorin et keresah umotziin et havalad shemma yimmatze chay shessefek nefashot doche et hashshabbat vaafillu laze sheen chezkato chay

Mefakkechin pikkuach nefesh beshabbat veen tzarich littol reshut mibbet din vehammakdim lehatztzil hannefesh hare ze meshubbach ketzad raa tinok shennafal layyam pores metzuda umaalehu veaf al pi shehu tzad haddagim immo shama shettava tinok bayyam ufaras metzuda lehaaloto veheela dagim bilvad patur mikkelum nitkaven lehaalot dagim veheela dagim vetinok patur afillu lo shama shettava hoil veheela tinok im haddagim patur

Nafal tinok labbor oker chulya umaalehu veaf al pi shehu metakken bah madrega bishat akirato ninal delet bifne tinok shover haddelet umotzio veaf al pi shehu mefatztzel otah kemin etzim sheruyin limlacha shemma yibbaet hattinok veyamut nafla deleka veyesh sham adam shechoshshin shemma yissaref mechabbin otah lehatztzilo min haesh veaf al pi shehu kovesh derech umtakkenah bishat kibbuy vechal hakkodem lehatztzil hare ze meshubbach veeno tzarich littol reshut mibbet din bechal davar sheyyesh bo sakkana
Mi shennafla alav mappolet safek hu sham safek eno sham mefakkechin alav metzauhu chay af al pi shennitrotzetz vei efshar sheyyibbare mefakkechin alav umotziin oto lechayye otah shaa

Badku ad chatmo velo matzu bo neshama mannichin oto sham shekkevar met badku umatzu elonim metim lo yomru kevar metu tachtonim ella mefakkechin al hakkol sheefshar bemappolet sheyyamut haelon veyihye hattachton chay

Hayeta chatzer sheyyesh bah ovde kochavim umazzalot veyisreelim afillu yisrael echad veelef ovde kochavim umazzalot venafla alehem mappolet mefakkechin al hakkol mippene yisrael perash echad mehem lechatzer acheret venafla alav otah chatzer mefakkechim alav shemma ze shepperash haya yisrael vehannisharim ovde kochavim umazzalot

Neekru kullan mechatzer zo lelech lechatzer acheret uvet akiratam perash echad mehen venichnas lechatzer acheret venafla alav mappolet veen yadua mi hu en mefakkechin alav shekkevan shenneekru kullam en kan yisrael vechal happoresh mehen keshehen mehallechin hare hu bechezkat shepperash min harov lefichach im haya harov yisrael af al pi shenneekru kullam uferash echad mehem lechatzer acheret venafla alav mappolet mefakkechin

Hamhallech bammidbar velo yada matay hu yom shabbat mone miyyom shettaa shishsha umkaddesh shevii umvarech bo birchot hayyom umavdil bemotzae shabbat uvchal yom vaom vaafillu beom ze shehu mekaddesh umavdil bo muttar lo laasot kede parnasato bilvad kede shello yamut veasur lo laasot yoter al parnasato shekkal yom vaom sefek shabbat hu veim yada shehu shemini litziato o chamishsha asar litziato vechayyotze beze hamminyan hare ze muttar laasot melacha beoto hayyom shehare haddavar vadday shello yatza beshayyara beshabbat ushar hayyamim chutz miyyom ze ose kede parnasa bilvad

Ovde kochavim umazzalot shetztzaru al ayarot yisrael im bau al iske mamon en mechallelin alehen et hashshabbat veen osin immahen milchama uvir hassemucha lassefar afillu lo bau ella al iske teven vekash yotzin alehen bichle zayin umchallelin alehen et hashshabbat uvchal makom im bau al iske nefashot o shearchu milchama o shetztzaru setam yotzin alehen bichle zayin umchallelin alehen et hashshabbat umitzva al kal yisrael sheyecholin lavo velatzet velaazor leachehem shebbammatzor ulhatztzilam miyyad haovde kochavim umazzalot beshabbat veasur lahen lehitmahameha lemotzae shabbat uchsheyyatztzilu et achehen muttar lahen lachazor bichle zayin shellahen limkomam beshabbat kede shello lehachshilan leatid lavo

Vechen sefina hamtorefet bayyam o ir shehikkifah karkom o nahar mitzva latzet beshabbat lehatztzilan bechal davar sheyyachol lehatztzilan vaafillu yachid hannirdaf mippene haovde kochavim umazzalot o mippene nachash o dov shehu rodef acharav lehargo mitzva lehatztzilo vaafillu baasiyyat kamma melachot beshabbat vaafillu letakken kele zayin lehatztzilo muttar vezoakim alehen umitchannenim beshabbat umatriin alehen laazor otam veen mitchannenim velo zoakin al haddever beshabbat

Tzarin al ayarot haovde kochavim umazzalot shelosha yamim kodem lashshabbat veosin immahen milchama bechal yom vaom vaafillu beshabbat ad shekkovshin otah veaf al pi shehi milchemet harshut mippi hashshemua lamdu ad ridtah vaafillu beshabbat veen tzarich lomar bemilchemet mitzva velo kavash yehoshua yericho ella beshabbat
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 3: Muttar lehatchil melacha meerev shabbat af al pi shehi nigmeret meeleha beshabbat shello neesar alenu laasot melacha ella beatzmo shel yom aval keshettease hammelacha meatzmah beshabbat muttar lanu lehanot bema shennaasa beshabbat meelav

Ketzad potkin mayim lagginna erev shabbat im chashecha vehi mitmallet veholechet kal hayyom kullo umannichin mugmar tachat hakkelim vehen mitgammerin veholchin kal hashshabbat kullah umannichim kilor al gav haayin veispelanit al gabbe hammakka umitrappein veholchin kal hashshabbat kullah veshorin deo vesammanin im chashecha vehen shorin veholchin kal hashshabbat kullah venotnin tzemer leura veunin shel pishtan lattannur vehem mishtannin veholchin kal hashshabbat kullah uforsim metzudot lechayya ulofot uldagim im chashecha vehen nitztzodin veholchin kal hashshabbat kullah vetoanin bekorot bet habbad uviggule haggat im chashecha vehammashkin zavin veholchin kal hashshabbat kullah umadlikin et hanner o et hammedura mibbaerev vehi doleket veholechet kal hashshabbat kullah

Mannichin kedera al gabbe haesh o basar battannur o al gabbe gechalim vehen mitbashshelim veholchin kal hashshabbat veochlin otah beshabbat veyesh bedavar ze devarim shehen asurin gezera shemma yachte baggechalim beshabbat

Ketzad tavshil shello bashel kal tzarko vechammin shello huchammu kal tzarkan o tavshil shebbashel kal tzarko vechal zeman shemmitztammek hu yafe lo en mashhin oto al gabbe haesh beshabbat af al pi shehunnach mibbeod yom gezera shemma yachte baggechalim kede lehashlim bishshulo o kede letzammeko lefichach im garaf haesh o shekkissa esh hakkira beefer o binoret pishtan haddakka o sheammu haggechalim shehare hen kimchussot beefer o shehissikuha bekash o bigvava o biglale behema dakka shehare en sham gechalim boarot hare ze muttar lishhot aleha shehare hissiach dato mizze hattavshil veen gozrin shemma yachte baesh

Bamme devarim amurim bechira shehevlah muat aval hattannur af al pi sheggaraf haesh o kissa beefer o shehissikuhu bekash o vigvava en mashhin betocho velo al gabbav velo somchin lo tavshil shello bashel kal tzarko o shebbashel kal tzarko umitztammek veyafe lo hoil vehevlo cham beoter eno massiach dato vechoshshim shemma yachte bezo haesh hammeuta af al pi shehu esh kash ugvava o mechussa

Velamma asru lishhot battannur af al pi sheggaruf mippene shehaggoref eno goref ella rov haesh veatzmah vei efshar ligrof kal haesh ad shello tishshaer nitzotz achat mippene shehevlo cham shemma yachte kede levaer hannitzotzot hannisharot battannur

Hakkuppach hevlo rav mehevel hakkira umat mehevel hattannur lefichach im hissikuhu begefet o beetzim hare hu ketannur veen mashhin betocho velo al gabbav velo somchin lo tavshil shello bashel kal tzarko o mitztammek veyafe lo af al pi sheggaraf o kissa beefer veim hissikuhu bekash o bigvava hare hu kechira shehusseka bekash ugvava umashhin alav umuttar lismoch lechira mibbaerev veaf al pi sheenah gerufa uktuma veezo hi kira vee zo kuppach kira mekom shefitat shette kederot kuppach mekom shefitat kedera achat

Tavshil chay shello bashel kelal o shebbashel kal tzarko umitztammek vera lo muttar lishhoto al gabbe haesh ben bechira vechuppach ben betannur vechen kal tavshil shebbashel velo bashel kal tzarko o bashel kal tzarko umitztammek veyafe lo im hishlich letocho evar chay samuch leven hashshemashot naasa hakkol ketavshil chay umuttar lishhoto al haesh af al pi shello garaf velo kissa mippene shekkevar hissiach dato mimmennu veeno ba lachtot bagechalim

Kal tavshil sheasur lishhoto im avar veshiha oto asur leachlo ad motzae shabbat veyamtin bichde sheyyeasu veim shechacho im tavshil shello bashel kal tzarko hu asur ad motzae shabbat veim tavshil shebbashel kal tzarko hu umitztammek veyafe lo muttar leachlo miyyad beshabbat

Kal shemmuttar lishhoto al gabbe haesh keshennotlim oto beshabbat asur lehachaziro limkomo veen machzirin leolam ella al gabbe kira gerufa o mechussa o bechira vechuppach shehusseku bekash ugvava vehu shello hinniach hakkedera al gabbe hakkarka aval mishshehinnicha al gabbe karka en machzirin otah vaafillu al gabbe kira gerufa o mechussa veen machzirin lattannur velo lechuppach shehusseku begefet o beetzim af al pi sheggaraf o kissa mippene shehevlan cham beoter vechal sheen machzirin alav en somchin lo beshabbat

Asur lehachnis magrefa likdera beshabbat vehi al haesh lehotzi mimmenna beshabbat mippene shemmegis bah veze mitztzarche habbishshul hu venimtza kimvashshel beshabbat umuttar lehachazir mikkira lechira afillu mikkira shehevlah muat lechira shehevlah merubbe aval lo mikkira litmina velo mittemina lechira

Lo yemalle adam kedera asasiot veturmusin o chavit shel mayim veyitten letoch hattannur erev shabbat im chashecha veyashhe otan sheellu vechal kayyotze bahen af al pi shello bashlu kal ikkar ketavshil shello bashel kal tzarko hen mippene sheenan tzerichim bishshul harbe vedato alehen leachlan lealtar ulfichach asur lishhotan battannur veim avar veshiha asurin ad motzae shabbat veyamtin bichde sheyyeasu

Tannur shennatan letocho basar mibbeod yom veshiha oto beshabbat im besar gedi hu vechayyotze bo muttar sheim yachte begechalim yitcharech habbasar sheeno tzarich ella chamimut haesh bilvad veim besar ez o besar shor hu asur shemma yachte begechalim levashshelo veim tach pi hattannur betit muttar sheim ba liftoach hattannur velachtot tikkanes haruach veyitkashshe habbasar veyippased veyitztannen hattannur veyafsid habbasar
Vechen kal davar sheharuach mafsedet oto en gozrin alav shemma yegallehu veyachte umippene ze notnin unin shel pishtan letoch hattannur im chashecha sheim gillahu yippasdu

Natan gedi shalem letoch hattannur hare hu kivsar ez o kivsar shor veasur lishhoto shemma yachte begechalim ella im ken tach hattannur umuttar leshalshel keves happesach lattannur im chashecha veaf al pi sheeno tach mippene shebbene chavura zerizim hen

En tzolin basar uvatzal uvetza al gabbe haesh ella kede sheyyitzolu mibbeod yom veyihu reuyin laachila veim nisharu achar ken al haesh beshabbat ad sheyyitzolu harbe muttar mippene shehen kemitztammek vera lo sheim yachte yacharoch otan sheal guf haesh hem umippene ze mannichin mugmar tachat hakkelim im chashecha sheim yachte begechalim yissaref hammugmar viashshen hakkelim

Ha lamadta shekkal davar sheanu osrin beinyan ze eno asur mishshum shehu naasa beshabbat ella gezera shemma yachte begechalim lefichach en notnin tzemer leura ella im ken hayeta akura meal haesh shemma yachte begechalim vehu sheyyihye piha tuach betit shemma yagis bah mishshechashecha

En notnin et happat battannur im chashecha velo charara al gabbe haggechalim ella kede sheyyikkarmu paneha shehem mudbakim battannur o baesh veim nisharu achare chen ad sheyyigmor afiyyatan muttar sheim yachte yafsid otan veim natan samuch lachashecha vechashcha vaadayin lo karmu paneha im bemezid asur leechol mehen ad motzae shabbat veyamtin bichde sheyyeasu veim beshogeg muttar lo lirdot mimmenna mezon shalosh seuddot shel shabbat uchshehu rode lo yirde bemirde kederech shehu ose bechol ella besakkin vechayyotze bah

Ose adam medura mikkal davar sheyyirtze ben al gabbe karka ben al gabbe menora umadlikah mibbeod yom umishtammesh leorah o mitchammem kenegdah beshabbat vetzarich sheyyadlik rov hammedura kodem chashecha ad shettehe shalhevet ola meeleha kodem hashshabbat veim lo hidlik rubbah asur lehanot bah beshabbat gezera shemma yachte bah veyanid haetzim kede shettaale hashshalhevet veim hidlik etz yechidi tzarich lehadlik rov avo verov hekkefo mibbeod yom
Bamme devarim amurim bigvulin aval bammikdash maachizin et haur baetzim bimdurat bet hammoked im chashecha veen choshshin shemma yachte begechalim shehakkohanim zerizin hen

Hayeta medura shel kanim o shel garinin eno tzarich lehadlik harov ella kevan shehitchil bahen haesh kodem hashshabbat muttar lehishtammesh bah mippene shehaesh nitlet bahen bimhera veeno tzarich lachtot lefichach im agad hakkanim o hinniach haggarinin bechotalot hare hen keetzim vetzarich shettaale bahen shalhevet meeleha kodem hashshabbat
Medura shel zefet o shel gafrit o shel revav o shel kira o shel kash o shel gevava eno tzarich lehadlik rubbah kodem hashshabbat mippene shehaesh madleket otam bimhera
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 4: Yesh devarim sheim taman bahen hattavshil hu mitchammem umosifin bevishshulo keen haesh kegon haggefet vezevel umelach vesid vechol o zaggin umochin vaasavim bizman sheshshelashtan lachim vaafillu mechamat atzman udvarim ellu nikrain davar hammosif hevel veyesh devarim sheim taman bahen hattavshil yishshaer bachamimuto bilvad veenan mosifin lo bishshul ella monin oto millehitztannen kegon zaggin umochin vaasavim yeveshin uchsut uferot vechanfe yona unoret happishtan unsoret charashim ushlachin vegizze tzemer udvarim ellu nikrain davar sheeno mosif hevel

Min haddin haya shettomnin bedavar hammosif hevel mibbeod yom veyishshaer hattavshil tamun beshabbat shehare mashhin al gabbe haesh beshabbat aval asru chachamim lehatmin bedavar hammosif hevel mibbeod yom gezera shemma tartiach hakkedera beshabbat veyitztarech legalotan ad shettanuach harticha veyachazor vichasse beshabbat venimtza tomen bedavar hammosif hevel beshabbat shehu asur lefichach muttar lehatmin bedavar hammosif hevel ben hashshemashot shessetam kederot ben hashshemashot kevar ratchu venachu mibbiabbuan vechevan shennachu shuv enan rotchin

Vechen min haddin haya litmon hattavshil bedavar sheeno mosif hevel beshabbat atzmah aval asru chachamim davar ze gezera shemma yatmin beremetz veyihye bo nitzotzot shel esh venimtza chote baggechalim lefichach asru lehatmin davar cham beshabbat vaafillu bedavar sheeno mosif hevel

Safek chashecha safek enah chashecha muttar litmon et davar cham umuttar litmon et davar hatztzonen beshabbat bedavar sheeno mosif kede shello yitztannen beoter o kede shettafug tzinnatan chammin shettemanan meerev shabbat venitgallu beshabbat muttar lechassotan shehare eno mosif umuttar lehachalif hakkissuy beshabbat ketzad notel kesut umanniach kanfe yona o notel kanfe yona umanniach hakkesut

Pinna hattavshil o hammayim hachammin mikkeli lichli acher muttar lehatmin hakkeli haacher beshabbat bedavar sheeno mosif kemo haddavar hatztzonen shello asru lehatmin beshabbat ella davar cham shehu bichli rishon shenitbashshel bo aval im pinnahu muttar

Mannichin mecham al gabbe mecham beshabbat ukdera al gabbe kedera ukdera al gabbe mecham umecham al gabbe kedera vetach pihem bevatzek lo bishvil sheyyuchammu ella bishvil sheyyaamdu al chummam shello asru ella lehatmin beshabbat aval lehanniach keli cham al gav keli cham kede sheyyihu omdin bachamimutan muttar aval en mannichin keli sheyyesh bo davar tzonen al gabbe keli cham beshabbat shehare molid bo chom beshabbat veim hinnicho mibbaerev muttar veeno ketomen bedavar hammosif
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 5: Ka t ner beshabbat enah reshut im ratza madlik veim ratza eno madlik velo mitzva sheeno chayyav lirdof achareha ad sheyyaasena kegon eruve chatzerot o netilat yadayim laachila ella ze chova veechad anashim veechad nashim chayyavin lihot bevattehen ner daluk beshabbat afillu en lo ma yochal shoel al happetachim velokeach shemen umadlik et hanner shezze bichlal oneg shabbat vechayyav levarech kodem hadlaka baruch atta elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lehadlik ner shel shabbat kederech shemmevarech al kal haddevarim shehu chayyav bahem middivre sofrim
Muttar lehishtammesh bener shel shabbat vehu shello yehe haddavar tzarich iyyun harbe aval davar shetztzarich ledakdek biriyyato asur lehavchino leor hanner gezera shemma yatte

Hammadlik tzarich lehadlik mibbeod yom kodem shekiat hachamma venashim metzuuot al davar ze yoter min haanashim lefi shehen metzuot babbattim vehen haasukot bimlechet habbayit veaf al pi chen tzarich haish lehazhiran velivdok otan al kach velomar lahen ulanshe beto erev shabbat kodem shettechshach hadliku et hanner sefek chashecha venichnas hashshabbat safek lo nichnas en madlikin

Mishshettishka hachamma ad sheyyerau shelosha kochavim benonim hu hazzeman hannikra ben hashshemashot bechal makom vehu safek min hayyom safek min hallayela vedanin bo lehachamir bechal makom ulfichach en madlikin bo vehaose melacha ben hashshemashot beerev shabbat uvmotzae shabbat beshogeg chayyav chattat mikkal makom vechochavim ellu lo gedolim hannirim bayyom velo ketannim sheen nirin ella ballayela ella benonim umisheyyerau shelosha kochavim ellu habbenonim hare ze layela vadday

Petila shemmadlikin bah leshabbat en osin otah middavar shehaur mesachsechet bo kegon tzemer vesear umeshi vetzemer haerez ufishtan shello nuppatz vesiv shel dekel umine haetz harakkim vechayyotze bahen ella middavar shehaur nitlet bo kegon pishta nefutza uvigde shesh vetzemer gefen vechayyotze bahen vehammadlik tzarich sheyyadlik berov hayyotze min happetila
Hakkorech davar shemmadlikin bo al gabbe davar sheen madlikin bo im lehaavot happetila kede lehosif orah asur veim lehakshot happetila kede shettehe omedet velo tishtalshel lematta muttar

Notnin gargir shel melach ugris shel pol al pi hanner beerev shabbat sheyyihye dolek belel shabbat vechal happetilot sheen madlikin bahen beshabbat osin mehen medura ben lehitchammem kenegdah ben lehishtammesh leorah ben al gabbe menora ben al gabbe karka velo asru ella laasotan petila lener bilvad

Shemen shemmadlikin bo lishabbat tzarich sheyehe nimshach achar happetila aval shemanin sheen nimshachin achar happetila kegon zefet veshaava veshemen kik vealya vechelev en madlikin bahen umippene ma en madlikin biftilot sheen haur nitlet bahen velo bishmanim sheen nimshachim achar happetila gezera shemma yihye or hanner afel veyatte otah beshaa sheyyishtammesh leorah
Chelev shehitticho vekirve dagim shennimmochu noten letochan shemen kal shehu umadlik aval shemanin sheen madlikin bahen afillu ervan bishmanim shemmadlikin bahen lo yadlik mippene sheen nimshachin

En madlikin beitran mippene sherecho ra shemma yannichennu veyetze vechova alav leshev leor hanner velo batzori mippene sherecho tov shemma yikkach mimmennu min hanner veod mippene shehu af velo beneft lavan vaafillu bechol mippene shehu af veyavo lide sakkana
Muttar lehadlik lechattechilla bishar shemanim kegon shemen tzenon veshumshemin velefet vechal kayyotze bahen en asur ella ellu shemmanu chachamim bilvad

Lo yitten adam keli menukkav male shemen al pi hanner bishvil sheyehe menattef velo yemalle keara shemen veyittenenna betzad hanner veyitten rosh happetila letochah bishvil shettehe shoevet gezera shemma yikkach min hashshemen shebbakkeli shehare lo nimas banner veasur lehanot beshabbat min hashshemen shehudlak bo vaafillu kavta hanner vaafillu nataf min hanner mippene shehu muktze mechamat issur veim chibber hakkeli sheyyesh bo hashshemen el hanner besid uvcharsit vechayyotze bahen muttar

En notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel bo shemen beshabbat shehare mevattel hakkeli mehechano veim netano mibbeod yom muttar venotnin keli tachat hanner beshabbat lekabbel bo nitzotzot mippene sheen bahen mammash vahare lo bitlo milletaltelo veasur litten letocho mayim vaafillu meerev shabbat mippene shehu mekarev kibbuy hannitzotzot

En polin leor hanner velo korin leor hanner vaafillu gavoha shette komot vaafillu asara battim ze al gav ze vehanner baelona lo yikra velo yafle leorah battachtona shemma yishkach veyatte veim hau shenayim korin beinyan echad muttarin likrot lifne hanner shekkal echad mehen mazkir chavero im shachach aval lo bishne inyanim shekkal echad mehen tarud beinyano

Hattinokot korin lifne rabban leor hanner mippene sheharav meshammeran aval hu lo yikra mippene sheen ematan alav veyesh lo lirot bassefer leor hanner ad sheyyire rosh happarasha shehu tzarich lehakrotan veachar kach noten hassefer beyadan vehem korin lefanav

Kelim haddomim ze laze veenan nikkarin ella beiyyun harbe asur lehakrivan leor hanner ulhavchin benehen shemma yishkach veyatte lefichach shammash sheeno kavua asur lo livdok kosot ukarot leor hanner mippene sheeno makkiran ben bener shel shemen zayit ben bener shel neft sheoro rav aval shammash kavua muttar lo livdok leor hanner kosot ukarot mippene sheeno tzarich iyyun harbe veim haya ner shel shemen zayit en morin lo livdok veaf al pi shehu muttar gezera shemma yistappek mimmennu

Ner sheachore haddelet asur liftoach haddelet velinol kedarko mippene shehu mechabbehu ella yizzaher beshaa sheppoteach uvshaa shennoel veasur liftoach et haddelet keneged hammedura beshabbat kede shettehe haruach menashshevet bah veaf al pi sheen sham ella ruach metzuya umannichin hanner shel shabbat al gabbe ilan hamchubbar lakkarka veeno choshesh
Kal medinot vaayarot shel yisrael tokin bahen shesh tekiot beerev shabbat uvmakom gavoha hau tokin kede lehashmia kal anshe hammedina vechal anshe hammigrash shellah

Tekia rishona nimneu haomdim bassadot millacharosh umillaador umillaasot melacha shebbassade veen hakkerovin rashshain likkanes lair ad sheyyavou rechokim veyikkansu kullam bevat achat vaadayin hachanuyyot petuchot vehatterisin munnachin hitchil litkoa sheniyya nistalleku hatterisin veninalu hachanuyyot vaadayin hachammin vehakkederot munnachin al gabbe kira hitchil litkoa tekia shelishit sillek hamsallek vehitmin hammatmin vehidliku et hannerot veshohe kede litzlot dag katan o kede lehadbik pat battannur vetokea umeria vetokea veshovet
Tekia rishona tokea otah bemincha vehashshelishit karov lishkiat hachamma vechen tokin bemotzae shabbat achar tzet hakkochavim lehattir haam lemaasehen

Yom hakkippurim shechal lihot beerev shabbat lo hau tokin chal lihot bemotzae shabbat lo tokin velo mavdilin yom tov shechal lihot beerev shabbat tokin velo mavdilin chal lihot leachar hashshabbat mavdilin velo tokin
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 6: Asur lomar lenachri laasot lanu melacha beshabbat af al pi sheeno metzuve al hashshabbat veaf al pi sheamar lo mikkodem hashshabbat veaf al pi sheeno tzarich leotah melacha ella leachar hashshabbat vedavar ze asur middivre sofrim kede shello tihye shabbat kalla beenehen veyavou laasot beatzman

Nachri sheasa melacha meatzmo beshabbat im bishvil yisrael asa otah asur lehanot beotah melacha ad motzae shabbat veyamtin bichde shettease vehu shello yehe haddavar befarhesya ad sheyyedu bo rabbim sheddavar ze bishvil peloni hu naasa beshabbat veim bishvil atzmo bilvad asa muttar lehanot bah beshabbat

Ketzad nachri shehidlik et hanner mishtammesh leoro yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur asa nachri kevesh lered bo min hassefina yered acharav yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur mille mayim lehashkot behemto mashke acharav yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur likket asavim lehaachil livhemto manniach yisrael behemto leechol mehen vehu shello yehe oto hannachri makkir leoto yisrael shemma yarbe bimlachto bishvilo venimtza ose bishvil yisrael vechen kal davar sheefshar leharbot bo lo yehane bo beshabbat ella im ken eno makkiro

Aval davar sheen bo leharbot ulmaet kegon ner vechevesh hoil veasa bishvil atzmo nehene acharav yisrael beshabbat veaf al pi shehu makkiro ner haddaluk bimsibba beshabbat im rov yisrael asur lehishtammesh leorah shehammadlik al daat harov madlik veim rov nachrim muttar lehishtammesh leorah mechetza lemechetza asur nafla deleka beshabbat uva nachri lechabbot en omrin lo kabbe veal techabbe mippene sheen shevitato alenu vechen kal kayyotze baze

Met sheasu lo nachrim aron vechafru lo kever beshabbat o heviu lo chalilin lispod bahen im betzina yamtin bichde sheyyeasu lemotzae shabbat veyikkaver bo veim haya hakkever bisratya gedola vehaaron al gabbav vechal haovrin vehashshavin omrim shezze shehannachrim osin achshav beshabbat lifloni hu hare ze lo yikkaver bo oto yisrael olamit mippene shehu befarhesya umuttar likbor bo yisrael acher vehu sheyyamtin bichde sheyyease vechen kal kayyotze baze

Nachri shehevi chalilin beshabbat lemet af al pi shehevian mitztzad hachoma yamtin lemotzae shabbat bichde sheyyavo mimmakom karov veachar kach yispedu bahen shemma ballayela hevium mimmakom acher ad hachoma uvabboker nichnesu bahen veim yada bevadday shemmimmakom peloni hevium beshabbat yamtin bichde sheyyavou meoto makom achar hashshabbat vehu shello yehe haddavar bisratya gedola kemo sheamarnu

Ir sheyyisrael venachrim darin betochah vehayeta bah merchatz hammarchetzet beshabbat im rov nachrim muttar lirchotz bah lemotzae shabbat miyyad veim rov yisrael yamtin bichde sheyyechammu chammin shebbishvil harov huchammu mechetza lemechetza yamtin bichde sheyyechammu chammin vechen kal kayyotze baze

Yisrael sheamar lenachri laasot lo melacha zo beshabbat af al pi sheavar umakkin oto makkat mardut muttar lo lehanot beotah melacha laerev achar sheyyamtin bichde shettease velo asru bechal makom ad sheyyamtin bichde sheyyeasu ella mippene davar ze sheim tomar yehe muttar miyyad shemma yomar lenachri laasot lo veyimtza haddavar muchan miyyad vechevan sheasru ad sheyyamtin bichde sheyyeasu lo yomar lenachri laasot lo shehare eno mistakker kelum mippene shehu mitakkev laerev bichde sheyyease davar ze shennaasa beshabbat

Davar sheeno melacha veen asur laasoto beshabbat ella mishshum shevut muttar leyisrael lomar lenachri laasoto beshabbat vehu sheyyihye sham miktzat choli o yihye tzarich laddavar tzorech harbe o mippene mitzva

Ketzad omer yisrael lenachri beshabbat laalot bailan o lashut al pene hammayim kede lehavi lo shofar o sakkin lemila o mevi lo mechatzer lechatzer sheen eruv benehen mayim chammin leharchitz bahem katan umitztaer vechen kal kayyotze baze

Hallokeach bayit beeretz yisrael min hannachri muttar lo lomar lannachri lichtov lo shetar beshabbat sheamira lenachri beshabbat asura middivrehem umishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael lo gazru bedavar ze vechen hallokeach bayit mehem besurya shessurya keeretz yisrael ledavar ze

Posek adam im hannachri al hammelacha vekotzetz damim vehannachri ose leatzmo veaf al pi shehu ose beshabbat muttar vechen hassocher et hannachri leyamim harbe muttar af al pi shehu ose beshabbat ketzad kegon shessachar hannachri leshana o lishtayim sheyyichtov lo o sheyyeerog lo hare ze kotev veoreg beshabbat umuttar keillu katzatz immo sheyyichtov lo sefer o sheyyeerog lo beged shehu ose bechal et sheyyirtze vehu shello yachshov immo yom yom

Bamme devarim amurim betzina sheen makkirim hakkol shezzo hammelacha hannaaset beshabbat shel yisrael hi aval im hayeta yedua ugluya umfursemet asura sheharoe et hannachri osek eno yodea shekkatzatz veomer sheppeloni sachar hannachri laasot lo melacha beshabbat

Lefichach happosek im hannachri livnot lo chatzero o katlo o liktzor et sadehu o shessecharo shana o shettayim livnot lo chatzer o litta lo kerem im hayeta hammelacha bammedina o betoch hattechum asur lo lahanichan laasot beshabbat mippene haroim sheenam yodim sheppasak veim hayeta hammelacha chutz lattechum muttar sheen sham yisrael sheyyire et happoalin keshehen osin beshabbat

Vechen muttar leadam lehaskir karmo o sadehu lenachri af al pi shehu zoran venotan beshabbat sheharoe yodea shessechurin hen o baarisut natan lahen vedavar sheshshem yisrael bealav karuy alav veen derech rov anshe oto hammakom lehaskiro o litteno baarisut asur lehaskiro lenachri mippene shehannachri ose beoto hammakom melacha beshabbat vehu nikra al shem hayyisrael bealav

Muttar lehashil kelim ulhaskiran lenachri veaf al pi shehu ose bahen melacha beshabbat mippene sheen anu metzuvim al shevitat hakkelim aval behemto veavdo asur mippene sheanu metzuvin al shevitat behema veeved

Hammishtattef im hannachri bimlacha o bischora o bachanut im hitnu battechilla sheyyihye sechar hashshabbat lannachri levaddo im meat im harbe uschar yom acher keneged yom hashshabbat leyisrael levaddo muttar veim lo hitnu battechilla kesheyyavou lachalok notel hannachri sechar hashshabbatot kullan levaddo vehashshear cholkin oto veeno mosif lo kelum keneged yom hashshabbat ella im ken hitnu battechilla vechen im kibbelu sade beshuttafut din echad hu

Veim lo hittenu uvau lachalok hassachar velo haya sechar shabbat yadua yerae li shehannachri notel levaddo sheviit hassachar vehashshear cholkin hannoten maot lenachri lehitassek bahen af al pi shehannachri nose venoten beshabbat cholek immo bassachar beshave vechen horu kal haggeonim

Lo yitten adam beerev shabbat kelim leumman nachri laasotan af al pi sheppasak immo ella bichde sheyyetze bahen mibbeto kodem shechashecha vechen lo yimkor adam chafatzav lenachri velo yashilennu velo yalvennu velo yemashkenennu velo yitten lo bemattana ella bichde sheyyetze beoto chefetz mippetach beto kodem hashshabbat shekkal zeman shehu beveto en adam yodea ematay natan lo uchsheyyetze hannachri mibbeto beshabbat vechefetz yisrael beyado yerae kemi shehillevahu lannachri o mishkeno o pasak immo o machar lo beshabbat

Hannoten iggeret lenachri leholichah leir acheret im katzatz immo sechar holacha muttar vaafillu netanah lo erev shabbat im chashecha vehu sheyyetze bah mippetach beto kodem hashshabbat veim lo katzatz im yesh bammedina adam kavua shehu mekabbetz haiggerot vesholeach otam lechal medina umdina im sheluchav muttar litten lannachri haiggeret vehu sheyyihye shehut bayyom kede sheyyaggia labbayit hassamuch lachoma kodem hashshabbat shemma ze shemmekabbel haiggerot vesholchan beto samuch lachoma hu veim en sham adam kavua lechach ella hannachri shennotnin lo haiggeret hu shemmolichah leir acheret asur lishloach beyad nachri haiggeret leolam ella im ken katzatz lo damim

Nachri shehevi chafatzav beshabbat vehichnisan levet yisrael muttar vaafillu amar lo hannichan bezavit zo hare ze muttar umzammenin et hannachri beshabbat venotnin lefanav mezonot leachlan veim netalan veyatza en nizkakin lo mippene sheen shevitato alenu vechen notnin mezonot lifne hakkelev bechatzer veim netalan veyatza en nizkakin lo

Mi shehaya ba badderech vekadash alav hayyom vehau immo maot noten kiso lenachri leholicho lo ulmotzae shabbat lokcho mimmennu veaf al pi shello natan lo sachar al ze veaf al pi shennetano lo mishshechashecha muttar mippene sheadam bahul al mamono vei efshar sheyyashlichennu veim lo tattir lo davar ze sheen issuro ella middivre sofrim yavo lahavio beyado veover al melacha shel tora bamme devarim amurim bechiso aval metzia lo yitten lannachri ella molichah befachot pachot mearba ammot

Yisrael sheasa melacha beshabbat im avar veasa bezadon asur lo lehanot beotah melacha leolam ushar yisrael muttar lahem lehanot bah lemotzae shabbat miyyad shenneemar ushmartem et hashshabbat ki kodesh hi hi kodesh veen maaseha kodesh ketzad yisrael shebbishshel beshabbat bemezid lemotzae shabbat yeachel laacherim aval lo lo yeachel olamit veim bishshel bishgaga lemotzae shabbat yochal ben hu ben acherim miyyad vechen kal kayyotze baze
Perot sheyyatzu chutz lattechum vechazru beshogeg yeachlu beshabbat shehare lo naasa begufan maase velo nishtannu bemezid lo yeachlu ad motzae shabbat

Hassocher et happoel lishmor lo et happara veet hattinok lo yitten lo secharo shel shabbat lefichach en acharaut shabbat alav veim haya hassachir sechir shabbat o sechir shana noten lo secharo mashlam lefichach acharaut shabbat alav velo yomar lo ten li sechari shel shabbat ella omer lo ten li sechari shel shana o shel asara yamim
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 7: Melachot shechayyavin alehen sekila vecharet bemezid o karban chattat bishgaga mehen avot umehen toladot uminyan kal avot melachot arbaim chaser achat veellu hen hacharisha vehazzeria vehakketzira vehaimmur vehaddisha vehazzeriyya vehabberira vehattechina vehaharkada vehallisha vehaafiyya vehaggeziza vehallibbun vehannipputz vehatztzevia vehatteviyya vaasiyyat hannirin vehansachat hammassecha vehaariga vehabbetzia vehakkeshira vehahattara vehattefira vehakkeria vehabbinyan vehassetira vehakkaa befattish vehatztzida vehashshechita vehahafshata vehahaavada umchikat haor vechittucho vehakketiva vehammechika vehassirtut vehahavara vehakkibbuy vehahotzaa mershut lirshut

Kal ellu hammelachot vechal shehu meinyanam hem hannikrain avot melachot ketzad hu inyanan echad hachoresh o hachofer o haose charitz hare ze av melacha shekkal achat veachat mehen chafira bakkarka veinyan echad hu
Vechen hazzorea zeraim o hannotea ilanot o hammavrich ilanot o hammarkiv o hazzomer kal ellu av echad hen meavot melachot veinyan echad hu shekkal achat mehen letzammeach davar hu mitkaven

Vechen hakkotzer tevua o kitnit o habbotzer anavim o haggoder temarim o hammosek zetim o haore teenim kal ellu av melacha achat hen shekkal achat mehen laakor davar miggiddulav mitkaven veal derech zo shear haavot

Hattolada hi hammelacha haddoma leav meellu haavot ketzad hamchattech et hayyarak meat levashshelo hare ze chayyav shezzo hammelacha toledet techina shehattochen lokeach guf echad umchalleko legufim harbe vechal haose davar haddome laze hare ze toledet tochen vechen hallokeach lashon shel mattechet veshaf oto kede likkach meafaro kederech sheosim tzorfe hazzahav hare ze toledet techina

Vechen hallokeach chalav venatan bo keva kede lechavtzo hare ze chayyav mishshum toledet borer shehare hifrish hakkom min hechalav veim gibbeno veasahu gevina chayyav mishshum bone shekkal hamkabbetz chelek el chelek vedibbek hakkol ad sheyyeasu guf echad hare ze dome levinyan vechen lechal melacha umlacha meellu haavot yesh lahen toladot al derech zo sheamarnu umigguf hammelacha hannaaset beshabbat teda meen e ze av hi vetoledet e ze av hi

Echad haose av meavot melachot o tolada min hattoladot bemezid chayyav karet veim bau edim niskal beshogeg chayyav chattat kevua im ken ma hefresh yesh ben haavot vehattoladot en benehen hefresh ella leinyan hakkarban bilvad shehaose beshogeg im asa avot harbe behealem echad chayyav chattat achat al kal av veav veim asa av vetoldotav behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat

Ketzad hare shecharash vezara vekatzar beshabbat behealem echad chayyav shalosh chattaot vaafillu asa haarbaim chaser achat bishgaga kegon sheshshachach sheellu hammelachot asurot leasot beshabbat chayyav al kal melacha umlacha chattat achat aval im tachan vechatach hayyarak veshaf lashon shel mattechet behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat shehare lo asa ella av echad vetoldotav vechen kal kayyotze baze

Haose melachot harbe meen melacha achat behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat ketzad hare shezzara venata vehivrich vehirkiv vezamar behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat shekkullan av echad hen vechen kal kayyotze baze
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 8: Hachoresh kal shehu chayyav hamnakkesh beikkere hailanot vehamkarsem asavim o hamzared et hassarigim kede leyappot et hakkarka hare ze toledet choresh umishsheyyaase kal shehu chayyav vechen hammashve pene hassade kegon shehishpil hattel veriddedo o mille haggaye chayyav mishshum choresh veshiuro kal shehu vechen kal hammashve gummot shiuro kal shehu

Hazzorea kal shehu chayyav hazzomer et hailan kede sheyyitzmach hare ze meen zorea aval hammashke tzemachin veilanot beshabbat hare ze toledet zorea vechayyav bechal shehu vechen hashshore chittin usorin vechayyotze bahen bammayim hare ze toledet zorea vechayyav bechal shehu

Hakkotzer kigrogeret chayyav vetolesh toledet kotzer hu vechal haoker davar miggiddulo chayyav mishshum kotzer lefichach tzeror shealu bo asavim uchshut sheala bassene vaasavim shetztzamchu al gav hechavit hattolesh mehen chayyav shezze hu mekom giddulan aval hattolesh meatzitz sheeno nakuv patur mippene sheen ze mekom giddulo veatzitz nakuv bichde shoresh katan hare hu keeretz vehattolesh mimmennu chayyav

Kal zera shekketzirato matzmachat oto umgaddalto kegon aspasta vesilka hakkotzro bishgaga chayyav shette chattaot achat mippene shehu kotzer veachat mippene shehu notea vechen hazzomer vehu tzarich laetzim chayyav mishshum kotzer umishshum notea gavshushit shel afar shealu bah asavim higbihah meal haaretz vehinnichah al gabbe yetedot chayyav mishshum tolesh hayeta al gabbe yetedot vehinnichah al haaretz chayyav mishshum zorea teenim sheyyavshu beibbehen vechen ilan sheyyavshu perotav bo hattolesh mehen beshabbat chayyav af al pi shehen kaakurin leinyan tuma

Hattolesh ulshin hamzared zeradin im laachila shiuro kigrogeret veim livhema shiuro kimlo pi gedi veim lehassaka shiuro kede levashshel betza hamammer ochalin im laachila shiuro kigrogeret veim immer livhema shiuro kimlo pi gedi veim lehassaka shiuro kede levashshel betza uvetza haamura bechal makom hi betza benonit shel tarnegolin vechal makom shenneemar kede levashshel betza hu kede levashshel kigrogeret mibbetza ugrogeret echad mishshelosha bevetza veen immur ella begiddule karka
Hamkabbetz devela veasa mimmenna iggula o shennikkev teenim vehichnis hachevel bahen ad shennitkabbetzu guf echad hare ze toledet meammer vechayyav vechen kal kayyotze baze

Haddash kigrogeret chayyav veen disha ella begiddule karka vehamfarek hare hi toledet haddash vechayyav vechen kal kayyotze baze hacholev et habbehema chayyav mishshum mefarek vechen hachovel bechay sheyyesh lo or chayyav mishshum mefarek vehu sheyyihye tzarich laddam sheyyetze min hachabbura aval im nitkaven lehazzik bilvad patur mippene shehu mekalkel veeno chayyav ad sheyyihye baddam o bachalav shehotzi kigrogeret

Bamme devarim amurim bechovel bivhema vechayya veof vechayyotze bahem aval hachovel bachavero af al pi shennitkaven lehazzik chayyav mippene nachat rucho shehare nitkarra dato veshachcha chamato vahare hu kimtakken veaf al pi sheeno tzarich laddam shehotzi mimmennu chayyav

Shemona sheratzim haamurim battora hen sheyyesh lahen orot leinyan shabbat kemo chayya uvhema veof aval shear shekatzim urmasim en lahen or lefichach hachovel bahen patur veechad hachovel bivhema chayya veof o bishmona sheratzim veasa bahen chabbura veyatza mehem dam o shennitzrar haddam af al pi shello yatza chayyav

Hassochet et happerot lehotzi memehen chayyav mishshum mefarek veeno chayyav ad sheyyihye bammashkin shessachat kigrogeret veen chayyavim min hattora ella al derichat zetim vaanavim bilvad umuttar lischot eshkol shel anavim letoch haochel shemmashke habba leochel ochel hu venimtza kimfarek ochel meochel aval im sachat lichli sheen bo ochel hare ze dorech vechayyav vehacholev letoch haochel o hayyonek befiv patur veeno chayyav ad sheyyachalov letoch hakkeli

Hazzore o habborer kigrogeret chayyav vehamchabbetz hare hu toledet borer vechen habborer shemarim mittoch hammashkin hare ze toledet borer o toledet merakked vechayyav shehazzore vehabborer vehamrakked domin inyenehem ze laze umippene ma manu otan bishlosha mippene shekkal melacha shehayeta bammishkan monin otah bifne atzmah
Habborer ochel mittoch pesolet o shehau lefanav shene mine ochalin uverer min mimmin acher benafa uvichvara chayyav bekanon o betamchuy patur veim berer beyado leechol lealtar muttar

Vehabborer pesolet mittoch haochel vaafillu beyado achat chayyav vehabborer turmosin mittoch pesolet shellahen chayyav mippene shehappesolet shellahen mematteket otan kesheyyishleku otan immahem venimtza kevorer pesolet mittoch ochel vechayyav habborer ochel mittoch pesolet beyado lehannicho afillu levo bayyom naasa kevorer laotzar vechayyav hau lefanav shene mine ochalin meoravin borer echad meacher umanniach leechol miyyad veim berer vehinniach leachar zeman afillu levo bayyom kegon shebberer beshacharit leechol ben haarbayim chayyav

Hmshammer yayin o shemen o mayim vechen shear hammashkin bammeshammeret shellahen chayyav vehu sheyeshammer kigrogeret aval mesannenin yayin sheen bo shemarim o mayim tzelulin besudarin uvichfifa mitzrit kede sheyehe tzalul beoter venotnin mayim al gabbe shemarim bishvil sheyyitztzolu venotnin betza terufa limsannenet shel chardal kede sheyyitztzalel chardal shellasho meerev shabbat lemachar memache veshote ben bayyad ben bichli vechen yayin miggitto kal zeman shehu toses toref chavit bishmareha venoten letoch hassudarin sheadayin lo nifreshu hashshemarim min hayyayin yafe yafe vechal hayyayin keguf echad hu vechen hachardal vechal kayyotze bo

Hattochen kigrogeret chayyav vechal hashshochek tavlin vesammanin bemachteshet hare ze tochen vechayyav hamchattech yarak talush hare ze toledet tochen vechen hannoser etzim lehanot binsoret shellahen o hashshaf lashon shel mattechet chayyav mishsheyyashuf kal shehu aval hamchattech etzim eno chayyav ad sheyedakdek mehen kede levashshel kigrogeret mibbetza

Hamrakked kigrogeret chayyav hallash kigrogeret chayyav hamgabbel et heafar hare ze toledet lash vechamma shiuro kede laasot pi kur shel tzorfe zahav veen gibbul beefer velo bechol haggas velo bemursan velo bechayyotze bahen vehannoten zera shumshemin o zera pishtan vechayyotze bahen bemayim chayyav mishshum lash mippene shehen mitarvin venitlin ze baze
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 9: Haofe kigrogeret chayyav echad haofe et happat o hamvashshel et hammaachal o et hassammanin o hamchammem et hammayim hakkol inyan echad hu shiur hamchammem et hammayim kede lirchotz bahen evar katan veshiur mevashshel sammanin kede sheyyihu reuyin ledavar shemmevashshelin otan lo

Hannoten betza betzad hammecham bishvil shettitgalgel venitgalgela chayyav shehamvashshel betoledet haur kimvashshel baur atzmah vechen hammediach bechammin dag maliach hayyashan o kulyas haispanin vehu dag dak verach beoter hare ze chayyav shehadachatan bechammin ze hu gemar bishshulan vechen kal kayyotze bahen

Hammafkia et habbetza beveged cham o bechol uvaavak derachim shehen chammim mippene hashshemesh af al pi shennitzlet patur shettoldot chamma enam ketoldot haesh aval gazru alehen mippene toldot haur vechen hamvashshel bechamme teverya vechayyotze bahem patur hamvashshel al haur davar shehaya mevushshal kal tzarko o davar sheeno tzarich bishshul kelal patur

Echad natan et haur veechad natan et haetzim veechad natan et hakkedera veechad natan et hammayim veechad natan et habbasar veechad natan et hattavlin uva acher vehegis kullam chayyavim mishshum mevashshel shekkal haose davar mitztzarche habbishshul hare ze mevashshel aval im shafat echad et hakkedera techilla uva acher venatan et hammayim uva acher venatan et habbasar uva acher venatan et hattavlin uva acher venatan et haur uva acher venatan etzim al haur uva acher vehegis shenayim haacharonim bilvad chayyavin mishshum mevashshel

Hinniach basar al gabbe gechalim im nitzla bo kigrogeret afillu bishnayim ushlosha mekomot chayyav lo nitzla bo kigrogeret aval nitbashshel kullo chatzi bishshul chayyav nitbashshel chatzi bishshul mitztzad echad patur ad sheyyahafoch bo veyitbashshel chatzi bishshul mishshene tzedadin shachach vehidbik pat battannur beshabbat venizkar muttar lo lirdota kodem shetteafe veyavo lide melacha

Hammattich echad mimmine mattachot kal shehu o hamchammem et hammattachot ad shettease gachelet hare ze toledet mevashshel vechen hammasses et haddonag o et hachelev o et hazzefet vehakkofer vehaggafrit vechayyotze bahem hare ze toledet mevashshel vechayyav vechen hamvashshel kele adama ad sheyyeasu cheres chayyav mishshum mevashshel kelalo shel davar ben sherippa guf kashe baesh o shehiksha guf rach hare ze chayyav mishshum mevashshel

Haggozez tzemer o sear ben min habbehema ben min hachayya ben min hachay ben min hammet afillu min hashshelach shellahen chayyav kamma shiuro kede litot mimmennu chut shearko kerochav hassit kaful vechamma rochav hassit kede limtoach min bohen shel yad ad haetzba harishona kesheyyiftach benehen bechal kocho vehu karov lishne shelishe zeret hattolesh kanaf min haof hare ze toledet gozez hattove et hatztzemer min hachay patur sheen derech geziza bechach veen derech nipputz bechach veen derech teviyya bechach

Hannotel tzipparnav o searo o sefamo o zekano hare ze toledet gozez vechayyav vehu sheyyittol bichli aval im netalan beyado ben lo ben leacher patur vechen hachotech yabbelet miggufo ben beyad ben bichli patur ben lo ben leacher umuttar lachtoch yabbelet bammikdash beyad aval lo bichli veim hayeta yevesha chotchah af bichli veoved avoda

Hannotel searo bichli kamma yittol veyihye chayyav shette searot veim likket levanot mittoch shechorot afillu achat chayyav tzipporen sheppersha rubbah vetzitzin shel or sheppershu rubban im pershu kelappe mala umtzaarot oto muttar littol otan beyado aval lo bichli veim netalan bichli patur veim enan metzaarot oto afillu bayyad asur veim lo pershu rubban afillu metzaarot oto asur lenatlan beyado veim netalan bichli chayyav

Hamlabben et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hashshani vechen kal kayyotze bahen mimma sheddarkan lehitlabben chayyav vechamma shiuro kede litot mimmennu chut echad arko kimlo rochav hassit kaful shehu orech arbaa tefachim

Hamchabbes begadim hare hu toledet melabben vechayyav vhassochet et habbeged ad sheyyotzi hammayim shebbo hare ze mechabbes vechayyav shehassechita mitztzarche kibbus hi kemo shehahagasa mitztzarche habbishshul veen sechita besear vehu haddin leor sheen chayyavin al sechitato

Hamnappetz et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hashshani vechayyotze bahen chayyav vechamma shiuro kede litot mimmennu chut echad arko arbaa tefachim vehamnappetz et haggidim ad sheyyeasu ketzemer kede litot otan hare ze toledet menappetz vechayyav

Hatztzovea chut shearko arbaa tefachim o davar sheefshar litot mimmennu chut kaze chayyav veen hatztzovea chayyav ad sheyehe tzeva hammitkayyem aval tzeva sheeno mitkayyem kelal kegon sheheevir sarak o shashar al gabbe barzel o nechoshet utzvao patur shehare atta maaviro lishato veeno tzovea kelum vechal sheen melachto mitkayyemet beshabbat patur

Haose en hatztzeva hare ze toledet tzovea vechayyav ketzad kegon shennatan kankantom letoch me appetza shennaasa hakkol shachor o shennatan istis letoch me karkom shennaasa hakkol yarok vechen kal kayyotze baze vechamma shiuro kede litzboa bo chut shearko arbaa tefachim

Hattove orech arbaa tefachim mikkal davar hannitve chayyav echad hattove et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hannotza o et hassear o et haggidin vechen kal kayyotze bahen haose et halleved hare ze toledet tove vechayyav vehu sheyelabbed davar sheefshar litot mimmennu chut orech arbaa tefachim beovi benoni

Haose shene batte nirin chayyav haose nafa o kevara o sal o sevacha o shessarag mitta bachavalim hare ze toledet ose nirin umishsheyyaase shene battim beechad mikkal ellu chayyav vechen kal haose shene batte nirin bedavar sheosin oto battim battim kegon ellu chayyav

Derech haorgin shemmotchin hachutin techilla beorech hayeria uvrachbah ushnayim ochazin ze mikkan veze mikkan veechad shovet beshevet al hachutin umtakken otan ze betzad ze ad shettease kullah sheti belo erev umtichat hachutin kederech haorgin hi hansachat hammassechet veze hammoteach nikra mesech uchshekkoflin otah umatchil lehachnis hashsheti baerev nikra oreg

Hammesech chayyav vehi melacha meavot melachot vehashshovet al hachutin ad sheyyipparku vitakkenem hare ze toledet mesech vechamma shiuro mishsheyetakken rochav shette etzbaot vechen haoreg shene chutin berochav shette etzbaot chayyav ben shearagan battechilla ben shehaya miktzat habbeged arug vearag al haarug shiuro shene chutin veim arag chut echad vehishlim bo habbeged chayyav arag bisfat hayeria shene chutin berochav shelosha batte nirin chayyav ha lema ze dome leoreg tziltzul katan berochav shelosha batte nirin
Hamdakdek et hachutin umafridan beet haariga hare ze toledet oreg vechen hakkolea et hannimin hare ze toledet oreg veshiuro mishsheyyaase kelia beorech shette etzbaot

Habbotzea shene chutin chayyav uvotzea hu hammafrish et haarug ben shehotzi haerev min hashsheti o sheheevir hashsheti meal haerev hare ze botzea vechayyav vehu shello yehe mekalkel ella yitkaven letakken kederech sheosin ellu shemmeachin et habbegadim hakkallim beoter shebbotzin veachar kach meachin vechozrin veorgin chutin shebbatzu ad sheyyeasu shene habbegadim o shene hakkeraim echad vehassoter et hakkelia letakken hare ze toledet botzea veshiuro keshiur habbotzea
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 10: Hakosher kesher shel kayyama vehu maase umman chayyav kegon kesher haggammalin vekesher hassappanin vekishre retzuot minal vesandal shekkoshrin haratzanin bishat asiyyatan vechen kal kayyotze baze aval hakkosher kesher shel kayyama veeno maase umman patur vekesher sheeno shel kayyama veeno maase umman muttar lekashro lechattechilla

Ketzad nifseka lo retzua uksharah nifsak hachevel uksharo o shekkashar chevel bidli o shekkashar resen behema hare ze patur vechen kal kayyotze beellu hakkesharim shehen maase hedot vechal adam kosher otan lekayyama vechal kesher sheeno shel kayyama im kesharo kesher umman hare ze asur

Kosheret ishsha mifteche hechaluk af al pi sheyyesh lo shene petachim vechute sevacha af al pi shehu rafuy beroshah urtzuot minal vesandal shekkoshrin otan al haregel bishat malbush venodot yayin veshemen af al pi sheyyesh lo shette aznayim ukdera shel basar af al pi sheyechola lehotzi habbasar velo tattir hakkesher vekoshrin deli bimshicha o beavnet vechayyotze bo aval lo bechevel vekoshrin lifne habbehema o beraglah bishvil shello tetze af al pi sheyyesh lah shene issarot vechevel shehaya kashur bappara koshro baevus haya kashur baevus koshro bappara aval lo yavi chevel mittoch beto veyikshor bappara uvaevus veim haya chevel gardi shemmuttar letaltelo hare ze mevi vekosher bappara uvaevus mippene shekkal ellu hakkesharim maase hedot hen veenan shel kayyama ella paam kosher ufaam mattir ulfichach muttar likshor otan lechattechilla chotalot shel temarim veshel gerogarot mattir umafkia vechotech venotel veochel

Kal sherauy lemaachal behema muttar likshor oto beshabbat lefichach im nifseka retzuat sandalo becharmelit notel gemi lach harauy lemaachal behema vechorech alav vekosher haggemi nishmeta lo retzuat minal vesandal o shennishmat rov haregel muttar lehachazir hartzuot limkoman uvilvad shello yikshor
Haaniva mutteret lefi sheenah mitchallefet bikshira lefichach hachevel shennifsak mekabbetz shene ketzotav vechorech alav meshicha veonev aniva

Muttar likshor kesher sheeno shel kayyama lidvar mitzva kegon sheyyikshor limdod shiur mishshiure hattora nimat kinnor shennifsak koshrin otah bammikdash aval lo bammedina velo yikshor nima lechattechilla afillu bammikdash
Kal kesher shechayyavin al kishshuro kach chayyavin al hettero vechal kesher shehakkosher oto patur kach hammattir oto patur vechal kesher shemmuttar lekashro kach muttar lehattiro

Happotel chavalim min hahutzin umin hachelef o michute tzemer o michute pishtan o chute sear vechayyotze bahen hare ze toledet kosher vechayyav veshiuro kede sheyyaamod hachevel biftilato belo keshira shennimtzet melachto mitkayyemet vechen hammafrid et happetil hare ze toledet mattir vechayyav vehu shello yitkaven lekalkel bilvad veshiuro keshiur happotel

Hattofer shette tefirot chayyav vehu shekkashar rashe hachut mikkan umikkan kede shettaamod hattefira velo tishshamet aval im tafar yeter al shette tefirot af al pi shello kashar chayyav shehare mitkayyemet hattefira vehammoteach chut shel tefira beshabbat chayyav mippene shehu mitztzarche hattefira

Hakkorea kede litpor shette tefirot al menat litpor shette tefirot chayyav aval hakkorea lehafsidah patur mippene shehu mekalkel hakkorea bachamato o al met shehu chayyav likroa alav chayyav mippene shemmeyashshev et dato bedavar ze veyanuach yitzro vehoil vachamato shochechet bedavar ze hare hu kimtakken vechayyav vehappoteach bet hatztzavar beshabbat chayyav

Hamdabbek neyarot o orot bekolan shel sofrim vechayyotze bo hare ze toledet tofer vechayyav vechen hamfarek neyarot devukin o orot devukin velo nitkaven lekalkel bilvad hare ze toledet korea vechayyav

Habbone kal shehu chayyav hammashve pene hakkarka bevayit kegon shehishpil tel o mille guma o gaye hare ze bone vechayyav echad natan et haeven veechad natan et hattit hannoten hattit chayyav uvannidbach haelon afillu heela et haeven vehinnichah al gabbe hattit chayyav shehare en mannichin aleha tit acher vehabbone al gabbe kelim patur

Haose ohel kavua hare ze toledet bone vechayyav vechen haose kele adama kegon tannur vechavit kodem sheyyissarfu hare ze toledet bone vechayyav vechen hamgabben et haggevina hare ze toledet bone veeno chayyav ad sheyegabben kigrogeret hammachnis yad hakkardom betoch haetz shello hare ze toledet bone vechen kal kayyotze bo vechen hattokea etz beetz ben shettaka bemasmer ben shettaka baetz atzmo ad shennitached hare ze toledet bone vechayyav
Haose nekev kal shehu belul shel tarnegolim kede sheyyikkanes lahen haora chayyav mishshum bone hammachazir delet shel bor veshel dut veshel yatzia chayyav mishshum bone
Hassoter kal shehu chayyav vehu sheyyistor al menat livnot aval im satar derech hashchata patur hassoter ohel kavua o shepperek etz takua hare ze toledet soter vechayyav vehu sheyyitkaven letakken

Hammakke befattish hakkaa achat chayyav vechal haose davar shehu gemar melacha hare ze toledet makke befattish vechayyav ketzad hamnappeach bichle zechuchit vehatztzar bakkeli tzura afillu miktzat hatztzura vehamgared kal shehu vehaose nekev kal shehu ben beetz ben bemattechet ben bevinyan ben bechelim hare ze toledet makke befattish vechayyav vechal petach sheeno asuy lehachnis ulhotzi en chayyavin al asiyyato

Hammefis shechin beshabbat kede leharchiv pi hammakka kederech sheharofin osin shehen mitkavvenin birfua leharchiv pi hammakka hare ze chayyav mishshum makke befattish shezzo hi melechet harofe veim hefisa lehotzi mimmenna hallecha shebbah hare ze muttar

Hamsattet et haeven kal shehu chayyav mishshum makke befattish hamtzadded et haeven bisod habbinyan vetikkenah beyado vehoshivah bammakom harauy lah chayyav mishshum makke befattish halloket yabbolet sheal gabbe begadim beyado kegon ellu hayyabbolot shebbichle tzemer chayyav mishshum makke befattish vehu sheyyakpid alehen aval im hesiran derech esek hare ze patur hamnaer tallit chadasha shechora kede lenaotah ulhasir hatztzemer hallavan hannitle bah kederech shehaummanin osin chayyav chattat veim eno makpid muttar

Hatztzad davar shedderech mino latzud oto chayyav kegon chayya veofot vedagim vehu sheyyatzud otan lemakom sheeno mechussar tzeda ketzad kegon sheradaf achare tzevi ad shehichniso levayit o leginna o lechatzer venaal befanav o shehifriach et haof ad shehichniso lemigdal venaal befanav o sheshshala dagim min hayyam betoch sefel shel mayim hare ze chayyav aval im hifriach tzippor levayit venaal befanav o shehivriach dag vaakaro min hayyam livrecha shel mayim o sheradaf achar tzevi ad shennichnas litraklin rachav venaal befanav hare ze patur sheen zo tzida gemura sheim yavo lekachto tzarich lirdof acharav velatzud oto mishsham lefichach hatztzad ari eno chayyav ad sheyyachnisennu lakkippa shello shehu neesar bah
