Hammotze tefillin beshabbat birshut harabbim ketzad hu ose lovshan kedarkan meniach shel yad beyado shel rosh berosho venichnas vecholtzan bevayit vechozer veotze velovesh zug sheni vecholtzan ad sheyyachnis et kullan veim hau harbe velo nishar min hayyom kede lehachnisan derech malbush hare ze machshich alehem umachnisan bemotzae shabbat veim haya bime haggezera shemmityare leshev ulshamran ad haerev mippene hakkutim mechassan bimkoman umannichan veholech

Haya mityare lehachshich alehen mippene hallistim notel et kullan keachat umolichan pachot pachot mearba ammot o notnan lachavero betoch arba ammot vachavero lachavero ad shemmaggia lechatzer hachitzona bamme devarim amurim beshehau bahen retzuotehen vehen mekushsharin kesher shel tefillin shevadday tefillin hen aval im lo hau retzuotehen mekushsharot eno nizkak lahen
Hammotze sefer tora yoshev umshammero umachshich alav uvassakkana mannicho veholech lo veim hau geshamim yordin mitattef beor vechozer umchasse oto venichnas bo

Lo yetze hachayyat bemachato beyado velo hallavlar bekulmoso erev shabbat samuch lachashecha shemma yishkach veotzi vechayyav adam lemashmesh bevigdo erev shabbat im chashecha shemma yihye sham davar shachuach veyetze bo beshabbat muttar latzet bitfillin erev shabbat im chashecha hoil vechayyav adam lemashmesh bitfillav bechal et eno shochchan shachach veyatza bahen lirshut harabbim venizkar sheyyesh lo tefillin berosho mechasse et rosho ad shemmaggia leveto o levet hammidrash
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 20: Asur lehotzi massa al habbehema beshabbat shenneemar lemaan yanuach shorcha vachamorecha vechal behemtecha echad shor vachamor veechad kal behema chayya vaof veim hotzi al habbehema af al pi shehu metzuve al shevitatah eno loke lefi sheissuro ba mikkelal ase lefichach hamchammer achar behemto beshabbat vehaya aleha massooy patur

Vahalo lav meforash battora shenneemar lo taase chal melacha atta uvincha uvittecha veavdecha vaamatecha uvhemtecha shello yacharosh bah vechayyotze bacharisha venimtza lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din veen lokin alav

Asur leyisrael lehashil o lehaskir behema gassa lenachri shello yaase bah melacha beshabbat vahare hu metzuve al shevitat behemto asru chachamim limkor behema gassa lenachri shemma yashil o yaskir veim machar konsin oto ad asara bedameha umachazirah vaafillu shevura en mochrin umuttar lo limkor lahem al yede sarsur shehassarsur eno maskir veeno mashil

Umuttar limkor lahem sus sheen hassus omed ella lirchivat adam lo lemassooy vehachay nose et atzmo uchderech sheasru limkor lenachri kach asru limkor leyisrael hechashud limkor lenachri umuttar limkor lahem para lishchita veshochet otah befanav velo yimkor setam afillu shor shel petam shemma yashhe oto veyaavod bo
Makom shennahagu limkor lahen behema dakka mochrin makom shennahagu shello limkor en mochrin uvchal makom en mochrin lahem chayya gassa kemo sheen mochrin lahem behema gassa ella al yede sarsur

Mi shehechshich badderech velo haya immo nachri sheyyitten lo kiso vehayeta immo behema manniach kiso aleha keshehi mehallechet uchshettirtze laamod notlo mealeha kede shello taamod vehu aleha uchde shello tihye sham lo akira velo hannacha veasur lo lehanhigah vaafillu bekol kal zeman shehakkis aleha kede shello yihye mechammer beshabbat ugzerat chachamim hi shello yanniach kiso al gabbe behema ella im en immo nachri

Haya immo cheresh shote vekatan manniach kiso al hachamor veeno notno leechad mehen mippene shehen adam miyyisrael haya immo cheresh veshote veen immo behema notno leshote shote vekatan notno leshote cheresh vekatan notno lee ze mehen sheyyirtze lo hayeta immo behema velo nachri velo echad mikkal ellu mehallech bo pachot pachot mearba ammot vaafillu metzia shebbaa leyado mehallech bah pachot pachot mearba ammot aval kodem shettavo leyado im yachol lehachshich aleha machshich veim lav molichah pachot pachot mearba ammot

Muttar limshoch et habbehema bemeteg varesen shellah lirshut harabbim vehu shettihye reuya leoto haresen kegon shir lesus veafsar legamal vachatam lenaka vesugar lechelev aval im hotzi behema bemeteg sheen mishtammeret bo kegon shekkashar chevel befi hassus o bemeteg sheenah tzericha lo ella mishtammeret befachot mimmennu kegon shehotzi chamor beshir shel sus o chatul besugar hare ze massooy shekkal shemira meulla o shemira pechuta massooy hu lah

Lo yikshor gemallim ze baze veyimshoch afillu hau keshurin meerev shabbat enan nimshachin beshabbat aval machnis hu chavalim letoch yado vehu shello yetze chevel mittoch yado tefach vetzarich sheyyihye hachevel shemmippi habbehema ad yado gavoha min haaretz tefach o yoter umippene ma lo yimshoch haggemallim hakkeshurim ze baze mippene shehu nire kemi shemmolichan leshuk shemmochrin bo habbehemot o shemmesachakin bahen sham umippene ze lo tetze behema bezog shebbetzavarah vaafillu haya pakuk sheen lo kol

Lo tetze behema bezug shebbichsutah velo bechotam shebbetzavarah velo bechotam shebbichsutah velo birtzua shebberaglah velo besullam shebbetzavarah veen chamor yotze bemardaat ella im ken hayeta keshura lo meerev shabbat velo yetze gamal bammetutelet hatteluya lo bedabbashto o biznavo ella im ken hayeta keshura biznavo vechotarto velo yetze haggamal akud yad velo akud regel vechen shear kal habbehemot

En hattarnegolim yotzin bechutin velo bartzuot shebberaglehem veen hakkevasin yotzin baagala shettachat alya shellahen veen hakkevasot yotzot baetzim shemmannichim lahen bechatman kede sheyyitatteshu veyippelu hattolain shebbemochan veen haegel yotze beol katan shemmannichin lo al tzavaro kede sheyyikkana veyihye noach lacharisha velo tetze behema bisvacha shemmannichin lah befiha kede shello tishshoch o shello tochal lo tetze happara beor hakkuppar shemmannichin lah al daddeha kede shello yinak mimmenna hashsheretz keshehi yeshena velo tetze bartzua shebben karneha ben lenoy ben leshammer ez shechakak lah bekarneha yotza beafsar hakkashur bechekek beshabbat veim techavo bizkanah asur shemma tenattechennu viviennu beyado birshut harabbim vechen kal kayyotze baze

Hazzecharim yotzim baor hakkashur lahen al zachrutan kede shello yaalu al hannekevot uvaor hakkashur lahem al libbehem kede shello yippelu alehem zeevim uvmatlaniyyot hamrukkamot shemmeyappin otan bahen veharchelot yotzot vealya shellahen keshura lemala al gabban kede sheyyaalu alehen hazzecharim o keshura lematta kede shello yaalu alehem hazzecharim veotzot meluppafot bematlaniyyot kede sheyyihye hatztzemer shellahen naki haizzim yotzot vedaddehen keshurot kede sheyyivash mehen hechalav aval im kesharan kede shello yetze hechalav ad sheyyachalov oto laerev hare ellu lo yetzu

En chamor yotze beukkaf af al pi shekkashur meerev shabbat velo yetze hassus biznav shual velo bizhorit shebben enav velo tetze behema bikrastal shebbefiha velo besandal shebberaglah velo bekamea sheeno mumche livhema aval yotza hi beeged sheal gav hammakka uvkaskassim sheal gabbe hashshever uvshilya hamduldelet bah ufokek lah zog shebbetzavarah umtayyelet bo bechatzer venoten lo mardaat al hachamor beshabbat umtayyel bechatzer aval en tolin lah kerastal befiha beshabbat

Keshem sheadam metzuve al shevitat behemto beshabbat kach hu metzuve al shevitat avdo vaamato veaf al pi shehen bene daat uldaat atzman osin mitzva alenu leshamran ulmanan measiyyat melacha beshabbat shenneemar lemaan yanuach shorcha vachamorecha veyinnafesh ben amatcha vehagger eved veama sheanu metzuvin al shevitatan hem avadim shemmalu vetavlu leshem avdut vekibbelu mitzot shehaavadim chayyavin bahen aval avadim shello malu velo tavlu ella kibbelu alehen sheva mitzot shennitztauu bene noach bilvad hare hen keger toshav umuttarin laasot melacha beshabbat leatzman befarhesya keyisrael bechol veen mekabbelin ger toshav ella bizman shehayyovel noheg hoil veger toshav ose melacha leatzmo beshabbat veger tzedek hare hu keyisrael lechal davar bemi neemar veyinnafesh ben amatcha vehagger ze ger toshav shehu lekito uschiro shel yisrael kemo ben amato shello yaase melacha leyisrael rabbo beshabbat aval leatzmo ose vaafillu haya hagger ze avdo hare ze ose leatzmo
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 21: Neemar battora tishbot afillu middevarim sheenan melacha chayyav lishbot mehen udvarim harbe hen sheasru chachamim mishshum shevut mehen devarim asurim mippene shehen domim limlachot umehen devarim asurim gezera shemma yavo mehen issur sekila veellu hen

Kal hammashve gummot hare ze chayyav mishshum choresh lefichach asur lehippanot bisde hannira beshabbat gezera shemma yashve gummot hamfanne et haotzar beshabbat mippene shehu tzarich lo lidvar mitzva kegon sheyyachnis bo orchim o yikba bo midrash lo yigmor et kal haotzar shemma yavo lehashot gummot tit sheal gabbe raglo mekannecho bakkotel o bekora aval lo bakkarka shemma yavo lehashot gummot lo yarok bakkarka veyashuf beraglo shemma yashve gummot umuttar lidros harok sheal gabbe karka veholech lefi tummo

Nashim hamsachakot beegozim ushkedim vechayyotze bahen asurot lesachek bahen beshabbat shemma yavou lehashot gummot veasur lechabbed et hakkarka shemma yashve gummot ella im ken haya ratzuf baavanim umuttar lezallef mayim al gabbe hakkarka veeno choshesh shemma yashve gummot shehare eno mitkaven lechach en sachin et hakkarka vaafillu haya ratzuf baavanim veen nofchin oto veen medichin oto afillu beom tov kal shekken beshabbat shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol veyavo lehashot gummot bizman shehu ose ken bemakom sheeno ratzuf
Chatzer shennitkalkela bememe haggeshamim mevi teven umradde bah uchshehu meradde lo yeradde lo besal velo bekuppa ella beshule hakkuppa shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol veyavo lehashot gummot

Hammashke et hazzeraim chayyav mishshum zorea lefichach asur lishov min habbor begalgal gezera shemma yemalle leginnato ulchurbato umippene ze im haya habbor shel galgal bechatzer muttar lemalleot mimmennu baggalgal

Htolesh chayyav mishshum kotzer lefichach asur lirdot devash mikkaveret beshabbat mippene shehu ketolesh en olin beilan ben lach ben yavesh veen nitlin beilan veen nismachin beilan velo yaale mibbeod yom leshev sham kal hayyom kullo veen mishtammeshin bimchubbar lakkarka kelal gezera shemma yitlosh

Perot shennashru beshabbat asur leachlan ad motzae shabbat gezera shemma yitlosh hadas hamchubbar muttar lehariach bo sheen hanayato ella lehariach bo vahare recho matzuy aval etrog vetappuach vechal harauy laachila asur lehariach bo bimchubbar gezera shemma yakotz oto leachlo

Ilan shehau sharashav gevohin min haaretz shelosha tefachim asur leshev alehen veim enan gevohin shelosha hare hen kaaretz hau bain millemala mishshelosha letoch shelosha muttar lehishtammesh bahen hau gevohin shelosha af al pi shetztziddan echad shave laaretz o sheyyesh chalal tachtehen shelosha asur leshev alehen

En rochvin al gabbe behema beshabbat gezera shemma yachtoch zemora lehanhigah veen nitlin bivhema velo yaale mibbeod yom leshev aleha beshabbat veen nismachin letzidde behema vetzidde tzedadin muttarin ala bailan beshabbat beshogeg muttar lered bemezid asur lered uvivhema afillu bemezid yered mishshum tzaar baale chayyim vechen porkin hammassooy meal habbehema beshabbat mishshum tzaar baale chayyim

Ketzad hayeta behemto teuna shalif shel tevua machnis rosho tachtav umsalleko letzad acher vehu nofel meelav haya ba min hadderech belel shabbat uvhemto teuna kesheyyaggia lechatzer hachitzona notel et hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat vesheenan nittalin mattir hachavalim vehassakkin noflin hau bassakkin devarim hammishtabberin im hau sakkin ketannim mevi karim uchsatot umanniach tachtehen vehassakkin noflin al hakkarim shehare im yirtze lishlof hakkar sholef mippene shehassakkim ketannim vekallim venimtza shello batel hakkeli mehechano hayeta teuna ashashiyyot shel zechuchit mattir hassakkim vehen noflin sheaf al pi sheyyishshavru en bechach hefsed gadol shehare hakkol lehattacha omed ulhefsed muat lo chashshu hau hassakkim gedolim umleim kele zechuchit vechayyotze bahem porek benachat umikkal makom lo yannichan sham al gabbe behema mishshum tzaar baale chayyim

Hamdabbek perot ad sheyyeasu guf echad chayyav mishshum meammer lefichach mi shennitpazzeru lo perot bachatzero melakket al yad al yad veochel aval lo yitten lo letoch hassal velo letoch hakkuppa kederech shehu ose bechol sheim yaase kederech shehu ose bechol shemma yichbeshem beyado betoch hakkuppa veyavo lide immur vechen en mekabbetzin et hammelach vechayyotze bo mippene shennire kimammer

Mefarek chayyav mishshum dash vehassochet zetim vaanavim chayyav mishshum mefarek lefichach asur lischot tutim verimmonim hoil umiktzat bene adam sochatim otam kezetim vaanavim shemma yavo lischot zetim vaanavim aval shear perot kegon perishin vetappuchim veuzradin muttar lesachotan beshabbat mippene sheenan bene sechita

Kevashin ushlakot shessechatan im lerakkech gufan muttar veim lehotzi memehen asur veen merassekin et hashsheleg sheyyazuvu memav aval merassek hu letoch hakkeara o letoch hakkos hashshum vehabboser vehammelilot sherissekan mibbeod yom im mechussarin dicha asur lo ligmor dichatan beshabbat veim mechussarin shechika bayyad muttar lo ligmor shechikatan beshabbat lefichach muttar ligmor shechikat harifot baetz happarur betoch hakkedera beshabbat achar shemmoridin otah meal haesh

Hammolel melilot molel beshinnuy kede shello yerae kedash hayyonek befiv patur veim haya goneach muttar lo linok befiv mippene shehu mefarek kilachar yad umishshum tzaaro lo gazru veaf al pi sheen sham sakkana

Perot shezzavu mehen mashkin beshabbat im zetim vaanavim hen asur lishtot otan hammashkin ad motzae shabbat gezera shemma yitkaven veyischot otan beshabbat veim tutim verimmonim hen im hichnisan laachila mashkin shezzavu mehen muttarin veim hichnisan ledarchan mashkin shezzavu mehen asurin ad motzae shabbat

Zetim vaanavim sherissekan meerev shabbat veyatzu mehen mashkin meatzman muttarin vechen challot devash sherissekan meerev shabbat mashkin hayyotzin mehen beshabbat muttarin sheen kan makom ligzera shekkevar rissekan mibbaerev

Zore uvorer meavot melachot hen lefichach af al pi shemmuttar limlol melilot berashe etzbeotav keshehu menappeach menappeach beyado achat bechal kocho aval lo bekanon velo betamchuy gezera shemma yenappe benafa uvichvara shehu chayyav vhamshammer shemarim toledet borer o merakked hu lefichach af al pi shemmuttar lesannen yayin tzalul o mayim tzelulin besudarin o bichfifa mitzrit lo yaase guma bassudar shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol veyavo leshammer bimshammeret vechen asur litlot et hamshammeret kederech shehu ose bechol shemma yavo leshammer vechen hamchabbetz toledet borer hu lefichach af al pi shennotnin shumshemin veegozim lidvash lo yachbetzem beyado

Hamchattech et hayyarak dak dak kede levashshelo hare ze toledet tochen vechayyav lefichach en merassekin lo et hashshachat velo et hacharuvin lifne behema ben dakka ben gassa mippene shennire ketochen aval mechattechin et haddeluin lifne habbehema veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim sheen techina beferot umattirin alummot shel amir lifne behema umfasfes beyado alummot ketannot aval lo alummot gedolot mippene hattorach shebbahen
Chavile pea veezov vekoranit vechayyotze bahen shehichnisan lemaachal behema mistappek mehen vekotem veochel berashe etzbeotav aval lo beyado harbe shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol veyavo laduk

Hatztzarich laduk pilpelim vechayyotze bahen litten letoch hammaachal beshabbat hare ze kotesh beyad hassakkin uvakkeara aval lo bemachteshet mippene shehu tochen lefichach asur labbari lehitrappeot beshabbat gezera shemma yishchok hassammanin

Ketzad lo yochal devarim sheenan maachal beriim kegon ezovon ufea velo devarim hamshalshelim kegon laana vechayyotze bahem vechen lo yishte devarim sheen derech habberiim lishtotan kegon mayim shebbishshelu bahen sammanin vaasavim

Ochel adam ochalin umashkin shedderech habberiim leachlan velishtotan kegon hakkusbara vehakkeshut vehaezov af al pi shehen merappein veochlan kede lehitrappeot bahem muttar hoil vehem maachal beriim shata chiltit mikkodem hashshabbat vahare hu shote veholech muttar lishtoto afillu shello nahagu habberiim lishtot hachiltit veshotin zetom hammitzri bechal makom

Vechen shemanim shedderech habberiim lasuch bahen muttar lasuch bahen beshabbat veaf al pi shennitkaven lirfua vesheen habberiim sachin bahen asurin hachoshesh bematnav lo yasuch yayin vechometz aval sach hu et hashshemen velo shemen vered ella bemakom shehabberiim sachin oto umuttar lasuch shemen umelach bechal makom niggefa yado o raglo tzomtah beyayin veeno tzomtah bechometz veim haya anog af beyayin asur

Hachoshesh beshinnav lo yigma bahen et hachometz veyiflot aval megammea hu uvolea hachoshesh bigrono lo yearennu beshemen aval bolea hu shemen harbe veim nitrappe nitrappe en loasin et hammastechi veen shafin et hashshinnayim besam beshabbat bizman shennitkaven lirfua veim nitkaven lereach happe muttar

En notnin yayin letoch haayin aval noten hu al gav haayin verok tafel afillu al gav haayin asur kilor sheshshara oto meerev shabbat maaviro al gav eno beshabbat veeno choshesh mi shellaka beetzbao lo yichroch alav gemi kede lerappeoto velo yidchakennu beyado kede lehotzi mimmennu dam

En notnin chammin veshemen al gabbe hammakka velo al gabbe moch sheal gabbe hammakka velo al gabbe moch litteno al hammakka beshabbat aval noten hu chutz lammakka veshotet veored lammakka venotnin moch yavesh al gabbe hammakka veim haya attik asur mippene shehu kirtiyya

Retiyya shepparsha al gabbe keli machzirin otah veim parsha al gabbe karka asur lehachazirah umannichin retiyya al gabbe hammakka lechattechilla bammikdash sheen issur shevut bammikdash uvchal makom mekannechin pi hammakka veen mekannechin et hartiyya shemma yemareach

Sachin ummashmeshin bivne meayim beshabbat vehu sheyyasuch vimashmesh bevat achat kede shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol veen mitammelin beshabbat e ze hu mitammel ze sheddorsim al gufo bechoach ad sheyyiga veyazzia o sheyehallech ad sheyyiga veyazzia sheasur leyaggea et atzmo kede sheyyazzia beshabbat mippene shehi refua vechen asur laamod bekarka dimosit shebbeeretz yisrael mippene shemmeammelet umrappet

En rochatzin bemayim shemmeshalshelin velo betit shettovin bo velo beme mishra habbeushim velo beyam sedom velo bammayim haraim shebbayyam haggadol mippene shekkal ellu tzaar hen vechatuv vekarata lashshabbat oneg lefichach im lo nishtaha bahem ella ala miyyad af al pi sheyyesh lo chatatin berosho muttar

En mitgardin bemigredet veim hau yadav meluchlachot betzoa o betit gored kedarko veeno choshesh sachin umfarchin leadam leanneg aval lo livhema veim haya lah tzaar muttar lehasir tzaarah besicha uferuch behema sheachla karshinin harbe meritzin otah bechatzer bishvil shettitrappe veim achazah dam maamidin otah bemayim bishvil shettitztannen veen choshshin shemma yishchak lah sammanin

En mekiin et haochel beshabbat bamme devarim amurim besam shemma yishchak sammanin aval lehachnis yado letoch piv ulhaki muttar veasur lidchok kereso shel tinok kede lehotzi hari shello shemma yavo lehashkoto sammanin hamshalshelin umuttar lichpot kos al hattabbur beshabbat kede lehaaloto vechen muttar lechanek ullappef et hakkatan ulhaalot aznayim ben beyad ben bichli ulhaalot unkeli shekkal ellu vechayyotze bahen en osin otan besammanin kede lachush lishchika veyesh lo tzaar mehen

Hamrakked meavot melachot lefichach en kovrin et hatteven bichvara velo yanniach hakkevara sheyyesh bah teven bemakom gavoha bishvil sheyyered hammotz mippene shehu kimrakked aval notel hatteven bakkevara umolich laevus af al pi sheyyered hammotz bishat holacha shehare eno mitkaven lechach

Megabbel chayyav mishshum lash lefichach en megabbelin kemach kali harbe shemma yavo lalush kemach sheeno kali umuttar legabbel et hakkali meat meat aval tevua shello hevia shelish shekkalu otah veachar kach tachanu otah techina gassa shehare hu kechol vehi hannikret shatit muttar legabbel mimmenna bechometz vechayyotze bo harbe bevat achat vehu sheyyihye rach aval kashe asur mippene shennire kelash vetzarich leshannot ketzad noten et hashshatit veachar kach noten et hachometz

Hammursan af al pi sheeno rauy legibbul en govlin oto shemma yavo legabbel heafar vechayyotze bo venotnin mayim al gabbe mursan umolich bo hattarvad sheti vaerev aval eno memares beyado shello yerae kelash im lo nitarev menaaro mikkeli lichli ad sheyyitarev venoten lifne hattarnegolin o lifne hashshevarim umuttar learev hammursan al derech zo bichli echad umchallek oto bechelim harbe venoten lifne kal behema uvhema umarev bichli echad afillu kor vaafillu korayim

En maachilin behema chayya veof beshabbat kederech shehu maachil bechol shemma yavo lide ketishat kitniyyot o lide lishat kemach vechayyotze bo ketzad lo yaachil haggamal beshabbat maachal shelosha o arbaa yamim velo yarbitz egel vechayyotze bo veyiftach piv veyitten letocho karshinin umayim bevat achat vechen lo yitten letoch pi yonim vetarnegolim lemakom sheenan yecholin lehachazir aval maachil hu et habbehema meemmad umashke otah meummad o noten letoch piha mayim bifne atzman vecharshinin bifne atzman bemakom sheyechola lehachazir vechen maachil haof beyado bemakom sheyyachol lehachazir veen tzarich lomar sheyyitten lifnehen vehen ochlin

Bamme devarim amurim bemi shemmezonotav alav kegon behemto vechayyato veone habbayit vaavazin vetarnegolin aval mi sheen mezonotav alav kegon chazir veone shovach udvorim lo yitten lifnehem lo mazon velo mayim umuttar leadam lehaamid behemto al gabbe mechubbarim vehi ochelet aval lo yaamid otah al gabbe davar shehuktza aval omed befaneha kede shettachazir paneha laddavar hammuktze vetochal mimmennu vechen beom tov
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 22: Rediyyat happat af al pi sheenah melacha asru otah chachamim shemma yavo leefot hammadbik pat battannur mibbeod yom vekadash alav hayyom matztzil mimmenna mazon shalosh seuddot veomer laacherim bou vehatztzilu lachem veaf al pi shehardiyya enah melacha keshehu matztzil lo yirde bemirde ella besakkin kede leshannot

Mippene ma asru chachamim likkanes bammerchatz beshabbat mippene habballanin shehau mechimmin chammin beshabbat veomrin meerev shabbat huchammu lefichach gazru shello yikkanes adam lammerchatz beshabbat afillu lehazzia vegazru shello yishtattef kal gufo bechammin vaafillu bechammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat aval panav yadav veraglav muttar bamme devarim amurim bechamme haur gezera mishshum merchatz aval bechamme teverya vechayyotze bahen muttar lehishtattef bahen kal gufo veasur lirchotz bemayim chammin shebbammearot mippene shehammeara yesh bah hevel veyavo lide zea venimtzet kemerchatz

Mitchammem adam keneged hammedura veotze umishtattef kal gufo betzonen aval eno mishtattef kal gufo betzonen umitchammem keneged hammedura mippene shemmafshir mayim shealav venimtza kerochetz kal gufo bechammin hammevi silon shel tzonen betoch mayim chammin afillu betoch chamme teverya hare ellu kechammin shehuchammu beshabbat vaasurin birchitza uvishtiyya

Mevi adam kiton shel mayim umannicho keneged hammedura lo bishvil sheyyechammu ella kede shettafug tzinnatan vechen manniach pach shel shemen keneged hammedura kede sheyyifshar lo sheyyecham vesach adam yado bemayim o beshemen umchammem keneged hammedura vehu shello yechammu hammayim sheal yado ad shettehe kereso shel tinok nichvet bahen umchammem beged umannicho al gabbe meayim beshabbat

Ambeti shel merchatz shehi melea mayim chammim en notnin lah mayim tzonen shehare mechammeman harbe vechen lo yitten letochah pach shel shemen mippene shehu kimvashshelo aval noten hu mayim chammin letoch ambeti shel tzonen

Mecham sheppinna mimmennu mayim chammin muttar litten letocho mayim tzonen kede lehafshiran umuttar litztzok mayim chammin letoch mayim tzonen o tzonen letoch hachammin vehu shello yihu bichli rishon mippene shehu mechammeman harbe vechen kedera rotachat af al pi shehoridah meal haesh lo yitten letochah tavlin aval noten letochah melach shehammelach eno mitbashshel ella al gabbe esh gedola veim yatzak hattavshil mikkedera likara af al pi shehu roteach bakkeara muttar lo litten letoch hakkeara tavlin shekkeli sheni eno mevashshel

En shorin et hachiltit ben befoshrin ben betzonen aval shore oto betoch hachometz veim shatahu beom chamishi veshishshi hare ze shore beshabbat betzonen umannicho bachamma ad sheyyecham veshote kede shello yechele im pasak millishtot

Davar shenitbashshel kodem hashshabbat o nishra bechammin millifne hashshabbat af al pi shehu achshav tzonen muttar lishroto bechammin beshabbat vedavar shehu tzonen meikkaro velo ba bechammin meolam medichin oto bechammin beshabbat im lo hayeta hadachato gemar melachto aval en shorin oto bechammin

Muttar lehachem bachamma af al pi sheasur lehachem betoldot chamma sheeno ba litot mechamma leur lefichach muttar litten mayim tzonen bashshemesh kede sheyyechammu vechen notnin mayim yafim letoch mayim raim bishvil sheyyetzannu venotnin tavshil letoch habbor bishvil sheyehe shamur

Mearev adam mayim umelach veshemen vetovel bo pitto o notno letoch hattavshil vehu sheyyaase meat aval harbe asur mippene shennire keose melacha mimmelechet hattavshil vechen lo yaase me melach azzin vehen shene shelishe melach ushlish mayim mippene shennire keose muryas umuttar limloach betza aval tzenon vechayyotze bo asur mippene shennire kechovesh kevashim beshabbat vehakkovesh asur mippene shehu kimvashshel umuttar litbol tzenon vechayyotze bo bemelach veochel
Muttar learev yayin udvash ufilpelin beshabbat leachlan aval yayin umayim veshemen afarsemon asur sheen ze rauy laachilat beriim vechen kal kayyotze baze

Chardal shellasho meerev shabbat lemachar memacho ben beyad ben bichli venoten letocho devash velo yitrof ella mearev shachalayim shetterafan meerev shabbat lemachar noten letocho shemen vechometz vetavlin velo yitrof ella mearev shum sherisseko meerev shabbat lemachar notno letoch haggerisin velo yishchok ella mearev

Hannotel sear migguf haadam chayyav mishshum gozez lefichach asur lirchotz et hayyadayim bidvar shemmashshir et hassear vadday kegon ahola vechayyotze bo umuttar lachof et hayyadayim baafar levona vaafar pilpelin vaafar yasmin vechayyotze bahen veeno choshesh shemma yashshir sear sheal yado shehare eno mitkaven erev davar shemmashshir et hassear vadday im davar sheeno mashshir vadday im haya harov middavar hammashshir asur lachof bo veim lav muttar
Asur lirot bemara shel mattechet beshabbat gezera shemma yashshir bah nimin hamduldalin min hassear vaafillu kavua bakkotel aval mara sheenah shel mattechet muttar lirot bah afillu enah kevua

Hamchabbes chayyav mishshum melabben vehassochet kesut chayyav mippene shehu mechabbes lefichach asur lidchok matlit o moch vechayyotze bahen befi haashisha vechayyotze bah kede lesatmah shemma yavo lide sechita veen mekannechin bisfog ella im ken yesh lo bet achiza shello yischot veen mechassin chavit shel mayim vechayyotze bah beveged sheeno muchan lah gezera shemma yischot

Nishbera lo chavit beshabbat matztzil mimmenna ma shehu tzarich leshabbat lo ulorchav uvilvad shello yispog beyayin o yetappach beshemen sheim yaase kederech shehu ose bechol shemma yavo lide sechita vechetzad matztzil mimmenna mevi keli umanniach tachteha velo yavi keli acher veyiklot keli acher vitzaref gezera shemma yavi keli derech reshut harabbim nizdammenu lo orchim mevi keli acher vekolet keli acher umtzarfo larishon velo yiklot veachar kach yazmin ella yazmin veachar kach yiklot veim heerim bedavar ze muttar

Tit sheal gabbe bigdo mechaskeso mibbifnim veeno mechaskeso mibbachutz gezera shemma yechabbes umuttar legardo betzipporen veeno choshesh shemma yelabbeno hamchaskes et hassudar asur mippene shehu melabbeno aval hechaluk muttar mippene sheen kavanato ella lerakkecho

Minal o sandal shennitlachlech betit uvtzoa muttar leshachshecho bemayim aval lechabbeso asur veen megardin lo minalim velo sandalim chadashim aval sachin otam umkannechin et hayeshanim kar o keset shehaya alehen tzoa o tinnuf mekannecho bismartut veim hayeta al shel or notnin aleha mayim ad shettichle

Mi shennitlachlecha yado betit mekannechah biznav hassus uviznav happara uvmappa hakkasha haasuya leechoz bah hakkotzim aval lo bemappa shemmekannechin bah et hayyadayim shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol veyavo lechabbes et hammappa

Mi sherachatz bemayim mistappeg baaluntito umviah beyado veen choshshin shemma yischot vechen mi shennashru kelav bemayim mehallech bahen veen choshshin shemma yischot veasur lo leshatchan vaafillu betoch beto gezera shemma yomar haroe hare ze kibbes kesuto beshabbat ushtachah leyabbeshah vechal makom sheasru chachamim mippene marit haayin afillu bechadre chadarim asur

Shette metahrot zo al gav zo notel et happekak mibbentayim umshikan umachazir et happekak limkomo mippene sheeno ba lide sechita shehare dato sheyyetzu hammayim ufokkin et habbiv besudarin uvchal davar hammittaltel kede shello yatzufu hammayim al haochalim veal hakkelim aval en pokkin et habbiv kede sheyyerdu hammayim labbor shemma yischot beet sheddochek shehare happekak sharuy bemayim

Asur letakken bet yad shel begadim ulshabberam shevarim shevarim kederech shemmetakkenin bechol habbegadim keshemmechabbesin otan vechen en mekappelim habbegadim beshabbat kederech sheosin bechol babbegadim kesheyechabbesu otan veim lo haya lo keli acher lehachalifo muttar lekappelo ulfashto ulhitkassot bo kede sheyyitnae bo beshabbat vehu sheyyihye beged chadash lavan shehare hu mitmaech umitlachlech miyyad uchsheyekappel lo yekappel ella ish echad aval lekappel bishnayim asur

Hatztzovea meavot melachot lefichach asur leishsha lehaavir serak al paneha mippene shehi ketzovaat vehattofer meavot melachot lefichach asur lemalleot hakkar vehakkeset hachadashim bemochin gezera shemma yitpor aval mochin shennashru min hakkar o min hakkeset machzirin otan beshabbat

Hakkorea meavot melachot lefichach mi shennistabbechu begadav bekotzim mafrishan betzina umitmahmeha kede shello yikra veim nikreu eno chayyav kelum shehare lo nitkavin umuttar lilbosh begadim chadashim veim nikreu nikreu potzin et haegoz bematlit veen choshshin shemma tikkara

Hattokea chayyav mishshum bone lefichach kal haddelatot hamchubbarot lakkarka lo notlin otan velo machzirin gezera shemma yitka aval delet shidda teva umigdal ushar daltot hakkelim notlin velo machzirin veim nishmat tzir hattachton shellahen dochakin oto limkomo uvammikdash machzirin oto aval tzir haelon shennishmat asur lehachaziro bechal makom gezera shemma yitka

En godlin et sear harosh veen poksin oto mippene shennire kevone veen machzirin menora shel chulot velo kisse hamfutztzal velo shulchan hamfutztzal vechayyotze bahen mippene shennire kevone veim hechezir patur sheen binyan bechelim veen setira bechelim veim haya rafuy muttar lehachaziro veen metakkenin chulot shel shidra shel katan zo betzad zo mippene shennire kevone

Haose ohel kavua chayyav mishshum bone lefichach en osin ohel aray lechattechilla velo sotrin ohel aray gezera shemma yaase o yistor ohel kavua veim asa o satar ohel aray patur umuttar lehosif al ohel aray beshabbat ketzad tallit shehayeta perusa al haammudim o al hakketalim vehayeta kerucha kodem hashshabbat im nishar mimmenna gag tefach matuach hare ze moteach et kullah beshabbat ad sheyyaase ohel gadol vechen kal kayyotze baze
En tolin et hakkilla shehare naaset tachteha ohel aray umuttar lehanniach mitta vechisse utraskal veaf al pi sheyyease tachtehen ohel sheen ze derech asiyyat ohel lo keva velo aray

Kal ohel meshuppa sheen begaggo tefach velo befachot mishshelosha samuch legaggo rochav tefach hare ze ohel aray vehaose oto lechattechilla beshabbat patur tallit kefula shehau aleha chutin shehi teluya bahen meerev shabbat muttar lintotah umuttar lefarkah vechen happarochet

Killat chatanim sheen begaggah tefach veen befachot mishshelosha samuch legaggah rochav tefach hoil shehi metukkenet lechach muttar lintotah umuttar lefarkah vehu shello tehe meshulshelet meal hammitta tefach pekak hachallon bizman shehu metukkan lechach af al pi sheeno kashur veeno taluy muttar lifkok bo hachallon

Kova sheosin al harosh veyesh lo safa makkefet shehi osa tzel kemo ohel al levusho muttar lelavsho veim hotzi min habbeged saviv lerosho o keneged panav kemo ohel vehaya mehuddak al rosho vehayeta hassafa shehotziah kasha beoter kemo gag asur mippene shehu ose ohel aray

Hannote parochet vechayyotze bah tzarich lehizzaher shello yaase ohel beshaa shennote lefichach im hayeta parochet gedola tolin otah shenayim aval echad asur veim hayeta killa sheyyesh lah gag en motchin otah vaafillu asara shei efshar shello tigbah meat meal haaretz vetease ohel aray

Beged shemmechasse bo pi hechavit lo yechasse bo et kullah mippene shennaasa ohel aval mechasse hu miktzat piha hamsannen bichfifa mitzrit lo yagbiha karkait hakkefifa min hakkeli tefach kede shello yaase ohel aray beshabbat
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 23: Haose nekev shehu asuy lehachnis ulhotzi kegon nekev shebbelul hattarnegolin shehu asuy lehachnis haora ulhotzi hahevel hare ze chayyav mishshum makke befattish lefichach gazru al kal nekev afillu haya asuy lehotzi bilvad o lehachnis bilvad shemma yavo laasot nekev shechayyavin alav umippene ze en nokvin bechavit nekev chadash veen mosifin bo aval potchin nekev yashan vehu shello yihye hannekev lematta min hashshemarim sheim haya lematta min hashshemarim hare ze asuy lechazzek veasur lefatcho

Nokvin megufa shel chavit lehotzi mimmenna yayin uvilvad sheyenakkevennah millemala aval mitztziddah asur mippene shehu kimtakken keli shover adam et hechavit leechol mimmenna gerogarot uvilvad shello yitkaven laasot keli umevi adam chavit shel yayin umattiz et roshah besayif lifne haorchin veeno choshesh sheen kavanato ella leharot nedivat libbo

Uchshem sheasur liftoach kal nekev kach asur listom kal nekev lefichach asur listom nekev hechavit vaafillu bedavar sheeno mitmareach veeno ba lide sechita kegon sheyyistom bekesam o bitzror katan aval im hinniach sham ochel kede lehatznio venimtza hannekev nistam muttar umuttar lehaarim bedavar ze

Kal davar shehu gemar melacha chayyav alav mishshum makke befattish umippene ze haggorer kal shehu o hamtakken keli beeze davar sheyetakken chayyav lefichach asur lehashmia kol shel shir beshabbat ben bichle shir kegon kinnorot unvalim ben bishar devarim afillu lehakkot beetzba al hakkarka o al halluach o achat keneged achat kederech hamshorrim o lekashkesh et haegoz letinok o lesachek bo bezog kede sheyyishtok kal ze vechayyotze bo asur gezera shemma yetakken kele shir

En mesappekin velo merakkedin veen metappechin beshabbat gezera shemma yetakken kele shir ulsappek kilachar yad muttar en shatin al pene hammayim gezera shemma yetakken chavit shel shayyatin berecha shebbechatzer muttar lashut betochah sheeno ba laasot chavit shel shayyatin vehu sheyyihye lah safa mukkefet shello yeaker mimmenna hammayim kede sheyyihye hekker vehefresh benah uven hayyam

En chotchin shefoferet shel kane mippene shehu kimtakken keli hayeta chatucha af al pi sheenah metukkenet muttar lehachnisah benekev hechavit beshabbat lehotzi mimmenna yayin veen choshshin shemma yetakken veasur lehanniach ale shel hadas vechayyotze bo betoch hannekev shel chavit kede sheyekalleach et hayyayin mippene shehu keose marzev beshabbat veen shovrin et hacheres veen korin et hanneyar mippene shehu kimtakken keli

Zemora shehi keshura betafiach memallein bah beshabbat veim enah keshura en memallein bah gezera shemma yiktom otah veyitkaah asur lachof kele kesef begartakon mippene shehu melabbenan kederech shehaummanin osin venimtza kimtakken keli vegomer melachto beshabbat aval choffin oto bechol uvneter vechen kal hakkelim choffin otan bechal davar veasur lehadiach kearot veilpasin vechayyotze bahen mippene shehu kimtakken ella im ken hedichan leechol bahen seudda acheret beotah shabbat aval kele shetiyya kegon kosot vekitonot muttar lahadichan bechal et sheen keva lishtiyya veen matztziin et hammittot beshabbat kede lishon alehen lemotzae shabbat aval matztziin millele shabbat leshabbat

Asur lehatbil kelim temein beshabbat mippene shehu kimtakken keli aval adam tame muttar litbol mippene shennire kemeker veen mazzin alav beshabbat hammatbil kelim beshabbat beshogeg yishtammesh bahen bemezid lo yishtammesh bahen ad lemotzae shabbat umuttar lehatbil et hammayim hattemeim beshabbat ketzad yaase notnan bichli sheeno mekabbel tuma kegon kele avanim umatbil hakkelim bammikve ad sheyyaale me hammikve alehen veyitharu
En magbihin terumot umaasrot beshabbat mippene shennire kimtakken davar shello haya metukkan

Meabbed meavot melachot hu vehamrakkech or beshemen kederech shehaabbedanim osim hare ze meabbed vechayyav lefichach lo yasuch adam raglo beshemen vehu betoch hamminal o betoch hassandal hachadashim aval sach hu et raglo shemen velovesh minalo o sandalo af al pi shehen chadashim vesach kal gufo shemen umitaggel al gabbe kattavliya chadasha veeno choshesh bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hashshemen muat kede sheyetzachtzeach haor bilvad aval im haya bivsaro shemen harbe kede sheyerakkech haor hare ze asur mippene shehu kimabbedo vehakkol bachadashim aval bishanim muttar
Hammareach retiyya beshabbat chayyav mishshum mochek et haor lefichach en sotmin nekev beshaava vechayyotze bah shemma yemareach vaafillu beshumman en sotmin et hannekev gezera mishshum shaava

Kotev meavot melachot lefichach asur lichchol bappuch vechayyotze bo beshabbat mippene shehu kechotev veasur lilot ulhalot gezera shemma yichtov vechen asur liknot velimkor veliskor ulhaskir gezera shemma yichtov lo yiskor adam poalim beshabbat velo yomar lachavero liskor lo poalin aval lishl ulhashil muttar shoel adam mechavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen uvilvad shello yeamer lo halveni
Echad hammocher bappe o bimsira veasur lishkol ben bemoznayim ben shello bemoznayim uchshem sheasur lishkol kach asur limnot velimdod ben bichli midda ben bayyad ben bechevel

En danin beshabbat velo choltzin velo meyabbemin velo mekaddeshin gezera shemma yichtov veen makdishin velo maarichin velo machrimin mippene shehu kemikkach umimkar veen magbihin terumot umaasrot shezze dome lemakdish otan perot shehifrish veod mippene shehu kimtakken otan beshabbat veen measserin et habbehema gezera shemma yirshom besikra umakdish adam pischo beshabbat vachagigato beom tov shezzo mitzvat hayyom hi uchshem sheen makdishin kach en mekaddeshin me chattat

Hammagbiha terumot umaasrot beshabbat o beom tov beshogeg yochal mimma shehitkin bemezid lo yochal ad motzae shabbat uven kach uven kach tikken et happerot vechen hammakdish o hammaarich o hammacharim beshabbat ben beshogeg ben bemezid ma sheasa asuy veen tzarich lomar beom tov vechen hammakne lachavero beshabbat kana measserin et haddemay ben hashshemashot aval lo et havadday

Mi shekkara shem litrumat maaser shel demay o lemaasar ani shel vadday lo yitlem beshabbat af al pi sheyeyached mekoman mikkodem hashshabbat vahare hen yeduin umunnachin betzad happerot veim haya kohen o ani lemudim leechol etzlo yavou veyochlu uvilvad sheyyodia lakkohen shezzo sheani maachilcha terumat maaser veodia leani shezzo sheani maachilcha maasar ani
Asur lehafis ulsachek bekubbiyya beshabbat mippene shehu kemikkach umimkar umefis adam im banav veim bene beto al mana gedola keneged mana ketanna mippene sheen makpidin

Asur lechashshev cheshbonot shehu tzarich lahen beshabbat ben sheavar ben sheatid lihot gezera shemma yichtov lefichach cheshbonot sheen bahen tzorech muttar lechashshevan ketzad kamma sein tevua haya lanu beshana pelonit kamma dinarin hotzi bechatnut beno vechayyotze beellu shehen bichlal sicha betela sheen bahen tzorech kelal hamchashshev otan beshabbat kimchashshev bechol

Asur likrot beshitre hedotot beshabbat shello yehe kederech chol veyavo limchok mone adam parperotav veet orchav mippiv aval lo min hakketav kede shello yikra beshitre hedotot lefichach im hau hashshemot chakukin al hattavla o al hakkotel muttar likrotan mippene sheeno mitchallef bishtar veasur likrot bichtav hamhallech tachat hatztzura vetachat haddeukni beshabbat af likrot bakketuvim beshabbat bishat bet hammidrash asur gezera mishshum bittul bet hammidrash shello yihye kal echad yoshev beveto vekore veyimmana mibbet hammidrash

Nafla deleka bechatzer beshabbat eno matztzil kal ma sheyyesh bechatzer lechatzer acheret shebbeoto hammavoy af al pi sheervu gezera shemma yechabbe haddeleka kede sheyyatztzil mippene sheadam bahul al mamono lefichach gazru shello yatztzil ella mazon shehu tzarich lo leoto shabbat vechelim shetztzarich lehishtammesh bahen beshabbat uvgadim sheyyachol lilbosh shennimtza mityaesh min hakkol veeno ba lide kibbuy veim lo ervu af mezono vechelav eno matztzil

Uma hu matztzil limzono im nafla deleka belele shabbat matztzilin mezon shalosh seuddot harauy leadam leadam veharauy livhema livhema nafla beshacharit matztzilin mezon shette seuddot bemincha matztzilin mezon seudda achat

Bamme devarim amurim bematztzil bechelim harbe o shehaya memalle keli umotzio umare vechozer ummalle oto shenit hu sheen matztzil ella ma shehu tzarich lo aval im hotzi keli echad behotzaa achat af al pi sheyyesh bo kamma seuddot muttar

Ketzad matztzil sal male kikkarot af al pi sheyyesh bo kamma seuddot veiggul shel devela vechavit shel yayin vechen im paras tallito vekibbetz bah kal ma sheyyachol lehotzi vehotziah melea bevat achat muttar

Veomer laacherim bou vehatztzilu lachem vechal echad veechad matztzil mazon shehu tzarich lo o keli echad shemmachazik afillu davar gadol vahare hu shel matztzil veim lo ratza hammatztzil lekachto untano livalav muttar lo littol mimmennu achar hashshabbat sechar amalo veen ze sechar shabbat shehare en sham melacha velo issur shello hotzio ella bemakom meorav

Hitztzil pat nekiyya eno chozer umatztzil pat sheenah nekiyya aval im hitztzil pat sheenah nekiyya chozer umatztzil pat nekiyya umatztzil beom hakkippurim ma shehu tzarich leshabbat im haya yom hakkippurim beerev shabbat aval eno matztzil beshabbat leom hakkippurim veen tzarich lomar leom tov velo mishshabbat zo leshabbat habbaa uma shehu matztzil lilbosh lovesh kal ma shehu yachol lilbosh veotef kal ma shehu yachol laatof umotzi veomer laacherim bou vehatztzilu lachem vechal echad veechad lovesh umitattef bechelav umotzi vahare hu shello kemo hammaachal shehare min hahefker hen zochin

Muttar lehatztzil kal kitve hakkodesh sheyyesh bechatzer lechatzer acheret shebbeoto hammavoy veaf al pi shello ervu uvilvad sheyyihye lammavoy shalosh mechitztzot velechi echad vehu sheyyihu ketuvin ashshurit uvilshon hakkodesh aval im haya ketuvin bechal lashon o bichtav acher en matztzilin otan afillu haya sham eruv uvchol asur likrot bahem ella mannichan bimkom hattoref vehen mitabbedin mealehen

Hau ketuvin besam uvsikra af al pi sheeno ketav shel kayyama hoil vehen ketuvin ashshurit uvilshon kodesh matztzilin otan gillaon shel sefarim shellemala veshellematta veshebben parasha lefarasha veshebben daf ledaf veshebbitchillat hassefer veshebbesof hassefer en matztzilin otan habberachot vehakkemein af al pi sheyyesh bahen otiyyot shel shem umeinyanot harbe shel tora en matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka

Sefer tora sheyyesh bo lelakket shemonim vechamesh otiyyot mittoch tevot shelemot vaafillu bichlalan yegar sahaduta vechen im hayeta bah parasha sheen bah shemonim vechamesh otiyyot veyesh bah hazkarot kegon vayehi binsoa haaron matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka umatztzilin tik hassefer im hassefer vetik tefillin im hattefillin af al pi sheyyesh betochan maot
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 24: Yesh devarim shehen asurin beshabbat af al pi sheenam domin limlacha veenam meviin lide melacha umippene ma neesru mishshum shenneemar im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha asot chafatzecha beom kadshi veneemar vechibbadto measot derachecha mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar lefichach asur leadam lehallech bachafatzav beshabbat vaafillu ledabber bahen kegon sheyedabber im shuttafo ma yimkor lemachar o ma yikne o heach yivne bayit ze uve ze sechora yelech lemakom peloni kal ze vechayyotze bo asur shenneemar vedabber davar dibbur asur hirhur muttar

Asur leadam lifkod ginnotav usdotav beshabbat kede lirot ma hen tzerichin o heach hen perotehen shehare ze mehallech laasot cheftzo vechen asur leadam sheyyetze beshabbat ad sof hattechum veyeshev sham ad shettechshach kede sheyyihye karov laasot chafatzav bemotzae shabbat shehare nimtza hillucho beshabbat laasot chafatzav

Bamme devarim amurim beshehechshich al hattechum laasot davar sheasur beshabbat laasoto aval im hechshich laasot davar shemmuttar laasoto beshabbat hare ze muttar ketzad en machshichin al hattechum lehavi perot mechubbarin o liskor poalin aval machshich hu lishmor perot shehare muttar lishmor beshabbat umachshich lehavi behema o perot telushin shehabbehema kore lah vehi baa af al pi shehi chutz lattechum uferot telushin illu hau sham mechitztzot haya muttar lahavian beshabbat vechen omer adam lachavero lichrach peloni ani holech lemachar sheim hau sham burganim haya holech lesham beshabbat vechen kal kayyotze baze

Muttar leadam lomar lefoel hannire shettaamod immi laerev aval lo yomar lo heye nachon li laerev shennimtza ose cheftzo beshabbat veasur larutz uldalleg beshabbat shenneemar measot derachecha shello yehe hilluchcha shel shabbat kehilluchcha shel chol veored adam levor veshiach umara afillu hen mea amma umtappes veored veshote umtappes veole veasur leharbot besicha betela shenneemar vedabber davar shello yehe dibburcha shel shabbat kedibburcha shel chl

Muttar larutz beshabbat lidvar mitzva kegon sheyyarutz levet hakkeneset o levet hammidrash umchashshevin cheshbonot shel mitzva umoddin medida shel mitzva kegon mikve leda im yesh kashshiur o beged leda im mekabbel tuma ufoskin tzedaka laaniyyim veholchin levatte kenesiyyot ulvatte midrashot vaafillu letarteot utraklin shel kutim lefakkeach al iske rabbim beshabbat umshaddechin al hattinoket leares veal hattinok lelammedo sefer ullammedo ummanut umvakkerin cholin umnachamim avelim vehannichnas levakker et hachole omer shabbat hi millizok urfua kerova lavo umachshichin al hattechum lefakkeach al iske kalla veal iske hammet lehavi lo aron vetachrichin veomer lo lech lemakom peloni lo matzata sham have mimmakom peloni lo matzata bemane have bematayim uvilvad shello yizkor lo sechum mikkach shekkal ellu vechayyotze bahen mitzva hen veneemar asot chafatzecha vechu chafatzecha asurin cheftze shamayim muttarin

Mafligin bayyam haggadol beerev shabbat lidvar mitzva ufosek immo lishbot veeno shovet umfirin nedarim beshabbat ben letzorech shabbat ben shello letzorech shabbat venishalin lechacham al hannedarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat umattirin af al pi shehaya lahen penay lehattiran kodem hashshabbat sheddevarim ellu mitzva hen

En onshin beshabbat af al pi shehaonesh mitzvat ase enah docha shabbat ketzad hare shennitchayyev bevet din malkot o mita en malkin oto veen memitin oto beshabbat shenneemar lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beom hashshabbat zo azhara levet din shello yisrefu beshabbat mi shennitchayyev serefa vehu haddin lishar onashin

Muttar leadam lishmor perotav beshabbat ben telushim ben mechubbarin veim ba adam littol mehen o behema vechayya leechol mehen goer bahen umakke bahem umarchikan vahalo davar ze mechafatzav hu velamma hu muttar mippene shello neesar ella lehaknot leatzmo chafatzim sheenan atta metzuyim o lehistakker ulharviach ulhittafel bahanaa shettavo leyado aval lishmor mamono shekkevar ba leyado ad sheyyaamod kemot shehu muttar ha lema ze dome lenoel beto mippene haggannavim
Hamshammer zeraav mippene haofot umikshaav umidlaav mippene hachayya lo yesappek velo yerakked kederech sheose bechol gezera shemma yittol tzeror veyizrok arba ammot birshut harabbim

Kal haddevarim shehen asurin mishshum shevut lo gazru alehen ben hashshemashot ella beatzmo shel yom hu shehen asurin aval ben hashshemashot muttarin vehu sheyyihye sham devar mitzva o dochak ketzad muttar lo ben hashshemashot laalot bailan o lashut al pene hammayim lehavi lulav o shofar vechen morid min hailan o motzi min hakkarmelit eruv sheasa vechen im haya tarud venechpaz venitzrach ledavar shehu mishshum shevut ben hashshemashot hare ze muttar aval im lo haya sham dochak velo devar mitzva asur lefichach en measserin et havadday ben hashshemashot af al pi sheissur hafrashat hammaaser beshabbat mishshum shevut aval measserim et haddemay
Katan sheasa beshabbat davar shehu mishshum shevut kegon shettalash meatzitz sheeno nakuv o tiltel becharmelit en bet din metzuvin lehafrisho vechen im hinnicho aviv en memachin beyado

Asru chachamim letaltel miktzat devarim beshabbat kederech shehu ose bechol umippene ma nagu beissur ze amru uma im hizhiru neviim vetziuu shello yihye hilluchcha beshabbat kehilluchcha bechol velo sichat hashshabbat kesichat hchol shenneemar vedabber davar kal vachomer shello yihye tiltul beshabbat ketiltul bechol kede shello yihye keom chol beenav veyavo lehagbiha ultakken kelim mippinna lefinna o mibbayit levayit o lehatznia avanim vechayyotze bahen shehare hu batel veoshev beveto vivakkesh davar sheyyitassek bo venimtza shello shavat uvittel hattaam shenneemar betora lemaan yanuach

Veod kesheyevakker vitaltel kelim shemmelachtan leissur efshar sheyyitassek bahen meat veyavo lide melacha veod mippene shemmiktzat haam enam baale ummanuyyot ella betelin kal yemehen kegon hattayyalin veoshve keranot shekkal yemehen hen shovtim mimmelacha veim yihye muttar lehallech uldabber ultaltel kishar hayyamim nimtza shello shavat shevita hannikkeret lefichach shevita middevarim ellu hi shevita hashshava bechal adam umippene devarim ellu nagu beissur hattiltul veasru shello yetaltel adam beshabbat ella kelim hatztzarich lahem kemo sheyyitbaer
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 25: Yesh keli shemmelachto lehetter vehu hakkeli shemmuttar laasot bo beshabbat davar shennaasa lo bechol kegon kos lishtot bo ukara leechol bah vesakkin lachtoch bo basar ufat vekurnas liftzoa bo egozim vechayyotze bahen
Veyesh keli shemmelachto leissur vehu hakkeli sheasur laasot bo beshabbat davar shennaasa bo kegon machteshet verechayim vechayyotze bahen sheasur lichtosh velitchon beshabbat

Kal keli shemmelachto lehetter ben haya shel etz o shel cheres o shel even o shel mattechet muttar letaltelo beshabbat ben bishvil atzmo shel keli ben letzorech mekomo ben letzorech gufo vechal keli shemmelachto leissur ben haya shel etz o shel cheres o shel avanim o shel mattechet muttar letaltelo beshabbat ben letzorech gufo ben letzorech mekomo aval bishvil atzmo shel keli asur

Ketzad metaltel hu et hakkeara shel etz leechol bah o leshev bimkomah o kede shello tigganev veze hu bishvil atzmah vechen im tiltel otah min hachamma kede shello tityabbesh vetishshaver o min haggeshamim kede shello titpach vetippased hare ze metaltel bishvil atzmah umuttar mippene shemmelachtah lehetter

Vechen metaltel hu harechayim o hammachteshet leshabber aleha egozim o laalot aleha lammitta veze hu letzorech gufo o leshev bimkomo aval eno metaltelah kede shello tishshaver velo kede shello tigganev vechen kal kayyotze baze

Vechal sheeno keli kegon avanim umaot vekanim vekorot vechayyotze bahen asur letaltelan even gedola o kora gedola af al pi shehi nittelet baasara bene adam im yesh torat keli aleha metaltelim otah daltot habbayit af al pi shehen kelim lo huchnu letaltel lefichach im nitparku afillu beshabbat en metaltelin otan vechen heafar vehachol vehammet en mezizin otan mimmekoman uven shemona chay hare hu keeven veasur letaltelo

Muttar letaltel hakkeli afillu shello letzorech tashmisho ella laasot bo melacha shello naasa letashmishah ketzad notel adam kurnas liftzoa bo egozim kordom lachtoch bo devela megera legarer bah et haggevina magrefa ligrof bah et haggerogarot et harachat veet hammazleg latet alav ochel lekatan et hakkosh veet hakkarkar litchov bo machat shel sakkain liftoach bo et haddelet et hammachteshet leshev aleha vechen kal kayyotze baze

Umtaltel adam machat shel yad hashshelema littol bah et hakkotz aval im nittal hakkatze hannakuv shellah o hakkatze hachad shellah en metaltelin otah veim hayeta golem vaadayin lo nikkeva muttar letaltelah

Kal keli shemmakpid alav shemma yifchatu damav kegon kelim hammuktzim lischora vechelim hayekarim beoter shemmakpid alehen shemma yippasdu asur letaltelan beshabbat veze hu hannikra muktze mechamat chesron kis kegon hammassar haggadol veyated shel machresha vesakkin shel tabbachim vecherev shel ushkafim vechitztzin hacharashim vekurnas shel bassamim vechayyotze bahen

Kal keli shehuktza mechamat haissur asur letaltelo kegon ner shehidliku bo beshabbat vehammenora shehaya hanner aleha veshulchan shehau alav maot af al pi shekkava hanner o shennaflu hammaot asur letaltelan shekkal keli shehaya asur letaltelo ben hashshemashot neesar letaltelo kal hashshabbat kullah af al pi shehalach haddavar sheggaram lo haissur
Aval keli hammuktze mechamat meuso kegon ner yashan shel neft uchli hatztzoa vechayyotze bahen muttar letaltelan beshabbat im hutzrach lahen

Kal hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat shennitparku daltotehen kegon daltot shidda teva umigdal ben shennitparku beshabbat ben shennitparku kodem hashshabbat muttar letaltel otan delatot vechen kal hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat shennishberu ben kodem hashshabbat ben beshabbat shivrehen nittalin vehu sheyyihu shivrehen osin meen melachtan ketzad shivre areva lechassot bahen et pi hechavit shivre zechuchit lechassot bahen et pi happach vechen kal kayyotze baze aval im en hashshevarim reuyin limlacha kelal asur letaltelan

Kal kissuye hakkelim nittalim beshabbat vehu sheyyesh torat keli alehen haya keli mechubbar bakkarka kegon chavit hattemuna baaretz im yesh bakkissuy shellah bet achiza metaltelin oto veim lav en metaltelin oto vechen kissuye hakkarkaot kegon borot vacharitzin en metaltelin kissuy shellahen ella im ken yesh lo bet achiza kissuy hattannur af al pi sheen lo bet achiza muttar letaltelo

Shene devarim echad asur letaltelo veechad muttar letaltelo vehen semuchim ze laze o ze al ze o ze baze uvizman shemmetaltelin echad mehen yetaltel hashsheni im haya tzarich laddavar shemmuttar letaltelo metaltelo veaf al pi sheddavar haasur mittaltel immo veim tzarich letaltel davar haasur lo yetaltelennu beoto davar hammuttar

Ketzad pagga shehayeta temuna beteven vacharara shehayeta al gabbe gechalim tochavan bechosh o becharkar venotlan veaf al pi shehatteven vehaggechalim ninarim beshabbat bishat netila vechen lefet o tzenonot shehau temunim beafar umiktzat healim megullim shomtan beshabbat beale shellahen veaf al pi sheheafar ninar aval im haya kikkar o tinok al gabbe haeven o al gabbe hakkora lo yetaltel haeven o hakkora bakkikkar o battinok sheyyesh aleha vechen kal kayyotze baze

Notel adam et beno sheyyesh lo gaguin alav vehaeven beyado aval lo dinar sheim yippol haddinar yittelennu haav beyado kalkala shehayeta nekuva vesatam nekev shellah beeven muttar letaltelah shehare haeven naaset kedofen hayeta hakkalkala melea perot vehaeven betoch happerot im hau happerot retubbim kegon anavim vetutim notel otah kemot shehi sheim yenaer happerot yittanfu beafar uvimkom hefsed lo gazru

Chavit sheshshachach even al piha mattah al tziddah vehi nofelet hayeta ben hechaviyyot vehaeven aleha magbihah lemakom acher umatte al tziddah sham vehaeven nofelet vechen hashshocheach maot al hakkar vetzarach lakkar noer et hakkar vehen noflot veim tzarich limkom hakkar notel et hakkar vehammaot alav aval im hinniach hammaot meerev shabbat al hakkar o hinniach haeven al pi hechavit hare ellu asurin letaltelan vaafillu nittelu hammaot vehaeven shehare naasu basis ledavar haasur
Haeven shebbakkeruya im memallein bah veenah nofelet hare hi kemiktzat hakkeruya umuttar lemalleot bah veim lav en memallein bah beged sheal hakkane shomto meal hakkane

Perot sheasur leechol kegon perot sheenam meessarin afillu hen chayyavin bemaaser middivrehem o maaser rishon shello nittela terumato o teruma temea o maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu kehilchatan asur letaltelan aval haddemay hoil verauy laaniyyim vechen maaser sheni vehekdesh sheppedaan af al pi shello natan hachomesh muttar letaltelan

Metaltel yisrael hatteruma af al pi sheenah reuya lo umtaltelin teruma temea im hattehora o im hachullin im hau shenehem bichli echad bamme devarim amurim beshehayeta hattehora lematta vehau perot hammittannefin bakkarka sheim yenaer otan yippasdu aval im hau egozim ushkedim vechayyotze bahen noer hakkeli venotel hattehora o hachullin umanniach hattuma veim haya tzarich limkom hakkeli ben shehattehora lemala ben shehayeta lematta metaltel hakkol keechad

Nidbach shel avanim shechashav alav mibbeod yom im limdum muttar leshev alehen lemachar veim lav asur charaot shel dekel sheggedaran leetzim venimlach alehen meerev shabbat lishiva muttar letaltelan vechen im yashav alehen mibbeod yom muttar letaltelan

Hakkash sheal hammitta lo yenaneennu beyado aval menaneo begufo veim hu maachal behema muttar letaltelo vechen im haya alav kar o sadin vechayyotze bahen menaneo beyado shehare naasa kemi sheyyashav alav mibbeod yom hammachnis kuppa shel afar beveto im yiched lah keren zavit meerev shabbat metaltelo beshabbat veose bo kal tzerachav

Asur levattel keli mehechano mippene shehu kesoter ketzad lo yitten keli tachat hanner beshabbat lekabbel et hashshemen hannotef shehashshemen shebbanner asur letaltelo uchsheyyippol lakkeli yeaser tiltul hakkeli shehaya muttar vechen kal kayyotze baze lefichach en notnin keli tachat hattarnegolet lekabbel betzatah aval kofe hu hakkeli aleha vechen kofe hakkeli al kal davar sheasur letaltelo shehare lo bittelo sheim yachpotz yittelennu

Notnin keli tachat haddelef veim nitmalle hakkeli shofech veshone veeno nimna vehu sheyyihye haddelef rauy lirchitza aval im eno rauy en notnin veim natan muttar letaltelo bammayim hammeusin shebbo sheen osin geraf shel rei lechattechilla

Chavit shel tevel shennishbera mevi keli umanniach tachteha hoil veim avar vetikkeno metukkan hare hu kimtukkan venotnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel nitzotzot mippene sheen bahen mammash umuttar letaltel hakkeli kora shennishbera en somchin otah besafsal o baarukkot hammitta ella im ken hau revachim vechal zeman sheyyachpotz yitlem kede shello yevattel keli mehechano porsin machtzelet al gabbe avanim beshabbat o al gabbe kaveret devorim bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim uvilvad shello yitkaven latzud shehare notlah bechal et sheyyirtze vechofin et hassal beshabbat lifne haefrochim bishvil sheyyaalu alav veyerdu shehare muttar letaltelo kesheyyerdu mealav vechen kal kayyotze baze

Behema shennafla levor o leammat hammayim im yachol litten lah parnasa bimkomah mefarnesin otah ad motzae shabbat veim lav mevi karim uchsatot umanniach tachteha veim alta alta veaf al pi shemmevattel keli mehechano shehare mashlicho labbor letoch hammayim mippene tzaar baale chayyim lo gazru veasur lehaalotah beyado vechen en okrin behema vechayya veof bechatzer aval dochin otan ad sheyyikkansu umdaddin agalim usyachim tarnegolet shebbarcha en medaddin otan mippene shehi nishmetet min hayyad venimtzeu agappeha nitlashin aval dochin otah ad shettikkanes
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 26: Kal kele haoreg vachavalav vekanim shello muttar letaltelan kichli shemmelachto leissur chutz mikkoved haelon vechoved hattachton lefi sheen nittalin mippene shehen tekuin vechen haammudim shel oreg asur letaltelan shemma yetakken haggummot shellahen ushar kele haoreg muttarin

Michbadot shel temara vechayyotze bahen shemmechabbedin bahen et hakkarka hare hen kichli shemmelachto lehetter shehare muttar lechabbed beshabbat levenim shennisharu min habbinyan hare hen kichli shemmelachto lehetter mippene sheruyin lehasev alehen shehare shafin otan umtakkenin otan veim tzavar otan hare hiktzam veasur letaltelam

Cheres ketanna muttar letaltelah afillu birshut harabbim hoil uruya hi bechatzer lechassot bah pi keli katan megufat chavit shennitkatta hi ushvareha muttar letaltelah veim zerakah laashpa mibbeod yom asur letaltelah keli shennitroea lo yitlosh mimmennu cheres lechassot bo o lismoch bo

Muttar lehachnis levet hakkisse shalosh avanim mekurzalot lekanneach bahen vechamma shiuran kimlo hayyad aval adama shehi kerova lehitparech asur letaltelah lekanneach bah umuttar lehaalot avanim laggag lekanneach bahen yardu alehen geshamim venishtaku betit im rishshuman nikkar muttar letaltel even sheyyesh aleha tinnuf shevadday lekanneach hi muttar letaltelah vaafillu hi gedola
Haya lefanav tzeror vecheres mekanneach batztzeror veim haya hacheres meogne kelim mekanneach bacheres hau lefanav tzeror vaasavim im hau asavim rakkim mekanneach bahen veim lav mekanneach batztzeror

Sheyare machtzelaot shebbalu hare hen kichli shemmelachto lehetter mippene sheruyin lechassot bahen hattinnuf aval sheyare begadim shebbalu sheen bahen shelosha al shelosha asur letaltelan sheenan reuyin lo laaniyyim velo laashirim shivre hattannur muttar letaltelan vahare hen kechal hakkelim shemmelachtan lehetter kira shennishmeta achat miyyarchoteha asur letaltelah shemma yitka

Sullam shel aliyya asur letaltelo sheen alav torat keli veshel shovach muttar lehattoto aval lo yolicho mishshovach leshovach shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol veyavo latzud kane shemmoskin bo hazzetim im yesh alav torat keli hare hu kichli shemmelachto leissur kane shehitkino baal habbayit lihot poteach venoel bo im yesh torat keli alav hare hu kichli shemmelachto lehetter

Delet shehaya lah tzir af al pi sheen lah atta tzir shehechinah listom bah makom muktze vehi nigreret shennotlin otah vesotmin bah vechen chadakim shessotmin bahen happirtza vechen machtzelet hannigreret bizman shekkeshurin utluyin bakkotel sotmin bahen venoalim bahem veim lav en noalin bahen veim hau gevohim meal haaretz noalin bahen

Delet shehaya lah luach echad sheshshomtin otah venoalin bah im lo haya lah lematta ken kemo askuppa shemmochiach aleha shehi keli muchan linila en noalin bah veim yesh lematta askuppa noalim bah vechen neger sheyyesh berosho kelustera shemmochachat alav shehu keli muchan linila veeno kora kishar kal hakkorot noalin bo beshabbat

Neger sheen berosho kelustera im haya kashur vetaluy baddelet noalin bo vechen im haya nittal veegdo immo aval im haya egdo kavua baddelet vehaya hanneger nishmat kemo kora umannichin oto bazzavit vechozrin venoalin bo beet sherotzin hare ze asur linol bo sheen alav torat keli veeno agud veen bo eged lehochiach alav

Menora shel chulot ben gedola ben ketanna en metaltelin otah shemma yachazirenah beshabbat hau bah chadakim vehi niret kevaalat chulot im hayeta gedola hannittelet bishte yadayim asur letaltelah mippene kavdah hayeta ketanna mizzo muttar letaltelah

Minal sheal gabbe haimmum shomtin oto beshabbat machbesh shel baale battim mattirin aval lo kovshin veshel kovsin lo yigga bo mippene shehu muktze mechamat chesron kis vechen gizze tzemer en metaltelin otan mippene shehu makpid alehen lefichach im yichadan letashmish muttarin vehashshelachin muttar letaltelan ben shehau shel baal habbayit o shel umman mippene sheeno makpid alehem

Kal davar metunnaf kegon rei veki vetzoa vechayyotze bahen im hau bechatzer sheyyoshvin bah muttar lehotzian leashpa o levet hakkisse veze hu hannikra geraf shel rei veim hau bechatzer acheret kofin alehen keli kede shello yetze hakkatan veyitlachlech bahen rok sheal hakkarka dorso lefi tummo veholech metaltelin kenuna mippene efro af al pi sheyyesh alav shivre etzim mippene shehu kigraf shel rei veen osin geraf shel rei lechattechilla beshabbat aval im naasa meelav o sheavar veasahu motziin oto

Shemen sheyyotze mittachat hakkora shel bet habbad beshabbat vechen temarim ushkedim hammuchanim lischora muttar leachlam beshabbat vaafillu otzar shel tevua o tevua tzevura matchil lehistappek mimmenna beshabbat sheen shum ochel shehu muktze beshabbat kelal ella hakkol muchan hu chutz miggerogarot vetzimmukin shebbammuktze bizman shemmeyabbeshim otam hoil umasrichot bentayim veenam reuyin laachila hare hen asurin beshabbat mishshum muktze chavit shennitgalleta vaavattiach shennishbera af al pi sheenan reuyin laachila notlan umannichan bemakom hammutzna kayyotze bo kamea sheeno mumche af al pi sheen yotzin bo metaltelin oto motar hashshemen shebbanner veshebbakkeara shehidliku bahen beotah shabbat asur lehistappek mimmennu beotah shabbat mippene shehu muktze mechamat issur

Otzar shel tevua o shel kadde yayin af al pi shemmuttar lehistappek mimmennu asur lehatchil bo lefannoto ella lidvar mitzva kegon sheppinnahu lehachnasat orchin o likboa bo bet hammidrash vechetzad mefannin oto kal echad veechad memalle arba o chamesh kuppot ad sheggomrin velo yechabbedu karkaito shel otzar kemo shebbearnu ella nichnas veotze bo veose shevil beraglav bichnisato uvitziato

Kal shehu rauy lemaachal behema vechayya veof hammetzuyin metaltelin oto beshabbat ketzad metaltelin et hatturmos hayyavesh mippene shehu maachal leizzim aval lo et hallach et hechatzav mippene shehu maachal litzvaim et hachardal mippene shehu maachal leonim et haatzamot mippene shehen maachal lichlavim vechen kal hakkelippin vehaggarinin haruyin lemaachal behema metaltelin otan vesheenan reuyin ochel et haochel vezorkan leacharav veasur letaltelan metaltelin basar tafuach mippene shehu maachal lechayya umtaltelin basar chay ben tafel ben maliach mippene sherauy leadam vechen dag maliach aval hattafel asur letaltelo

En metaltelin shivre zechuchit af al pi shehen maachal lenaamiyyot velo chavile zemorot af al pi shehen maachal lefilim velo et halluf af al pi shehen maachal leorvim mippene sheen ellu vechayyotze bahen metzuyin etzel rov bene adam

Chavile kash vachavile zeradin im hitkinan lemaachal behema metaltelin otan veim lav en metaltelin otan chavile sea pua veezov vekoranit hichnisan leetzim en mistappek mehem beshabbat lemaachal behema mistappek mehen vechen baaminta vechen befegam vechen bishar mine tavlin

En gorfin maachal millifne happetam ben beevus shel keli ben beevus shel karka veen mesallekin latztzedadin mippene hari gezera shemma yashve gummot notlin millifne hachamor venotnin lifne hashshor aval en notlin millifne hashshor venotnin lifne hachamor mippene shehammaachal shellifne hashshor metunnaf beriro veen rauy lemaachal behema acheret vechen alim sherecham ra umusin veen habbehema ochaltan asur letaltelan lefichach telay shel dagim asur letaltelo veshel basar muttar vechen kal kayyotze baze

Af al pi sheasur letaltel et hammet beshabbat sachin oto umdichin oto uvilvad shello yazizu bo evar veshomtin et hakkar mittachtav kede sheyyihye muttal al hachol bishvil sheyyamtin velo yasriach umviin kele meker uchle mattachot umannichin lo al kereso kede shello yitpach ufokkin et nekavav shello yikkanes bahen haruach vekoshrin et hallechi lo sheyyaale ella shello yosif veen meammetzin et enav beshabbat

Met hammuttal bachamma manniach alav kikkar o tinok umtaltelo vechen im nafla deleka bechatzer sheyyesh bah met manniach alav kikkar o tinok umtaltelo veim en sham kikkar velo tinok matztzilin oto min haddeleka mikkal makom shemma yavo lechabbot mippene shehu bahul al meto shello yissaref velo hittiru letaltel bechikkar o tinok ella lemet bilvad mippene sheadam bahul al meto

Haya muttal bachamma veen lahem makom letaltelo o shello ratzu lahazizo mimmekomo bain shene bene adam veoshvim mishshene tzedadav cham lahem millematta ze mevi mittato veoshev aleha veze mevi mittato veoshev aleha cham lahem millemala ze mevi machtzelet uforesh al gabbav veze mevi machtzelet uforesh al gabbav ze zokef mittato venishmat veholech lo veze zokef mittato venishmat veholech lo venimtza mechitztza asuya meeleha shehare machtzelet ze umachtzelet ze gaggehen semuchot zo lazo ushne ketzotehem al hakkarka mishni tzidde hammet

Met shehisriach bevayit venimtza mitbazze ben hachayyim vehem mitbazzim mimmennu muttar lehotzio lecharmelit gadol kevod habberiyyot sheddoche et lo taase shebbattora shehu lo tasur min haddavar asher yaggidu lecha yamin usmol veim haya lahen makom acher latzet bo en motziin oto ella menichin oto bimkomo veotzin hem
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 27: Hayyotze chutz litchum hammedina beshabbat loke shenneemar al yetze ish mimmekomo bayyom hashshevii makom ze hu techum hair velo natna tora shiur litchum ze aval chachamim hetiku shettechum ze hu chutz lishnem asar mil keneged machane yisrael vechach amar lahem moshe rabbenu lo tetzu chutz lammachane umiddivre sofrim shello yetze adam chutz lair ella ad alpayim amma aval chutz lealpayim amma asur shealpayim amma hu migrash hair

Nimtzeta lamed shemmuttar leadam beshabbat lehallech et kal hair kullah afillu hayeta keninve ben shehayeta mukkefet choma ben shello hayeta mukkefet choma vechen muttar lo lehallech chutz lair alpayim amma lechal ruach merubbaot ketavla merubbaat kede sheyyihye niskar et hazzaviyyot veim yatza chutz lealpayim amma makkin oto makkat mardut ad shenem asar mil aval im yatza vehirchik min hair yeter al shenem asar mil afillu amma achat loke min hattora

Hamhallech chutz lattechum lemala measara tefachim kegon shekkafatz al gabbe ammudim sheggevohin asara veen bechal echad mehen arbaa al arbaa tefachim hare ze safek im yesh techumin lemala measara o en techumin lemala measara aval im halach al makom sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa hare ze kimhallech al haaretz veyesh issur techumin sham

Mi sheshshavat bedir shebbammidbar o besahar o bimara vechayyotze bahen mershut hayyachid mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma lechal ruach beribbua vechen hashshovet bevika afillu haya yashen beshaa shennichnas hashshabbat shello kana shevita yesh lo lehallech mimmekomo alpayim amma lechal ruach beribbua haya mehallech bevika veeno yodea techum shabbat mehallech alpayim pesiot benoniyyot veze hu techum shabbat

Hamhallech alpayim amma sheyyesh lo lehallech veshalma middato betoch dir o sahar o meara o betoch hammedina eno mehallech ella ad sof middato veen omrin hoil vechilleta middato betoch reshut hayyachid mehallech et kullah bamme devarim amurim beshekkalta middato bemiktzat hair o bemiktzat hammeara aval im hayeta otah reshut hayyachid muvlaat betoch alpayim amma shello techashev lo kal otah harshut kearba ammot umashlimin lo et hashshear

Ketzad hare shehaya elef amma mimmekom shevitato im michutz lair ad medina o meara sheyyesh bearkah elef amma o pachot meelef mehallech et kal hammedina o hammeara sheppaga bah umhallech chutza lah elef amma pachot arba ammot
Aval im haya bammedina o bammeara sheppaga bah betoch middato elef amma veamma eno mehallech bah ella elef amma bilvad shehu tashlum alpayim amma sheyyesh lo

Mi shekkalta middato bachatzi hair af al pi sheeno mehallech ella ad sof middato muttar letaltel bechal hair al yede zerika vechen mi sheshshavat bevika vehikkifuhu nachrim mechitztza beshabbat eno mehallech bah ella alpayim amma lechal ruach af al pi shehu betoch hammechitztza umuttar lo letaltel bechal hammechitztza al yede zerika im hikkifuha leshem dira

Mi shehaya ba badderech likkanes limdina ben shehaya ba bayyam ben shehaya ba becharava im nichnas betoch alpayim amma karov lair kodem sheyyikkanes hashshabbat af al pi shello higgia lammedina ella beshabbat hare ze yikkanes vihallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma lechal ruach

Haya ba limdina veyashen badderech velo neor ella beshabbat uchshenneor matza atzmo betoch hattechum hare ze yikkanes lah vihallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma lechal ruach mippene sheddato hayeta lehallech limdina zo ulfichach kana shevita im bene hammedina kemotan shehare nichnas immahen battechum

Mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum afillu amma achat lo yikkanes shehaarba ammot sheyyesh lo laadam techillatan mimmakom shehu omed bo lefichach kevan sheyyatza chutz mittechumo amma o yeter yeshev bimkomo veen lo lehallech ella betoch arba ammot meamidat raglav velachutz vechen mi shehechshich chutz litchum hammedina afillu amma achat hare ze lo yikkanes lah ella mehallech mimmakom shennichnas alav hashshabbat vehu omed bo alpayim amma bilvad veim kalta middato bemiktzat hair mehallech ad sof middato kemo sheamarnu hayeta raglo achat betoch hattechum veraglo achat chutz lattechum hare ze yikkanes

Mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum shello ledato kegon shehotziuhu nachrim o ruach raa o sheshshagag veyatza en lo ella arba ammot chazar ledaat en lo ella arba ammot hechziruhu keillu lo yatza veim netanuhu birshut hayyachid kegon shennetanuhu nachrim baddir vesahar umara o beir acheret yesh lo lehallech et kullah vechen im yatza leechad meellu bishgaga venizkar vehu betochan mehallech et kullah

Yatza chutz lattechum ledaat af al pi shechazar shello ledaat kegon shehechziruhu nachrim o ruach raa en lo ella arba ammot vechen im yatza chutz lattechum ledaat af al pi shehu betoch reshut hayyachid kegon dir vesahar en lo ella arba ammot hammefaresh bayyam haggadol af al pi shehu chutz lattechum sheshshavat bo mehallech et kal hassefina kullah umtaltel bechullah

Mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum shello ledaat vehukkaf bimchitztza beshabbat yesh lo lehallech kal otah hammechitztza vehu shello tihye yeter al alpayim amma veim haya techum sheyyatza mimmennu muvla miktzato betoch hammechitztza shennaaset shello ledato hoil veyesh lo lehallech et kal hammechitztza hare ze nichnas litchumo vechevan sheyyikkanes hare hu keillu lo yatza

Kal mi sheen lo lazuz mimmekomo ella betoch arba ammot im nitzrach linkavav hare ze yotze umarchik venifne vechozer limkomo veim nichnas lemiktzat techum sheyyatza mimmennu beet sheyyitrachek lehippanot hoil venichnas yikkanes uchillu lo yatza vehu shello yatza battechilla ledaat aval im yatza ledaat af al pi shennichnas en lo ella arba ammot

Kal mi sheyyatza birshut bet din kegon haedim shebbau lehaid al reiyyat hallevana vechayyotze bahen mimmi shemmuttar lo latzet lidvar mitzva yesh lo alpayim amma lechal ruach beoto makom shehiggia lo veim higgia limdina hare hu keanshe hair veyesh lo alpayim amma lechal ruach chutz lammedina

Haya yotze birshut veamru lo vehu holech badderech kevar naaset hammitzva sheyyatzata laasot yesh lo mimmekomo alpayim amma lechal ruach veim haya miktzat techum sheyyatza mimmennu birshut muvla betoch alpayim amma sheyyesh lo mimmekomo hare ze chozer limkomo uchillu lo yatza vkal hayyotzin lehatztzil nafshot yisrael miyyad ovde kochavim umazzalot o min hannahar o min hammappolet yesh lahem alpayim amma lechal ruach mimmakom shehitztzilu bo veim hayeta yad haovde kochavim umazzalot takkifa vehau mefachadim lishbot bammakom shehitztzilu bo hare ellu chozrin beshabbat limkoman uvichle zenan
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 28: Kal bet dira shehu yotze min hammedina im haya beno uven hammedina shivim amma ushne shelishe amma shehu tzela bet satayim hamrubbaat o pachot mizze hare ze mitztaref limdina venechshav mimmenna uchshemmoddin lah alpayim amma lechal ruach moddin chutz mibbet dira ze

Haya bayit ze karov lammedina beshivim amma uvayit sheni karov levayit rishon beshivim amma uvayit shelishi karov lashsheni beshivim amma vechen ad mahalach kamma yamim hare hakkol kimdina achat uchshemmoddin moddin michutz labbayit haacharon vehu sheyyihye bet dira ze arba ammot al arba ammot o yeter

Vechen bet hakkeneset sheyyesh bo bet dira lechazzanin uvet avodat kochavim umazzalot sheyyesh bo bet dira lechohanehem vehaotzarot sheyyesh bahen bet dira vehaggesher vehakkever sheyyesh bahen bet dira veshalosh mechitztzot sheen aleha tikra veyesh bahen arba al arba ammot vehabburganin vehabbayit habbanuy bayyam ushte mechitztzot sheyyesh alehen tikra umara sheyyesh binyan al piha veyesh bah bet dira kal ellu mitztarfin immah im hau betoch shivim amma veshirayim umeoto habbayit hayyotze roin keillu chut matuach al pene kal hammedina umoddin chutz leoto hachut alpayim amma

Veellu sheen mitztarfin immah shette mechitztzot sheen alehen tikra af al pi sheddarin benehen vehaggesher vehakkever uvet hakkeneset uvet avodat kochavim umazzalot vehaotzarot sheen bahen bet dira vehabbor vehashshiach vehammeara vehashshovach uvayit shebbassefina kal ellu vechayyotze bahen en mitztarfin immah

Hau shette ayarot zo semucha lazo im yesh benehen mea vearbaim veachat ushlish kede sheyyihye shivim amma veshirayim lazo veshivim amma veshirayim lazo choshvin shettehen keir achat venimtzet kal ir mehen mehallechet et kal hair hashsheniyya vachutza lah alpayim amma hau shelosha kefarim meshullashin im yesh ben haemtzai uven kal echad veechad min hachitzonim alpayim amma o pachot mikkan uven hashshenayim hachitzonim matayim shalosh ushmonim pachot shelish kede sheyyihye ben kal echad mehen uven haemtzai keshettire oto keillu hu benehen mea vearbaim veachat amma ushlish hare shelashtan kimdina achat umoddin alpayim amma lechal ruach michutz lishlashtan ir shehukkefa ulvassof yashva moddin lah mishivatah yashva ulvassof hukkefa moddin lah mechomoteha

Ir shehayeta arukka o merubbaat hoil veyesh lah arba zaviyyot shaot mannichin otah kemot shehi umoddin lah alpayim amma lechal ruach mearba ruchoteha hayeta agulla osin lah zaviyyot veroin otah keillu hu betoch hamrubba umoddin chutz mitztzalot oto merubba alpayim amma lechal ruach shennimtza mistakker hazzaviyyot

Vechen im hayeta hair meshulleshet o sheyyesh lah tzelaot rabbot merabbein otah veachar kach moddin chutz lamrubba alpayim amma lechal ruach uchshehu merabbeah merabbeah beribbua haolam kede shettehe kal ruach mimmenna meshucha keneged ruach meruchot haolam umchuvenet kenegdah

Hayeta rechava mitztzad echad uktzara mitztzad echad roin otah keillu hi kullah rechava hayeta asuya kemin gam o shehayeta asuya kekeshet im yesh ben shene rasheha pachot mearbaat alafim amma moddin lah min hayyeter veroin et kal harochav shebben hayyeter vehakkeshet keillu hu male battim veim haya ben shene rasheha arbaat alafim en moddin lah ella min hakkeshet

Ir sheyyoshevet al sefat hannachal im yesh lefaneha dakka rochav arba ammot al sefat hannachal kede sheyyaamdu aleha veyishtammeshu bannachal nimtza hannachal bichlal hair umoddin lah alpayim amma missefat hannachal hashsheniyya veyease hannachal kullo bichlal hammedina mippene haddakka habbenuya mitztziddo veim lo haya sham dakka en moddin lahen ella mippetach battehen venimtza hannachal nimdad min haalpayim shellahem
Yoshve tzerifin en moddin lahen ella mippetach battehen veim yesh sham shalosh chatzerot shel shene shene battim hukbeu kullam umrabbein otah venotnin lahem alpayim amma lechal ruach kishar haayarot

En moddin ella bechevel shel chamishshim amma lo pachot velo yeter uvchevel shel pishtan kede shello yimmashech yoter midday higgia legaye im haya rachbo chamishshim amma sheyyachol lehavlio bechevel hammidda mavlio vehu sheyyihye beamko pachot mearbaat alafim
Bamme devarim amurim shehaya chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo shei efshar lehishtammesh bo aval im en chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo eno mavlio ella im ken haya amko alpayim o pachot mikken
Haya gaye meukkam mekadder veole mekadder veored haya gaye rachav mechamishshim sheeno yachol lehavlio holech lemakom shehu yachol lehavlio umavlio vetzofe keneged middato vechozer
Higgia lechotel en omrim yikkov et hakkotel ella omed rachbo veholech lo veim efshar lehishtammesh bo moddo medida yafa veim haya chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo moded rachbo medida yafa

Higgia lehar im haya har mitlakket mimmennu gavoha asara tefachim beorech chamesh ammot mavlio vechozer lemiddato veim haya gavoha harbe ad sheyyitlakket mimmennu asara tefachim mittoch meshech arba ammot omdo veholech lo veim eno yachol lehavlio kegon shehaya rachbo yeter mechamishshim mekaddero meat meat veze hu sheamru mekadderin beharim

Ketzad mekadderin beharim o begeaot sheeno yachol lehavlian ochazin shenayim chevel shel arba ammot haelon ochez ketzato mikkeneged margelotav vehattachton ochez bakkatze hashsheni keneged libbo vechozer haelon laamod bimkom hattachton vehattachton yored umarchik mimmennu middat hachevel vechen mitgalgelim veholchin ad shemmoddin et kullo uchsheyyelech hammoded lehavlia hahar o haggaye lo yetze chutz lattechum shello yiru oto haovrim veyomru middat techumin baa lechan

En somchin ella al medidat adam mumche shehu yodea middat hakkarka hau lanu techume shabbat muchzakin uva mumche umadad ribba battechum mehen umiet battechum shomin lo battechum sheribba vechen im bau shenayim mumchin umaddu hattechum echad ribba veechad miet shomin lamrabbe uvilvad shello yerabbe yeter mimmiddat alachsonah shel ir
