Ketzad beet sheyerabbe ze nomar shemma harishon mikkeren alachson shel ir madad haalpayim ulfichach miet middato venimtza tzela hattechum beno uven hammedina pachot mealpayim veze haacharon madad alpayim mitztzela hammedina veen machazikin al harishon shettaa beoter al ze lefichach im ribba ze haacharon yeter al harishon afillu bachamesh meot ushmonim amma bekeruv shomin lo beoter al ze en shomin lo

Afillu eved afillu shifcha neemanin lomar ad kan techum hashshabbat veneeman haggadol lomar zachur ani shead kan hayinu baim beshabbat keshehayiti katan vesomchin al eduto bedavar ze shello amru chachamim baddavar lehachamir ella lehakel mippene sheshshiur alpayim amma middivrehem
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 29: Mitzvat ase min hattora lekaddesh et yom hashshabbat bidvarim shenneemar zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho kelomar zachrehu zechirat shevach vekiddush vetzarich lezachrehu bichnisato uvitziato bichnisato bekiddush hayyom uvitziato behavdala

Veze hu nosach kiddush hayyom baruch atta elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav veratza vanu veshabbat kadsho beahava veratzon hinchilanu zikkaron lemaase vereshit techilla lemikrae kodesh zecher litziat mitzrayim ki vanu vacharta veotanu kiddashta mikkal haammim veshabbat kadshecha beahava uvratzon hinchaltanu baruch atta mekaddesh hashshabbat

Veze hu nosach hahavdala baruch atta elohenu melech haolam hammavdil ben kodesh lechol uven or lechoshech ben yisrael laammim uven yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase baruch atta hammavdil ben kodesh lechol

Ikkar hakkiddush ballayela im lo kiddesh ballayela ben beshogeg ben bemezid mekaddesh veholech kal hayyom kullo veim lo hivdil ballayela mavdil lemachar umavdil veholech ad sof yom shelishi aval eno mevarech al haur ella belel motzae shabbat bilvad

Asur leadam leechol o lishtot yayin mishshekkadash hayyom ad sheyekaddesh vechen mishsheyyatza hayyom asur lo lehatchil leechol velishtot velaasot melacha o litom kelum ad sheyyavdil velishtot mayim muttar shachach o avar veachal veshata kodem sheyekaddesh o kodem sheyyavdil hare ze mekaddesh umavdil achar sheachal

Middivre sofrim lekaddesh al hayyayin ulhavdil al hayyayin veaf al pi shehivdil battefilla tzarich lehavdil al hakkos umeachar sheyyavdil veyomar ben kodesh lechol muttar lo laasot melacha af al pi shello hivdil al hakkos umvarech al hayyayin techilla veachar kach mekaddesh veeno notel et yadav ad sheyekaddesh

Ketzad hu ose lokeach kos shehu machazik reviit o yeter umdicho mibbifnim veshotfo mibbachutz ummalleehu yayin veochazo bimino umagbiho min hakkarka tefach o yeter velo yesayyea bismol umvarech al haggefen veachar kach mekaddesh uminhag pashut bechal yisrael likrot battechilla parashat vayechullu veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mekaddesh veshote melo lugmav umashke lechal bene chavura veachar kach notel yadav umvarech hammotzi veochel

En kiddush ella bimkom seudda ketzad lo yekaddesh bevayit ze veyochal bevayit acher aval im kiddesh bezavit zo ochel bezavit sheniyya velamma mekaddeshin bevet hakkeneset mippene haorchin sheochlin veshotin sham
Haya mitave lappat yoter min hayyayin o shello haya lo yayin hare ze notel yadav techilla umvarech hammotzi umkaddesh veachar kach botzea veochel veen mavdilin al happat ella al hakkos

Mi shennitkaven lekaddesh al hayyayin belele shabbat veshachach venatal yadav kodem sheyekaddesh hare ze mekaddesh al happat veeno mekaddesh al hayyayin achar shennatal yadav lasseudda umitzva levarech al hayyayin beom hashshabbat kodem sheyyisod seudda sheniyya veze hu hannikra kiddusha rabba mevarech bore peri haggafen bilvad veshote veachar kach yittol yadav veyisod veasur lo leadam sheyyitom kelum kodem sheyekaddesh vegam kiddush ze lo yihye ella bimkom seudda

Yesh lo leadam lekaddesh al hakkos erev shabbat mibbeod yom af al pi shello nichnesa hashshabbat vechen mavdil al hakkos mibbeod yom af al pi sheadayin hi shabbat shemmitzvat zechira leamrah ben bishat kenisato vitziato ben kodem leshaa zo kimat

Mi shehaya ochel beerev shabbat vekadash alav hayyom vehu betoch hasseudda pores mappa al hashshulchan umkaddesh vegomer seuddato veachar kach mevarech birkat hammazon haya ochel beshabbat veyatza hashshabbat vehu betoch seuddato gomer seuddato venotel yadav umvarech birkat hammazon al hakkos veachar kach mavdil alav veim haya betoch hashshetiyya posek umavdil veachar kach chozer lishtiyyato

Haya ochel vegamar achilato im hachnasat shabbat mevarech birkat hammazon techilla veachar kach mekaddesh al kos sheni velo yevarech vayekaddesh al kos echad sheen osin shette mitzot bechos echad shemmitzvat kiddush umitzvat birkat hammazon shette mitzot shel tora hen

En mekaddeshin ella al hayyayin harauy lenassech al gabbe hammizbeach lefichach im nitarev bo devash o seor afillu ketippat hachardal bechavit gedola en mekaddeshin alav kach anu morin bechal hammaarav veyesh mi shemmattir lekaddesh alav veomer lo neemar hayyayin harauy lenassech al gabbe hammizbeach ella lehotzi yayin sherecho ra o megulle o mevushshal sheen mekaddeshin al echad mehen

Yayin shettaamo taam chometz af al pi sherecho reach yayin en mekaddeshin alav vechen shemarim shennatan alehen mayim af al pi sheyyesh bahen taam yayin en mekaddeshin alehen bamme devarim amurim beshennatan al hashshemarim shelosha mayim vehotzi pachot mearbaa aval im hotzi arbaa hare ze yayin mazug umkaddeshin alav
Keli shehaya male yayin afillu machazik kamma reviiyyot im shata mimmennu meat hare ze pegamo venifsal veen mekaddeshin al hashshear mippene shehu keshiyyure kosot

Yayin sherecho reach hachometz vetaamo taam yayin mekaddeshin alav vechen yayin mazug vechen yen tzimmukim mekaddeshin alav vehu sheyyihu tzimmukim sheyyesh bahen lachluchit sheim yidroch otan yetze mehen divshan vechen yayin chadash miggitto mekaddeshin alav vesochet adam eshkol shel anavim umkaddesh alav bishato medina sherov yenah shechar af al pi shehu pasul lekiddush muttar lehavdil alav hoil vehu chamar hammedina

Keshem shemmekaddeshin belele shabbat umavdilin bemotzae shabbat kach mekaddeshin belele yamim tovim umavdilin bemotzaehen uvmotzae yom hakkippurim shekkullam shabbetot hen umavdilin bemotzae yamim tovim lechullo shel moed uvmotzae shabbat leom tov aval en mavdilim bemotzae yom tov leshabbat

Nosach kiddush yom tov baruch atta elohenu melech haolam asher bachar banu mikkal am verommanu mikkal lashon bachar banu vayegaddelenu ratza banu vayefaarenu vattitten lanu elohenu beahava moadim lesimcha chaggim uzmannim lesason et yom tov mikra kodesh hazze et yom chag hammatztzot hazze o chag hashshavuot o chag hassukkot zeman cherutenu o zeman mattan toratenu o zeman simchatenu beahava zecher litziat mitzrayim ki vanu vacharta veotanu kiddashta mikkal haammim umoade kadshecha besimcha uvsason hinchaltanu baruch atta mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim veim chal lihot beshabbat mazkir shabbat vechotem kederech shechotem battefilla mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael vehazzemannim

Berosh hashshana omer vattitten lanu elohenu beahava et yom tov mikra kodesh hazze zichron terua mikra kodesh beahava zecher litziat mitzrayim ki vanu vacharta veotanu kiddashta mikkal haammim udvarcha emet vekayyam laad baruch atta melech al kal haaretz mekaddesh yisrael veom hazzikkaron veim chal lihot beshabbat chotem mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael veom hazzikkaron kederech shechotem battefilla
Belele yom tov mekaddesh al hayyayin kivshabbat veim en lo yayin o shehaya mitave lefat mekaddesh al happat vechen beom tov mekaddesh kiddusha rabba kederech shemmekaddesh beshabbat

Ketzad mevarchin belele yom tov shechal lihot beechad beshabbat battechilla mevarech al haggefen veachar kach mekaddesh kiddush yom tov veachar kach mevarech al hanner veachar kach mavdil vechotem behavdala hammavdil ben kodesh lekodesh veachar kach mevarech shehecheyanu
Kal lele yom tov uvlel yom hakkippurim omrim shehecheyanu uvishvii shel pesach en mevarchin shehecheyanu mippene sheeno regel bifne atzmo uchvar berech al hazzeman bitchillat happesach
Seder havdala bemotzae shabbat mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach al habbesamim veachar kach al hanner vechetzad mevarech al hanner bore meore haesh veachar kach mavdil

En mevarchin al hanner ad sheyyeotu leoro kede sheyyakkir ben matbea medina zo lematbea medina acheret veen mevarchin al hanner shel ovde kochavim umazzalot shessetam mesibbatan laavodat kochavim umazzalot veen mevarchin lo al hanner shel avodat kochavim umazzalot velo al hanner shel metim

Yisrael shehidlik meoved kochavim umazzalot o oved kochavim umazzalot miyyisrael mevarchin alav oved kochavim umazzalot meovde kochavim umazzalot en mevarchin alav haya mehallech chutz lakkerach veraa or im rov anshe hakkerach ovde kochavim umazzalot eno mevarech veim rov yisrael mevarech ur shel kivshan shel tannur veshel kirayim lechattechilla lo yevarech alav haggechalim im kesheyyachnis kesam benehen dolek meelav mevarchin alehen ur shel bet hammidrash im yesh sham adam chashuv shemmadlikim bishvilo mevarchin alav shel bet hakkeneset im yesh sham chazzan shehu dar sham mevarchin alav vaavuka lehavdala mitzva min hammuvchar veen mechazzerin al haur kederech shemmechazzerin al kal hammitzot ella im yesh lo mevarchin alav

Ur shehudlak beshabbat lechole ulchayya mevarchin alav bemotzae shabbat ur shehukdach min haetzim umin haavanim mevarchin alav bemotzae shabbat shehi hayeta techillat beriyyato bide adam aval en mevarchin alav bemotzae yom hakkippurim sheen mevarchin bemotzae yom hakkippurim ella al ur sheshshavat af al pi shehudlak lechole o lechayya beom hakkippurim mevarchin alav shehare shavat meavera

Yom tov shechal lihot beemtza shabbat omer behavdala hammavdil ben kodesh lechol uven or lechoshech uven yisrael laammim uven yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase kederech sheomer bemotzae shabbat shesseder hahavdalot hu mone veeno tzarich levarech lo al habbesamim velo al hanner vechen eno tzarich levarech al habbesamim bemotzae yom hakkippurim
Velamma mevarchim al habbesamim bemotzae shabbat mippene shehannefesh doevet litziat shabbat mesammechin otah umyashshevin otah bereach tov
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 30: Arbaa devarim neemru beshabbat shenayim min hattora ushnayim middivre sofrim vehen meforashin al yede hanneviim shebbattora zachor ve shamor veshennitparshu al yede hanneviim kavod vaoneg shenneemar vekarata lashshabbat oneg velikdosh mechubbad

Ezehu kavod ze sheamru chachamim shemmitzva al adam lirchotz panav yadav veraglav bechammin beerev shabbat mippene kevod hashshabbat umitattef betzitzit veoshev bechoved rosh meyachel lehakbalat pene hashshabbat kemo shehu yotze likrat hammelech vachachamim harishonim hau mekabbetzin talmidehen beerev shabbat umitattefim veomrim bou venetze likrat shabbat hammelech

Umikkevod hashshabbat sheyyilbash kesut nekiyya velo yihye malbush hchol kemalbush hashshabbat veim en lo lehachalif meshalshel tallito kede shello yehe malbusho kemalbush hachol veezra tikken sheyehu haam mechabbesim bachamishi mippene kevod hashshabbat

Asur likboa seudda umishte beerev shabbat mippene kevod hashshabbat umuttar leechol velishtot ad shettechshach veaf al pi chen mikkevod hashshabbat sheyyimmana adam min hammincha ulmala millikboa seudda kede sheyyikkanes leshabbat keshehu mitave leechol

Mesadder adam shulchano beerev shabbat veaf al pi sheeno tzarich ella lichzayit vechen mesadder shulchano bemotzae shabbat veaf al pi sheeno tzarich ella lichzayit kede lechabbedo bichnisato uvitziato vetzarich letakken beto mibbeod yom mippene kevod hashshabbat veyihye ner daluk veshulchan aruch leechol umitta mutztzaat shekkal ellu lichvod shabbat hen

Af al pi shehaya adam chashuv beoter veen darko likkach devarim min hashshuk velo lehitassek bimlachot shebbabbayit chayyav laasot devarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat begufo shezze hu kevodo chachamim harishonim mehem mi shehaya mefatztzel haetzim levashshel bahen umehen mi shehaya mevashshel o moleach basar o godel petilot o madlik nerot umehen mi shehaya yotze vekone devarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat mimmaachal umashke af al pi sheen darko bechach vechal hammarbe bedavar ze hare ze meshubbach

Ezehu oneg zehu sheamru chachamim shetztzarich letakken tavshil shamen beoter umashke mevussam leshabbat hakkol lefi mamono shel adam vechal hammarbe behotzaat shabbat uvtikkun maachalim rabbim vetovim hare ze meshubbach veim en yado masseget afillu lo asa ella shelek vechayyotze bo mishshum kevod shabbat hare ze oneg shabbat veeno chayyav lehatzer leatzmo velishl meacherim kede leharbot bemaachal beshabbat amru chachamim harishonim ase shabbattecha chol veal titztarech labberiyyot

Mi shehaya anog veashir vahare kal yamav keshabbat tzarich leshannot maachal shabbat mimmaachal hachol veim i efshar leshannot meshanne zeman haachila im haya ragil lehakdim meacher veim haya ragil leacher makdim

Chayyav adam leechol shalosh seuddot beshabbat achat arvit veachat shacharit veachat bemincha vetzarich lehizzaher beshalosh seuddot ellu shello yifchot mehen kelal vaafillu ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka soed shalosh seuddot veim haya chole merov haachila o shehaya mitanne tamid patur mishshalosh seuddot vetzarich likboa kal seudda mishshelashtan al hayyayin velivtzoa al shette kikkarot vechen beyamim tovim

Achilat basar ushtiyyat yayin beshabbat oneg hu lo vehu shehayeta yado masseget veasur likboa seudda al hayyayin beshabbat uvyamim tovim bishat bet hammidrash ella kach haya minhag hatztzaddikim harishonim mitpallel adam beshabbat shacharit umusaf bevet hakkeneset veyavo leveto veyisod seudda sheniyya veyelech levet hammidrash yikra veyishne ad hammincha veyitpallel mincha veachar kach yikba seudda shelishit al hayyayin veyochal veyishte ad motzae shabbat

Asur lo laadam sheyehallech bearve shabbatot yoter mishshalosh parsaot mittechillat hayyom kede sheyyaggia leveto veod hayyom rav veyachin seudda leshabbat shehare en anshe beto yodin shehayyom yavo kede lehachin lo veen tzarich lomar im haya mitareach etzel acherim shehare mevayeshan mippene shello hechinu lahen davar harauy leorchin

Asur lehitannot velizok ulhitchannen ulvakkesh rachamim beshabbat vaafillu betzara min hatztzarot shehatztzibbur mitannin umatriin alehen en mitannin velo matriin beshabbat velo beyamim tovim chutz meir shehikkifuha ovde kochavim umazzalot o nahar o sefina hammittarefet bayyam shemmatriin alehen beshabbat leazran umitchannenin umvakkeshin alehen rachamim

En tzarin al ayarot shel ovde kochavim umazzalot pachot mishshelosha yamim kodem hashshabbat kede shettityashshev daat anshe hammilchama alehen velo yihu mevohalim utrudim beshabbat en mafligin bisfina pachot mishshelosha yamim kodem hashshabbat kede shettityashshev dato alav kodem hashshabbat velo yitztaer yeter midday velidvar mitzva maflig bayyam afillu beerev shabbat ufosek immo lishbot veeno shovet umitztzor letzidon vechayyotze bahen afillu lidvar harshut muttar lehaflig beerev shabbat umakom shennahagu shello yaflig beerev shabbat kelal en mafligin

Tashmish hammitta meoneg shabbat hu lefichach onat talmide chachamim habberiim meshammeshin millele shabbat lelele shabbat umuttar livol betula lechattechilla beshabbat veen baze lo mishshum chovel velo mishshum tzaar lah

Hashshabbat vaavodat kochavim umazzalot kal achat mishshettehen shekula keneged shear kal mitzot hattora vehashshabbat hi haot shebben hakkadosh baruch hu uvenenu leolam lefichach kal haover al shear hammitzot hare hu bichlal rishe yisrael aval hamchallel shabbat befarhesya hare hu keoved avodat kochavim umazzalot ushnehem keovde kochavim umazzalot lechal divrehem lefichach meshabbeach hannavi veomer ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo vego vechal hashshomer et hashshabbat kehilchatah umchabbedah umannegah kefi kocho kevar meforash bakkabbala secharo baolam hazze yeter al hassachar hatztzafun laolam habba shenneemar az titannag al vehirkavticha al bamote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha ki pi dibber
Mishneh Torah, Sanctification of the New: Chadshe hashshana hem chadshe hallevana shenneemar lat chodesh bechadsho veneemar hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim kach amru chachamim hera lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe bemare hannevua demut levana veamar lo kaze ree vekaddesh vehashshanim sheanu mechashshevin hem shene hachamma shenneemar shamor et chodesh haaviv

Vechamma yetera shenat hachamma al shenat hallevana karov meachad asar yom lefichach kesheyyitkabbetz min hattosefet hazzot kemo sheloshim yom o pachot meat o yoter meat mosifin chodesh echad veosin otah hashshana shelosha asar chodesh vehi hannikret shana meebberet shei efshar lihot hashshana shenem asar chodesh vechach vechach yamim shenneemar lechadshe hashshana chodashim atta mone leshana veen atta mone yamim

Hallevana nisteret bechal chodesh veenah niret kemo shene yamim o pachot o yoter meat kemo yom echad kodem shettidbak bashshemesh besof hachodesh uchmo yom echad achar shettidbak bashshemesh veterae bammaarav baerev uvallayil shetterae bammaarav achar shennistera hu techillat hachodesh umonin meoto hayyom tisha veesrim yom veim yerae hayyareach lel sheloshim yihye yom sheloshim rosh hachodesh veim lo yerae yihye rosh hachodesh yom echad ushloshim veyihye yom sheloshim mechodesh sheavar veen nizkakin layyareach belel echad ushloshim ben shennira ben shello nira sheen lecha chodesh levana yoter al sheloshim yom

Chodesh sheyyihye tisha veesrim veyerae yareach belel sheloshim nikra chodesh chaser veim lo yerae hayyareach veyihye hachodesh sheavar sheloshim yom nikra chodesh meubbar venikra chodesh male veyareach sheyyerae belel sheloshim hu hannikra yareach shennira bizmanno veim nira belel echad ushloshim velo nira belel sheloshim hu nikra yareach shennira belel ibburo

En reiyyat hayyareach mesura lechal adam kemo shabbat bereshit shekkal echad mone shishsha veshovet bashshevii ella levet din haddavar masur ad sheyekaddeshuhu bet din veyikbeu oto hayyom rosh chodesh hu sheyyihye rosh chodesh shenneemar hachodesh hazze lachem edut zo tihye mesura lachem

Bet din mechashshevin becheshbonot kederech shemmechashshevim haitztagninim sheyyodin mekomot hakkochavim umahalacham vechokrim umdakdekim ad sheyyedu im efshar sheyyerae hayyareach bizmanno shehu lel sheloshim o i efshar im yadu sheefshar sheyyerae yoshvin umtzappin laedim kal hayyom kullo shehu yom sheloshim im bau edim udrashum vachakarum kahalacha veneemnu divrehem mekaddeshin oto veim lo nira velo bau edim mashlimin sheloshim veyihye chodesh meebbar veim yadu becheshbon shei efshar sheyyerae en yoshvim yom sheloshim veen metzappin laedim veim bau edim yodin bevadday shehen ede sheker o shenniret lahem demut levana min heavim veenah hallevana havaddait

Mitzvat ase min hattora al bet din sheyechashshevu veyedu im yerae hayyareach o lo yerae vesheyyidreshu et haedim ad sheyekaddeshu et hachodesh veyishlechu veodiu shear haam bee ze yom hu rosh chodesh kede sheyyedu bee ze yom hen hammoadot shenneemar asher tikreu otam mikrae kodesh veneemar veshamarta et hachukka hazzot lemoadah

En mechashshevin vekovin chodashim umabberin shanim ella beeretz yisrael shenneemar ki mitztziyyon tetze tora udvar mirushalayim veim haya adam gadol bechachma venismach beeretz yisrael veyatza lechutza laaretz velo hinniach beeretz yisrael kemoto hare ze mechashshev vekovea chodashim umabber shanim bechutza laaretz veim noda lo shennaasa beeretz yisrael adam gadol kemoto veen tzarich lomar gadol mimmennu hare ze asur likboa ulabber bechutza laaretz veim avar vekava veibber lo asa kelum

En kasher leedut hachodesh ella shene anashim kesherim haruyin lehaid bechal davar vedavar aval nashim vaavadim hare hen kishar pesule edut veen meidin av uvno sherau et hayyareach yelchu levet din lehaid lo mippene sheedut hachodesh keshera bikrovim ella sheim yimmatze echad mehen pasul mippene shehu gazlan vechayyotze bo mishshear happaslanut yitztaref hashsheni im acher veyaidu vechal happasul leedut middivre sofrim af al pi shehu kasher min hattora pasul leedut hachodesh

Din tora sheen medakdekin beedut hachodesh sheafillu kiddeshu et hachodesh al pi edim venimtzeu zommin beedut zo hare ze mekuddash lefichach hau barishona mekabbelin edut hachodesh mikkal adam miyyisrael shekkal yisrael bechezkat kashrut ad sheyyivada lecha shezze pasul mishshekkilkelu habbayetosim vehau sochrin anashim lehaid sherau vehem lo rau hitkinu shello yekabbelu bet din edut hachodesh ella meedim shemmakkirin bet din otan shehem kesherim vesheyyihu dorshin vechokrim baedut

Lefichach im lo yihu bet din yodim et haedim sherau et hayyareach meshallechin anshe hair shennira bah im haedim sherau edim acherim shemmezakkin otan levet din umodiin otan sheellu kesherim hem veachar kach mekabbelin mehem

Bet din mechashshevin badderachim shehaitztagninin mechashshevin bahem veodin hallevana keshetterae bechodesh ze im tihye bitzfon hashshemesh o bidromah veim tihye rechava o ketzara ulhechan yihu rashe karneha notin uchsheyyavou haedim lehaid bodkin otam ketzad reitem otah betzafon o bedarom lehechan hau karneha notot kamma hayeta gevoha biriyyat enechem vechamma hayeta rechava im nimtzeu divrehem mechuvanin lema shennoda bacheshbon mekabbelin otam veim lo nimtzeu divrehem mechuvanin en mekabbelin otam

Amru haedim reinuhu bammayim o beavim o baashashit o sherau miktzato barakia umiktzato beavim o bammayim o baashashit en zo reiyya veen mekaddeshin al reiyya zot amar echad reitiv gavoha beenay kemo shette komot veamar hashsheni kemo shalosh komot haya gavoha mitztarfin amar haechad kemo shalosh komot vehashsheni omer kemo chamesh en mitztarfin umitztaref echad mehem im sheni sheyyaid kemoto o yihye benehen koma achat

Amru reinuhu belo kavana vechevan shehitbonannu bo venitkavannu liroto lehaid shuv lo reinuhu en zo edut veen mekaddeshin aleha shemma avim nitkashsheru veniru kallevana vechalu vehalchu lahem amru edim reinuhu beom tisha veesrim shacharit bammizrach kodem shettaale hashshemesh urinuhu arvit bammaarav belel sheloshim hare ellu neemanim umkaddeshin al reiyya zo shehare rauhu bizmanno aval hariyya sheamru sherauhu beshacharit en nizkakin lah sheen anu achrain liriyyat shacharit uvyadua sheheavim hem shennitkashsheru venira lahem kilvana vechen im rauhu bizmanno uvlel ibburo lo nira hare ellu neemanin sheen anu achrain ella liriyyat lel sheloshim bilvad

Ketzad mekabbelin edut hachodesh kal mi sherauy lehaid sheraa et hayyareach ba levet din uvet din machnisim otan kullan lemakom echad veosin lahen seuddot gedolot kede sheyyihu haam regilin lavo vezug shebba rishon bodkin otan rishon babbedikot sheamarnu machnisin et haggadol veshoalin oto nimtzeu devarav mechuvanim lacheshbon machnisim et chavero nimtzeu divrehem mechuvanin edutan kayyemet ushar kal hazzugot shoalin otam rashe devarim lo shetztzerichim lahem ella kede shello yetzu befache nefesh kede sheyyihu regilin lavo

Veachar kach achar shettitkayyem haedut rosh bet din omer mekuddash vechal haam onim acharav mekuddash mekuddash veen mekaddeshin et hachodesh ella bishlosha veen mechashshevin ella bishlosha veen mekaddeshin ella chodesh shennire bizmanno veen mekaddeshin ella bayyom veim kiddeshuhu ballayela eno mekuddash vafillu rauhu bet din vechal yisrael velo amru bet din mekuddash ad shechashcha lel echad ushloshim o shennechkeru haedim velo hispiku bet din lomar mekuddash ad shechashcha lel echad ushloshim en mekaddeshin oto veyihye hachodesh meubbar velo yihye rosh chodesh ella yom echad ushloshim af al pi shenniret belel sheloshim sheen hariyya kovaat ella bet din sheamru mekuddash hem shekkovin

Rauhu bet din atzman besof yom tisha veesrim im adayin lo yatza kochav lel sheloshim bet din omrim mekuddash sheadayin yom hu veim rauhu belel sheloshim achar sheyyatzu shene kochavim lemachar moshivin shene dayyanin etzel echad mehem veyaidu hashshenayim bifne hashshelosha vikaddeshuhu hashshelosha

Mitzva likrot et kullah umitzva likrotah ballayela uvayyom vechal hallayela kasher likriat hallayela vechal hayyom kasher likriat hayyom umvarech kodem keriatah ballayela shalosh berachot veellu hen baruch atta elokenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al mikra megilla baruch atta elokenu melech haolam sheasa nissim laavotenu bayyamim hahem uvazzeman hazze baruch atta elokenu melech haolam shehecheyanu vekiyemanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze uvayyom eno chozer umvarech shehecheyanu umakom shennahagu levarech achareha mevarech baruch atta elokenu melech haolam hael harav et rivenu vehaddan et dinenu vehannokem et nikmatenu vehannifra lanu mitztzarenu vehamshallem gemul lechal oyeve nafshenu baruch atta hannifra leyisrael mikkal tzarehem hael hammoshia

Ezehu zeman keriatah zemannim harbe tikkenu lah chachamim shenneemar bizmannehem veellu hen zemanne keriatah kal medina shehayeta mukkefet choma mime yehoshua bin nun ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz af al pi sheen lah achshav choma korin betv baadar umdina zo hi hannikret kerach vechal medina shello hayeta mukkefet choma bimot yehoshua veaf al pi shehi mukkefet atta korin bed umdina zo hi hannikret ir

Shushan habbira af al pi shello hayeta mukkefet choma bime yehoshua bin nun korin betv shebbah haya hannes shenneemar venoach bachamishsha asar bo velamma talu haddavar bime yehoshua kede lachalok kavod leeretz yisrael shehayeta chareva beoto hazzeman kede sheyyihu korin kivne shushan veyechashvu keillu hen kerakkin hammukkafin choma af al pi shehen atta charevin hoil vehau mukkafin bime yehoshua korin betv veyihye zikkaron leeretz yisrael benes ze

Bene hakkefarim sheenam mitkabbetzim bevatte kenesiyyot ella besheni uvachamishi tikkenu lahem sheyyihu makdimin vekorim beom hakkenisa ketzad im chal yom yd lihot besheni o bachamishi korin bo bayyom veim chal beom acher chutz mishsheni vachamishi makdimin vekorin besheni o bachamishi hassamuch led

Ketzad chal yd lihot beechad beshabbat makdimin vekorin bachamishi shehu yom y chal lihot bishlishi korin besheni shehu yom yg chal lihot birvii korin besheni shehu yom yv vechal ellu shemmakdimin vekorin kodem yd en korin otah befachot measara

Kefar shemmakdimin vekorin beom hakkenisa bizman sheen nichnasin bo besheni uvachamishi en korin otah ella bed vechal ir sheen bah asara batlanin kevuin bevet hakkeneset letzarche hatztzibbur hare hi kichfar umakdimin vekorin beom hakkenisa veim en sham asara bene adam takkanato kalkalato vahare hem keanshe ir gedola veen korin ella bed

Bamme devarim amurim shemmakdimin vekorin beom hakkenisa bizman sheyyesh lahem leyisrael malchut aval bazzeman hazze en korin otah ella bizmannah shehu yom yd veom tv bene hakkefarim uvne ayarot korin bed uvne kerakkin korin betv

Ben ir shehalach lakkerach o ben kerach shehalach lair im haya dato lachazor limkomo bizman keria venitakkev velo chazar kore kimkomo veim lo haya bedato lachazor ella leachar zeman hakkeria kore im anshe hammakom shehu sham uchrach vechal hassamuch lo vechal hannire immo im en benehem yeter al alpayim amma hare ze kichrach vekorin bachamishsha asar

Ir shehi safek veen yadua im hayeta mukkefet choma bimot yehoshua bin nun o achar ken hukkefa korin bishne hayyamim shehen yd vetv uvlelehem umvarchin al keriatah bed bilvad hoil vehu zeman keriatah lerov haolam
Karu et hammegilla baadar rishon veachar kach ibberu bet din et hashshana chozrim vekorim otah baadar hashsheni bizmannah

En korin et hammegilla beshabbat gezera shemma yittol otah beyado veyelech etzel mi shehu baki likrotah veyaavirenna arba ammot birshut harabbim shehakkol chayyavim bikriatah veen hakkol bekiin bikriatah lefichach im chal zeman keriatah beshabbat makdimin vekorin otah kodem hashshabbat veshoalin vedorshin behilchot purim beotah shabbat kede lehazkir shehu purim

Ketzad yom arbaa asar shechal lihot beshabbat bene ayarot makdimin vekorin beerev shabbat uvne kerakkim korim bizmannam beechad beshabbat chal yom tv lihot beshabbat bene kerakkim makdimin vekorin beerev shabbat shehu yom arbaa asar uvne ayarot korin bo bayyom shehu zemannam venimtzeu hakkol korin bearbaa asar

Hakore et hammegilla lemafrea lo yatza kara veshachach pasuk echad vekara pasuk sheni lo vechazar vekara pasuk sheshshachach vechazar vekara pasuk shelishi lo yatza mippene shekkara pasuk echad lemafrea ella ketzad ose matchil mippasuk sheni sheshshachach vekore al hasseder

Matza tzibbur shekkaru chetzyah lo yomar ekra chetzyah haacharon im hatztzibbur veechezor veekra chetzyah rishon shezze kore lemafrea ella kore mittechilla vead sof al hasseder kara veshaha meat vechazar vekara af al pi sheshshaha kede ligmor et kullah hoil vekara al hasseder yatza

Hakkore et hammegilla al pe lo yatza yede chovato halloez sheshshama et hammegilla hakketuva bilshon hakkodesh uvichtav hakkodesh af al pi sheeno yodea ma hen omrin yatza yede chovato vechen im hayeta ketuva yevanit ushmaah yatza af al pi sheeno makkir vaafillu haya hashshomea ivri

Hayeta ketuva targum o belashon acheret milleshonot haggoyim lo yatza yede chovato bikriatah ella hammakkir otah hallashon bilvad vehu shettihye ketuva bichtav oto hallashon aval im hayeta ketuva bichtav ivri ukraah aramit laarami lo yatza shennimtza ze kore al pe vechevan shello yatza yede chovato hakkore lo yatza hashshomea mimmennu

Hakkore et hammegilla belo kavana lo yatza ketzad haya kotvah o dorshah o maggihah im kiven et libbo latzet bikria zo yatza veim lo kivin libbo lo yatza kara vehu mitnamnem hoil velo nirdam bashshena yatza

Bamme devarim amurim shehamchaven libbo bakketiva yatza beshennitkaven latzet bakkeria shekkore besefer shemmatik mimmennu beshaa shehu kotev aval im lo nitkaven latzet bikria zo shekkatav lo yatza sheeno yotze yede chovato ella bikriatah missefer shekkullah ketuva bo bishat keria

Hakkore et hammegilla vetaa bikriatah vekara keria meshubbeshet yatza lefi sheen medakdekin bikriatah keraah omed o yoshev yatza vaafillu betzibbur aval lo yikra betzibbur yoshev lechattechilla mippene kevod hatztzibbur kerauha shenayim afillu asara keechad yatzu hakkorin vehashshomim min hakkorin vekore otah gadol im hakkatan vaafillu betzibbur

En korin betzibbur bimgilla hakketuva ben hakketuvim veim kara lo yatza ella im ken hayeta yetera al shear hayeriot o chasera kede sheyehe lah hekker aval hayyachid kore bah vaafillu enah chasera velo yetera veotze bah yede chovato

En kotvin hammegilla ella bido al haggevil o al hakkelaf kesefer tora veim ketavah beme appetza vekankantom keshera ketavah bishar mine tzivonin pesula utzricha sirtut kattora atzmah veen haor shellah tzarich leabbed lishmah hayeta ketuva al hanneyar o al or sheeno meubbad o shekketavah akkum o eppikoros pesula

Hau bah otiyyot metushtashot o mekoraot im rishshuman nikkar afillu hau rubbah keshera veim en rishshuman nikkar im haya rubbah shalem keshera veim lav pesula vehakkore bah lo yatza hishmit bah hassofer otiyyot o pesukim ukraan hakkore et hammegilla al pe yatza

Hammegilla tzericha shettehe tefura kullah ad sheyyihu kal oroteha megilla achat veenah nitperet ella begidin kesefer tora veim tefarah shello begidin pesula veeno tzarich litpor et kal hayeria begidin kesefer tora ella afillu tafar begidin shalosh tefirot biktze hayeria veshalosh beemtzaah veshalosh bakkatze hashsheni keshera mippene shennikret iggeret

Vetzarich hakkore likrot aseret bene haman vaaseret binshima achat kede lehodia lechal haam shekkullam nitlu venehergu keechad uminhag kal yisrael shehakkore hammegilla kore ufoshet keiggeret leharot hannes uchsheyyigmor chozer vechorchah kullah umvarech

Shene hayyamim haellu shehen yd vetv asurin behesped vetaanit lechal adam bechal makom ben livne kerakkin shehen osin tv bilvad ben livne ayarot shehen osin yd bilvad ushne hayyamim asurin behesped vetaanit baadar harishon uvaadar hashsheni anshe kefarim shehikdimu vekaru besheni o bachamishi hassamuch lefurim muttarim behesped vetaanit beom keriatah vaasurin behesped vetaanit bishne hayyamim haellu af al pi sheen korin bahen

Mitzvat yom yd livne kefarim vaayarot veom tv livne kerakkim lihot yom simcha umishte umishloach manot lereim umattanot laevonim umuttar baasiyyat melacha veaf al pi chen en rauy laasot bo melacha amru chachamim kal haose melacha beom purim eno roe siman beracha leolam bene kefarim shekkadmu vekaru besheni o bachamishi im chilleku maot laevonim beom keriatan yatzu aval hassimcha vehammishte en osin otam ella beom yd veim hikdimu lo yatzu usuddat purim sheasaah ballayela lo yatza yede chovato

Ketzad chovat seudda zo sheyyochal basar vitakken seudda naa kefi asher timtza yado veshote yayin ad sheyyishtakker veyeradem beshichruto vechen chayyav adam lishloach shette menot basar o shene mine tavshil o shene mine ochalin lachavero shenneemar umishloach manot ish lereehu shette manot leish echad vechal hammarbe lishloach lereim meshubbach veim en lo machalif im chavero ze sholeach leze seuddato veze sholeach leze seuddato kede lekayyem umishloach manot ish lereehu

Vechayyav lechallek laaniyyim beom happurim en pochatin mishshene aniyyim noten lechal echad mattana achat o maot o mine tavshil o mine ochalin shenneemar umattanot laevonim shette mattanot lishne aniyyim veen medakdekin bimot purim ella kal happoshet yado littol notnin lo veen meshannin maot purim litzdaka acheret

Mutav laadam leharbot bemattenot evonim milleharbot bisuddato uvshilluach manot lereav sheen sham simcha gedola umfoara ella lesammeach lev aniyyim vitomim vealmanot vegerim shehamsammeach lev haumlalim haellu dome lashshechina shenneemar lehachaot ruach shefalim ulhachaot lev nidkaim

Kal sifre hanneviim vechal hakketuvim atidin libbatel limot hammashiach chutz mimmegillat ester vahare hi kayyemet kachamishsha chummeshe tora vechahalachot shel tora shebbeal pe sheenan betelin leolam veaf al pi shekkal zichron hatztzarot yevuttal shenneemar ki nishkechu hatztzarot harishonot vechi nisteru meeni yeme happurim lo yibbatlu shenneemar vime happurim haelle lo yaavru mittoch hayehudim vezichram lo yasuf mizzaram

Vevayit sheni keshemmalche yavan gazru gezerot al yisrael uvittelu datam velo henichu otam laasok betora uvmitzot ufashtu yadam bemamonam uvivnotehem venichnesu lahechal ufartzu bo peratzot vetimmeu hattahorot vetzar lahem leyisrael meod mippenehem ulchatzum lachatz gadol ad sherichem alehem elohe avotenu vehoshiam miyyadam vehitztzilam vegavru bene chashmonay hakkohanim haggedolim vaharagum vehoshiu yisrael miyyadam veheemidu melech min hakkohanim vechazra malchut leyisrael yeter al matayim shana ad hachurban hashsheni

Uchsheggavru yisrael al oyevehem veibbedum bech bechodesh kislev haya venichnesu lahechal velo matzu shemen tahor bammikdash ella pach echad velo haya bo lehadlik ella yom echad bilvad vehidliku mimmennu nerot hammaaracha shemona yamim ad shekkatshu zetim vehotziu shemen tahor

Umippene ze hitkinu chachamim shebbeoto haddor sheyyihu shemonat hayyamim haellu shettechillatan ch bechislev yeme simcha vehallel umadlikin bahen hannerot baerev al pitche habbattim bechal layela velayela mishshemonat hallelot leharot ulgallot hannes veyamim ellu hen hannikrain chanukka vehen asurin behesped vetaanit kime happurim vehadlakat hannerot bahen mitzva middivre sofrim kikriat hammegilla

Kal shechayyav bikriat hammegilla chayyav behadlakat ner chanukka vehammadlik otah ballayela harishon mevarech shalosh berachot veellu hen baruch atta elokenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lehadlik ner shel chanukka vesheasa nissim laavotenu vechu veshehecheyanu vekiyemanu vechu vechal haroe otah velo berech mevarech shettayim sheasa nissim laavotenu veshehecheyanu uvishar hallelot hammadlik mevarech shettayim veharoe mevarech achat sheen mevarchin shehecheyanu ella ballayela harishon

Bechal yom vaom mishshemonat hayyamim ellu gomrin et hahallel umvarech lefanav asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu ligmor et hahallel ben yachid ben tzibbur af al pi shekkeriat hahallel mitzva middivre sofrim mevarech alav asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu kederech shemmevarech al hammegilla veal haeruv shekkal vadday shel divrehem mevarchin alav aval davar shehu middivrehem veikkar asiyyatan lo mippene hassafek kegon maaser demay en mevarchin alav velamma mevarchin al yom tov sheni vehem lo tikkenuhu ella mippene hassafek kede shello yezalzelu bo

Velo hallel shel chanukka bilvad hu shemmiddivre sofrim ella keriat hahallel leolam middivre sofrim bechal hayyamim sheggomrin bahen et hahallel ushmona asar yom bashshana mitzva ligmor bahen et hahallel veillu hen shemonat yeme hechag ushmonat yeme chanukka verishon shel pesach veom atzeret aval rosh hashshana veom hakkippurim en bahen hallel lefi shehen yeme teshuva veyira vafachad lo yeme simcha yetera velo tikkenu hallel befurim shekkeriat hammegilla hi hahallel

Mekomot sheosin yom tov shene yamim gomrin et hahallel esrim veechad yom tisha yeme hechag ushmona yeme chanukka ushne yamim shel pesach ushne yamim shel atzeret aval berashe chodashim keriat hahallel minhag veeno mitzva uminhag ze betzibbur lefichach korin bedillug veen mevarchin alav sheen mevarchin al hamminhag veyachid lo yikra kelal veim hitchil yashlim veyikra bedillug kederech shekkorin hatztzibbur vechen bishar yeme happesach korin bedillug kerashe chodashim

Ketzad medallegin matchilin mittechillat hahallel ad challamish lemayeno mayim umdalleg veomer zecharanu yevarech chu ad halluyah umdalleg veomer ma ashiv la ad halluyah umdalleg veomer min hammetzar karati yah ad sof hahallel ze hu hamminhag happashut veyesh medallegin dillug acher

Kal hayyom kasher likriat hahallel vehakkore et hahallel lemafrea lo yatza kara veshaha vechazar vekara af al pi sheshshaha kede ligmor et kullo yatza yamim sheggomrin bahen et hahallel yesh lo lehafsik ben perek leferek aval beemtza happerek lo yafsik veyamim shekkorin bahen bedillug afillu beemtza happerek posek

Kal yom sheggomrin bo et hahallel mevarech lefanav umakom shennahagu levarech acharav mevarech ketzad mevarech yehallucha elohenu kal maasecha vetzaddikim vachasidim ose retzonecha vechal ammecha bet yisrael berinna yodu leshimcha ki atta lecha tov lehodot venaim leshimcha lezammer umeolam vead olam atta hael baruch atta hammelech hamhullal hamshubbach hamfoar chay vekayyam tamid yimloch leolam vaed
Yesh mekomot shennahagu lichpol me odcha ki anitani ad sof hahallel koflin kal davar vedavar shette peamim umakom shennahagu lichpol yichpol umakom shennahagu shello lichpol en koflin

Minhag keriat hahallel bime chachamim harishonim kach haya achar shemmevarech haggadol shemmakre et hahallel matchil veomer halluyah vechal haam onin halluyah vechozer veomer hallu avde vechal haam onin halluyah vechozer veomer hallu et shem vechal haam onin halluyah vechozer veomer yehi shem mevorach meatta vead olam vechal haam onin halluyah vechen al kal davar ad shennimtzeu onin bechal hahallel halluyah mea veshalosh veesrim peamim siman lahem shenotav shel aharon

Vechen keshehakkore maggia lerosh kal perek uferek hen chozrin veomrin ma sheamar ketzad keshehu omer betzet yisrael mimmitzrayim kal haam chozrin veomrin betzet yisrael mimmitzrayim vehakkore omer bet yaakov meam loez vechal haam onin halluyah ad sheyyomar ahavti ki yishma et koli tachanunay vechal haam chozrin veomrin ahavti ki yishma vechu vechen kesheyyomar hakkore hallu et kal goyim kal haam chozrin veomrin hallu et kal goyim

Hakkore omer anna hoshia na vehem onin acharav anna hoshia na af al pi sheeno rosh perek hu omer anna hatzlicha na vehem onim anna hatzlicha na hu omer baruch habba vechal haam omrim baruch habba veim haya hammakre et hahallel katan o eved o ishsha ona acharehem ma shehen omrin milla milla bechal hahallel zehu hamminhag harishon uvo rauy lelech aval bizmannim ellu raiti bechal hammekomot minhagot meshunnot bikriato uvaaniyyat haam veen echad mehem dome leechad

Kamma nerot hu madlik bachanukka mitzvatah sheyyihye kal bayit uvayit madlik ner echad ben shehau anshe habbayit merubbin ben shello haya bo ella adam echad vehamhadder et hammitzva madlik nerot keminyan anshe habbayit ner lechal echad veechad ben anashim ben nashim vehamhadder yoter al ze veose mitzva min hammuvchar madlik ner lechal echad ballayela harishon umosif veholech bechal layela velayela ner echad
Ketzad hare shehau anshe habbayit asara ballayela harishon madlik asara nerot uvlel sheni esrim uvlel shelishi sheloshim ad shennimtza madlik belel shemini shemonim nerot

Minhag pashut bechal arenu bisfarad sheyyihu kal anshe habbayit madlikin ner echad ballayela harishon umosifin veholchin ner bechal layela ad shennimtza madlik belel shemini shemona nerot ben shehau anshe habbayit merubbim ben shehaya adam echad

Ner sheyyesh lo shette piyyot ole lishne bene adam mille keara shemen vehikkifah petilot im kafa aleha keli kal petila uftila nechshevet kener echad lo kafa aleha keli naaset kimdura vaafillu kener echad enah nechshevet

En madlikin nerot chanukka kodem shettishka hachamma ella im shekiatah lo meacharin velo makdimin shachach o hezid velo hidlik im shekiat hachamma madlik veholech ad shettichle regel min hashshuk vechamma hu zeman ze kemo chatzi shaa o yeter avar zeman ze eno madlik vetzarich sheyyitten shemen banner kede shettihye doleket veholechet ad shettichle regel min hashshuk hidlikah vechavta eno zakuk lehadlikah paam acheret nishara doleket achar shekkalta regel min hashshuk im ratza lechabbotah o lesallekah ose

Kal hashshemanim vechal happetilot kesherot lener chanukka veaf al pi sheen hashshemanim nimshachim achar happetila veen haur nitlet yafe beotan happetilot vaafillu belele shabbat shebbetoch yeme chanukka muttar lehadlik hashshemanim vehappetilot sheasur lehadlik bahen ner shabbat lefi sheasur lehishtammesh lener chanukka ben beshabbat ben bechol vaafillu livdok maot o limnotan leorah asur

Ner chanukka mitzva lehannicho al petach beto mibbachutz battefach hassamuch lappetach al semol hannichnas labbayit kede shettihye mezuza miyyamin vener chanukka missemol veim haya dar baaliyya mannicho bachallon hassemucha lirshut harabbim vener chanukka shehinnicho lemala meesrim amma lo asa kelum lefi sheeno nikkar

Bime hassakkana manniach adam ner chanukka betoch beto mibbifnim vaafillu hinnicho al shulchano dayyo vetzarich lihot betoch habbayit ner acher lehishtammesh leoro veim hayeta sham medura eno tzarich ner acher veim adam chashuv hu sheen darko lehishtammesh limdura tzarich ner acher

Ner chanukka shehidliko cheresh shote vekatan o akkum lo asa kelum ad sheyyadlikennu mi shehu chayyav bahadlaka hidliko mibbifnim vehotzio daluk vehinnicho al petach beto lo asa kelum ad sheyyadlikennu bimkomo achaz hanner beyado veamad lo asa kelum sheharoe omer letzarko hu omed ashashit shehayeta doleket kal hayyom kullo lemotzae shabbat mechabbe umvarech umadlikah shehahadlaka hi hammitzva velo hahannacha umuttar lehadlik ner chanukka minner chanukka
Chatzer sheyyesh lah shene petachim bishte ruchot tzericha shette nerot shemma yomru haovrim beruach zo lo hinniach ner chanukka aval im hau beruach achat madlik beechad mehen

Oreach shemmadlikin alav betoch beto eno tzarich lehadlik alav bemakom shennitareach bo en lo bayit lehadlik alav bo tzarich lehadlik bammakom shennitareach bo umishtattef immahen bashshemen veim haya lo bayit bifne atzmo af al pi shemmadlikin alav betoch beto tzarich lehadlik babbayit shehu bo mippene haovrin

Mitzvat ner chanukka mitzva chaviva hi ad meod vetzarich adam lehizzaher bah kede lehodia hannes ulhosif beshevach hael vehodaya lo al hannissim sheasa lanu afillu en lo ma yochal ella min hatztzedaka shoel o mocher kesuto velokeach shemen venerot umadlik

Hare sheen lo ella peruta achat ulfanav kiddush hayyom vehadlakat ner chanukka makdim liknot shemen lehadlik ner chanukka al hayyayin lekiddush hayyom hoil ushnehem middivre sofrim mutav lehakdim ner chanukka sheyyesh bo zichron hannes

Haya lefanav ner beto vener chanukka o ner beto vekiddush hayyom ner beto kodem mishshum shelom beto shehare hashshem nimchak laasot shalom ben ish leishto gadol hashshalom shekkal hattora nittena laasot shalom baolam shenneemar deracheha darche noam vechal netivoteha shalom
Mishneh Torah, Sheqel Dues 1: Mitzvat ase min hattora litten kal ish miyyisrael machatzit hashshekel bechal shana veshana afillu ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka chayyav veshoel meacherim o mocher kesut sheal ketefo venoten machatzit hashshekel kesef shenneemar heashir lo yarbe vehaddal lo yamit vego veeno notno bifamim rabbot hayyom meat ulmachar meat ella notno kullo keachat befaam achat

Minyan kesef haamur battora beones uvimfatte uvmotzi shem ra vehoreg eved hu kesef hu shekel hanneemar bechal makom battora umishkalo shelosh meot veesrim seora uchvar hosifu chachamim alav veasu mishkalo kemishkal hammatbea hannikra sela bizman bayit sheni vechamma hu mishkal hassela shelosh meot vearba ushmonim seora benonit

Hassela arbaa dinarin vehaddinar shesh main umaa hi hannikret bime moshe rabbenu gera umaa hi shene pundeonin ufundeon shene isarin ufruta achat mishshemona beisar nimtza mishkal hammaa vehi haggera shesh esre seorot umishkal haisar arba seorot umishkal happeruta chatzi seora

Veod matbea acher haya sham shehaya mishkalo shette selaim vehu haya nikra darkon veellu hammatbeot kullan sheamarnu uvearnu mishkal kal echad mehen hen shemmeshaarin bahen bechal makom uchvar bearnum kede shello ehye tzarich lefaresh mishkalam bechal makom

Machatzit hashshekel zo mitzvatah sheyyitten machatzit matbea shel oto hazzeman afillu haya oto matbea gadol mishshekel hakkodesh ulolam eno shokel pachot mechatzi hashshekel shehaya bime moshe rabbenu shehu mishkalo mea veshishshim seora

Bizman shehaya matbea shel oto zeman darkonot haya kal echad veechad noten bemachatzit hashshekel shello sela uvizman shehaya hammatbea selaim haya noten kal echad bemachatzit hashshekel shello chatzi sela shehu shene dinarin uvizman shehaya hammatbea chatzi sela haya kal echad veechad noten bemachatzit hashshekel oto chatzi hassela umeolam lo shaklu yisrael bemachatzit hashshekel pachot mechatzi shekel shel tora

Hakkol chayyavin litten machatzit hashshekel kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim vegerim vaavadim meshuchrarim aval lo nashim velo avadim velo ketannim veim natnu mekabbelin mehem aval hakkutim shennatnu machatzit hashshekel en mekabbelin mehem katan shehitchil aviv litten alav machatzit hashshekel shuv eno posek ella noten alav bechal shana veshana ad sheyyagdil veyitten al atzmo
Hashshekalim enan nohagin ella bifne habbayit uvizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam notnin et hashshekalim ben beeretz yisrael ben bechutza laaretz uvizman shehu charev afillu beeretz yisrael en nohagin

Beechad baadar mashmiin al hashshekalim kede sheyyachin kal echad veechad machatzit hashshekel shello veyihye atid litten bachamishsha asar bo yashvu hashshulchanim bechal medina umdina vetovin benachat kal mi sheyyitten lahem yekabbelu mimmennu umi shello natan en kofin oto litten bachamishsha veesrim bo yashvu bammikdash ligbot umikkan veelach kofin et mi shello natan ad sheyyitten vechal mi shello yitten memashkenin oto velokchin avoto baal karcho vaafillu kesuto

Kal mi sheeno chayyav bishkalim af al pi sheddarko litten o hu atid litten en memashkenin oto veen memashkenin et hakkohanim leolam mippene darche shalom ella kesheyyittenu mekabbelin mehen vetovin otan ad sheyyittenu
Mishneh Torah, Sheqel Dues 2: Ketzad konsin hashshulchanim et hashshekalim bechal medina umdina mannichin lifnehem shette tevot shule hatteva rechavin millematta ufiha tzar millemala kemin shofar kede sheyyashlichu letochan velo yihye efshar likkach mehen benachat velamma osin shette tevot achat shemmashlichin bah shekalim shel shana zo vehashsheniyya mannichin bah shikle shana sheavra sheggovin mimmi shello shakal beshana sheavra

Uvammikdash haya lifnehem tamid shelosh esre tevot kal teva kemin shofar rishona leshikle shana zo sheniyya leshikle shana sheavra shelishit lechal mi sheyyesh alav karban shette torim o shene bene yona echad ola veechad chattat mashlich demehen leteva zo reviit lechal mi sheyyesh alav olat haof bilvad mashlich dameha leteva zo chamishit lemi shehitnaddev maot liknot etzim lammaaracha bahen shishshit lemi shehitnaddev maot lilvona sheviit lemi shehitnaddev zahav lakkapporet sheminit lemotar chattat kegon shehifrish maot lechattato velakach chattat vehotir min hammaot yashlich hashshear letochah teshiit lemotar asham asirit lemotar kinne zavim vezavot veoldot achat esre lemotar karbenot nazir shettem esre lemotar asham metzora shelosh esre lemi shehitnaddev maot leolat behema

Veshem kal davar sheyyihu maotav betoch hatteva katuv al hatteva mibbachutz utnay bet din hu al kal hammotarot sheyyikkarvu olat behema nimtzeta lamed shekkal hammaot hannimtzaot beshesh hattevot haacharonot leolat behema veoroteha lakkohanim kishar kal haorot vechal hammaot shebbeteva shelishit likkach bahen ofot chetzyan olot vechetzyan chattaot veshebbarviit kullan olat haof

Bechal medina umdina kesheggovin hashshekalim meshallechin otan beyad sheluchim lammikdash veyesh lahem letzaref otan bedinre zahav mippene massooy hadderech vehakkol mitkabbetzin lammikdash umannichin otan belishka achat min halleshachot bammikdash vesogrin kal daltoteha bemaftechot vechotmin aleha chotamot ummallein mikkal hashshekalim sheyyitkabbetzu sham shalosh kuppot gedolot shiur kal kuppa kede shettachil tesha sein vehashshear mannichin oto ballishka veze shebbetoch hakkuppot hu hannikra terumat hallishka veze sheyyishshaer sham yeter al ma sheyyesh bakkuppot hu hannikra sheyare hallishka

Bishlosha perakim bashshana tormin et hallishka berosh chodesh nisan uvrosh chodesh tishre kodem yom tov o acharav vekodem atzeret bachamishsha asar yom vechetzad tormin otah echad nichnas lifnim min hallishka vehashshomrin omdim bachutz vehu omer lahem etrom vehen omrim lo terom terom terom shelosha peamim veachar kach memalle shalosh kuppot ketannot kal kuppa mehen mechila shalosh sein meotan shalosh kuppot haggedolot umotzian lachutz kede lehistappek mehen ad sheyyichlu vechozer ummalle otan hashshalosh kuppot hakketannot min shalosh gedolot paam sheniyya kodem atzeret umistappekin mehen ad sheyyichlu

Vechozer ummalle otan paam shelishit min hashshalosh kuppot haggedolot betishre umistappekin mehen ad sheyyichlu ad rosh chodesh nisan uvrosh chodesh nisan tormin mitteruma chadasha lo hispiku lahen hashshekalim shebbeshalosh kuppot haggedolot vechalu ad shello higgia nisan chozrin vetormin mishsheyare hallishka

Shalosh kuppot hakketannot shehu torem bahem umotzian lachutz katuv alehen alef bet gimel kede sheyyistappeku min harishona ad shettichle veachar kach mistappekin min hashsheniyya veachar kach mistappekin min hashshelishit vetorem rishona min hakkuppa haachat haggedola umchappe otah haggedola bemitpachat vetorem hashsheniyya mehakkuppa haggedola hashsheniyya umchappe otah haggedola bemitpachat vetorem hashshelishit min hakkuppa haggedola hashshelishit veeno mechappe otah bemitpachat kede shettihye nikkeret shebbah siyyem veyatchil mimmenna battechilla befaam sheniyya kesheyyikkanes kodem atzeret vetorem harishona min haggedola shehayeta megulla umchappe otah vetorem hashsheniyya min haggedola shettaram mimmenna barishona techilla umchappe otah vetorem hashshelishit min haggedola hassemucha lah veeno mechappe otah kede sheyyatchil mimmenna battechilla befaam shelishit kesheyyikkanes betishre ad shennimtza torem rishona ushniyya ushlishit hakketannot mikkal achat veachat min haggedolot

Keshehu torem shalosh kuppot ellu torem et harishona leshem eretz yisrael vehashsheniyya leshem hakkerakkin hammukkafin lah ulshem kal eretz yisrael vehashshelishit leshem bavel ulshem maday ulshem hammedinot harchokot ulshem shear kal yisrael

Keshehu torem mitkaven litrom al haggavuy sheyyesh ballishka veal haggavuy sheadayin lo higgia lallishka veal heatid liggavot kede sheyyihu ellu hashshekalim shehotzian lehistappek mehen kappara al kal yisrael uchillu higgiu kal shiklehen lallishka venitrema mehen teruma zo

Kesheyyikkanes hattorem litrom lo yikkanes beveged sheefshar lehachbot bo kesef velo beminal velo besandal velo bitfilla velo bekamea shemma yachshedu oto haam veyomru hechbi mimmeot hallishka tachtav keshetteramah umdabberim hau immo mishshaa sheyyikkanes ad shaa sheyyetze kede shello yitten letoch piv veaf al pi shennizharim kal kach ani o mi shehu nivhal lahon lo yitrom mippene hachashad shenneemar vihyitem nekiyyim me umiyyisrael
Mishneh Torah, Sheqel Dues 3: Chatzaye hashshekalim hakkol tzerichin lahen kede sheyyitten kal echad veechad chatzi shekel shehu chayyav lefichach keshehaya adam holech etzel hashshulchani umtzaref shekel bishne chatzain yitten lo tosefet al hashshekel veotah hattosefet nikret kalbon lefichach shenayim shennatnu shekel al shenehem chayyavin bekalbon

Kal mi sheeno chayyav bishkalim kegon shette nashim o shene avadim shennatnu shekel peturim min hakkalbon vechen im haya echad chayyav veechad patur venatan hachayyav al yad happetur kegon ish shennatan shekel alav veal ishsha o eved patur min hakkalbon vechen hakkohanim peturin min hakkalbon vehashshokel al yad hakkohen patur min hakkalbon

Hannoten shekel alav veal heani o al shecheno o al ben iro im netano lahem mattana patur min hakkalbon shehare natan chatzi shekel mattana kede leharbot bishkalim veim natan lahem hachatzi sheshshakal al yadam derech halvaa ad sheyyachaziru lo keshettimtza yadam chayyav hakkalbon

Haachin sheadayin lo chalku ma shehinniach lahem avihem vechen hashshuttafim shennatnu shekel al yede shenehem peturin min hakkalbon bamme devarim amurim beshuttafin shennasu venatnu bimot hashshuttafut venishtanna en hammaot aval im hevi ze meotav veze meotav veervum vaadayin lo nishtannu hammaot velo hotzium hare ellu chayyavin bekalbon nasu venatnu veachar zeman chalku vechazru venishtattefu chayyavin bekalbon ad sheyyisseu veyittenu beshuttafut zo haacharona veyishtannu hammaot

Haachin vehashshuttafin shehaya lahen behema uchsafim vechalku bakkesafim chayyavim bekalbon af al pi sheadayin lo chalku habbehema veim chalku habbehema velo chalku hakkesafim peturin min hakkalbon ad sheyyachleku hakkesafim veen omrin hare hem omdin lachaluka

Hannoten shekel lehekdesh kede sheyechashshevu lo machatzit hashshekel shehu chayyav bah veyittol chatzi shekel mimma shennigba min haacherim chayyav shene kalbonot sheillu haya hashshekel kullo lishkalim haya chayyav kalbon echad

Kamma hu shiur hakkalbon bizman shehau notnin bemachatzit hashshekel shene dinarin haya hakkalbon chatzi maa shehu echad mishshenem asar bedinar umeolam lo nittan hakkalbon pachot mizze vehakkalbonot enan kishkalim ella mannichin otan hashshulchanim bifne atzman ad sheyyistappek mehen hahekdesh

Mi sheavad shiklo chayyav beachrauto ad sheyyimserennu laggizbar bene hair sheshshalchu et shiklehen beyad shaliach venignevu o avdu im shomer chinnam hu hare ze nishba lahem veniftar kedin kal shomre chinnam vehen chozrin venotnin shiklehen paam sheniyya veim amru anshe hair hoil veanu meshallemin shekalenu en retzonenu sheyyishshava hashshaliach shehu neeman lanu en shomin lahen lefi shettakkanat chachamim hi sheen hekdesh yotze belo shevua nimtzeu hashshekalim harishonim achar shennishba hashshaliach ellu veellu shekalim hem veen olin lahen leshana acheret veharishonim yippelu leshikle hashshana vehaacharonim yippelu leshikle shana sheavra

Shalchu et shiklehem beyad shomer sachar shehare hu chayyav bigneva vaaveda veavdu mimmennu beones kegon shellekachum listim mezuyyanim shehu patur roin im achar shennitrema hatteruma neenas nishba hashshaliach laggizbarim uvne hair peturin shehattorem torem al haggavuy veal heatid liggavot uvirshut hekdesh hen uvne hair me haya lahen laasot hare lo masru ella leshomer sachar shehu chayyav bigneva vaaveda aval haones eno matzuy veim avdu kodem shennitrema hatteruma adayin birshut bene hair hem vehashshaliach nishba lifne anshe hair vehen meshallemin nishba vegavu shekalim shenit veachar kach hechezirum hallistim ellu veellu shekalim veen olin lahen leshana acheret vehashsheniyyim yippelu leshikle shana sheavra yesh mi sheomer shehashshekalim harishonim sheyyippelu leshikle hashshana hem hashshekalim shenniggebbu battechilla veavdu o neensu vechazru veyesh mi sheomer shehashshekalim harishonim hen shehiggiu leyad haggizbar techilla

Hannoten chatzi shekel lachavero leholicho leshulchani lishkol oto al yado halach ushkalo al yede atzmo kede shello yemashkenu oto im nitrema hatteruma meal hashshokel shezze hashshekel birshut hekdesh hu shekkevar teramo al heatid ligbot venimtza ze hitztzil atzmo bemamon hahekdesh venehena bashshekel hazze veim lo nitrema hatteruma lo maal vehu chayyav litten lachavero chatzi shekel shennatan lo vechen haggozel o haggonev chatzi shekel ushkalo yatza vehu chayyav leshallem labbealim shenayim o lehosif chomesh

Hannoten machatzit hashshekel min hahekdesh venitrema hatteruma mimmennu kesheyyistappeku mimmenna yitchayyev bimila veyatza yede machatzit hashshekel netano mimmeot maaser sheni yochal kenegdo birushalayim middeme sheviit yochal kenegdo bikdushshat sheviit haya shel ir hanniddachat lo asa kelum

Hammafrish shiklo vesavur shehu chayyav bo venimtza sheeno chayyav lo kaddash hammafrish shenayim venimtza sheeno chayyav ella echad im beze achar ze haacharon lo kaddash veim bevat achat haechad shekalim vehashsheni motar shekalim hifrish shiklo vamet yippol lindava

Hallokeach maot beyado veamar ellu leshikli o shehaya melakket maa maa o peruta peruta uchshehitchil lelakket amar hareni melakket maot leshikli afillu likket melo kis noten mehen chatzi shekel shehu chayyav bo vehashshear chullin shemmotar hashshekalim chullin

Maot shennimtzeu ben teva shel shekalim leteva shel nedava karov lashshekalim yippelu lishkalim karov lannedava yippelu lindava mechetza al mechetza yippelu lindava mippene shehannedava kullah ola laishshim vehashshekalim mistappekin mehen leolot velidvarim acherim

Vechen kal hammaot hannimtzaim ben kal teva veteva yippelu lakkarov nimtzeu mechetza lemechetza im ben etzim lallevona nimtzeu yippelu lallevona ben kinnim legozale ola yippelu legozale ola ze hakkelal holchin achar hakkarov bechullan mechetza lemechetza lehachamir vechal hammaot hannimtzaot behar habbayit chullin sheen haggizbar motzi maot mitterumat hallishka ad shehu mechallelan al habbehemot shellokeach lekarbanot
Mishneh Torah, Sheqel Dues 4: Terumat hallishka ma yease bah lokchin mimmenna temidin shel kal yom vehammusafin vechal karbenot hatztzibbur veniskehem vehammelach shemmolchin bo kal hakkarbanot vechen haetzim im lo heviu etzim velo nimtzeu ella bedamim vehakketoret uschar asiyyatah velechem happanim uschar ose lechem happanim vehaomer ushte hallechem ufara adumma vesair hammishtalleach velashon shel zehorit shekkoshrin ben karnav kal ellu bain mitterumat hallishka

Aval par helem davar shel tzibbur usire avodat kochavim battechilla govin lahen veenan bain mitterumat hallishka parochot shel hechal tachat binyan asuot veenan bain mitterumat hallishka ella mikkadshe bedek habbayit aval parochot shel shearim bain mitterumat hallishka hammenora uchle sharet mitzvatan sheyyavou mimmotar hannesachim uvhilchot kele hammikdash vehaovdim bo yitbaer ma hu motar hannesachim veim lo haya lahen motar nesachim yaviu mitterumat hallishka bigde kehunna ben bigde kohen gadol ben shear bigde hakkohanim sheovdin bahen bammikdash hakkol mitterumat hallishka

Kal habbehemot hannimtzaot birushalayim o bechutza lah bekarov mimmenna baot olot kemo sheyyitbaer bifsule hammukdashin niskehen bain mitterumat hallishka vechen oved kochavim sheshshalach olato mimmedina acheret velo shalach immah deme nesachim yaviu niskehem mitterumat hallishka

Ger shemmet vehinniach zevachim im yesh lo nesachim kerevin mishshello veim lav bain mitterumat hallishka kohen gadol shemmet velo minnu acher tachtav makrivin et hachavitin mitterumat hallishka mevakkere mumim shebbirushalayim vetalmide chachamim hamlammedim hilchot shechita lakkohanim vehilchot kemitza venashim hamgaddelot benehen lefara adumma kullan notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka vechamma hu secharan kemo sheyyifseku lahen bet din

Bishnat hashshemitta shehi hefker sochrin bet din shomrin sheyyishmeru miktzat sefichim shetztzamchu kede sheyyaviu mehen haomer ushte hallechem sheen baim ella min hechadash veellu hashshomrin notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka

Mi shehitnaddev lishmor bechinnam en shomin lo mishshum baale zeroa shemma yavou veyittelum mehen lefichach tikkenu lahem chachamim sheyyittelu sachar min hallishka kede sheyyifreshu hakkol meoto makom sheellu shomrim sham

Maggihe sefarim shebbirushalayim vedayyanin sheddanin et haggazlanin birushalayim notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka vechamma hau notlim tishim mane bechal shana veim lo hispiku lahen af al pi shello ratzu mosifin lahen kede tzarkan hem unshehem uvnehem uvne betan

Kevesh hau bonin mehar habbayit lehar hammishcha shealav motziin para adumma vechevesh shemmotziin alav sair hammishtalleach ushnehem naasin mishsheyare hallishka vechen mizbach haola vehahechal vehaazarot naasin mishsheyare hallishka ammat hammayim shebbirushalayim vechomat yerushalayim vechal migdeloteha vechal tzarche hair bain mishsheyare hallishka veoved kochavim shehitnaddev maot laddevarim haellu o laasot immahem bechinnam en mekabbelin mimmennu vaafillu ger toshav shenneemar lo lachem valanu livnot vego veneemar velachem en chelek vego

Motar terumat hallishka ushyare hallishka lokchin bo zecharim vikarvu kullan olot shettenay bet din hu al kal hammotarot sheyyikrevu olat behema aval lo olat haof sheen bekarbenot hatztzibbur of veellu haolot habbain mimmotar hashshekalim hem hannikraim kayitz lammizbeach
Shekalim shello hispiku lahen lechal karbenot hatztzibbur motziin et harauy lahem mikkadshe bedek habbayit aval en bedek habbayit motzi et harauy lo mikkadshe hammizbeach

Mishsheyaggia rosh chodesh nisan en makrivin karbenot tzibbur ella mitteruma chadasha veim lo baa hachadasha lokchin min hayeshana lefichach im higgia rosh chodesh nisan veyesh immahen behemot litmidim mitteruma yeshana podin otan veotzin lechullin af al pi shehen temimin veyippelu demehen litruma yeshana shemmekitzin bah et hammizbeach shettenay bet din hu al kal habbehemot shellokchin litmidin sheim lo yihu tzerichin lahen yetzu lechullin

Vechach hau osin bemotar hakketoret mishsheyaggia rosh chodesh nisan mechallelin oto al sechar haummanin vechozrin maot hassachar leketz hammizbeach venotlin haummanin motar hakketoret bischaran vechozrin velokchin et hakketoret mehen mitteruma chadasha kede lehakrivah mimmeot teruma chadasha veim en lahen teruma chadasha maktirin otah mitteruma yeshana salik lehu hilchot shekalim
Mishneh Torah, Shofar, Sukkah and Lulav: Mitzvat ase shel tora lishmoa teruat hashshofar berosh hashshana shenneemar yom terua yihye lachem veshofar shettokin bo ben berosh hashshana ben beovel hu keren hakkevasim hakkafuf vechal hashshofarot pesulin chutz mikkeren hakkeves veaf al pi shello nitparesh battora terua beshofar berosh hashshana hare hu omer beovel vehaavarta shofar vechu taaviru shofar umippi hashshemua lamdu ma teruat yovel beshofar af teruat rosh hashshana beshofar

Bammikdash hau tokin berosh hashshana beshofar echad ushte chatzotzrot min hatztzedadin hashshofar maarich vehachatzotzrot mekatztzerot shemmitzvat hayyom beshofar velamma tokin immo bachatzotzrot mishshum shenneemar bachatzotzrot vekol shofar hariu lifne hammelech aval bishar mekomot en tokin berosh hashshana ella beshofar bilvad

Shofar shel akkum en tokin bo lechattechilla veim taka yatza veshel ir hanniddachat im taka bo lo yatza shofar haggazul shettaka bo yatza sheen hammitzva ella bishmiat hakkol af al pi shello naga bo velo higbiho hashshomea yatza veen bakkol din gezel vechen shofar shel ola lo yitka bo veim taka yatza sheen bakkol din meila veim tomar vahalo nehena bishmiat hakkol mitzot lo lehanot nittenu lefichach hammuddar hanaya mishshofar muttar litkoa bo tekia shel mitzva

Shofar shel rosh hashshana en mechallelin alav et yom tov vaafillu bedavar shehu mishshum shevut ketzad haya hashshofar berosh hailan o meever hannahar veen lo shofar ella hu eno ole bailan veeno shat al pene hammayim kede lahavio veen tzarich lomar sheen chotchin oto o osin bo melacha mippene shettekiat shofar mitzvat ase veom tov ase velo taase veen ase doche lo taase vaase muttar litten betocho mayim o yayin o chometz beom tov kede letzachtzecho velo yitten letocho me raglayim leolam mippene hakkavod shello yihu mitzot bezuot alav

Shiur hashshofar kede sheyyochazennu beyado veyerae lechan ulchan nisdak learko pasul lerachbo im nishtayyer bo kashshiur kasher uchillu nichrat mimmekom hassedek nikkav im setamo shello bemino pasul setamo bemino im nishtayyer rubbo shalem velo ikkevu hannekavim shennistemu et hattekia hare ze kasher kedacho bezichruto kasher shemmin bemino eno chotzetz dibbek shivre shofarot ad shehishlimo leechad pasul

Hosif alav kal shehu ben bemino ben shello bemino pasul tzippahu zahav mibbifnim o bimkom hannachat pe pasul tzippahu mibbachutz im nishtanna kolo mikkemot shehaya pasul veim lo nishtanna kasher natan shofar betoch shofar im kol penimi shama yatza veim kol chitzon shama lo yatza hirchiv et hakkatzar vekitztzer et harachav pasul
Haya aroch vekitztzero kasher gerdo ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz afillu heemido al gildo kasher haya kolo av o dak o tzarur kasher shekkal hakkolot kesherin beshofar
